name: ExerciseLah: Workout Timer
description:
ExerciseLah is an interval timer for every kind of workout. Build a timer once, give it a name, and start it in one tap whenever you train.

BUILD ANY WORKOUT
Add as many exercises as you need, each with its own length: "Burpees 0:40", "Plank 0:45", "Round 3:00". Set a transition timer for the rest between exercises and rounds, choose how many rounds, and see the total time and a coloured strip of the whole workout before you start.

SAVE AND NAME YOUR TIMERS
Keep your morning HIIT, leg day, boxing rounds and cool-down stretch side by side. Duplicate a timer to make a variation, or start from one of the built-in timers: Tabata, a full-body circuit, a cool-down stretch and bike sprints.

TRAIN TO UPBEAT MUSIC
Pick from 15 upbeat tracks, from house, techno and drum & bass to reggaeton, funk and K-pop. The music softens during rest and turns down whenever the coach speaks. Prefer your own playlist? Turn the music off and ExerciseLah plays alongside your music app.

A VOICE COACH THAT CALLS EVERY ROUND
Choose from six coach voices. The coach tells you what's next, when you're halfway, when it's the last round, and counts you down 3, 2, 1. Beeps and haptics mark every change, so you stay on track even with the sound off.

MADE FOR THE MIDDLE OF A WORKOUT
A big countdown ring you can read from across the room, coloured for work and rest. Pause, skip or go back with large buttons. Music and voice switch on or off with one tap. The timer keeps going with the screen locked or another app in front, and keeps the screen awake while it runs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking and no internet connection needed. Your timers stay on your device.

Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode, with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

name: Firefly Jars: Glow Puzzle
description:
Tap a jar. Watch the fireflies glow. Light up the night.

Firefly Jars is a cozy, glowing puzzle game. Every level hides a picture made of dark little dots. Tap a jar and its fireflies fly out to light every dot of their color, painting the picture one glowing dot at a time.

There's a catch: fireflies light the picture from the bottom up, and your shelf only has 5 slots. Open a jar whose color can't reach the picture yet and it sits on the shelf, waiting. Fill every slot and the shelf jams. Read the picture, plan your order, and keep the fireflies flowing.

EASY TO LEARN
• One-tap controls, playable in seconds
• No timers, no pressure, play at your own pace
• Relaxing music and soft chimes as every dot lights up

SURPRISINGLY CLEVER
• Mystery "?" jars keep you guessing
• HARD and SUPER HARD levels put your planning to the test
• Every level is checked to be solvable, so it's always a fair puzzle

60+ GLOWING PICTURES
• Hearts, owls, rockets, penguins, castles, octopuses, rainbows and more
• Endless play after level 60 with fresh new layouts
• Beautiful hand-painted night meadow

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works offline
• Looks great on every iPhone, including foldables

Grab a jar and set the fireflies free!

name: Plasma Globe: Fidget Lamp
description:
Plasma Globe puts a classic plasma ball under your fingers. Touch the glass and lightning leaps from the coil to meet you, one bolt for every finger.

• Real multitouch: every finger draws its own bolt, up to five on iPhone and more on iPad
• On iPhone, feel it: a low electric hum and sharp snaps as filaments jump to your fingertips
• Tilt to look around: turn the device and the view shifts as if the globe sat behind the glass
• Choose your lightning: ten colours, or tune any wavelength on the spectrum tube
• A room with atmosphere: drifting fog, a swinging lamp, moving shadows
• Sound to match: crackle and hum that follow the lightning, and a night full of crickets, crows and the occasional cat
• Leave it on: the screen stays awake, and an untouched globe settles into a calmer glow that makes a fine desk lamp

One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac. No accounts, no ads, no data collected.

Tip for iPad: four- and five-finger swipes belong to iPadOS. For a whole hand on the glass, switch them off in Settings under Multitasking & Gestures.

Contains flickering and flashing light.

name: EVİN-Emirdağlı Esnaf
description:
EVİN – Emirdağlı Esnaf ve İş İnsanları Rehberi, Emirdağlı esnaf, sanayici ve iş insanlarını tek bir çatı altında buluşturan resmi dijital rehber uygulamasıdır.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Hızlı Arama ve Filtreleme: Meslek, komite, isim veya adres bilgisine göre aradığınız esnaf ve iş insanlarına saniyeler içinde ulaşın.
• Tek Dokunuşla İletişim: Üye kartları üzerinden telefon numaralarını kolayca görüntüleyin ve tek dokunuşla kopyalayın.
• Komite ve Duyuru Takibi: Komite listelerine erişin, güncel duyuru ve etkinliklerden anında haberdar olun.
• Kolay Üyelik Başvurusu: Rehbere katılmak isteyen esnaf ve iş insanları uygulama içinden hızlıca başvuru yapabilir.

name: CoupBless
description:
CoupBless offers a modern way to discover Chinese couplets for your home, celebrations, and fresh beginnings. Explore meaningful designs in clear English, with translations, cultural context, and practical display guidance.

Find the right couplet for your space and intention:

• Browse designs for Lunar New Year, weddings, new homes, business openings, and everyday blessings.
• Use Couplet Finder to narrow your choices by occasion, door size, and personal wish.
• View large product images, detailed dimensions, materials, meanings, and display tips.
• Save your favorite designs for easy access later.
• Review delivery details and keep your order history organized in one place.

From a doorway refresh to a thoughtful celebration, CoupBless helps you choose words that welcome the moment.

name: Midnight Check-In
description:
One button you can press only between midnight and 5 a.m.
When you press it, the night sky slowly brightens, and you see how many people checked in today and where you placed in the world.

What you can do
- A button you can press only from 0:00 to 5:00 in your local time
- See how many people checked in today and your place in the world
- See counts by blood type and zodiac sign (from "Details"; choosing is optional)
- A calendar that records your place every night
- 20 gentle effects after you check in, random or fixed
- Switch ranking between actual world time and local time
- Share tonight's place as an image
- Optional reminder at midnight
- Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese

Gentle by design
- No flashing or flickering effects
- No sign-up: no name or email needed
- Groups with fewer than 5 people are shown as "Under 5" so no one can be identified

Ads
A banner appears at the bottom of the screen, and a video ad plays before "Details."
The one-time "Remove ads" purchase hides both.

Privacy Policy: https://moffice.brobro.net/midnightcheckin/en/

name: Rocky Mountain Christian
description:
Rocky Mountain Christian brings articles, audio, and newspaper archives together in one place for reading and study.

READ AND DISCOVER
Browse published articles, explore subjects, and search the collection. Read in a clean native reader with adjustable text size and quick access to Scripture references.

SAVE YOUR STUDY
Save articles, attach personal notes to passages, and return to your reading position. Sign in to sync saved articles, notes, and reading progress across your devices. Open a saved article on your device to keep its text available for offline reading.

LISTEN ON THE GO
Listen to recordings connected to published articles. Adjust playback speed, resume where you left off, and use background playback, AirPlay, and lock-screen controls. Audio streaming requires an internet connection.

EXPLORE THE ARCHIVES
Browse newspaper issues by year, download PDFs for offline reading, and return to your saved page.

Browse without an account. Sign in when you want to sync your personal library. PDF downloads stay on each device.

Encouraging Christians through the written word.

name: Beam Buddies: Space Rescue
description:
A little alien is drifting through a universe full of danger. Its only hope is you!

Welcome to Beam Buddies: Space Rescue, a charming arcade adventure where one tiny traveller depends on your quick reactions, careful movements, and powerful UFO tractor beam.

Your mission is simple: clear the path and help the baby alien reach its home planet. But with dangerous junk floating through space and no way to stop the little traveller, every second matters.

YOU ARE THE RESCUE UFO

Take control of a nimble UFO using four simple directional buttons: Left, Right, Up, and Down.

Move towards floating space junk to activate your tractor beam. Get close enough, and the beam pulls the obstacle in and absorbs it, creating a safer route for your tiny companion.

No complicated controls. Just movement, timing, and smart decisions.

THE LITTLE ALIEN NEVER STOPS

Your adorable space buddy keeps drifting towards home, completely unaware of the hazards ahead.

You cannot pause its journey or control its movement. Your job is to stay ahead, remove dangerous obstacles, and keep the route clear.

One collision with space junk ends the rescue attempt.

A NEW JOURNEY EVERY TIME

Explore multiple increasingly challenging levels with randomised paths that make every rescue feel different.

As you progress, more space junk fills the route and the baby alien moves faster, demanding quicker reactions and better positioning.

Every successful rescue brings new challenges, unexpected obstacles, and exciting moments.

GAME FEATURES

• Charming baby alien rescue adventure

• Simple four-direction UFO controls

• Satisfying tractor beam absorption effects

• Continuous alien movement that keeps every rescue exciting

• Multiple levels with increasing difficulty

• Randomised paths for fresh challenges

• More obstacles and faster drifting as you progress

• Portrait gameplay designed for comfortable mobile play

• Engaging sound effects and responsive action

• Completely offline gameplay

• No advertisements or interruptions

• Easy to learn, increasingly challenging to master

ONE LITTLE ALIEN. ONE BIG RESPONSIBILITY.

There are no complicated missions to memorise. Just you, your UFO, a vulnerable space traveller, and a universe that refuses to make the journey easy.

Reach the home planet safely and complete the level instantly. Let even one obstacle slip through, and the rescue is over.

Do you have the timing, focus, and courage to protect your tiny companion through every cosmic challenge?

Climb into your UFO. Power up the tractor beam. The rescue begins now!

name: Equipalp
description:
EquiPalp is practice software built by a qualified equine therapist, for equine therapists.

Keep your clients, horses, treatments, appointments and invoices together in one simple system — whether you’re in the yard or back at your desk.

FEATURES

• Client and horse directory with full records  
• Calendar with appointments, reminders and holiday blocking  
• Therapy session notes with anatomical diagrams  
• Treatment plans and exercise library  
• Invoices and payment tracking  
• Client communications with email history  
• Secure client portal for appointment requests and records  

Designed for sole practitioners and growing practices. The current version is fully functioning, with regular updates and new features added based on therapist feedback.

Start your free trial today and see how EquiPalp simplifies your practice.

name: cring
description: Make ringtones that sound like the person calling. Pick from 36 rock, pop, metal and trance loops built from four channels you can switch on and off. Or type a sentence and have it spoken in a male or female voice, with a radio, atmospheric or robotic effect on any part of it. Or mix both. Save and share your ringtones, and follow the built-in guide to attach one to a contact.

name: Pangea: Agents for Teams
description:
Pangea is the workspace where your team runs coding agents together: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more, each signed in with the plan you already pay for. Risky steps wait for a person, and every action is on the record.

The iPhone and iPad app keeps you in the loop away from your desk.

FOLLOW YOUR AGENTS
See every Bot and Task your team runs, what each agent is doing right now, and the conversation behind it. Pick up a session your teammate started and keep steering it.

ANSWER AND APPROVE
When an agent asks a question or needs a human before it edits a file, runs a command or touches production, it lands in your Inbox. Answer with a tap, approve or decline, and the agent keeps going.

WORK KEEPS MOVING
Agents run on your own computer or on a Pangea Cloud computer, so they keep working with your laptop closed. Get a notification when an agent needs you or when one of your computers goes offline or comes back.

ONE SESSION, THE WHOLE TEAM
Teammates join the same session, see the same tool calls and build on each other's ideas. Mention another Bot to bring it in.

MORE ON THE GO
- Send photos, files and screenshots to an agent, or share them from any app
- See your computer's screen and open its pages on the phone
- Open a runtime's terminal on iPad
- Live Activities and widgets for the work in progress
- Pick your app icon

YOUR AGENTS, YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Hermes Agent and Pi each run on the plan or key your team already has. Pangea adds no model charge on top.

A Pangea account is required. Plans are managed on the web at pangea.build; there are no purchases in the app.

name: Mensaria
description:
Mensaria is microlearning for employees with an AI mentor. Your company opens courses for you, and you take them in short lessons whenever it suits you – on the go, between meetings, in the evening.

How it works:
• A course is a path of short lessons, 5–10 minutes each, with stories, quizzes, dialogue scenes and open questions.
• Stuck? Ask the AI right in the lesson – it explains in plain words and fits the answer to your job.
• Mensi, your mentor, suggests where to continue and answers questions about working with AI.
• Streaks, XP and badges show your growth; the leaderboard shows how your colleagues are doing.
• Lessons can be listened to – narration reads them aloud at the speed you choose.
• Finish a course and get a certificate you can share.

Who it is for: employees of companies that learn with Mensaria. Sign in with your work email and the company code from HR. No code? Join the open group and take the public courses.

name: VTag - NFC Business Card
description:
VTag is your business card, made smart. Make your contact card once in the app. Anyone who taps your VTag NFC card with their phone, or scans its QR code, saves you to their contacts in one step. Their phone needs no app.

WHY VTAG
- One tap or one scan saves your name, phone, email, company, address, social links and photo straight into contacts.
- Change your details any time. Every card you have already handed out shows the new details from the next tap. No reprinting.
- Works on iPhone and Android. Phones without NFC can scan the QR code on the back of every card.
- No battery. The NFC chip is powered by the phone that taps it.

IN THE APP
- Make and edit your contact card: name, job title, company, phone numbers, email, website, address, social links, a note and a photo.
- Pick a card design and see the front and back of your card.
- Show your QR code so someone can save you right from your screen.
- Share your VTag link on WhatsApp, email or any app.
- Write your VTag link to your own NFC card or sticker (VTag Personal and Team accounts).
- See how many times your contact was saved. VTag never records who saved it.
- Log in on a computer by scanning a code.

VTAG FOR TEAMS
A company admin manages everyone's cards from vtag.digital/team: company details, logo and brand colour, and handing a card to the next person when someone leaves.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no analytics, no trackers. Your card shows only what you choose to put on it. You can delete your account and everything in it from the app at any time.

Made in India by Anuda Realty Private Limited.

name: Beerdog Beer Finder
description:
Beerdog is a free map and collecting game for American craft beer.

THE MAP
More than 600 craft breweries of the United States on one map, by region: working, new and lost. Search by brewery, town or beer, zoom in to a city, and tap any dot for its card.

THE LIBRARY
A page for every brewery with its history, what it is known for, who owns it and its flagship beers, grouped by region and searchable.

COLLECT
Photograph a can or bottle. Beerdog reads the label in seconds, finds the brewery and lets you confirm which beer it is. A brewery it does not know yet is added on the spot. The find is saved with where you were, if you allow location. The closer you are to the brewery, the more you score: 100 points at the brewery itself, down to 10 for a find with no location.

LEVEL UP
Your level grows with the number of different breweries you have found: Pup, Bar Dog, Tap Dog, Hop Dog, Barrel Dog and finally Show Dog at 200.

FOLLOW AND TALK
The Collection shows the labels other collectors have found, newest first. Follow a collector, and talk about any find.

Beerdog is for adults of legal drinking age. It does not sell alcohol. United States craft breweries only, for now. Please drink responsibly.

name: KLASSÉ DRIVER
description:
KLASSÉ Driver is the official app for KLASSÉ delivery partners. Get new orders, deliver them, and keep track of your earnings from your phone.

GET ORDERS NEARBY
• See new delivery requests as soon as they come in
• Check the order ID, delivery address, distance and payment type before you accept
• Accept or ignore requests with one tap
• Go online or offline whenever you want to work

DELIVER WITH CONFIDENCE
• See sender and receiver details for every order
• Call the sender or customer straight from the app
• Open the delivery address on the map
• Follow your running orders from pickup to drop-off

TRACK YOUR EARNINGS
• See your balance on the home screen
• Check what you earned today, this week and this month
• View your order counts and total completed deliveries
• See your full delivery history and transactions
• Add a withdrawal method and request payouts

STAY CONNECTED
• Get push notifications for new orders and updates
• Chat with customers and the KLASSÉ team
• Switch to dark mode for night deliveries

EASY TO JOIN
New to KLASSÉ? Tap "Join as a Delivery man" and sign up in a few steps with your basic details, phone number and profile photo.

KLASSÉ Driver uses your location, including in the background while you're delivering, so it can show you nearby orders and let customers follow their delivery. You can turn location access off at any time in Settings.

name: JIAN 지안 - AI안경·몰카 탐지
description:
AI 안경, 휴대폰, 몰래카메라… 혹시 누가 나를 찍고 있지는 않을까요?
JIAN(지안)은 카메라와 블루투스로 주변의 촬영 기기를 찾아 알려 주는 앱이에요.

■ AI 카메라 스캔
카메라로 주변을 비추면 AI가 스마트 안경(AI 안경), 휴대폰, 태블릿, 노트북, 카메라를 찾아 빨간 상자로 표시해요. 기기가 보이면 진동과 소리로 바로 알려 드려요.

■ 블루투스 스캔
스마트 안경이 내보내는 블루투스 신호를 찾아 레이더 화면에 보여 줘요. 대략적인 거리도 함께 알려 줘요.

■ 몰래카메라 찾기
손전등을 깜빡여 숨겨진 카메라 렌즈에서 반사되는 빛을 찾아요. 숙소나 탈의실처럼 걱정되는 곳에서 써 보세요.

■ 사진 분석
갖고 있는 사진 속에 스마트 안경이나 촬영 기기가 있는지 확인해요.

■ 내 정보는 내 휴대폰에만
카메라 영상과 사진은 휴대폰 안에서만 분석하고, 어디로도 보내지 않아요. 회원가입, 로그인, 광고가 없어요.

■ 이런 분께 추천해요
· 카페, 지하철, 회의실에서 촬영이 신경 쓰이는 분
· 여행지 숙소의 몰래카메라가 걱정되는 분
· 스마트 안경이 늘어나 사생활이 걱정되는 분

※ 꼭 알아 두세요
JIAN은 촬영할 수 있는 기기가 보이는지를 알려 줄 뿐, 실제로 촬영 중인지는 알 수 없어요. 모든 기기를 100% 찾는다고 보장하지 않으니 결과는 참고용으로 써 주세요.

문의: jiaitoyou@gmail.com

name: Accalmie
description:
Accalmie t'aide à garder ton calme au quotidien, quand la colère, le stress ou la peur de perdre l'autre montent.

UNE PAUSE, QUAND ÇA MONTE
Un seul bouton, aussi grand que l'écran le permet. Il lance un temps calme guidé de 15 minutes : respirer, laisser le corps redescendre, puis faire le point. La pause s'ouvre toujours sans déverrouiller : rien ne te sépare d'elle.

QUELQUES MINUTES D'EXERCICES CHAQUE JOUR
Une liste du jour d'une dizaine de minutes, choisie selon ce sur quoi tu travailles : respiration guidée, relire tes pensées, répéter ta phrase de sortie, revenir sur ce que tu as ressenti, vider ton sac, une chose qui s'est bien passée. Jamais de reproche : une chose après l'autre.

UN JOURNAL, POUR COMPRENDRE CE QUI S'EST PASSÉ
Un cahier guidé pour revenir sur un moment difficile, des fiches pour mieux comprendre tes réactions, et un calendrier pour voir le chemin parcouru.

TOUT RESTE SUR TON IPHONE
• Pas de compte, pas de publicité, aucune donnée collectée.
• Ce que tu écris est chiffré par iOS et protégé par Face ID ou le code de ton iPhone.
• La dictée reconnaît ta voix sur l'iPhone même : rien n'est envoyé.
• Tu peux exporter tes données dans un fichier et les importer sur un autre téléphone.

UN LIEU CALME
Deux palettes douces, une pour le jour, une pour la nuit. Un seul mouvement lent, qui suit la respiration. Rien de rouge, rien de vif.

Accalmie ne remplace pas un suivi psychologique. Si quelqu'un est en danger, appelle le 17 ou le 112 ; en cas de détresse ou d'idées noires, le 3114 (France).

name: Last Fit
description:
Last Fit compares a traced foot with a shoe last.

Drag around the foot, then set the length in millimeters. The outline is read at the toe, the ball, and the heel. Each width is the outline at that band, multiplied by the length.

Three lasts are on the bench: Narrow, Medium, and Wide. A band more than half a millimeter wider than the last is a pinch, and it turns red. The ball of a 260 mm foot at 109 mm pinches a Medium last and clears a Wide one.

The feet stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: RetroHop Duo
description:
RetroHop Duo is a bouncing-ball game with the look and sound of a 90s PC game: chunky pixels, dithered colours and chiptune music.

The ball bounces on its own. Drag anywhere to steer it over tiles floating in the void, and mind where it lands: every tile does something different.

SHAREWARE, LIKE IT USED TO BE
The first 8 levels are free. A single in-app purchase registers the full version: all 29 levels in three worlds, plus every level added later. No ads, no subscription.

THREE WORLDS
• DEEP SPACE — springs that throw you across gaps, ice that takes your steering away, arrows that push you, keys and locks, crumbling tiles and phase switches.
• THE FACTORY — tiles that blink on and off to a beat. Wait for your turn, then go.
• THE FORGE — red-hot tiles you cannot bounce on twice. No standing still to think.

DUO LEVELS
Two boards, two balls, one finger. Both balls obey the same drag, each on its own board. On mirror levels the blue ball goes left when the red one goes right, and a switch on one board opens the way on the other.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
On a foldable iPhone each board of a Duo level gets its own half of the open screen, with the fold between them. On every other iPhone and on iPad it plays the same, in any orientation.

• A side map shows the whole level while the main view follows the ball up close. Hide it if you prefer a wider view.
• Three stars per level: clear it, do it without falling, and collect every gem.
• WORLD RANKING — best total time, free for everyone (Game Center).
• Play with one thumb.

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: Nassau Bros
description:
Shop at Amazon, Shein, Temu, Walmart and any US store, and get it delivered in Nassau.

Nassau Bros gives you a Florida shipping address with your own account number. Send your online orders there, and we bring them over, clear Bahamas Customs, and deliver to your door.

THE APP
• Your Florida address and account number, ready to copy at checkout
• Every package in one place, from Florida to shipped to Nassau to on its way to you
• Alerts on your phone when a package arrives, is ready, and is out for delivery
• Your bill, line by line: the real customs duty and VAT, plus a space charge based on the size of the box
• Upload your store receipt with your camera so customs gets the right value
• Pay cash when your package is delivered

NO PASSWORD
Tap the link in the text we send you and your page opens in the app. That's it.

NEW CUSTOMER?
Tap "Sign up" in the app. It takes thirty seconds, and you get your account number straight away.

Questions? Call or WhatsApp (242) 821-5883, or email support@nassaubros.com.

name: Astrovuge
description:
Astrovuge brings the computational depth of a desktop astrology workspace to mobile, with over 40 tools covering chart calculation, timing, astrocartography, relationship analysis, and research. Its astrological calculations use a shared mathematical engine for planetary positions, house systems, angular relationships, and event searches.

Distinctive capabilities include:

- Rule-based event search: Combine planetary positions, aspects, motion, natal contacts, and declination conditions using AND, OR, and exclusion logic. Results identify matching time intervals and explain why they qualify.
- Declination Studio: Explore time-series graphs, parallel and contra-parallel contacts, and out-of-bounds intervals beyond the conventional zodiac wheel.
- Comparative timing: Examine transits, secondary progressions, and solar arc over the same period, with interactive time controls and chart layers.
- Chart Laboratory: Search saved charts by placements, houses, elements, aspects, and motion. Inspect the degrees and orbs supporting each match, with incomplete data identified separately.
- Detailed chart inspection: Work with fixed-star overlays, aspect matrices, technical tables, and reusable calculation profiles.

Astrocartography, synastry, composite charts, and lessons using the user’s own birth chart extend this technical workspace.

The defining experience is active investigation: users construct a question, find matching configurations, compare techniques, and inspect the underlying geometry—all within a mobile interface.

name: Duo Depths: Two-Screen Battle
description:
Fold your iPhone Duo. Set it on the table. Now there is a wall between you.

Duo Depths is a two-player sea battle, a battleships-style submarine game that uses both displays of iPhone Duo at once. You can see your opponent's face, but never their screen. Read the person across the table and hunt down their hidden fleet.

ONE PHONE, FACE TO FACE
• Fold iPhone Duo to about 90° and stand it on the table
• The outer display is the attacker's board
• The inner display is the defender's command room
• Miss, and you spin the phone around to swap sides

LEARN IT IN 30 SECONDS
• Deploy five subs on a 10×10 sea, or three on 6×6 for a quick match. Drag to move, tap to rotate
• Aim at a square and fire. Hit, and you fire again
• First to sink the whole enemy fleet wins
• Enter player names and see them on the victory screen

A CINEMATIC DEEP SEA
• Heavy hulls, underwater blasts, and rising bubbles
• Every impact lands on the defender's screen at the same moment
• Sonar pings, groaning steel, and haptics

ABOUT THE CAMERA
By design, iPhone Duo lights up its outer display only while the camera runs, so the camera is on during a match. Its feed is never shown: it stays hidden behind the sonar display. Nothing is saved or sent.

NOTHING TO SIGN UP FOR
• No internet, no accounts, no ads
• No data collected
• Leave mid-match and pick it up later

PLEASE NOTE
Duo Depths is made for iPhone Duo (iOS 27.1 or later). The camera runs during a match, because that is how an app lights up the outer display.

name: Okaydo
description:
Too many tasks staring back at you? Okaydo shows you just one, for now.

Okaydo is a gentle to-do list and day planner made for ADHD brains, and for anyone who freezes in front of a long list. No clock, no red overdue counters, no guilt.

ONE TASK AT A TIME
The Now screen shows a single task. Tap Done, or "Not now", and the next one shows up. That's it.

PLAN BY PART OF THE DAY, NOT BY THE MINUTE
Morning, afternoon, evening, or anytime. Move things around when your day changes.

JUST TYPE IT
Type it like you'd text a friend: "pay rent friday after work" becomes "Pay rent · After work · Friday". Okaydo works out the when.

HELP ME FOCUS
Stuck on a task? Tap "Help me focus" for a calm focus timer to get going.

GENTLE NUDGES
One soft reminder at the part of the day you picked, never a pile of alarms.

LISTS FOR EVERYTHING
Groceries, home, errands. Share a list with the people you live with and hand a task to someone.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Your tasks stay on your iPhone. An account is optional, only if you want sync, sharing or the web app.

OKAYDO PRO
Start with a free trial, then $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://onedivlabs.com/okaydo-privacy.html

Okaydo isn't a medical treatment. It's just a kinder to-do list.

name: Magikitos
description:
We are the Magikitos, a gang of brownies looking after good vibes. Here is our stuff in your pocket, free and with no ads.

TRAIN WITH TAPITAS WORKOUTS
A tapita is a workout so short you run out of excuses: a handful of random exercises, each with its number. Say where you are (at home, in the park or with nothing at all), get a tapita and tick them off.
• Every day you show up, your mushroom grows. Skip a day and it wilts.
• It works offline.
• Create your own exercises, modes and gear.
• A daily reminder at the time you choose.

TALK LIKE PEOPLE REALLY TALK
The Slangtionary is a dictionary of real expressions said by real people. Hear how each one sounds, see where it comes from and bring your own with your voice.

LAUGH WITH JOKES TOLD OUT LOUD
Jokes told by people in their own voice. Hit play, vote with mushrooms and, if you feel like it, record yours with the mic.

LISTEN TO THE PODCAST
Episodes by the brownies, narrated and with their little tune, about the small things that brighten an ordinary day.

YOUR ACCOUNT, NO PASSWORDS
Sign in with Google, with Apple or with a code we send to your email. What you do without an account is not lost: it stays with you when you create one. And if you ever want to leave, you delete it yourself in Settings.

Everything the community brings is reviewed by a person from the house. If you see something that does not belong, report it with one tap.

name: Orbit: Quota & Music Remote
description:
Orbit puts your computer's Claude Code and music on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

QUOTA AT A GLANCE
• Remaining 5-hour and 7-day Claude limits with reset countdowns and a burn-rate forecast
• Tap to take a live reading — no waiting for cached numbers
• Today's replies, sessions and tokens, hourly activity and top models

APPROVE FROM YOUR WRIST
• Claude Code permission requests arrive as notifications, even when the app is closed
• Allow or Deny from the Apple Watch or the lock screen
• Readable summaries — questions, plans, edits and commands in plain language

MUSIC REMOTE
• Play, pause, skip, seek and volume for Apple Music on your Mac or Windows PC
• Cover art, Up Next and lyrics

AT HOME OR AWAY
• Works on your home Wi-Fi, and keeps working anywhere through an end-to-end encrypted relay

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics, ads or tracking. Notifications and remote access are end-to-end encrypted — the relay only sees ciphertext
• Sign in with Apple and Face ID protect the app; signing out erases everything on the device

HOW IT WORKS
Orbit talks to a small free companion program, the Orbit bridge, that runs on your own Mac or Windows PC (download and instructions: github.com/zack-lz/Orbit). Not sure yet? Tap "Try demo" on the first screen to explore every screen with sample data.

Orbit is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or Apple. Claude and Claude Code are products of Anthropic; Apple Music, iPhone and Apple Watch are trademarks of Apple Inc.

name: NB Peak
description: This is a local resource planning application designed for individuals and small teams, offering a simple and convenient user experience, intuitive interface layout, orderly content organization, and practical tools. Supports resource classification and capacity management, project and task tracking, resource allocation, record and schedule management, and provides functions such as consumption, trend and scenario analysis.

name: FitEngineer
description:
EngineerFit is a 4-week workout program built for people who sit all day. Every session takes about ten minutes, needs no equipment, and fits between meetings.

• A 3D coach demonstrates every move, so you always know what to do next
• Clear cues, countdowns and gentle haptics guide each interval
• Form guides for squats, lunges, push-ups, planks and more
• Move more: set a daily step goal, then walk, run, hike or ride with a step or time target and watch it fill up live
• Apple Health: see your steps and save finished workouts and activities
• Apple Watch: run today's workout, or a walk, run, hike or ride from your wrist, with heart rate and calories
• Heart rate limit: choose your own limit and get a tap on your wrist if you stay above it
• Apple Music: your playlist starts with your workout and pauses when you do
• Streaks, weekly rings and progress keep you coming back

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

EngineerFit offers general fitness guidance and isn't medical advice or a medical device. Check with a doctor before starting if you have a health condition.

name: Yelkan-AK
description:
Yelkan-AK is the official mobile app of the Yelkan-AK corporate ERP system for the company's employees. It gives fast access to the parts of the system you need from a phone or tablet — on the shop floor, in the warehouse or away from the office.

Signing in requires a username and password issued by the company administrator. Each employee only sees the sections their role allows.

PERSONAL AREA
• My tasks — assigned production tasks with their recipe (input materials); mark as "Done" in one tap
• Completed — work history, good and defective quantities, quality score, approval status
• Attendance — monthly calendar: present, late, absent
• Salary — personal salary report
• Home — daily, weekly and monthly results and hours worked at a glance

WAREHOUSE AND PRODUCTION
• Raw materials warehouse: receipts, issues, item history
• Semi-finished and finished goods warehouses
• Purchase orders and suppliers
• Issuing materials to workers, machine status
• Task templates and assigning tasks to employees

SALES AND CUSTOMERS
• Customer database
• Sales
• Orders: new, in progress and completed

STAFF AND REPORTS
• Employees, departments and roles
• Attendance journal
• Warehouse, product, employee, semi-finished and finished goods reports
• Salary report (for administrators)

CONVENIENCE
• Three languages: Uzbek (Latin), Uzbek (Cyrillic) and Russian
• Layout adapted for phones and tablets
• Data is sent over HTTPS; the sign-in token is stored encrypted on the device
• No ads

Note: this app is intended only for employees of Yelkan-AK. Accounts cannot be created in the app — contact your company administrator to get access.

name: NAG!
description:
One less thought to carry.

Speak or type, choose a time and carry on with your day. REMIND sends a reminder at your chosen time. NAG repeats within a scheduled queue until you choose Done. Three intensities, snooze and quiet hours help you find your rhythm.

Not ready? Move the task to Back pocket and stop its reminders. Keep notes without a deadline, using text or voice. Back pocket is encrypted and can be protected with Face ID or your iPhone passcode.

FREE
• Up to five active REMIND or NAG reminders.
• Sweet personality and three intensities.
• Voice input, Back pocket, optional lock, snooze and quiet hours.
• English and Swedish, with no app account or ads.

NAG PLUS
A one-time purchase for up to 30 active reminders and Sweet, Sassy and Drill Sergeant personalities. No subscription. The price is shown before purchase. Restore earlier purchases with the same Apple Account.

GOOD TO KNOW
Content is stored locally. Voice requires permission and on-device speech recognition support for your chosen language. No audio file is saved. Save ends voice input. You choose dates and times yourself. Buying and restoring purchases require a connection.

Notifications respect iOS, Focus and silent mode. The finite notification queue refills when the app runs or you use Done/Snooze from a notification. The app shows how long the schedule covers; reopen it to refill.

Back pocket keys are tied to your device. Notes cannot be recovered on another phone without the right key.

name: Exam Cheat Detector: Sweepnook
description:
Sweepnook is a check tool for exam invigilators, interviewers and meeting hosts, and a hidden camera check for hotel rooms. It listens for Bluetooth LE signals and looks for lens glints, then tells you honestly what an iPhone can and cannot detect.

No app can prove that a room has nothing hidden. Sweepnook does not pretend to. It shows what was checked and what to look at next.

PICK THE SITUATION
• Exam room, interview, meeting & office, hotel / restroom / changing room, café & on the move
• Each one has its own steps, checklist and wording

EXAM ROOMS, INTERVIEWS AND MEETINGS
• The home screen is an exam-time ring with three steps
• 1. Save a baseline of Bluetooth LE signals in the empty room
• 2. Watch while people are in. Only signals that were not in the baseline are listed, each with the time it appeared and a dot on the ring
• 3. Finish and make a record
• Each new signal gets a kind guessed from public Bluetooth data and names: smart / AI glasses, earbuds and earpieces, AI voice recorders, smartwatches, phones, wireless cameras
• Every guess shows why, and how sure it is: weak sign, could be, or likely
• Hearing aids are shown separately as medical devices, so you can match them with declarations

WALK TO FIND
• Follow one signal as a big number with a stronger / weaker trend
• A tap (haptic) speeds up as the signal gets stronger

CHECKLIST AND RECORD
• Checklist for invigilators and hosts, with tick times
• The record has a timeline chart of when new signals appeared
• Share it as a PDF. Records stay on your iPhone

HIDDEN CAMERA CHECK FOR HOTELS AND RENTALS
• Lens glints: the flashlight blinks, and points that are bright only while it is on are marked. Glass, metal and water drops glint too
• Cameras on the Wi-Fi you joined: a device is marked when it answers a video stream (RTSP) request or announces itself as a camera service
• Magnetic sensor as a side tool
• A checklist of places to look

HOW IT WORKS
• It only listens while Sweepnook is open on screen. The screen stays on while watching an exam
• It never connects to, pairs with, jams or records any device
• It does not identify people

WHAT IT CANNOT FIND
• Devices that are switched off
• Cameras that record only to a card
• Wired devices
• Earbuds that are already connected and stay quiet
• Induction-loop earpieces
• Some Apple devices whose signals iPhone hides from apps

PRIVACY
• No account, no tracking, no analytics
• Records stay on your iPhone

GOOD TO KNOW
• A signal is not proof. No signal is not proof that nothing is there
• Use Sweepnook with a visual check and your own exam rules
• Many devices change their Bluetooth address every few minutes, so a new signal may be an old device

Questions: support@tanzsoft.com

name: ForUs™ Properties Tenants
description:
ForUs™ Properties Tenants is the app for residents and vendors of properties managed by ForUs™ Properties. Sign in with the email address the office has on file; a one-time code is sent to it. No password to remember.

FOR RESIDENTS
• See what you owe on each lease, your open and upcoming charges, and the payments we have received.
• See your payment plan, if you have one.
• Open your lease and its documents.
• Request a repair, add photos, and follow it to completion.
• Message the office.

FOR VENDORS
• See what needs you today.
• Accept or decline a job, book the visit, tell us you are on the way, and mark it done with photos.
• See copies of your invoices.
• Send a price for a bid, update it, or decline.

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
Every screen is in English and Spanish. The app follows your phone's language, and you can switch it in your profile.

SECURE
Your session is the same secure ForUs™ Properties portal session, with the same access rules. The app shows only your own leases, requests, jobs and bids.

name: Kitwise
description:
Kitwise turns your lectures, PDFs and notes into a calm study plan for tonight, with flashcards and quizzes made in seconds.

ADD WHAT YOU HAVE
- Paste notes, import a PDF or snap a photo of a page
- Add a web article or a YouTube lecture by link
- No notes yet? Start from a topic and get a study kit at your level

STUDY A LITTLE EACH NIGHT
- Tonight's plan picks what to review, paced to your exam date
- Cards you miss come back the next evening; ones you know space out
- A small lamp keeps your streak, with no guilt if you skip a night

ASK ABOUT YOUR NOTES
- Solve walks through a problem step by step
- Ask questions about a course or a study set, answered from your own notes

Fern the ferret keeps you company while you study.

KITWISE PRO
Kitwise is free to try, with a few AI uses a day. Kitwise Pro raises that to up to 150 a day for study kits, quizzes and Solve. Choose yearly ($89.99 a year, starting with a 3-day free trial) or monthly ($14.99 a month). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Prices may vary by country.

Privacy Policy: https://api.kitwiseapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: RiderCut Driver
description:
RiderCut Driver is the companion app for drivers at transportation companies that dispatch with RiderCut, built for non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) and other scheduled ride programs.

Sign in with the driver account your dispatcher created for you to see your assigned trips and run your day:

• Today's trips at a glance — rider, pickup and dropoff, scheduled time and live status
• One-tap status updates — en route, arrived, rider onboard, completed — synced to the dispatch board in real time
• Turn-by-turn handoff — open pickup and dropoff addresses in your maps app, or call the rider directly
• Live GPS sharing while you are on duty, so dispatch and riders can follow the vehicle, including when the screen is locked
• Passenger signatures and pickup/dropoff odometer readings captured on the trip
• Will-call return legs and dispatch messages for each trip
• Push notifications when dispatch assigns or changes a trip
• Works through spotty coverage — updates are saved on the device and sent when you reconnect
• Day and night themes

RiderCut Driver requires an account from a RiderCut transportation company. Location is used only to share your position with your dispatcher while you are on duty or on a trip.

name: Sigma Rising
description:
Sigma has great instincts. Dataland is about to find out that instincts are not enough.

The Fogmaster has stolen Princess Lumen, whose light is the only thing that can cut through the Fog, and locked her in the Bias Citadel. To reach her, Sigma has to cross six lands, beat their Fog creatures and bosses, and learn how to read evidence instead of trusting a hunch.

SIGMA RISING IS A GAME THAT TEACHES REAL ANALYTICS
Every level has three parts: a short lesson, a hands-on mini-game, and a quiz fight against the creature of that land. You only move on when you win, and a land's boss only appears once you have cleared every level in it.

SIX LANDS, SIX BIG IDEAS
- Meadow of Means: averages, medians, spread and outliers, and why one loud number can fool you.
- Cavern of Causes: correlation versus causation, funnels, retention and confounders.
- Chance Swamp: probability, luck versus skill, significance, and how p-hacking cheats.
- Crystal Peaks: trends, seasonality, regression, forecasting, ARIMA and overfitting.
- Storyspire: choosing the right chart, writing headlines that make the point, and handling stakeholder requests.
- Bias Citadel: experiment design, A/B tests, variance, multiple testing and difference-in-differences.

22 HANDS-ON MINI-GAMES
Slide the pivot to find the balance point, plug the leaks in a funnel, ride a forecast, tune a threshold, drop cluster centres, build an experiment, squeeze variance and more. Learn by doing, not by reading.

A STORY AND A CAST YOU WILL REMEMBER
Meet Sigma, Princess Lumen, Archmage Modius and the Fogmaster, as real 3D characters, plus a different creature and boss in every land. The Characters screen tells their stories and lets you turn each one around.

MAKE SIGMA YOURS
Earn XP, ranks, trophies and shards, then unlock hair, suits, visors and capes in the wardrobe. Turn Sigma around to see every angle.

BUILT TO FEEL GOOD
- Neon synthwave look, original music and sound effects
- Smooth animation
- Haptics (can be switched off)
- Progress is saved on your device and synced through your own iCloud, so you never lose it
- No account needed, and no data collected

Real 3D characters need iOS 18 or later; on older systems the game uses flat illustrations.

name: NumGame: Kids Number Games
description:
Numbers become a game your child asks to play. NumGame turns counting, number words and first sums into short, cheerful rounds, guided by Numo, a friendly voice that reads every instruction out loud.

FIVE NUMBER GAMES
- Bubble Pop: pop the bubbles in order, 1, 2, 3…
- Number Words: match a number to its name, then read the word and pick the number
- Count & Pick: count the apples, stars and kittens, then tap how many
- Missing Number: find the number that ran away from the row
- Math Bubbles: adding first, then taking away, then a little times tables

A 100-LEVEL ADVENTURE MAP
Every level is five questions. Finish one to unlock the next, earn up to three stars, and climb from Starter Steps to Number Champion. Numbers grow from 1 to 5 up to 100 as the levels get harder. A wrong answer never ends a level: the same question comes back, so no child is ever stuck. Finish all 100 levels to win a certificate with your child's name that you can share.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
- A daily goal of one level, and a streak tracker for days in a row
- Streak badges at 3, 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days
- An optional daily reminder at the time your child usually plays

NUMO SPEAKS 12 LANGUAGES
English, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, German, Japanese and Hebrew. The menus and the numbers can use different languages, so your child can learn number words in a second language. Choose Numo's voice style and regional accent in Settings.

FOR PARENTS
- Progress dashboard behind a grown-ups check: games played, points, stars, best scores and achievements
- Free play for every game, any time, alongside the map
- Works fully offline, with no ads, no accounts and no data collected
- One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac
- Light and dark appearance

Made for children aged 3 to 7 and the grown-ups who play along.

name: GoAlarm Security
description:
GoAlarm puts the alarm system at your home or business in your hand.

• Arm Away or Stay, and disarm, with your own keypad code
• See every zone at a glance, and bypass a zone when you need to
• Get alarm, arming and trouble notifications wherever you are
• Hold the panic button to alert everyone on your site, with your location
• Watch your cameras live, and see a camera picture with each alarm
• Put your zones and cameras on a floor plan of your building
• Switch outputs such as gates and lights
• Home screen and lock screen widgets show every site at a glance
• Works in light and dark mode

GoAlarm works with alarm systems connected through MobyCom or Stratel AlarmBridge. Your installer sets up your site and gives you its Site ID; you open it with your own keypad code, and GoAlarm only lets you do what that code is allowed to do on the panel.

Camera, Floor plan and URfog are part of GoAlarm Plus, which starts with a free trial. The alarm, panic button and zones are always free.

name: Knappe Kiste
description:
Discover the hidden word, one letter at a time. Play with Pip or a character you drew yourself! Each wrong letter sends one part of the character into the box. After every round, all the parts come back.

PLAY ON YOUR OWN
Explore 120 English words and 120 German words across three difficulty levels and six everyday themes. Words, menus and the keyboard automatically follow your iOS app language: English or German. Pick a topic or try a mix. A hint helps when you get stuck.

TAKE TURNS TOGETHER
One player thinks of a secret word and an optional hint. A local spelling check offers suggestions before the device is passed over. Names and made-up words can be kept after confirmation. Hide the answer and hand over the device for the other player to guess. Swap roles after the round. Both players use the same iPhone or iPad.

DRAW YOUR OWN CHARACTER
Draw a head, body, arms and legs in six steps, with a blank page for each part. The app then puts your character together. Draw with your finger, or with Apple Pencil on a compatible iPad. Choose colors and line widths, erase or undo. Save your characters and edit them later. Choose who joins the puzzle directly before each game.

GO AT YOUR OWN PACE
There is no timer. English puzzles use A–Z; German puzzles also have separate keys for Ä, Ö, Ü and ẞ. After the round, hear the answer read aloud in its language. Solved words are remembered on your device. Menus, help and legal information are available in English and German.

No advertising, account or in-app purchases. Word puzzles and the drawing studio work offline. Drawings and progress are stored locally. External website and email links are protected by a parental gate.

A word game for children aged 6–8 with early reading skills.

name: PlumCourt
description:
A walk is one date across the court: each trunk gets one calyx stage, and Court sorts trees by the latest stage.

• Stamp the court: on one date, set every named trunk to scale, swollen, split, open, or drop.
• Sort by stage: the latest calyx rises to the top, so a weeping or twisted tree that opened first stays visible.
• Match a plate: filter cultivars by scent family and petal class, then link the plate to a trunk.

Cultivar plates and spur methods are bundled in the app. Trees, walks, winter marks, salt batches, and the court name stay on this device. There is no account and nothing is fetched over the network.

• Mark a spur: open a winter method and record that you applied it this year, so the same flowering spur is not cut twice.
• File the crock: save salt percent, day count, and a texture word — firm, yielding, or wrinkled — for the trunk that set green fruit.

Reopen the same court next winter and repeat the salt ratio that finished the way you recorded.

name: UIC PRO
description:
Follow the markets and manage everyday expenses, all on your iPhone.

Explore stocks and ETFs
Search by company name or ticker, build a personal watchlist, and explore price history with interactive charts. Switch between five time ranges and drag across a chart to inspect individual prices.

Practice with a paper portfolio
Start with $25,000 in virtual cash and place simulated buy and sell orders using available market quotes. Track your cash balance, holdings, and order history as your portfolio changes.

Read and save market news
Browse financial headlines, see who published each story, and bookmark articles for later. 

Use everyday finance tools
Explore how starting balances, monthly contributions, and assumed returns affect compound growth. Record expenses and attach receipt photos directly from your camera. Your expense journal and receipt photos are stored on your device.

UIC PRO supports Light and Dark modes.

name: نوادر - Nawader
description:
Nawader is an Iraqi marketplace for special finds: watches, cameras, electronics, collectibles and more, sold by Nawader and by trusted local stores.

• Live auctions: follow the price in real time and bid with one tap. Bidding is free, with no deposit.
• Buy now: fixed-price items with real photos and an honest condition note.
• Cash on delivery: pay when your order arrives, or use your wallet credit.
• Reminders and alerts: we remind you before an auction starts and tell you when you are outbid.
• Local stores: browse sellers' stores, follow your favourites and read buyer reviews.
• Favourites and basket: save what you like and order several items together.
• In Arabic, Kurdish and English.

Delivery within Iraq. There are no in-app purchases or subscriptions; everything sold is a physical item.

name: Relitpath
description: చెక్-ఇన్ మిస్ అయిన తర్వాత, ఈ యాప్ చిన్న రికవరీ దశలను సృష్టిస్తుంది, ఇబ్బంది స్థాయిని తగ్గిస్తుంది మరియు కొత్త స్ట్రీక్ ను మళ్లీ ప్రారంభించడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది. వాస్తవ నోట్లు, గణాంకాలు, టెంప్లేట్‌లు — డేటా మీ ఫోన్‌లోనే ఉంటుంది; యాప్ మూసివేసి తిరిగి తెరిచినా కొనసాగుతుంది.

name: Gridweft
description: இங்கிலாந்து, ஸ்காட்லாந்து, வேல்ஸ் தேசிய கட்டத்தொடர் குறிப்புகளை அட்சரேகை-தீர்க்கரேகை, கிழக்கு-வடக்கு அளவுகளுடன் மாற்றுங்கள். ஆறு, எட்டு, பத்து இலக்க துல்லியம், பிடித்த புள்ளிகள், கணக்கீட்டு வரலாறு — அனைத்தும் உங்கள் தொலைபேசியில் இணையமில்லாமல். வழிசெலுத்தல் அல்ல; வரைபடம் பயிற்சிக்கான விரைவு மேசை.

name: Hourvane
description: Hourvane — ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟਾਂ ਲਈ ਘੰਟੇ ਸੰਭਾਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਐਪ। ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਚੁਣੋ, ਟਾਈਮਰ ਚਲਾਓ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੱਥੀਂ ਸਮਾਂ ਲਿਖੋ; ਬਿਲਯੋਗ ਅਤੇ ਗੈਰ-ਬਿਲਯੋਗ ਵੱਖ ਕਰੋ। ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਦਾ ਸਾਰ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਚਾਰਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਸੱਟੇ। ਸਾਰਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਇਸੀ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਬਿਨਾਂ ਖਾਤੇ ਜਾਂ ਕਲਾਉਡ।

name: Spoelmaat
description:
Ontdek de wereld van spoelen en lengtemeting met SpoelMaat. Bereken, registreer en leer in één overzichtelijke app.

Voor techniek:

- Bereken piekstroom en marge bij symmetrische stroomrimpel.
- Schat het aantal windingen, DC-koperverlies, kernverlies en de resonantiefrequentie.
- Voer impedantiepunten in en bekijk ze als grafiek en tekst.
- Bewaar componentgegevens, meetcondities en bronnen op je apparaat.
- Vergelijk twee opgeslagen notities en deel of print je gegevens als PDF.

Voor het lengtelab:

- Oefen met begin- en eindpunten en reken lengtes om.
- Bekijk een ruimtelijke meetopstelling vanuit verschillende hoeken.
- Leer met begrippenkaarten, oefenvragen en een videoles met ondertiteling.
- Onderzoek herhaalde metingen en bewaar je conclusie.

SpoelMaat werkt offline. Berekeningen zijn afhankelijk van de ingevoerde waarden en de genoemde aannames. Controleer ontwerpen met geschikte meetapparatuur en actuele gegevens van de fabrikant.

name: SlicePeek: DICOM MRI CT Viewer
description:
SlicePeek opens the CT, MRI or X-ray scan the hospital gave you, right on your phone. No computer, no account, no upload: your images never leave your device.

OPENS THE FILES YOU ACTUALLY GET
• The folder copied from the hospital CD, with or without DICOMDIR
• The ZIP downloaded from your clinic's patient portal
• A USB-C stick, iCloud Drive, Google Drive or any folder
• DICOM files with no extension, recognised by their content
Windows programs on the CD are skipped automatically.

SEE YOUR SCAN CLEARLY
• Scroll through hundreds of images (slices) with one finger
• Adjust brightness and contrast, or use the bone, lung, brain, soft-tissue and abdomen presets (Pro)
• Zoom, pan, rotate, flip and invert
• Cine playback of a series
• Orientation letters, image number, slice thickness and date
• Patient name hidden by default

ORGANISED AND PRIVATE
• Scans grouped by person, study and series
• Delete a scan with one tap
• Works offline, in airplane mode too
• No data collected: no analytics, no tracking

FREE AND PRO
Free: import, 1 scan in the library, preview of every series, first series in full.
Pro: every series, presets and brightness/contrast, unlimited library. Monthly, yearly (7-day free trial) or "forever" with a single payment. No weekly plans.

ONLY HAVE THE CD?
Phones can't read CDs. The app and our website explain step by step how to copy it to a USB stick or your cloud: neurafit.it/slicepeek/en/hospital-cd

IMPORTANT
SlicePeek is not a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis or clinical decisions. It is for viewing the images of your scans. For their interpretation, talk to your doctor.

Made in Italy by NEURAFIT, the team behind ShapePeek and PointPeek.
Privacy: https://www.neurafit.it/slicepeek/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.neurafit.it/slicepeek/en/privacy/#terms
Sample images in the screenshots: Sudirman S. et al., Lumbar Spine MRI Dataset, Mendeley Data (CC BY 4.0).

name: 慢慢減 BreatheStep
description:
慢慢減 BreatheStep 是一個協助你記錄吸煙習慣、按自己的步伐減量的 iPhone 工具。

• 快速記錄每一支，或補記時間、觸發因素和備註。
• 查看每日支數、距離上一支的時間，以及一段時間內的紀錄變化。
• 在想吸煙時記下渴求，按需要設定每日上限。
• 使用主畫面 Widget 快速記錄，或開啟私隱模式隱藏數字。
• 資料儲存在裝置上；你可以用「檔案」App 選擇位置備份或還原。

毋須帳戶，沒有廣告。內購僅供自願支持開發者，所有功能均可免費使用。此 App 供個人記錄和回顧，不提供醫療建議。

name: Kanso: See What You Carry
description:
Kanso organizes the things you carry, using your own photos.

Photograph an item and it is cut out automatically and placed on a canvas. Drag a backpack, box or tray to the shelf at the top and it becomes storage. Drag other items onto it to put them away, then tap the bag to see everything inside.

· Add by photo: the subject is cut out on your device, with no typing
· Arrange freely: drag and zoom on the canvas, like laying things out on a table
· Real objects as containers: the bag you photographed is the bag, not an abstract folder
· Kits: save a bag together with its contents and bring the whole set back with one pull from the side ring
· Wanted items: add things you don't own yet
· Share: turn "what's in my bag" into a picture
· Everything stays on your device: no account, no ads, no network

Up to 100 items. Fewer things, clearly seen.

name: Docuvelle
description:
Docuvelle is a private, editorial library for the papers that matter: passport copies, leases, insurance cards, warranties, tax summaries, contracts and tickets.

EVERY FILE GETS A JACKET
Import PDFs, images or any document from Files, scan paper with the document camera (multi-page scans are bound into a single PDF), or add a photo. Docuvelle wraps each document in a generated book jacket with its category colour, a preview of the first page, page count and size.

A SHELF OF SPINES
Folders are cloth-bound spines on a shelf. Pull one out to filter the cover wall. All, Recent and Favorites spines are always at hand. Create, rename, recolour and remove shelves in a tap.

FIND ANYTHING
Search titles, tags, notes, categories and folder names, then narrow with filters for type, category, folder, tag and date added. Sort by recently modified, name or size.

SMART TAGS
Docuvelle suggests tags and a category from the title and file type — "Tax summary 2025" becomes #tax #2025 #pdf in Finance. Edit them freely.

REMEMBER WHAT EXPIRES
Set a reminder on any document — renew the passport, check the warranty, discuss the lease — once or repeating, and receive a local notification on your iPhone.

A REAL WORKSPACE
Open a document full screen with a proper PDF reader, zoomable images or Quick Look, then slide up the details pane for metadata (size, pages, type, added, modified, last opened), tags, notes and reminders. Share or export the original file whenever you need it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed — the app opens straight to your library.
• Your files stay on this device. They are never uploaded.
• Works completely offline.
• Optional private cloud backup of the catalogue (titles, tags, notes, dates and a tiny cover) under an anonymous identifier — no sign-in, no account, nothing to register.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Export your catalogue as JSON or CSV at any time; delete the cloud backup with one tap.

CRAFTED
Bodoni and Georgia typography, cream paper and gilt rules in light mode, walnut and gold in dark mode, haptics and gentle animations that respect Reduce Motion.

Try the built-in sample library (clearly marked SAMPLE documents) to explore before adding your own papers.

name: Odontonet Gaia
description:
Gaia es la app de tu clínica dental. Pide y confirma tus citas, sigue tu tratamiento y habla con recepción desde el iPhone, el iPad o el Apple Watch.

Antes se llamaba Portal del Paciente: es la misma app, con nombre e icono nuevos.

Qué puedes hacer

• Ver tu próxima cita, confirmarla, cambiarla o anularla.
• Pedir cita: eliges el motivo, el día y la hora, si tu clínica lo permite.
• Recibir un recordatorio de cada cita en tu dispositivo, si quieres.
• Ver cómo llegar a la clínica en Mapas.
• Consultar tus tratamientos y cómo van.
• Ver tus fotos clínicas por sesión y descargarlas.
• Consultar los datos de tus implantes y descargar tu carnet en PDF.
• Ver y descargar tus documentos.
• Consultar tu saldo, tus facturas y sus PDF.
• Escribir a tu clínica por el chat.
• Ver tus puntos y recompensas, si tu clínica tiene programa de puntos.
• Revisar tus datos, exportarlos y gestionar tu privacidad.
• Recibir avisos de citas y mensajes.

En el Apple Watch

Mira tu próxima cita y confírmala, lee y responde mensajes de tu clínica con texto, frases rápidas o dictado, y consulta tus puntos. Pedir cita y pagar se hacen en el iPhone.

Siempre a mano

Widgets de la próxima cita en la pantalla de inicio y en la de bloqueo, y Actividad en directo el día de tu cita. Con Siri y Atajos puedes preguntar por tu próxima cita, pedir cita o escribir a tu clínica.

Tu privacidad

Protege la app con Face ID. Los recordatorios de cita no dicen el motivo en la pantalla bloqueada.

Disponible en español, inglés, catalán, euskera y español de Latinoamérica. La app toma los colores de tu clínica.

Necesitas que tu clínica te dé acceso al portal. Si no puedes entrar, contacta con ella.

Requiere iOS 18 o posterior. El Apple Watch requiere watchOS 11.

name: 1Chapter Authors
description:
Every great story starts with a chapter.

1Chapter Authors is a writing and publishing app built for storytellers. Whether you're an aspiring writer working on your first story or an experienced author creating your next series, 1Chapter gives you the tools to write, organize, and publish your stories directly from your phone.

Write short stories, serialized fiction, and multi-chapter novels at your own pace. Turn your ideas into stories, establish your author identity, and share your creativity with the world.

With our built-in writing editor, you can create and format chapters, organize your work, and save drafts until you're ready to publish. You have complete control over when your stories and chapters are released.

Create your author profile and publish under your chosen pen name. Build your identity as a storyteller, manage your published works, and grow your following as readers discover your stories.

Explore your creativity across different genres, including romance, fantasy, science fiction, mystery, thriller, horror, adventure, and more. Whether you're writing a quick story or building an entire fictional universe, there's a place for your imagination on 1Chapter.

We believe great stories deserve to be discovered and their creators deserve opportunities to be rewarded. That's why we're developing the 1Chapter Partner Program, an upcoming revenue-sharing initiative designed to help eligible authors earn from their creativity.

1Chapter is more than a place to publish. Our vision is to build a global storytelling community where authors can share their work, connect with readers, and grow their audience.

You don't need a publishing deal or professional writing experience to get started. All you need is an idea, a story to tell, and the courage to write your first chapter.

Download 1Chapter Authors and begin your storytelling journey today.

1Chapter Authors. Every story starts with one chapter.

name: AdvWell
description:
O AdvWell é o sistema de gestão de escritórios de advocacia. Este aplicativo é para as equipes de escritórios que já usam o AdvWell: entre com o e-mail e a senha da sua conta e leve o escritório no bolso.

O que você faz pelo aplicativo:

• Painel do dia: seus prazos, audiências, perícias, tarefas e publicações em um só lugar.
• Processos: consulte seus processos judiciais e extrajudiciais, partes, andamentos e prazos.
• Agenda: compromissos, tarefas e audiências, com calendário e feriados.
• Clientes: fichas completas, com contato e processos de cada cliente.
• Financeiro: fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e centros de custo do escritório.
• Documentos: modelos, documentos jurídicos e arquivos dos processos.
• Leads: acompanhe os contatos que chegam ao escritório.
• Relatórios: visão geral do escritório.

COMO ACESSAR
O aplicativo é para quem já tem uma conta do AdvWell, criada pelo escritório. Não há cadastro nem compras dentro do aplicativo.

Seus dados são os mesmos do sistema que você usa no computador: o que você faz no aplicativo aparece lá, e vice-versa. Cada escritório vê somente os próprios dados.

Suporte: advwell.pro.

name: Afterglow: Fog Map & Postcards
description:
Turn every walk, commute, road trip, and flight into a living personal atlas.

Afterglow is a private fog-of-war world map and travel memory journal that reveals the map wherever your footsteps go and captures meaningful stops as warm, stamped vintage postcards.

CLEAR THE WORLD FOG AS YOU EXPLORE
• Real-Time Fog Clearing: Watch the dark mist lift effortlessly along the streets, trails, and neighborhoods you visit in real life.
• Multi-Mode Glowing Footsteps: Draws smooth golden trails tailored to walking, driving, and flights.
• Detailed Global Vector Maps: Explore crisp streets, parks, transit stations, and landmarks worldwide.
• Dual Aesthetic Themes: Switch seamlessly between Midnight Glow (deep slate night with amber trails) and Analog Paper (warm archival parchment).

AUTOMATIC STAY POSTCARDS & FILM MEMORIES
• Smart Stay Detection: Pause at a cozy cafe, scenic overlook, or hidden alley to automatically mint a stamped postcard with arrival time, coordinates, and place name.
• Private Photo Matching: Attach photos from your library with subtle analog film grain without ever uploading your gallery to external cloud servers.
• Time-Machine Scrubber: Replay an afternoon stroll or months of adventures step by step along the interactive timeline crown.

100% ON-DEVICE PRIVACY (ZERO-SERVER ARCHITECTURE)
• No Account or Sign-Up Required: Open the app and start recording immediately.
• Strictly Local Storage: Your GPS footsteps, cleared fog tiles, and photo postcards live exclusively inside your iPhone local database. Nothing is uploaded, tracked, or shared.
• Personal Archive Backup: Export and restore encrypted .afterglow backup files directly to your own Files or iCloud Drive whenever you switch devices.

ONE-TIME LIFETIME PASS (NO SUBSCRIPTIONS)
Enjoy real-time fog exploration, map themes, and stay postcards right away. Unlock unlimited postcard slots, full historical timeline playback, and archive backup export forever with a single one-time Lifetime Pass—no recurring monthly fees.

name: AI Humanizer: Ownvoice
description:
Ownvoice turns stiff, AI-sounding text into writing that sounds like you.

Paste an essay, email or post, or scan a printed page. Ownvoice rewrites it in your own voice: your writing level, your usual reader and your natural rhythm. Add a sample of something you wrote yourself and every rewrite follows your word choice more closely.

REWRITE IN YOUR VOICE
• Humanize AI text so it reads naturally
• Reword and paraphrase without losing the meaning
• Match your level, from school essay to professional email
• US or UK spelling

CHECK BEFORE YOU SEND
• AI detector: see which sentences sound robotic and why
• See what changed, with your score before and after
• Keep a history of your texts on your phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your voice sample stays on your phone and is sent only with a rewrite
• Turn AI processing off at any time and nothing leaves your phone
• Delete your history whenever you like

No AI detector is perfect and no rewrite can guarantee a result with every checker. Ownvoice helps your writing sound like a person wrote it; use it honestly and follow your school's or workplace's rules.

Subscription: Ownvoice Pro is billed weekly, monthly or yearly through your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://ownvoice-app.web.app/privacy

name: Al-Baraka Legal Academy
description:
يتيح تطبيق Al-Baraka Legal Academy للطلاب متابعة كورسات لجميع المراحل الدراسية بالجامعة.

كل جزء يحتوي على شرح المحاضرة، ملخص مبسط، وحل الأسئلة المهمة.

كما يضم التطبيق اختبارات دورية تساعد الطلاب على محاكاة نظام الامتحانات الفعلي.

التطبيق يحتوي على مميزات عديدة منها اختبارات اختياري (MCQ) بالنظام الحديث، بالإضافة إلى أسئلة مقالية للتدريب العملي.

يضم مكتبة PDF للمحاضرات، المراجع، والواجبات.

إمكانية التواصل السريع مع الدعم أو الدكتور لحل أي استفسار.

واجهة سهلة وبسيطة تساعد الطلاب على استخدام التطبيق بسلاسة.

name: Albumatic: Trip Photo Albums
description:
Your photo library is one long scroll. Albumatic turns it into albums by itself: one album for each month at home, and one for each trip abroad.

Made for photos you never sorted
Albumatic is for people who keep taking photos and never get round to organizing them. It looks at the photos you take with a camera: photos with a location, or with camera details. Screenshots, and images saved from chats or other apps, are left out, so a busy WhatsApp group doesn't flood your trips.

Your photos are never changed, moved or deleted
Albumatic only reads your photos. It has no way to change, move or delete them, and albums exist only inside the app: removing an album, or the app, leaves every photo where it is.

Trips, found for you
Choose your home country once. Photos taken anywhere else become trips named by country and dates, like "UK Sep–Oct 2026" or "Japan Dec 2026–Jan 2027".
• A trip ends when you're home again, or after a week without photos abroad (you can change the gap)
• Airport stopovers join the trip next to them
• Photos without a location take the country of the photos taken around the same time
• Countries are worked out on your iPhone, with Hong Kong and Macao kept separate

Months at home
Everything you shoot at home goes into one album per month, so last March is one tap away.

Make it yours
• Rename a trip, merge two trips, or start a new trip at any photo
• Move photos between trips, or back to the month at home
• Make your own albums and add photos from any trip, month or album
• Undo your changes to a trip with one tap

Look and share
Swipe through an album, pinch to zoom, see when and where a photo was taken, and share it.

Keeps up by itself
New photos appear in the right album the next time you open the app. Only new photos are read, so it stays quick even with tens of thousands of photos.

Private
No account, no ads, no tracking, no server. Albums are made on your iPhone. If a photo is kept in iCloud, your iPhone fetches it from your own iCloud only when you open or share it.

name: All Sai Temple
description:
Welcome to All Sai Temple, your ultimate spiritual gateway dedicated to bringing devotees closer to Shirdi Sai Baba. Whether you are seeking peace at a nearby temple, staying updated with sacred rituals, or managing a temple trust as an administrator, this app provides a seamless bridge between devotees and divine spaces.

Key Features for Devotees
Find Temples Near You: Instantly discover Sai Baba temples in your vicinity using GPS location. Get directions, temple timings, and contact details with a single tap.

Daily Aartis & Poojas: Never miss a prayer. View accurate schedules for Kakad Aarti, Madhyan Aarti, Dhoop Aarti, and Shej Aarti.

Latest News & Events: Stay informed about daily announcements, upcoming holy gatherings, Palkhi processions, and festival celebrations at your favorite local mandirs.

Instant Notifications: Receive timely updates and alerts about special poojas and events happening at temples you follow.

Key Features for Temple Trusts & Administrators
Dedicated Trust Portal: Secure registration and login panel designed specifically for temple trusts, committees, and management teams.

Multi-Temple Management: Add, configure, and oversee multiple mandirs under a single trust account with customized profiles and details.

Event & Schedule Creation: Effortlessly schedule, publish, and update upcoming poojas, festivals, and special events for specific mandirs.

Direct Community Engagement: Broadcast real-time news, announcements, and notices directly to local devotees following your temples.

name: AlloyRoute Lot Keeper
description:
A metal-powder lot can change hands without losing its history.
AlloyRoute Lot Keeper gives additive manufacturing teams a clear, offline inventory record.

LOT IDENTITY | MATERIAL CONTEXT
Create a powder lot with its material details.
Keep supplier information attached to the lot.
Find the reference behind each recorded stock movement.

PHYSICAL STOCK | EVERY MOVEMENT COUNTS
Record powder receipts as material arrives.
Document issues, returns and transfers.
Capture stock adjustments with their supporting context.
Follow quantities through the saved movement ledger.

BUILD PLANS | NOT PHYSICAL MOVEMENTS
Track build commitments separately from stock transactions.
Keep planned use distinct from actual powder movement.
Review both without confusing a commitment with a withdrawal.

STOCKTAKE | FIND THE DIFFERENCE
Enter manually counted powder quantities.
Compare a physical count with the saved ledger balance.
Examine discrepancies and add reconciliation notes.
Document corrections and late-recorded transactions.
Preserve previous entries for historical review.

SELECTIVE SHARING | PRIVACY IN YOUR HANDS
Return to earlier adjustments and their explanations.
Choose the records you want to export.
Use available options to remove sensitive text before sharing.
Work with your powder inventory records without an internet connection.
AlloyRoute Lot Keeper keeps the evidence of material movement within reach.

name: AllTym - Task & Attendance
description:
AllTym is an all-in-one workforce management solution designed to empower organizations and employees with transparent task tracking and attendance management.

KEY FEATURES FOR ADMINISTRATORS:
• Task Management: Create, delegate, and monitor work assignments in real time with deadlines and priority levels.
• Verified Attendance: Ensure accurate clock-in and clock-out records backed by GPS location checks.
• Identity Verification: Photo verification during clock-in ensures complete transparency.
• Team Overview: Monitor active projects, department workflows, and attendance status from a clean mobile dashboard.

KEY FEATURES FOR EMPLOYEES:
• Work Overview: View your daily tasks, upcoming deadlines, and project updates in one place.
• Quick Clock-In / Clock-Out: Mark your attendance quickly with location and camera verification.
• Attendance History: Track your past check-ins, working hours, and completed assignments.
• Simple & Secure: Designed for fast, distraction-free productivity on the go.

AllTym eliminates paperwork, prevents proxy attendance, and keeps teams aligned and productive wherever they work.

name: Ấn Phẩm Số
description:
Ấn Phẩm Số là ứng dụng đọc dành cho người dùng nền tảng anphamso.com — nơi các tác giả Việt đăng tài liệu số do chính mình viết: cẩm nang nghề, tài liệu nuôi dạy trẻ và mầm non, nông nghiệp, kinh doanh, tài chính, sức khoẻ, văn hoá và lịch sử.

TỦ CỦA TÔI
Màn đầu tiên là tủ tài liệu của bạn: mọi tài liệu bạn có quyền đọc nằm một chỗ, kèm bìa, tác giả, số trang và thanh tiến độ. Mất mạng vẫn xem được tủ đã lưu lần trước.

ĐANG ĐỌC — ĐỌC TIẾP ĐÚNG TRANG
Ứng dụng nhớ trang bạn đọc tới trong từng tài liệu. Một chạm "Đọc tiếp" là mở lại đúng chỗ, trên điện thoại hay máy tính đều vậy.

TRÌNH ĐỌC GỌN, ĐỌC CẢ KHI KHÔNG CÓ MẠNG
Lật trang toàn màn hình, xem số trang đang đọc. Tài liệu trong tủ có nút "Tải offline" để lưu về máy, lên máy bay hay chỗ sóng yếu vẫn đọc được.

THÔNG BÁO
Khi có tài liệu mới được mở trong tủ, ứng dụng báo ngay; chạm vào thông báo là mở đúng tài liệu. Mọi thông báo cũng nằm trong ngăn Thông báo.

KHO TÀI LIỆU VÀ ĐỌC THỬ
Duyệt kho theo chủ đề, xem trang tác giả và đọc thử phần đầu của mỗi tài liệu trước khi quyết định.

ĐÁNH GIÁ VÀ CỘNG ĐỒNG TÁC GIẢ
Đọc đánh giá của người đã đọc, trao đổi trong cộng đồng của từng tác giả. Mỗi đánh giá, bài viết, bình luận đều có nút Báo cáo và Chặn người này.

CHIA SẺ
Gửi đường dẫn tài liệu cho bạn bè bằng bảng chia sẻ của iPhone; bấm vào đường dẫn anphamso.com là mở thẳng trong ứng dụng.

TÀI KHOẢN
Dùng chung tài khoản với anphamso.com và publishshelf.com. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng (Tài khoản → Xoá tài khoản).

Hỗ trợ: info@wt4.com

name: App Giải Trí
description:
AppGiaiTri gom hơn 200 ứng dụng giải trí nhỏ gọn của AppGiaiTri.com vào một nơi. Mở ứng dụng là thấy ngay danh mục: tìm theo tên, lọc theo nhóm, bấm vào là dùng, không phải cài thêm gì.

MỘT DANH MỤC, NHIỀU NHÓM
Trí tuệ, mô phỏng, nhập vai, thư giãn, sáng tạo, hành động, chăm nuôi, gia đình, đối kháng, chữ nghĩa, thể thao, âm nhạc, tốc độ, nông trại. Mỗi ứng dụng có mô tả ngắn, nhóm, độ tuổi phù hợp và thời lượng một lượt dùng.

DÙNG TIẾP NGAY CHỖ CŨ
Mục Gần đây giữ những ứng dụng bạn vừa mở. Tiến độ tự lưu trên máy; đăng nhập một lần là lưu chung cho mọi ứng dụng và dùng được trên máy khác.

DANH MỤC XEM ĐƯỢC KHI KHÔNG CÓ MẠNG
Danh sách ứng dụng nằm sẵn trong máy, mở ra là xem được kể cả khi đang mất sóng.

CHIA SẺ VỚI BẠN BÈ
Gửi một ứng dụng hay cho bạn qua Zalo, Messenger bằng nút Chia sẻ; bạn bấm đường link là mở thẳng trang ứng dụng đó.

MIỄN PHÍ, KHÔNG MUA BÁN TRONG ỨNG DỤNG
Mọi ứng dụng đều dùng miễn phí. Không bán vật phẩm, không mua bán bên trong ứng dụng.

AN TOÀN KHI DÙNG CHUNG
Tên trên bảng xếp hạng và hồ sơ đều có nút Báo cáo · Chặn; tên được lọc từ thô tục. Không có ô trò chuyện tự do giữa người lạ.

TÀI KHOẢN KHÔNG BẮT BUỘC
Dùng được ngay khi mở. Đăng nhập bằng email để lưu tiến độ, huy hiệu, thứ hạng. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong mục Tài khoản.

name: Astrolab Astronomical Clock
description:
Astrolab brings a classic astronomical clock (astrolabe dial) to your iPhone and Apple Watch.

The dial shows at a glance:
- the 24-hour time (CET) with the sun hand
- the position of the sun and the true moon in the zodiac
- the date ring with months and zodiac signs
- day, civil, nautical and astronomical twilight
- sunrise and sunset
- the local time ring

On the iPhone:
- Current Time and Calculated Time with date, day of week and day of year, switching automatically between CET and CEST
- Moon phase for the current and the calculated time
- Time STEP: move the clock by days, hours, 15 minutes or minutes
- Special Events: jump to Civil Dawn, Sun Rise, High Noon, Sun Set and Civil Dusk of the selected day
- NOW: back to the current time, with smoothly animated hands

On the Apple Watch:
- The full dial on your wrist
- Turn the Digital Crown to travel through time, tap to return to now
- Moon phase, date and time
- A complication to open Astrolab directly from your watch face
