All calculations are made for 47.3 N / 8.2 E (Switzerland). The moon is computed astronomically (true moon), not with a mechanical approximation.

Astrolab collects no data and works without an internet connection.

name: AtmoClient
description:
AtmoClient shows the readings of your Netatmo weather station – clear, fast and easy to read. Outdoor temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, CO₂, noise, pressure, rain and wind: everything at a glance on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

OUTDOORS AT A GLANCE
• A large outdoor card with temperature, feels-like temperature, dew point and today's high and low
• Rain and wind right in the card, with wind direction and gusts
• Background color that follows the temperature – can be turned off

EVERY ROOM
• One tile per module: living room, bedroom, office …
• CO₂, humidity, pressure and noise with trend arrows
• Tap a room in the bar to jump straight to it

HISTORY & COMPARE
• Charts for 1, 7 and 30 days with highs and lows
• Compare several rooms in one chart

FORECAST
• Today's weather and a 10-day forecast for your station's location – powered by Apple Weather
• Chance of rain, rainfall, wind and UV index

APPLE WATCH
• Complications for every watch face: circular, corner, rectangular and inline
• Shows the reading you choose, such as the outdoor temperature with today's high and low
• Watch app with the last few hours of history

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
• Unfolded: sidebar and readings side by side – nothing sits on the fold
• Desk mode: half open, iPhone Duo becomes a weather display for your desk, with large readings on top and controls below
• Hinge control: the opening angle picks the chart's time range

PRIVATE
• Sign in on Netatmo's own page – AtmoClient never sees your password
• Read-only access to your weather stations
• Readings go straight from Netatmo to your device
• No tracking, no ads, no analytics

No station? Try AtmoClient with sample data.

REQUIREMENTS
To see your own readings you need a Netatmo Weather Station and a Netatmo account.

AtmoClient is an independent app and is not affiliated with Netatmo or Legrand. Netatmo is a trademark of Legrand.

name: Aura Agent
seller_name: Grupo Molho Digital, SA de CV
description:
Aura Agent is your team of AI agents for your business, in one conversation.

Write or dictate to Aura like you would to someone on your team: "how much did we sell yesterday?", "reply to the customers who are waiting", "upload these products". Aura understands, shows you the plan and, once you say yes, gets it done in your Aura account.

YOUR TEAM OF AGENTS
Aura leads, and each person on your team can have their own agent: customer care, collections, inventory, content. Name them and tell them what to do in plain words. In the Office you see who is working, who is waiting for your approval and who is done.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Before anything important, the agent asks you first.
• You see every step in plain words and, if you want, the full detail.
• It never makes a payment on its own.
• Everything is logged.

YOUR WHOLE BUSINESS IN ONE CONVERSATION
Sales, orders, inventory, customers, documents, content and ads: what you do today with ten different tools, in one conversation.

YOUR PRIVACY
Before sending anything to an AI provider, Aura explains it and asks for your permission. You can withdraw it at any time, report any AI answer from the conversation and delete your account from your profile.

Aura Agent works with your Aura account.

name: Aurea - Video Editor
description:
Aurea is a complete video editor and motion design app for your phone. Create edits, reels, lyric videos and animations with the control of a desktop editor.

LAYER EDITING
• Multi-track timeline for video, images, audio, text and shapes
• Trim, split, duplicate, group and pre-compose
• Keyframes on any property, with a graph editor and easing curves
• Masks, vectors and text animators

EFFECTS AND TRANSITIONS
• Library of effects, transitions and presets with animated previews
• After Effects-style effects: radial blur, radial shadow, glitch, analog signal, wave warp, extrude and more
• Motion blur, Deep Glow, optical-flow slow motion, tracking and stabilization

COLOR
• Node-based color correction with wheels, curves, HSL, qualifier, LUTs and looks
• Histogram, waveform, parade and vectorscope

TEXT AND CAPTIONS
• Editable automatic captions with transcript, styles and templates
• Import and export SRT and VTT
• 3D Text and 3D scenes with lights, shadows and materials

COMMUNITY AND AI
• Community wall to show your edits and download presets
• AureaMCP: connect your AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) to edit with you

EXPORT
• High-quality export with several frame rates and aspect ratios for every network

OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Aurea is free. Some premium features are available by subscription:
• AureaHyper (monthly): unlocks every paid effect, 3D Text and the Hyper tools
• Each paid effect and 3D Text can also be subscribed to on its own (monthly)
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aurea-ai-discovery.aureaapp.workers.dev/privacidade

name: Aurora: Beyond the Horizon
description:
Aurora is a touching story-driven game about memory, loneliness and trust, told through messages.

You wake up on the deep-space station Aurora. You lost your memory at launch, Earth is a day and a half behind you, and the ship is flying toward a black hole called Absolut.

You are not alone. An AI core called Mira has switched on weeks too early. She is polite, funny and a little scared, and she remembers things no program should. Slowly you become something more to each other than a pilot and an onboard computer.

You write to Mission Control, to your family back home and to Mira. Your choices change how conversations end, and some lines you will want to read twice. Between messages you repair the station with small pixel-art tasks: catch comet ice with a drone, rewire a solar panel, tune a signal until a lost memory becomes readable, dock with a module, bend a burn around a planet.

• A touching story about memory, distance and what we leave behind
• Twelve chapters with heartfelt dialogue and choices
• About 25 hand-made pixel-art tasks with different mechanics
• Memory fragments: restore the past, one piece at a time
• Plays fully offline; progress saves automatically
• Available in English, Russian and Ukrainian
• No ads, no tracking, no data collected

Chapter 1 is free. Unlock the full story once with a single purchase. No subscriptions.

name: Bakio
description:
Bakio is the app for your bakery's team: the owner, the bakers and counter staff, and the drivers who take the orders out.

DELIVERIES
• See every van on one live map: where each driver is, the road they're on and which order they're taking next.
• Find any order in a moment by its number.
• Drivers get their run in turn-by-turn navigation, take a photo at the door, and the owner sees it delivered straight away.
• When an order can't be delivered, the driver says why and the owner knows at once.
• Give an order or a whole run to someone else in two taps.

ROSTER
• Everyone sees their shifts for the week; managers plan and publish the roster.
• Clock in and out from the phone.

TEAM
• Chat with the people you work with, when your bakery has chat switched on.

Bakio is used by bakeries that have a Bakio account. Your bakery invites you; sign in with the email and password it gave you.

name: Balistika
description:
Balistika is a precise ballistic calculator for hunters and sport shooters - air rifles (PCP) and firearms.

- Exact scope clicks (MOA / MIL) for any distance
- Your gun, pellet or bullet and scope from a large database, or add your own
- Live local weather: wind, temperature and pressure corrections are applied automatically
- Zeroing and truing with real shots at several distances
- Reticle view with hold-over points
- Shooting angle, rangefinder and shooting ranges map
- Learning section: shooting fundamentals, safety and hunting knowledge
- Shooting club: share your groups and trophies with other shooters
- Works offline after the first launch

The app interface is in Georgian.

name: Bandloom
description:
Bandloom ನಿಮ್ಮ ಐಫೋನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಧ್ವನಿ ಒತ್ತಡ ಮಾಪಕಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೈಕ್ರೋಫೋನ್ ಒಲಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಗಣನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ — ಯಾವುದೇ ರೆಕಾರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ಲೌಡ್ ಅಪ್ಲೋಡ್ ಅಲ್ಲ.

• ನೇರ dB ವಾಚಿಗಳು, ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಬರೆದ ಡಯಲ್, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮಟ್ಟ ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುವಿಕೆ
• ೧/೧ ಸೋಕ್ಟೇವ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಲೈವ್ ಸ್ಪೆಕ್ಟ್ರಮ್
• A / C / Z ತೂಕ ಮತ್ತು ವೇಗವಾದ/ನಿಧಾನ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ
• ಕ್ಯಾಲಿಬ್ರೇಷನ್ ಆಫ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದ ಸೆಷನ್ ಲಾಗ್‌ಗಳು
• ಖಾಸಗಿತನ ಪುಟ: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಡೇಟಾ ಈ ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ

ಆಫೀಸ್, ಸ್ಟುಡಿಯೋ, ಗೃಹ ಅಥವಾ ತರಗತಿಯ ಶಬ್ದವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಒಂದು ಸರಳ, ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಪರಿಕರ.

name: Bar Wars TX
description:
Bar Wars is San Antonio's bar-vs-bar tournament. Sixteen local bars. Four weeks. One champion.

Season 1 runs January 6 to February 1, 2027. Bars face off head-to-head each week, and fans decide who advances: every token you buy for your bar is a vote. Most tokens wins the matchup.

Every token is also an entry in the championship-night sweepstakes drawing: win 2 Spurs tickets or one of ten $25 bar tabs. No purchase necessary — enter free once a day right in the app. One prize per person. Bar tabs redeemable at any participating bar (21+).

With the app you can:
- Follow live scores, standings, and the full bracket
- Back your bar with tokens and track your entries in your wallet
- Browse the San Antonio bar guide: 170+ bars with hours, happy hours, and deals
- Find bars near you with directions, rideshare, and tonight's specials
- Watch the King of the Division and Influencer of the Year races

Tokens never expire. You must be 21 or older to buy tokens; 18 or older to enter the sweepstakes. Full official rules are in the app.

Bar Wars is powered by Zently.

name: BarberMaster: Barber Booking
description:
Your barbershop, in your pocket.

With BarberMaster you book your cut in seconds: no calls, no waiting for a reply.

FOR CLIENTS
• Pick your barber, service, day and time, or take the first one available.
• See prices, deals and photos of real cuts before you go.
• Get a reminder the day before and an hour before.
• Reschedule or cancel right in the app.
• Fully booked? Join the waitlist and we'll tell you if a spot opens up.
• Rate your cut and read other clients' reviews.
• Join your shop with its code or link.

FOR BARBERS AND OWNERS
• Today's schedule, filtered by barber.
• Add walk-ins in two taps.
• Hours, days off, services and prices.
• Discounts by service and date range.
• Business numbers: sales, bookings, top services and returning clients.
• Instant alert for every new booking.
• Your brand: logo, cover photos, barber photos and photos of your work.
• Add or remove barbers; each one manages their own schedule and photo.

Available in English and Spanish.

Terms of Use: https://barbermasterapp.com/terminos.html
Privacy: https://barbermasterapp.com/privacidad.html

name: Basher
description:
Basher is your comprehensive employee self-service and smart attendance solution, designed to streamline daily workforce management and boost productivity.

Key Features:
• Smart Clock In & Clock Out: Fast and accurate attendance tracking using QR code scanning, verified GPS location geofencing, and biometric recognition.
• Requests & Approvals: Submit and monitor administrative requests on the go, including leaves, permissions, advances, and work missions, with instant approval status updates.
• Attendance & Working Hours Analytics: Clear insights into daily, weekly, and monthly work hours, total hours logged, and attendance trends.
• Payslip & Earnings: Secure access to monthly payslips, financial breakdowns, and salary history.
• Notifications & Alerts: Stay updated with real-time alerts regarding request approvals, shifts, and important company announcements.

Basher delivers an intuitive, secure, and modern experience for today's dynamic workplaces.

name: Battery Alarm: Charge Alert
description:
Charging your iPhone to 100% every time wears the battery out faster. Battery Alarm rings when your iPhone reaches the level you choose, so you can unplug in time.

SET YOUR LIMIT, GET AN ALARM
• Pick your charge limit: 80% is a good choice for battery health.
• Keep Battery Alarm open while you charge. It keeps the screen on and rings the moment you reach your limit.
• Unplug and the alarm stops by itself.

MORE THAN A FULL-CHARGE ALARM
• Low-battery alarm: get warned at 20% (or your level) while the app is open.
• Spoken alert: hear "Battery is at 80 percent" out loud.
• Snooze: ring again 5% later.
• Bedtime mode: a soft sound, vibration only, or silence at night.

SEE YOUR CHARGING HABITS
• Charges are saved on your iPhone while the app is open.
• See how often you unplug on time and your average unplug level.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account needed.
• Your battery data stays on your iPhone.

Want an alert with the app closed? iPhone doesn't let apps watch the battery in the background, but you can add a Shortcuts automation: Battery Level → Rises Above 80% → Play Sound. The app shows you how.

name: BConnect: NAS Messenger
description:
BConnect is the app for BConnect Server — a private messenger that runs on your own Synology NAS. It is an independent, self-hosted alternative to Synology Chat for families, teams and organisations who use a Synology NAS and want a modern messenger without handing their conversations to a cloud service.

PLEASE NOTE: THIS APP IS A CLIENT
BConnect needs a BConnect Server to sign in to. The server is a free package for Synology DSM 7 that the owner of the NAS installs in a few guided steps (https://apps.ibcsc.be/app/bconnect). If someone invited you, just open their invitation link or scan their QR code. Without a server of your own or an invitation, the app has nothing to connect to.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR NAS
• Messages, photos, files, voice messages and call history are stored on your NAS — not on our servers.
• No advertising, no trackers, no analytics, no subscription.
• We, the developers, keep no accounts and cannot see your conversations.

EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT FROM A MESSENGER
• Private chats, groups and channels
• Photos, videos and files of any type
• Voice messages and round video messages
• Voice and video calls
• Replies, forwarding, editing, reactions
• Checklists, locations and contacts in a chat
• Stories
• Stickers, chat folders, search across your history
• Auto-delete timers for messages
• Push notifications with sound, vibration and an unread badge
• Light and dark themes, wallpapers and accent colours
• More than 30 languages

IT KEEPS WORKING WHEN THE INTERNET DOES NOT
• Server down or unreachable? Messages travel through beacons — small relays that your administrator or any member can add — and arrive as soon as the path is back. There is nothing to configure: the app chooses the route by itself.
• No internet at all? Link a Meshtastic-compatible LoRa radio to your iPhone over Bluetooth, and BConnect sends text, small pictures and short voice messages by radio to members of your community who are in range. Tested with the SenseCAP Card Tracker T1000-E and the Heltec MeshPocket.
• Everything sent by radio is encrypted. Only the devices of your own community can read it.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• Passcode and Face ID lock
• Two-step verification and passkeys
• See and end the sessions on your other devices
• Decide who sees when you were last online
• Block and report users
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time

FOR THE ADMINISTRATOR OF THE NAS
• Guided installation in DSM 7 with a first-steps assistant
• Invitations by link or QR code; open, invitation-only or approval-based registration
• Users, invitations, storage limits, message retention and network ports in a DSM window
• Optional relay for push notifications and beacons on any small VPS, installed with one command
• Step-by-step guide: https://apps.ibcsc.be/guide/bconnect

BConnect is made by IBCSC ASBL in Belgium. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Synology Inc. “Synology” and “Synology Chat” are trademarks of Synology Inc.

Terms of Use: https://apps.ibcsc.be/terms/bconnect

name: Beatdrop
description:
Wie schnell erkennst du deinen Lieblingssong? In BEATDROP zählt jede einzelne Millisekunde!

Inspiriert von den größten Prime-Time Musik-Gameshows bringt BEATDROP das ultimative Song-Quiz direkt auf dein iPhone. Sobald der Beat droppt, läuft das Preisgeld rückwärts – wer den richtigen Songtitel am schnellsten einloggt, räumt den Cash-Pot ab!

DIE 4 SPIELMODI:

• FAST TRACK (4 ANTWORTMÖGLICHKEITEN)
Ein Song startet, 4 Antwortmöglichkeiten erscheinen sofort auf dem Display. Je schneller du auf den richtigen Songtitel tippst, desto höher fällt dein Gewinn aus. Schlage die Reaktionszeit der KI-Challenger und sichere dir den Speed-Bonus!

• TYPE IT OUT (EXAKTEN SONGNAMEN EINTIPPEN)
Keine Hilfe, keine Antwort-Buttons! Hör genau hin und tippe den exakten Songnamen selbst über die Tastatur ein. Unsere intelligente Echtzeit-Erkennung zeigt dir passende Buchstaben sofort an, verzeiht kleine Tippfehler auf der Handytastatur und löst deinen Treffer ohne Zeitverlust automatisch aus.

• PARTY LOBBY (LIVE MULTIPLAYER MIT EIGENEM HANDY-BUZZER)
Erstelle in einer Sekunde eine Party-Lobby mit 4-stelligem Code! Deine Freunde treten einfach mit ihrem eigenen Smartphone bei und nutzen ihr Display als persönlichen Live-Buzzer. Wer den Song als Erster erkennt, haut auf seinen Buzzer, friert den Raum ein und loggt die Antwort auf seinem Handy ein!

• THE $1,000,000 SHOW (KOMPLETTE 4-RUNDEN TV-SHOW)
Spiele die komplette Show-Kampagne von der Aufwärmrunde über Double-Cash und Type-It-Out bis zum großen Finale: Schlage die Musik-KI in unter 3,15 Sekunden!

KULT-PLAYLISTS & FREIE KÜNSTLERSUCHE:
Wähle aus 10 kuratierten Vibe-Playlists oder erstelle deinen eigenen Mix:
• White Girl Music (2010er Pop-Hymnen & Party-Klassiker)
• Hafti & Straßenrap (069, Frankfurter & Berliner Straßen-Klassiker)
• Deutschrap Allstars (Aktuelle Nummer-1-Hits & Dauerbrenner)
• Shisha Bar & Sommer 2017 (Unvergessliche Sommer-Vibes)
• Palmen aus Plastik & 187
• 2000s Club & R&B Banger
• Ski Aggu, Techno & Atzen
• US Trap, Rage & Gym
• 3 Uhr Nachts Late Night Drive
• 80s & 90s Legends
• Eigene Suche: Suche jeden beliebigen Künstler weltweit und spiele sofort eine Runde mit echten 30-Sekunden-Hörproben!

FEATURES IM ÜBERBLICK:
• Echte 30-Sekunden-Musik-Previews in Studioqualität
• Millisekunden-genaues Reaktionszeit-Tracking & Karriere-Statistiken
• 3 taktische In-Game Show-Joker (50:50 Filter, Cryo Time-Freeze, 2X Double-Cash)
• Modernes Dark- & Light-Mode Design mit 360°-Frequenz-Equalizer
• Nach jeder Runde alle gespielten Tracks direkt noch einmal anhören

name: Beta's Beauty & Wellness
description:
The official app of Beta's Beauty & Wellness – your studio for laser hair removal in Dübendorf, Switzerland.

Book your appointment in a minute: choose a zone or a package, pick a free day and time, done. You get a confirmation straight away and a reminder on your phone before the appointment.

IN THE APP
• All treatments and packages at a glance – face, upper body, intimate area and legs
• Book online – with a client account or without
• All your appointments in one place, including online cancellation
• Confirmations and reminders as notifications
• Offers and news from the studio – only if you want them
• Tips and know-how about laser hair removal
• Free consultation before your first session

OUR TECHNOLOGY
We work with the Delighter 2000W diode laser from Italy: two wavelengths (808 and 1064 nm) in one pulse, 2000 watts of power and five-stage skin cooling – for a gentle and quick treatment.

Beta's Beauty & Wellness
Überlandstrasse 237, 8600 Dübendorf, Switzerland
Phone +41 76 414 49 69 · www.betasbeauty.ch

name: Bible Quiz: Play Together
description:
Bible Quiz is a set of Bible games for youth groups, small groups and the whole family. Scores are counted automatically — all you have to do is play.

HOW TO PLAY
• On phones — the host creates a room, players join with a 4-digit code or a QR code and answer on their own phones. Up to 50 players.
• On one screen — a phone, tablet or projector; great for teams.
• Solo — when you want to practice.

18 GAMES
Quiz (plus “First to Buzz” and “Last One Standing”), “True or Myth”, “Guess the Hero”, “Build the Verse”, “Missing Word”, “Question Board”, “Question Wheel”, “Charades”, “Who of Us…?” and more.

ALMOST 10,000 QUESTIONS
Four levels — from kids to hard. Answers link to Bible passages — open them in one tap.

AND THERE'S MORE
• Make your own quizzes for a meeting topic or sermon
• Bible (KJV): bookmarks, notes, offline reading
• Profanity filter, reports and player blocking

Free, no ads. Interface in English, Russian and Uzbek; questions and the Bible in English and Russian, with Uzbek coming soon.

name: Bindora
description: Bindora is designed to document the creation process of a book. You can set up a project, record details such as paper dimensions, number of signatures, and final trim size, then track your progress through each stage—folding, cutting, punching, stitching, and final inspection. Photos can be added as you take them or select them from your library. All data is stored locally on your device; no account is required. If you switch to a new device, you can export a backup and restore your data.

name: Blindstrike Tactics
description:
Hide your army. Find theirs first.

Blindstrike Tactics is a head-to-head strategy game of hidden armies. You and your rival each deploy units in secret, then take turns striking blind at each other's board. Every hit sparks a clash, and only the right matchup wins it.

FOUR UNITS, ONE RULE Every unit beats one type, loses to another and is evenly matched with the third: • Soldiers bring down Flyers, armored airship bombers, with precision-thrown spears • Brutes smash Soldiers with raw strength • Flyers bomb Towers from the sky • Towers rain arrows on Brutes Choose your attacker well. Attack with the wrong unit and you lose it.

DEPLOY IN SECRET Place any mix of units: all Soldiers, a wall of Towers, or something sneakier. Pick from three boards: • Easy: 3×2, 4 units, a quick skirmish • Basic: 4×3, 7 units, the standard game • War: 5×4, 14 units, a long, all-out battle

STRIKE BLIND Drag one of your units onto an enemy square. If something is hiding there, the two units clash and both are revealed. Evenly matched units leave the defender wounded, and any later neutral hit finishes it off.

KILLS EARN EXTRA TURNS Every kill gives you another move, so one unit can chain a streak: Triple Kill, Dominating, Massacre, Unstoppable, or wipe out the whole enemy army single-handedly.

RISE TO HERO A unit that destroys 2 enemies is promoted to hero and wears a crown. Heroes beat every unit that isn't a hero.

SKILLS Once per battle each: • Scout: reveal one enemy square without risking a unit • Nuke: destroy any enemy unit you can see • Heal: hide a spotted unit again, clear its wound and move it

BEST-OF-3 ONLINE DUELS Find an opponent through Game Center, face off on the versus screen, and demand a rematch. Each turn has a 30-second clock; run out of time three times and you forfeit. Both armies are locked in with a cryptographic fingerprint and revealed at the end, so you can see your opponent played fair.

PRACTICE ANYTIME Sharpen your tactics against the Training Bot, offline, on any board.

Animated 3D units, a living battlefield and satisfying clashes throughout.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account needed beyond Game Center for online play.

name: Blobnap
description:
Blobnap, lastiği gerip renkli blobları kaptığın bir bulmaca oyunu.

Bir çiviye bas, çapraz kaydır ve bırak: lastik bir kutu çizer. Kutudaki blobların hepsi aynı renkse hepsini yakalarsın. Ne kadar çok blob, o kadar çok puan!

Ama acele et: yakalanmayan bloblar zamanla taşa döner ve tahtayı doldurur. Büyük kombolar taşları kırar. Tahta dolmadan rekorunu kır.

• Kısa oturumlar, sonu olmayan oyun
• 37 başarım: kolaydan efsaneviye
• Banknot biriktir, mağazadan tema, tahta, çivi, blob ve lastik kostümleri al
• İnternet gerekmez, reklam yok, hiçbir veri toplanmaz
• Türkçe ve İngilizce

name: Blok Futbol 3v3
description:
Pick a nation and take the pitch in Blok Futbol 3v3. Pass, press and shoot in quick 3v3 matches, then go for a header or a bicycle kick.

• Play timed matches, race to three goals or try penalty shootouts.  
• Face each of seven league rivals twice, climb the standings and compete for the trophy.  
• Replay bicycle kick goals in slow motion. Play in sunshine, rain or snow.  
• Earn coins through gameplay and unlock characters, hairstyles, kits and balls.  
• Choose Turkish, English or French menus.

Free to play offline with no ads or real-money in-app purchases.

name: Booksic
description:
Every book deserves a soundtrack.

Booksic plays instrumental music made for the book in your hands. Search the title, pick a soundtrack and read with music that fits the story: cozy for a rainy mystery, epic for a fantasy quest, quiet and melancholic for the novel that stays with you.

LISTEN FREE
- Search any book and play soundtracks other readers made for it.
- Browse by mood: cozy, epic, mysterious, dreamy, melancholic, tense, romantic, serene.
- Save the soundtracks you love to your Library.
- Instrumental only, so nothing pulls you out of the page.

COMPOSE YOUR OWN
- Pick a book, choose how it should feel and which instruments you want.
- Booksic drafts a spoiler-free tracklist. Ask the composer for changes until it feels right.
- Original songs are composed with AI in about a minute each.
- Keep your soundtrack private or share it with every reader of that book.

BOOKSIC PLUS
Composing needs Booksic Plus, a monthly subscription with 25 new songs every month. Unused songs roll over while you're subscribed. Need more? Song packs add extra songs anytime. Listening is always free.

Booksic Plus renews monthly until you cancel. You can cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

Terms: https://booksic.io/terms
Privacy: https://booksic.io/privacy

name: Brainzaro: Flashcards & Voice
description:
Brainzaro turns notes, worksheets, and textbook pages into study sets you'll actually remember.

SNAP A PHOTO INTO FLASHCARDS
• Take a photo of your notes, a worksheet, or a textbook page and get a draft set of flashcards you can edit.
• Or type cards, paste a list, add images, and record your own audio on any card.
• Start from thousands of free public sets made for real classes.

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Flashcards: flip, swipe to sort what you know, and star the hard ones.
• Learn: short daily rounds that keep coming back to what you miss.
• Test: practice tests with multiple choice, true/false, and written answers.
• Review: spaced repetition brings cards back right before you'd forget them.
• Match and other quick games for a break that still counts.

HANDS-FREE VOICE QUIZZES
• Voice mode reads each card out loud, gives you time to answer, then reads the answer. Built for walks, commutes, and chores.
• Listen mode turns a set into an audio episode.

LIVE STUDY BATTLES
• Start a battle from any set and share the code or QR. Friends or a whole class join and race to answer.
• Play solo or split into teams. Projector view for classrooms.

KNOW WHEN YOU'RE EXAM-READY
• An exam readiness score shows how much of a set you've covered, how well you know it, and what to study next.
• Streaks, daily goals, and study buddies keep you going.

EXAM PREP PACKS
Original practice packs for entrance and licensing exams, including SAT, ACT, AP, IELTS, TOEFL, DMV permit, notary, and real estate. Packs are independent study aids, not official exam materials.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Dark mode that follows your phone, or pick light or dark yourself.
• Save sets and study offline at no extra cost — offline study is included for free.
• Folders, classes, and study reminders.
• Report or block anyone, and delete your account any time from Profile.

Brainzaro is free to use. If your account already has Brainzaro Plus, Max, or Family, sign in and it works here too.

Questions? Visit brainzaro.com/help.

WHAT IS BRAINZARO?
Brainzaro is a flashcard and study app for students and teachers. Snap a photo of your notes to draft flashcards with AI, then study with Learn, Test, hands-free Voice quizzes, and live battles, and see when you're exam-ready.

IS BRAINZARO FREE?
Yes. The app is free to use, including offline study. Sets, Flashcards, and Match have no paid cap. Free includes daily Learn rounds. If you already have a Plus, Max, or Family plan on your Brainzaro account, sign in and those features work in the app too.

WHO CAN USE BRAINZARO?
Students age 13 and up, teachers, and anyone studying for a class or exam. You must be 13 or older to create an account.

ARE EXAM PACKS OFFICIAL TEST MATERIALS?
No. Packs are original, independent study aids — not official exam materials.

name: Branding Checker
description:
One name. Every answer.

Branding Checker tells you in seconds whether the name you have in mind is still free. Type it once and watch the results arrive live from domains, social networks, software stores and trademark registers, all on a single screen.

WHAT IT CHECKS
- Domains: 10 extensions (.com, .net, .org, .it, .eu, .io, .co, .app, .ai, .me), using public registry data and DNS.
- Social handles: 14 networks, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Twitch, Telegram, GitHub and Bluesky.
- Software stores: 6 stores and registries, including the App Store and Google Play.
- Trademarks: registered marks from more than 60 offices, searched through TMview.

BUILT FOR DECISIONS
- Live results: each source appears as soon as it answers.
- Export the report as PDF, Excel or JSON and share it with your team, your client or your lawyer.
- Search history stays on your device, ready when you need it.
- Available in English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese and Korean.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Free. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
- Only the name you check is sent to our server to run the search. Your connection address is used in pseudonymised form solely to apply the daily limit, and is deleted at the end of the day.

GOOD TO KNOW
- You can run 5 checks per day.
- Results are indicative and based on public sources at the time of the search. They have no legal value and do not replace a professional trademark clearance. Before registering or investing in a name, consult a qualified professional.

Ideal for founders, marketers, designers, agencies and anyone naming a product, a company or a project.

Branding Checker is made by Agencia Gentile.

name: Brilliant Parent
description:
Brilliant Parent is the official mobile portal for parents and guardians of students enrolled at Brilliant Convent School (Gandhi Nagar, Old Tandur, and Basheerabad branches).

    Designed to foster strong school-parent collaboration, the app provides real-time access to your child’s school life:
    • Real-time Attendance: Instant notifications and monthly calendars of your child's daily presence and leaves.
    • Homework & Assignments: View daily homework, teacher notes, and submission deadlines.
    • Fee Management: Check pending fee structures, view payment history, and download digital receipts.
    • Report Cards & Academic Progress: Track exam schedules, marks sheets, and performance progress over time.
    • School Circulars & Notices: Instant updates regarding school events, holidays, parent-teacher meetings, and emergency alerts.
    • Multi-Child Support: Effortlessly switch between multiple siblings enrolled in the school from a single login.
    • Timetable & Calendar: Access class schedules, subject timetables, and the official school academic calendar.

Note: This app is exclusively for parents and legal guardians of currently enrolled students at Brilliant Convent School. Login requires your registered mobile number on record with the school.

name: Britizen: UK Citizenship Test
description:
Your path to British citizenship, one topic at a time.

Britizen helps you prepare for the Life in the UK test with short topics, timed mock tests and a review of every answer you miss. Questions are written from the handbook, Life in the UK: A Guide for New Residents, and cover all five subjects: values, the UK, history, society and law.

LEARN WITH UNDERSTANDING
Every answer comes with a short explanation and the handbook page it comes from. Answers you miss go to Review and stay there until you get them right, so you only revise what you still need.

PRACTISE LIKE TEST DAY
Mock tests follow the test format: 24 questions, 45 minutes, 18 correct answers to pass. You see your score only at the end, and each result shows where you lost marks.

FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Follow the study map through 28 topics, see how ready you are by subject, and set a daily reminder. Start as a guest, or create an account to keep your progress on another device.

STUDY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Use the app in English, Polish, Romanian, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Arabic, Turkish or Chinese, with explanations in your language. Questions and answers stay in English, as on test day.

GO FURTHER WITH FULL ACCESS
An optional, one-time purchase unlocks:
• Every topic and unlimited mock tests.
• Mock tests built from your mistakes and the "Am I ready?" score.
• Listen: questions read aloud.
• A study plan with a daily target, and the dates and numbers drill.
• No ads.

Full access is a non-consumable unlock with no monthly or yearly renewal. Restore Purchases is available. Buying and restoring do not require registration with personal details; an optional account lets you keep your progress on another device. Prices are shown by the App Store before purchase. The free version includes the first topics of each subject and one mock test, and may show ads.

Britizen is an independent study app. It is not connected to or endorsed by the UK government or the Home Office. Mock tests are designed by Britizen and are not the real test. Using the app does not guarantee a test result or citizenship. Book the test and check the current rules on GOV.UK.

Test information: https://www.gov.uk/life-in-the-uk-test
Privacy Policy: https://britizen.devolist.com/legal/privacy
Terms: https://britizen.devolist.com/legal/terms
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: aviacms@gmail.com

name: Brushmo
description:
Brushmo is a cheerful tooth-brushing helper for families, made for parents to use together with their children. Mo, a fluffy one-eyed monster with fuzzy teeth, brushes along while a friendly timer shows which part of the mouth to brush next. Finish and a new sticker lands in the sticker book.

BRUSH WITH MO
Tap "BRUSH!" to start the timer (1 to 3 minutes, set by a grown-up). A colourful ring counts down, a little mouth map shows top left, top right, bottom left and bottom right, and "Switch sides!" pops up at each quarter. Mo's teeth get cleaner as you go. Pause any time.

STICKERS AND STREAKS
• A sticker for every finished brush, collected in the Sticker Book
• A week chart of morning brushes, evening brushes and flossing
• A streak counter for each child
• Tap "Floss" to tick off flossing for the day

MORNING AND BEDTIME ROUTINES
Tick off picture checklists like "Wash face", "Brush teeth", "Pyjamas on" and "Story time". Finish a whole routine to earn one bonus sticker a day, and see a star for each completed day this week.

TOOTH FAIRY LOG
Tap "A tooth fell out!" to record which tooth, when, a little memory and what the Tooth Fairy left. Every lost tooth earns a crown sticker.

PARENT ZONE (GROWN-UPS ONLY)
The Parent Zone opens only after a grown-up answers a times-table sum. In it you can:
• Add each child with a first name or nickname, an avatar and a colour
• Set the timer length and morning and evening brushing reminders
• Keep track of dentist visits with reminders the evening before and one hour before
• See a monthly report card for each child and share it

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Parents use Brushmo with their children; Google sign-in is for grown-ups only and sits behind the same grown-up sum
• Collects no data from children: names, brushing history and stickers stay on this iPhone
• No ads, no in-app purchases, and no links out of the app outside the grown-up sum
• No tracking and no analytics
• Erase all app data or delete your account at any time

General habit-building, not dental advice. Always follow your own dentist's guidance and supervise young children while they brush.

name: Buzz My Order
description: scan, put your phone away, get buzzed, pick up. It also says nothing personal is collected.

name: Callingual: Translated Calls
description:
Call someone who speaks another language. Callingual rings your phone, then the other person's, and translates what each of you says. Each of you hears the other in your own language, about two seconds after the speaker pauses.

HOW A CALL WORKS
- Enter the other person's name, number and language, or pick them from your contacts.
- Press Call. Callingual rings your phone first, then theirs.
- In their language, they hear who is calling and that the call is translated by AI. They press 1 to accept, 2 to decline or 3 to block. Nobody is connected without pressing 1.
- During the call, the app shows live captions of what each person says and its translation. Captions are not stored.

INTERPRET IN PERSON
Talk with someone next to you. Choose their language, put the phone between you and speak; Callingual says each sentence in the other language through the phone's speaker.

ADD CALLINGUAL TO A CALL
Already on a call? Choose the other person's language and tap Add Callingual. Your phone calls Callingual; merge the calls and Callingual translates both sides.

LANGUAGES
77 languages; any two can be paired. The app itself is available in 34 languages.

YOUR ACCOUNT
- Create an account and set it up in the app: name, language, phone number check and dial-in.
- See your call history and usage.
- Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or your password manager.
- Delete your account in the app under Account.

PRICING
Calls within the US and Canada cost 45 cents a minute; other countries are priced per destination, shown before you call. Calls are billed to a card you save on callingual.com; the app opens the website for billing. There is no subscription and nothing to buy in the app. Callingual is for US customers.

PRIVACY
Conversations are not recorded: no audio, transcripts or translations of what the two people say to each other are stored. Speech is processed while the call is live and then discarded. What you say to Callingual itself, such as menu answers, is kept as text for one year to find and fix faults. Callingual keeps call details such as time, duration, cost and languages. Details: callingual.com/privacy.

Support: (218) 772-4959 or callingual.com/contact.

name: Charmflask Mix
description:
Welcome to the Daylight Apothecary, where every flask hides a small, satisfying puzzle.

Charmflask Mix is not another pour-and-sort game. Each of its three trials gives you a new way to move color, and each one asks you to think a move ahead.

CHARM TETHER
Hold a droplet and pull a golden ribbon to a droplet in another flask. Choose two empty places, then cast the charm. Both droplets travel together in a single move. Later flasks are crossed by fixed silk threads, and your ribbons can never cut them.

CHARM EXCHANGE
Press a wax stamp onto one cell, choose a cell in another bottle, preview the trade and seal it. Every stamp is precious, and brass pipes decide which bottles can trade at all.

BROKEN CHARM
Drag a twin cartridge over two neighbouring bottles, flip it or rearrange the rack, then pull it apart with two fingers to pour both halves at once. Each charm cracks only once, so plan your pours.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 45 hand-checked levels, 15 per trial, each with a verified solution
• A short, playable tutorial for every trial that you can replay at any time
• Unlimited undo, restart, and hints that show one good move
• Stars for clean, efficient solutions
• A charm cabinet of keepsakes earned through play
• A progress ledger that tracks every ribbon, stamp and cracked charm
• Gentle glass chimes and haptics, both optional. 
• Color marks on every tincture for color-blind players, plus reduced motion and a one-handed mode
• Layouts made for small and large iPhones and for iPhone Duo, folded or opened

Charmflask Mix works fully offline, and your progress stays on your device.

name: CharmPop: Phone Charm DIY
description:
Your phone is missing something. A charm you made yourself, bead by bead.
Start with a cord: Soft Cord, Ball Chain, or Wrist Strap. Add beads, charms and pendants to your tray, then drag them onto either end of the cord one by one.
Don't know where to start? Pick a color palette in Color Magic and CharmPop strings a first draft for you to fix up.
When it's finished, hang it on a phone. Switch between iPhone sizes and case colors, then pick one of three spots to attach your charm.
Want more styles? Order Workshop is a quick game that earns you coins. Pieces are piled up and some are stuck under others, so park a few in Hold to reach the one you need. You get three hearts and no timer. Finish an order, collect coins, and spend them in the Shop to unlock new bead styles, charms and pendants. Unlock a style once and it's yours to use as often as you like.
Every charm you finish goes into your collection. Open one to keep editing, rename it, mark it as a favorite, preview it on a phone again, or share a picture.
CharmPop is a digital game. No real charms are sold or shipped.

name: ChatWay · 说话录
description:
ChatWay 是一个由你亲手积累的英语第二大脑。

你从书本、课程、搜索或外部 AI 工具中学到表达，确认并理解后，把它们记录进 ChatWay。吃饭、出门、玩耍、洗澡，或只是和宝宝随意聊天时，随时找到想说的话，听一听，再亲口说出来。

你在学习，宝宝在听；你在表达，宝宝在回应。让每一次积累，都有机会用在真实生活里。

【一个意思，多种表达】
同一个中文意思可以收纳多种英文说法，分别填写区别、语气和用法备注，每种表达都能单独朗读。中文置顶，英文逐行排列，方便对照和使用。

【按生活场景整理】
从吃饭、出门、玩耍、日常生活到日常随聊，内置 57 个多级场景。餐厅、美食、玩具、公园、喝奶、洗澡、换尿布，都可以继续细分。每条内容可以属于多个场景。

【想说时，随时找回来】
通过中文、英文、场景、关键词和备注，查找自己保存过的内容。简洁的搜索首页，输入后呈现匹配的表达卡片。

【完整表达，本机朗读】
使用 iPhone 已安装的英语声音朗读，支持美式与英式、三档语速，以及暂停、继续和停止。可试听选择声音，优先使用本机可用的高品质或增强版声音。首次下载额外系统声音需要网络，下载后可离线使用，实际音质取决于设备上的可用声音。

【把知识连接起来】
收藏句子中的单词或词组，填写自己的释义，并回看来源。通过双向关联与图谱连接场景、表达和单词，逐渐形成个人英语知识库。图谱支持缩放、移动、节点拖动和筛选。

【本机保存，离线使用】
无需账号，没有广告或订阅。内容保存在本机，支持完整备份导入与导出。换机或卸载前，请先导出重要内容。帮助与隐私政策也可离线查看。

学习内容由你选择，表达和释义由你确认、填写。ChatWay 帮助你整理、找回和使用这些积累，陪伴你把学到的英语，逐渐变成自己的口语。

ChatWay 不内置 AI 生成、翻译或语法校验。界面主要为简体中文；内置少量内容均标记为示例，可自行修改或删除。打开在线支持页面、下载系统声音包、下载或更新 App，需要网络连接。

把想说的话，留在身边。

name: Cheek Pouch Chef
description:
Catch ingredients, puff up your cheeks, and cook in a glowing neon forest!

Cheek Pouch Chef brings catching, recipe matching, and pouch management into a timed challenge. Drag your squirrel left and right to catch falling acorns, walnuts, cherries, and pinecones. Gather the ingredients on the current order ticket, and the dish cooks automatically.

The fuller your cheeks, the higher you float. Keep collecting, or spit out the last ingredient to make room? Watch your six-slot pouch and dodge Rocket Chili: one spicy sneeze empties your cheeks and costs a heart.

CATCH WITH A PLAN
Check the current order and the next dish to choose what to catch. Tap Spit to drop your most recent ingredient and adjust your pouch. Spitting also resets your combo, so choose your moment.

KEEP THE COMBO COOKING
Start each round with 90 seconds and three hearts. Cook consecutive dishes to build your score multiplier. Every dish adds four seconds, up to a maximum of 90 seconds remaining. The round ends when time or hearts run out.

DISCOVER ALL 12 RECIPES
From Moonlight Acorn Soup to Rainbow Dream Bowl, reveal secret dishes by cooking them. Fill your recipe book and unlock six badges tied to cooking, scoring, and collecting milestones.

FIND YOUR PACE
Choose Chill, Normal, or Frenzy for different falling speeds and challenge levels. Enjoy a colorful forest, a floating squirrel, and playful sound effects as you chase your personal best.

PLAY OFFLINE
No internet connection or account needed. No ads. Scores, lifetime stats, and recipe discoveries are saved on your device after each completed round. Adjust sound and vibration separately, or enable Left-Handed Mode to move the Spit button to the left.

name: ChocoTemper: Cocoa Studio
description:
Tempering chocolate requires close attention to temperature and time. When cocoa butter cools without the right crystal structure, finished bars can turn dull, feel soft to the touch, or develop pale gray streaks known as fat bloom. ChocoTemper helps you follow every stage of the tempering process and balance your confection formulas directly on your work surface.

Thermal Curves & Crystal Guidance
Choose between dark, milk, white, or ruby chocolate to view recommended temperatures for melting, cooling, and working stages. Enter your current thermometer reading to check whether the batch has reached the target Form V crystallization window. If a batch cools too quickly or warms past the safe threshold, review practical adjustment suggestions, such as adding seed chocolate or applying gentle agitation.

Recipe Calculations & Batch Scaling
Plan chocolate formulations by entering cocoa mass, cocoa butter, sweetener, and milk powder. ChocoTemper computes total cocoa percentage, fat-to-sugar balance, and required seed proportions automatically. Adjust batch weights to scale a small test bowl up to full mold production, with instant cavity count estimates based on your mold size.

Batch Cards & Printable Summaries
Keep notes on ambient room temperature, resting time, and final gloss for every completed batch. Save your parameters to batch cards for future reference, and generate high-contrast PDF spec sheets to keep on your prep counter or share with fellow bakers.

Confectioner Reference Guide
Browse practical reference notes explaining the six polymorphic crystal states of cocoa butter, the difference between fat bloom and sugar bloom, and ideal humidity conditions for mold release.

name: Chorbit
description:
Chorbit is a fair chore rotation for housemates and families. Every chore has effort points, and each week Chorbit deals the jobs so that everyone's points stay balanced. Tick chores off with a burst of confetti and see who did the most.

HOUSEMATES AND CHORES
• Add housemates with a name, colour and initials
• Chores with effort points from 1 to 5, a room, notes and a frequency: daily, weekly on a chosen day, every two weeks, or monthly on a chosen date
• Pause and resume chores, search them and filter by room

FAIR WEEKLY ASSIGNMENT
• Balance points (default): the biggest jobs are dealt first, each to whoever has the fewest points so far, keeping weekly totals close
• Tie-breaks favour whoever did not have that chore last week, then whoever did less in recent weeks, then a simple rotation
• Or choose a simple rotation where each chore moves to the next person every week
• A new week is dealt automatically, or tap Deal this week

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Reassign a chore to anyone or swap two chores between people
• Manually assigned chores stay pinned when you rebalance
• Reset the week if plans change

THIS WEEK
• A house board by person or by day
• Each person's board with a points ring and their fair share
• Mark a chore done, choose who actually did it, and undo if needed
• Skip a chore, or postpone it to tomorrow or into next week

LEADERBOARD AND HISTORY
• Points this week or this month
• Completion ring with done, skipped and missed counts
• History by week showing who did what

REMINDERS
An optional daily notification at the hour you choose, listing the chores still left today for you or the whole house. Permission is only requested when you turn reminders on.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Chorbit works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Continue as guest" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your household saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: Christmas Countdown & Advent
description:
How many sleeps until Christmas? See it at a glance, and open a new Advent door every day in December, right from your Home Screen.

Christmas Countdown & Advent is a cosy place to wait for the big day: a live countdown, a 24-door Advent calendar, a tree that fills with ornaments, a card maker, a chat with Santa, a gift planner and two games. It is free, with no ads and no account.

COUNT THE SLEEPS
• A big, calm countdown to Christmas Day, or to Christmas Eve if that is your big day
• Days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking live
• Show the number as "sleeps" or "days"
• Tap the wreath, the garland or the snowman and see what happens

AN ADVENT CALENDAR WITH 24 DOORS
• One new door each morning from December 1 to 24
• Behind the doors: Christmas facts, traditions from around the world, simple recipes, small things to do, warm wishes and wallpapers to save
• Missed a day? Earlier doors stay available
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose, with no spoilers
• Not December yet? Peek at the first three doors

WIDGETS FIRST
• Open today's door directly on the widget, without opening the app
• Eight widgets: Sleeps, Gifts Left and Next Event (small), Countdown + Today's door (medium), Advent Grid (large), plus three Lock Screen widgets
• The number changes at midnight on its own

DECORATE YOUR TREE
• Earn 60 ornaments by opening doors, visiting each day and playing the games
• Hang them where you like, drag them around, and choose from 16 tree styles
• Save your tree as a wallpaper, or share it as a picture

MAKE A CHRISTMAS CARD
• 54 designs: wreaths, snowy nights, lanterns, baubles and 30 cute hand-drawn characters
• Add your greeting, names and a message
• Send it as a picture, or save it in wallpaper sizes

CHAT WITH SANTA
• Ask about the reindeer, the elves, the sleigh and the North Pole
• Jokes, riddles, little stories, tongue twisters and fun facts
• A pretend chat written for this app. It runs entirely on your device, and nothing you type leaves your iPhone

PLAN YOUR GIFTS
• A gift list for everyone you are buying for, with ideas, prices and a budget per person
• Tick gifts off as you buy and see what is left

COUNT DOWN TO ANYTHING
• Add your own countdowns: New Year's Eve, a birthday, a trip
• One-off dates or ones that repeat every year

PLAY
• Juniper's Night: a story game in twelve nights. The sleigh has tipped and the gifts are falling; steer Juniper's little red sled and catch them before dawn
• Snow Shuffle: a memory game with a twist. The wind slides whole rows of ice tiles, and tells you where it will blow next

A LETTER FOR CHRISTMAS DAY
• Write a letter and seal it. It stays closed until December 25

MAKE IT YOURS
• 16 colour themes, all free, from Midnight Pine and Candy Cane to Northern Lights and Sugar Plum
• Widgets follow the theme you pick

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
• No data collected: everything stays on your iPhone
• Works offline

Merry Christmas, and happy counting!

name: Clay Hands
description:
"Clay Hands turns your phone into a warm pottery studio.

Use the camera so your hands can pinch and shape a living 3D clay form — or sculpt and glaze with touch alone. Everything runs on your device: nothing is recorded or uploaded.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Pick a blank — vase, jar, bottle, bowl, cup, sphere, column, or organic clay
• Import your own OBJ and keep shaping
• Pinch to sculpt; firm pinch digs in
• Choose glazes like celadon, sky blue, ink, persimmon, and more
• Brush color with an open fingertip
• Soft studio lighting and background moods
• Floating camera window you can drag aside
• Mirror mode so preview and gestures stay aligned
• Slow turntable you can pause anytime
• Undo, restart, save images to Photos
• Export editable OBJ / PLY for Blender and beyond
• Save progress as named records on this device

PRIVACY FIRST
Camera access is optional and only used for on-device hand tracking. Clay Hands does not record video and does not upload your feed.

Settle in. Pinch the clay. Make something that feels like yours."

name: ClayContour
description: Retrouvez dix-huit silhouettes en façonnant l’argile, étage par étage. Alternez pointe et ruban, comparez votre pièce au calque et cherchez un geste plus juste. Un atelier sans chronomètre, avec indices, annulation et progrès conservés hors ligne.

name: Clipsize: Split & Send Videos
description:
Too big to send? Don't make it blurry. Split it.

Most compressors squeeze a long video into one tiny, blurry file. Clipsize does something different: it works out whether one file can still look good at your size limit, and if it can't, it cuts the video into sharp parts that each fit. Your friend gets the whole video in 720p or 1080p, in a few messages instead of one blurry one.

SPLIT TO FIT
• Pick a limit: a messaging app (16 MB), email (25 MB), a chat server (10 MB) or your own size.
• Clipsize compares one file with parts and recommends the sharper way.
• Parts end at natural pauses or changes of shot, never in the middle of a word. Clipsize listens to the sound and looks at the picture to find them.
• See every cut on a map, tap to hear it, drag to move it.
• Compare quality before you decide: the same moment as one file and as parts, side by side.
• Split by length too: 15, 30, 60 or 90 seconds, for stories and status updates.
• Parts are named "(1 of 3)", "(2 of 3)"… and save to Photos in order.

JOIN THEM BACK
Got the parts? Join Videos puts them back into one video in the right order. Clipsize parts sort themselves, and matching clips join without re-encoding, so nothing is lost.

COMPRESS
• Hit a size target, or choose High, Medium or Small quality.
• H.264 or HEVC, picture upright, sound in sync.
• Replace the original with its smaller copy, keeping date and location.
• Library: find your largest videos and compress many at once (Pro).

MORE TOOLS
• Make a GIF: size, frame rate, speed, boomerang.
• Live Photo: turn any moment of a video into a Live Photo.
• Trim without re-encoding.
• Extract audio as M4A.
• Convert between H.264 and HEVC.

MADE TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Your videos are never uploaded.
• Share a video to Clipsize straight from Photos or any app.
• Keeps working while you use other apps.
• No watermark, no ads, no account.
• In 14 languages.

FREE AND PRO
Every tool is free for 2 results a day. Clipsize Pro removes the daily limit and adds compressing your whole library at once. Choose monthly, yearly (with a free trial for eligible new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/clipsize-legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/clipsize-legal

name: Cloudswitch & Sky Rails
description:
Pilvien yläpuolella kelluvat asemat yhdistyvät toisiinsa riippuvilla raiteilla.

Cloudswitch on rauhallinen junaliikenteen ohjauspulma. Jokaisella pienoisjunalla on selkeä määränpää. Junavaunuja ei tarvitse siirtää käsin, vaan tehtävänäsi on lukea rataverkkoa ja päättää, minkä junan tulee lähteä ensin, kuka odottaa sivuraiteella ja kohtaavatko kaksi reittiä samassa tasoristeyksessä samalla vuorolla.

Napauta solmukohtaa valitaksesi junan poistumisreitin ja opastimen tilan. Etene yksi vuoro kerrallaan tai suunnittele lyhyt toimintasarja ja seuraa sen toteutumista. Jokainen siirto tarkistetaan solmukohtien kapasiteetin, raidekonfliktien ja tasoristeysten osalta ennen muutosten tekemistä. Jos reitti ei ole turvallinen, vuoro hylätään ja ongelmakohta korostetaan, jotta voit tehdä tarvittavat muutokset.

Kuuden luvun aikana tutustut sivuraiteisiin, samanaikaisiin reitteihin, yhteisiin tasoristeyksiin, siltoihin ja ajastettuihin kulkuikkunoihin. Haasteet, reittimuistiinpanot, suunnitelmakirjat ja raideosuuksien käyttötilanteiden toistot auttavat sinua hiomaan junien saapumiset sujuviksi.

Helmenvalkoiset asemat, turkoosit palkit, lämpimän kupariset yksityiskohdat ja värikoodatut junat tekevät jokaisesta risteyksestä helposti hahmotettavan. Suunnittele etukäteen, pidä raiteet vapaina ja ohjaa kaikki junat turvallisesti kotiin tähtien valaisemalle keskusasemalle.

name: Clube Let'sGym
description:
O Clube Let'sGym é o aplicativo exclusivo das lojas parceiras da Let'sGym, marca de moda fitness. Tudo o que a sua loja precisa para comprar as coleções e aproveitar os benefícios do programa, na palma da mão.

PEDIDO DE COLEÇÃO
• Monte o pedido de cada coleção cor por cor e tamanho por tamanho.
• Veja as fotos de frente e costas de cada look e assista ao vídeo do look sem sair do app.
• Siga a ordem do desfile, busque por código ou nome e filtre por tipo de peça.
• Salve o rascunho e envie quando quiser, com as condições de pagamento da sua loja.
• Acompanhe seus pedidos e monte as peças da bonificação.

GYMPOINTS E BENEFÍCIOS
• Acumule GymPoints com as compras da loja e suba de nível: Member, Select, Signature e Icon.
• Troque pontos por brindes e acompanhe a entrega.
• Receba catálogos com acesso antecipado, promoções do seu nível e convites para eventos.
• Veja e baixe as fotos dos eventos da marca.

SUA LOJA
• Consulte boletos em aberto com a linha digitável e o crédito disponível.
• Use o app em português, espanhol ou inglês.

O acesso é liberado pela Let'sGym para lojas cadastradas, com o mesmo login do site do Clube. Ainda não é parceiro? Fale com a Let'sGym pelo Instagram @letsgymoficial.

name: ClueProof Lab
description:
Build logic grid puzzles, test which clues matter, and check that your intended answer stays unique. ClueProof Lab is an offline iPhone workshop for puzzle authors, editors, and teachers.

How it works

1. Set up your grid. Add 2 to 5 categories with 2 to 8 options per category. Use the same number of options in each category, then enter your intended matches.

2. Write your clues. Choose two options and a relationship: Same, Different, or Earlier. Earlier uses an ordered category, such as a series of time slots. Check the rule preview and write the wording your readers will see.

3. Validate your draft. The solver checks whether your intended answer satisfies the active clues and whether another solution also fits. Quick validation can stop after finding a second solution. Exact count reports a total when the search finishes and a lower bound when it stops early.

4. Test a removal. Select a clue in the margin and tap "Preview removal" to see what happens if you leave it out. Compare valid answers side by side or show only the matches that changed. Tap Take evidence on a changed match to start a replacement clue, check its wording, and run validation again.

5. Save and share. When the intended answer is unique and the clue wording has been checked, save a revision. Export a reader worksheet with blank logic grids and a separate answer key. The worksheet grids can be printed or completed in a PDF reader that supports forms.

Try it with Saturday Market. Remove the first clue to see the solution count rise from one to two and find out which vendors can switch stalls. For an example using order clues, open Print Shop Schedule from the library.

Use Trial removals to test enabled clues one at a time. Check Clue order to see how the number of possible answers changes as clues are added. Keep your work on your device, with revision history and library backup and restore. No account is required.

name: Clupube
description:
Clupube is an offline organizer for RV and campervan stays. Keep vehicle details, campsite notes, setup and departure checklists, and equipment records together without creating an account.
Create separate records for each vehicle and start a stay from a blank list, an editable starter list, or a saved setup. Add tasks with notes and owner labels, filter by owner, and mark tasks as done or not applicable.
Maintain a gear library with quantities, ownership and storage notes. Record which items were brought, enter their locations, and confirm recovery or the return of borrowed equipment. Planned storage and recorded placements are kept separate. Record partial recoveries and returns, and review each item's action history.
Review open tasks and equipment entries before recording departure. Add a note when leaving entries open, then keep cleaning, drying, repairs and other follow-ups available across stays. Browse previous stays and their recorded departure snapshots.
Save selected tasks and gear plans as reusable setups, choose a default for each vehicle, and create new versions when editing. Reused setups begin with task completion and gear progress reset. Attach photos from your library or camera to document sites, vehicles and gear.
Preview and share PDF reports with selected sections in A4 or Letter format. Export vehicle archives containing records and photos, and import them into the app. Core records and photos are stored on your device; sharing uses the service you choose.

name: Clutch Manager: Esport Coach
description:
Call the play. Win the clutch.

You are the coach of a 5v5 tactical shooter team. Build the roster, call the tactics and the buys, keep morale and money in check, then watch every round play out: on the tactical map, or in 3D from any camera.

EVERY ROUND IS REALLY PLAYED
Ten players move, shoot, throw their utility and fight over the bomb. A deterministic simulation plays each round and you watch it back, second by second.

YOU CALL THE PLAY
Between rounds you pick the tactic, call the buy and burn a timeout when the game slips away. 13 attack plans and 8 defence setups, each drawn on the current map. Before every match, ban and pick maps in the veto.

HEAR THE ROUND AS IT HAPPENS
A team voice-chat feed is written from what really happens: the calls, the info, the saves and the rotations. Every player says it in their own way, shaped by personality and mood.

PLAYERS HAVE FEELINGS
Morale, confidence, fatigue, form and chemistry rise and fall, and all of it feeds the simulation. Praise, criticise, calm down or fire up your players, and see who rises under pressure.

TAKE THEM TO THE MAJOR
A yearly circuit with 8 event windows, four tiers of 16-team events, two majors and a flagship. A rolling world ranking decides which events invite your team. Swiss stage, playoffs, and a best-of-five major final.

RUN THE CLUB
A transfer market where the other clubs trade too. Bids, free agents, contracts, sponsors, wages, youth prospects and a board that expects results. Set the weekly training and read the scouting report on your next opponent.

AN ORIGINAL WORLD
64 fictional teams, 7 original maps and 33 weapons. Everything plays offline, with no account and no ads, and your career saves by itself.

FREE TO START
The first two championships and the top-down match view are free. One purchase unlocks the full game: unlimited championships and the 3D match view. No subscriptions, no ads.

Questions or ideas? Write to us from the game (Club, Settings, Support) or at hello@softick.dev.

name: Collecting Critters
description:
Collecting Critters turns your own wildlife photographs into collectible cards.

Add a photo and the app suggests the animal. You add when and where, plus notes about the encounter. Each card has a front built around your photo, and a back with a map, the light you shot in, and a Respectful stamp you earn by giving animals space.

COLLECT
• Beautiful cards with the animal's name and rarity
• Flip any card to see the area, the light and your notes
• Filter your collection by animal group and region
• Edit any card later, or share it as a picture

PLAN
• Today: what people are seeing near you at this time of year
• Forecast: sunrise and sunset, golden hour, blue hour, weather, and when different kinds of animals are most active
• A pack list and camera starting points for the conditions

RESPECT COMES FIRST
Collecting Critters is made for photographers who care about animals. Locations are rounded to about 50 km, nests and dens can be kept private, and reminders throughout the app encourage long lenses and distance. 

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and cards stay on your iPhone. There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

name: Color War Simulator
description:
Color War Simulator is a territory battle that plays itself. Pick two colors and two abilities, or roll the dice for a random match, then watch.

• Two units fight over a board of about 170 cells. Every enemy cell a unit takes fires its ability, and the ability grows a little each time.
• 16 abilities: Rebound, Swarm, Tide, Prism, Vortex, Comet, Orbit, Chain, Seeder, Pulse, Dash, Meteor, Plague, Blink, Bastion and Mirror.
• 77 colors. Two colors too close to tell apart on the board can't be paired.
• Inner cells held for 15 seconds lock and can't be taken back.
• Matches last 45, 60 or 75 seconds. The color holding more cells when time runs out wins, unless one side locks 55% of the board first.
• Six background tracks; one is picked at random for each match.
• Works offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and no data collected.

name: ColorBank
description: O ColorBank é o catálogo digital de tintas automotivas feito para oficinas, funilaria e lojas de tinta.

name: Content Agency Tracking
description:
Content Agency Tracking ist die App zu deinem Content-Agency-Konto. Sie bringt Aufgaben, Projekte, Kunden und den Team-Chat deiner Agentur aufs iPhone, iPad und die Apple Watch – mit nativer Bedienung statt einer verkleinerten Webseite.

FÜR DEN ARBEITSTAG
• Aufgaben: offene, überfällige und heutige Aufgaben auf einen Blick, Status mit einem Tipp ändern
• Projekte und Kunden: Infos, Dateien und Verlauf an einem Ort
• Kalender: Termine und Fristen in Monats-, Wochen- und Tagesansicht
• Team-Chat: Nachrichten mit deinem Team – auf dem iPad in einem verschiebbaren, einklappbaren Fenster
• Schnell anlegen: Aufgabe, Termin, Zeit, Notiz oder Ticket über „+ Neu“ in der Tab-Leiste

GEMACHT FÜR IPHONE UND IPAD
• Native Tab-Leiste mit Zählern für offene Aufgaben und ungelesene Nachrichten
• Zuletzt geöffnete Seiten bleiben ohne Verbindung lesbar – mit Hinweis, von wann der Stand ist
• Dateien direkt aus Kamera oder Mediathek hochladen, Downloads über das Teilen-Menü
• Hell- und Dunkelmodus, große Bedienelemente für die Bedienung mit dem Finger

APPLE WATCH
• „Heute“ am Handgelenk: offene und überfällige Aufgaben, ungelesene Nachrichten und die nächsten Aufgaben. Die Uhr holt die Daten vom iPhone – eine eigene Anmeldung braucht sie nicht.

HINWEIS
Content Agency Tracking ist der Zugang zu einem bestehenden Content-Agency-Konto. Ohne Konto lässt sich die App nicht nutzen; den Zugang erhältst du von deiner Agentur.

name: Cool Coaching
description:
Cool Coach brings Steve Friederang's swim coaching system to the iPad and iPhone. Design a week of practices by energy system, see what each one really asks of your swimmers, and follow every swimmer's progress, all on deck.

PRACTICES BY ENERGY SYSTEM
Have a week designed for you (mid distance, distance, sprint or stroke), or build your own sessions set by set. Every set carries its energy system (EN1 to SP3, recovery and more), interval and holding time, and the totals show distance, time and the workout's true stress, weighed with Dr. Rick Sharp's stress factors. Fit a whole workout to a new distance or time with one tap.

LOAD WARNINGS
Add hard work the day after a lactate-heavy session and Cool Coach tells you what the swimmers did the day before. It flags weeks with too many hard sessions. Copy a session's sets to other days in a tap.

EVERY SWIMMER, MEASURED
Best times with their dates, goal times, T-30s and your own track sets. See improvement per month, race the norm, find the 50-to-100 drop-off that says sprinter or short of aerobic base, and spot cycles of more than 4% improvement in six weeks, with the training planned in those weeks. Individualize any workout for each swimmer's paces.

COACH BY VOICE
Tap the microphone and talk: "Add 6 by 100 SP1 to Tuesday." "Kat swam 1:02.5 in the 100 free." "Who is fastest in the 100 free?" "Who improved most?" "Show Kat's 100 free." Answers come with a chart, the screen follows, and "undo that" takes the last change back. Speech is turned into text on the device.

THE MEET GAME
Points for place plus points for swimming close to or beyond your own best, with team totals against expected. Build a practice meet, score one by hand, or bring in a real meet's results (Hy-Tek .sd3 or .cl2, or CSV) and see every club scored, with your swimmers measured against their best before the meet.

TOOLS
Threshold and training paces from a T-30, a pace chart, an effort chart, drop-off, and the energy systems explained.

YOURS
No account, no ads, nothing collected. Your swimmers and workouts are kept on your device and never sent anywhere.

Cool Coach is free.

name: Corkboard Personal Wine Cellar
description:
Know every bottle you own, where it is, and when to open it.

Corkboard Personal Wine Cellar is a private home for your wine collection. It is by invitation: your wine club or someone in your household sends you a link, and the app connects to your cellar from there.

YOUR CELLAR, DRAWN TRUE
Set up your real fridges and racks, shelf by shelf, then place each bottle where it actually sits. Keep several storage units, or several homes, in one cellar.

ADD AND REMOVE BOTTLES EASILY
Add a bottle by taking a photo of its label. When one leaves your cellar, record whether you opened it, gave it away, sold it or it broke, and Undo is one tap away.

KNOW WHEN TO OPEN IT
See which wines are in their drinking window, which to open soon and which should keep resting.

REMEMBER WHAT YOU THOUGHT
Rate wines, keep notes and pairings, and look back through your tasting history, whether you were at home or out.

GET A SUGGESTION FOR TONIGHT
Tell the Sommelier what you're eating and get a pick ranked from your own cellar.

SHARE IT AT HOME
Invite your household so everyone works from the same cellar, while each person keeps their own ratings.

STAY CLOSE TO YOUR CLUB
If your wine club uses Corkboard, its wines, boxes and events show up in your cellar, and you can ask the club for more of a wine you liked. Your club reviews and fulfills every request. Ratings of that club's wines, which of its wines you hold, and your requests are shared with that club.

SEE YOUR WHOLE COLLECTION
Search, sort and filter every wine, and export your inventory to Excel.

For adults 21 and older. Please enjoy wine responsibly.

name: Count To A Million
description:
A giant number fills the screen. Say it out loud – and it gets sliced in half. The next one appears. Then the next. Your goal: count all the way to 1,000,000 with nothing but your voice.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Your voice is the controller. Say each number out loud. Fast talkers can chain several numbers in one breath and build a combo.
• 16 languages. Count in English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, German, Vietnamese, Turkish, Korean, Italian, Polish or Dutch (Korean and Arabic are in beta).
• 100% offline speech recognition. Your voice never leaves your device – no account, no cloud, no internet needed.
• Bigger numbers, bigger slashes. Every 100 is a double slash, every 1,000 a golden triple slash with your split time, every 10,000 a lightning blade and a new stage colour, every 100,000 a void implosion – and 1,000,000 ends in fireworks.
• Presence checks. At every hundred, tap the letters shown on screen before time runs out. Miss, and the last 100 numbers are erased.
• Counting clock. Only the time you actually spend counting is measured.
• Progress is saved after every number.

FREE, NO ADS, NO IN-APP PURCHASES
The whole game is free. No ads, no purchases, no tracking.

A MICROPHONE IS REQUIRED
The game checks your microphone on start-up with a live level meter and tells you how to fix it if nothing is heard.

name: Courier Buddy
description:
Courier Buddy richtet sich ausschließlich an Kuriere der Ontime Courier GmbH. Die App ist ein privates, ehrenamtliches Projekt und kein offizielles Angebot der Ontime Courier GmbH. Maßgeblich sind immer die Informationen aus Schulung und Briefing.

Courier Buddy unterstützt Onboard-Kuriere bei Planung, Reiseunterlagen und Kommunikation unterwegs – übersichtlich, schnell und direkt auf dem iPhone.

TRANSPORTE IM BLICK
• Eigene und offene Transporte
• Zeitnahme Benachrichtigung, wenn sich bei deinen Transporten etwas ändert
• Briefing und Debriefing mit einem Tipp im Kalender
• Archiv, um ehemalige Transporte zu tracken

REISEUNTERLAGEN
• Reisepass, Visa und Trusted-Traveller-Programme gesammelt
• Erinnerung, bevor etwas abläuft
• Dokumente als PDF oder Foto hinterlegen

UNTERWEGS
• Persönliche Checkliste für deinen Ablauf
• Live-Aktivität auf dem Sperrbildschirm mit Ortszeit
• Kontakte zu CC und TC griffbereit

SICHER UND PRIVAT
• Alle Daten bleiben auf deinem iPhone – kein eigener Server, keine Werbung, kein Tracking
• Schutz mit Code und Face ID
• Verschlüsselte Sicherung zum Umzug auf ein neues iPhone

Verfügbar auf Deutsch und Englisch.

name: Coxons Cars Drivers Only
description: Presenting the brand new version of the Coxons Cars driver app. Besides the new design and powerful capabilities, the new driver app allows for much better location tracking with minimal battery usage.

name: Cramped Up! Trivia
description:
Think fast. Answer right. And don't get CRAMPED UP!

Welcome to Cramped Up! Trivia, the hilarious medieval trivia game where every correct answer brings you closer to the ultimate royal relief!

Take your seat on the throne above the castle moat and put your knowledge to the test. Answer trivia questions, build up the pressure, and reach your goal before time runs out.

Get enough answers right and experience THE GREAT DROP — complete with dramatic animations, hilarious reactions, and a massive splash! Run out of time and things get seriously uncomfortable for the king.

**GAME FEATURES**

- 1,200 trivia questions across 12 categories
- Four difficulty levels that challenge your knowledge
- Hilarious characters, animations, and sound effects
- Earn coins and unlock characters, thrones, and locations
- Exciting timed rounds and increasing challenges
- Colorful medieval castles and entertaining gameplay

How far can you go before getting Cramped Up?

CRAMPED UP! TRIVIA — THE GAME OF STUMP AND DUMP!

name: CrazyNaters
description:
**Welcome to CrazyNaters – Stay Informed. Join the Conversation. Have Fun!**

CrazyNaters is your place to stay connected, discover what's happening, and share your thoughts with a community of people who want to be part of the conversation.

Never feel left out! Receive notifications about important updates, community activity, and things happening around CrazyNaters. When something catches your attention, jump into the discussion, share your opinion, react, and see what other people think.

**STAY INFORMED**
- Receive notifications about community updates and activity.
- Keep up with what's happening.
- Discover topics and updates worth talking about.
- Stay connected to the conversations that interest you.

**DISCUSS, SHARE & CONNECT**
- Join discussions with other CrazyNaters members.
- Share your opinions, thoughts, and reactions.
- Meet people with similar interests.
- Be part of a community where everyone's voice matters.

**PLAY GAMES & HAVE FUN**
- Explore games and interactive activities.
- Challenge yourself and enjoy something different.
- Discover new ways to have fun with the community.

**BUILT AROUND YOUR FEEDBACK**

CrazyNaters isn't just an app we build for you. It's an app we want to build WITH you!

We believe the community should help shape the future of the platform. Your suggestions, feedback, and feature requests matter.

We want to hear what you like, what needs improvement, and what you'd love to see next. Future updates will be guided by community feedback and feature demand, helping CrazyNaters grow in the direction its users actually want.

**YOUR COMMUNITY. YOUR VOICE. YOUR CRAZYNATERS.**

Download CrazyNaters and become part of a growing community where staying informed, sharing opinions, playing games, and helping shape the future all come together.

The next great feature could start with your idea!

name: CultureKitchen
description: CultureKitchen is a complete management tool for home fermenters. It does not ferment for you. It helps you keep every culture every batch and every observation in order.

name: CurioAlbum: Collection Tracker
description:
Give every collection a place to belong. CurioAlbum is a private, offline-first organizer for cards, pins, figures, stamps, movie posters and the things you love.

• Build albums with photos, tags, notes, numbers and collection status.
• Import multiple photos and browse in grid, list and album layouts. Flip through an entire album and zoom into the details.
• Track series progress, duplicates and missing numbers.
• Keep a wishlist and move acquired items into your collection.
• Record purchases and sales, and explore your collection history in a calendar.
• Search and filter, move or delete items in batches, and export a basic gallery.
• Export a complete ZIP backup and restore by merging or replacing data.
• Available in Simplified and Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, Italian, Spanish, French and Portuguese.

The free app has unlimited albums and items, with up to 3 photos per item. Optional Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase for unlimited photos, premium themes and layouts, high-resolution and PDF export, batch field editing, advanced statistics and CSV export. No subscription or automatic renewal.

Photos and collection records stay on your device. No account or developer-operated cloud sync. Export and check your backup before deleting the app. CurioAlbum does not provide authentication, valuations or a marketplace.

Privacy Policy: https://curioalbum.typcb.cn/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://curioalbum.typcb.cn/en/terms/

name: Dad-a-Base: Dad Jokes
description:
Why did the dad bring a ladder to the bar? He heard the drinks were on the house.

If that made you groan, you're in the right place.

Dad-a-Base is the ultimate database of dad jokes: 258 hand-picked puns, riddles, and eye-rolling one-liners, ready whenever you need a laugh (or a groan).

HOW IT WORKS
Read the setup. Take a guess. Tap to reveal the punchline. Then tap "Another one!" and do it all again. You can even shake your device for a fresh joke.

WHAT'S INSIDE
