• 258 dad jokes across 7 categories: Food, Animals, Work, Family, Science, Wordplay, and Classics
• Joke of the Day: a new pick every day, the same for everyone
• Search: find any joke by a word from the setup or the punchline
• Favorites: tap the heart to save the ones that made you groan the loudest
• Share: send a joke to friends, family, or the group chat in one tap

A NATURAL VOICE
Skip the robotic voice. Every joke is read aloud in a natural, human-sounding voice, with comic timing. Tap the speaker on any joke to hear it, or turn on Read Jokes Aloud and let the app do the telling.

PERFECT TIMING
Want some suspense? Turn on the optional punchline countdown and choose 3, 5, or 10 seconds. Changed your mind? Tap "Show it now" to skip ahead.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Works offline: no Wi-Fi or signal needed
• No ads, no sign-up, no tracking
• Clean, bright design that works on iPhone and iPad
• Great for kids, grandparents, road trips, family dinners, and dads who just can't help themselves

Whether you're a dad, you have a dad, or you just love a good (bad) pun, Dad-a-Base delivers the groans.

Download now and get your daily dose of dad humor.

name: Dalil : Coran et Sunnah
description:
Dalîl réunit le Coran et la Sunnah dans une seule application, en français, pour lire, comprendre et apprendre à votre rythme.

LISEZ SELON VOTRE LECTURE
- Hafs an Asim est incluse dans l'application.
- Six autres lectures se téléchargent en un geste : Shuba, Warsh, Qalun, al-Duri, al-Bazzi et Qunbul.
- Dalîl vous montre, mot par mot, où les lectures diffèrent.

COMPRENEZ CHAQUE VERSET
- La traduction française de chaque verset.
- L'exégèse abrégée (Al-Mukhtasar fi tafsir al-Quran, Tafsir Center for Quranic Studies), en français.
- Les enseignements de chaque page du mushaf.
- La récitation, par plus de cent récitants, verset par verset, même écran verrouillé.

LA SUNNAH, AUTHENTIQUE
- 1 643 hadiths en français, tous jugés authentiques, avec leur explication.
- Classés en 267 thèmes, pour retrouver un sujet en quelques secondes.

CHERCHEZ ET GARDEZ
- Une recherche commune au Coran, à l'exégèse, aux leçons et aux hadiths.
- Marque-pages, notes, surlignages et collections.
- Un plan de lecture complète du Coran (khatm) et un outil de mémorisation.
- Des rappels doux, à l'heure où vous lisez d'habitude, que vous pouvez couper à tout moment.

APPRENEZ EN CONFIANCE
Pas de publicité, pas de compte, rien qui vous suive. Vos marque-pages, notes et progression restent sur votre téléphone. Dalîl n'écrit aucun texte religieux : chaque texte vient d'une source publiée, citée dans l'application (Sources et méthode).

Dalîl est gratuite.

name: DdayInk
description:
Keep the dates that matter in DdayInk.
Bring birthdays, anniversaries, exams, trips and days of remembrance together.

• Count down to upcoming dates and keep track of days past
• Manage recurring events and yearly anniversaries
• Set Korean lunar birthdays and remembrance dates, including leap-month handling
• Decorate events with photos, emoji and illustrated templates
• Place text on photos and adjust its size, color and position
• Use small, medium and large Home Screen widgets and Lock Screen widgets
• Set event reminders and choose your language and accent color

A quiet, paper-and-ink look for your important dates.

Your first event can be saved without watching an ad. From the second event, complete one rewarded video ad to add one new event. Ads may also appear in the event list. Editing and deleting existing events do not require watching an ad. There are no in-app purchases.

Timed lookup drills train you to find articles and tables fast in your own copy of the NEC, and a guide shows how to tab your book. The app cites numbers and explains in its own words. It never reproduces the code, so you need your own copy.

MOCK EXAMS THAT SAVE YOUR PLACE
Full-length timed practice tests matched to your exam's length and pass mark, with separate portions where your exam has them. Your place is saved automatically if you leave. Half-length mocks suit a shorter sitting, and a built-in scientific calculator and formula sheet are one tap away.

HANDS-ON LAB
• Motor-starter ladder simulators: press the buttons and watch the circuit work, with a step-by-step "How it works"
• Troubleshooting cases with a virtual multimeter: find the fault by taking readings
• Calculators that teach: voltage drop, ampacity adjustment, box fill, dwelling load and three-phase. Code-table values are ones you type in from your own book.
• A chart of electrical symbols

HOW DO I PREPARE FOR THE JOURNEYMAN ELECTRICIAN EXAM?
1. Take the diagnostic to see where you stand across every topic.
2. Follow the daily plan: review what's due, then work on your weakest topics.
3. Train your lookups in your own code book, then sit full practice exams until you're passing them in a row.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
A diagnostic sets your baseline. Mastery per topic, a readiness score and a study plan that counts down to your exam date show what to study next. Readiness is a guide, not a prediction.

FOR YOUR STATE'S EXAM
Your state sets the question count, time limit, pass mark and code edition. The app uses them where they're published, and an ICC-style exam where a state licenses locally. Study theory, load calculations, grounding and bonding, wiring methods, motors and controls, and special occupancies.

CORRECTIONS IN THE OPEN
Report a problem from any question. Every correction is listed in a public errata log. Check anything important against your code book.

ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The free sample includes the diagnostic, sample questions from every topic, all ladder simulators, the calculators and some drills and cases. One purchase unlocks the rest, including new questions as they're added. No account, no ads, no analytics. Works offline. In English and Spanish.

NOT AFFILIATED
This is an independent study aid. It isn't affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by NFPA, the International Code Council, PSI, Pearson VUE, or any government or licensing board. It doesn't provide government services. NFPA 70®, National Electrical Code® and NEC® are registered trademarks of the National Fire Protection Association. Questions are original practice items, not real exam questions. Exam formats come from each authority's published information: check your own authority's site for current rules.

name: Eye Age Simulator
description:
"Eye Age Simulator" lets you experience how aging and cataract change the way the eye sees. It was developed by Kazunori Asada (Ph.D. Medical Science and Media Design), using a literature-based calculation of the eye's optics.

As we age, the lens of the eye yellows and more light scatters inside the eye, which increases glare and haze. In a cataract the lens becomes cloudy, and how things look depends on where it is cloudy (nuclear, cortical or posterior subcapsular).

"Eye Age Simulator" applies a calculation of the eye's optics (yellowing of the lens, blur, and glare and haze from opacities) to a sample photo, the camera video or a photo from Photos, and shows it next to the original image and a normal eye.

- Choose from three views: "Original", "Normal" (a normal eye at the set age) and "Cataract". Each chosen view becomes a panel, so you can compare them side by side.
- Set the age (20 to 90, in steps of 5) to see the lens yellowing and light scatter (glare and haze) of that age.
- Turn the cataract types (Nuclear, Cortical, PSC) on or off, and set the progress (0 to 100%) of each type. More than one type can be on at the same time.
- Switch "Dark pupil" (the pupil opened in the dark) and "Color adapt" (getting used to the yellowing).
- Choose from 50 sample photos grouped by scene (night driving, at home, reading and more).
- The calculation is applied directly to the rear and front camera video and to photos from Photos. Pinch to zoom up to 500%.
- With an HDR photo that has a gain map (an iPhone HDR photo, Android Ultra HDR or the ISO 21496-1 format), the glare of strong lights such as headlights and street lamps is shown according to their strength. 44 of the 50 samples are HDR. The camera video shows the glare only on devices that can record HDR (HLG).
- In the research settings, change the values of the eye's optics one by one. The full set of values can be saved and loaded as JSON, and values saved in the Web Edition can be loaded too.
- Save the screen to Photos. The panel names, the age and the progress can be written on the saved image (switch in Settings). With the camera, you can also save with the volume buttons.
- On devices with a wide color gamut (Display P3), images are shown and saved in the wide color gamut.
- Works with VoiceOver.
- Available in Japanese and English.
- Images and settings are not sent anywhere. Camera video and photos are processed only on your device.
- The theory is published on the website.
  https://asada.website/eyeagesimulator/e/theory.html
- The Web Edition, which runs in a web browser, is also available.
  https://asada.website/webEAS/

Notes
This app is an experience tool to help you understand how aging and cataract change vision. It is not a medical device. It cannot be used for diagnosis, treatment or vision testing. If you are concerned about symptoms in your eyes, please see an eye doctor. The numbers are literature-based estimates, and how things look differs between people.

Factoo hands you a science fact you didn't know, every day. It takes about a minute: on the commute, with your coffee, or before a trivia night.

- Central Financial Dashboard
View your total monthly EMI, paid amounts, outstanding loan balances, and upcoming due dates in a unified executive overview.

Track all active, pending, overdue, and completed loans. Store essential terms including loan name, lender institution, loan amount, interest rate, tenure, and monthly installment.

- Homeowners managing residential mortgage schedules and property taxes.

name: Foooot Party
description:
One ball. Every phone.

Foooot Party turns the phones around the table into one big football pitch. The ball is only ever on one screen at a time: tilt your phone to roll it, and send it off the left or right edge to pass it on. It comes out on another player's screen exactly as it left yours.

HOW TO PLAY
• One player creates a game and shows the QR code. Everyone else scans it. That's it: no account, no setup.
• Tilt your phone to roll the ball. Knock the phone sharply to head the ball high and far.
• Every now and then, a goal circle opens on a random phone — often not yours. Pass the ball around until it reaches that phone.
• Roll the ball into the circle, tap the screen, and score!

WHO'S ON YOUR RIGHT?
The app secretly decides the passing order, not where people sit. Nobody knows at first whose phone the ball will land on when it leaves the right edge — or the left. Working out the circle together, and passing faster and faster, is the whole game.

PLAY TOGETHER
The score belongs to the whole group: everyone scores together, and it never goes down. Every bounce counts, every goal counts, and a quick shot earns a bonus.

Every 10 points, the pitch changes — clay, fire, a temple, the seabed, the Moon… — and the app reshuffles the circle: everyone has to find their new neighbors.

Best with 3 players or more, sitting around a table. Playable with 2, and there's a solo demo to see how it works.

• Free, no ads, no account
• No personal data collected
• An internet connection is required to link the phones

name: Formwerk Fitness
description:
Formwerk Fitness ist deine App für Training und Ernährung. Statt zwei Apps und zwei Abos hast du alles an einem Ort: Laufen, Krafttraining, Kalorien und Makros.

LAUFEN UND MEHR
• GPS-Aufzeichnung für Laufen, Gehen, Wandern, Rad, Trail, E-Bike, Inlineskaten, Skilanglauf und Rudern
• Kilometer-Zeiten, Intervalle, Tempo-Wächter und Geisterlauf gegen deine eigene Bestzeit
• Strecke nach Tempo eingefärbt, eigene Segmente, Heatmap aller Wege
• Routen planen mit Abbiege-Ansagen
• Import von GPX-, TCX- und FIT-Dateien

KRAFTTRAINING
• Sätze, Gewichte und Wiederholungen mit einem Tipp
• Pausen-Timer, Rekorde, geschätztes Maximalgewicht
• Über 70 Übungen mit Anleitung, eigene Übungen und Routinen

ERNÄHRUNG
• Kalorien und Makros mit Barcode-Scanner
• Essen per Foto, per Satz oder per Sprache eintragen (Pro)
• Wasser, Fasten, Wochenplan mit Einkaufsliste
• Vitamine und Mineralstoffe im Überblick

PLÄNE UND ZIELE
• Trainingspläne vom Einstieg bis zum Zielrennen
• Eigene Pläne bauen oder von der KI erstellen lassen (Pro)
• Wochenziel, Abzeichen und Monats-Challenge

COMMUNITY (FREIWILLIG)
• Freunden folgen, Trainings teilen, Kudos und Kommentare
• Clubs mit Wochen-Rangliste und Bestenlisten auf Segmenten
• Live-Standort für Familie und Freunde während des Trainings
• Anmeldung mit Apple, nichts wird ohne dein Zutun geteilt

DEINE DATEN
• Alles liegt auf deinem iPhone. Ein Konto brauchst du nur für die Community. Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.
• Apple Health: Trainings, Gewicht, Schlaf und Schritte
• Sicherung und Export jederzeit

FORMWERK PRO
Eigene Pläne, Auswertungen, KI-Funktionen, Wochenplan, Rezept-Import, Routen und Farbwelten. Als Jahresabo, Monatsabo oder Einmalkauf.

Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, wenn es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf gekündigt wird. Verwalten und kündigen kannst du es in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Kontos.

Formwerk ersetzt keine ärztliche Beratung.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://formwerk.rttnsdsgnr.workers.dev/nutzungsbedingungen
Datenschutz: https://formwerk.rttnsdsgnr.workers.dev/datenschutz

name: Fotosieb: Fotos löschen
description:
Dein iPhone ist voll? Fotosieb sucht die Fotos und Videos, die du nicht brauchst, und du entscheidest mit einem Wisch, was bleibt. Ohne Abo, ohne Werbung, ohne Konto. Alles wird auf deinem iPhone berechnet.

WAS FOTOSIEB FINDET
• Ähnliche Fotos: Aus zehn fast gleichen Bildern einer Serie bleibt das schärfste mit den besten Gesichtern.
• Doppelte: Kopien und gleiche Bilder, auch wenn sie verschieden groß sind.
• Große Videos: Die größten Speicherfresser zuerst, zum Ansehen vor dem Löschen.
• Alte Screenshots, Fotos aus WhatsApp und Co., Fehlschüsse (verwackelt, schwarz, leer).
• Zettel, Belege und abfotografierte Bildschirme. Belege zeigt Fotosieb, wählt sie aber nie für dich aus.

MIT EINEM WISCH
Links weg, rechts behalten, nach oben später. Wisch dich Monat für Monat durch deine Mediathek. Was du wegwirfst, landet zuerst im Papierkorb von Fotosieb. Gelöscht wird erst, wenn du es dort bestätigst.

TAGESRUNDE UND SERIE
Jeden Tag ein paar Fotos, statt alles auf einmal. Schaffst du dein Ziel, wächst deine Serie. Ein verpasster Tag pro Woche unterbricht sie nicht. Gibt es Fotos von heute vor ein paar Jahren, beginnt die Runde mit ihnen. Auf Wunsch erinnert dich Fotosieb abends, wenn die Runde noch offen ist.

PLATZ SPAREN, OHNE ZU LÖSCHEN
• Videos verkleinern: 4K-Videos in Full HD, das spart oft mehr als die Hälfte.
• Videos kürzen: Nur die besten Sekunden behalten, in voller Qualität.
• Live Photos als normale Fotos speichern.
Datum, Ort und Alben bleiben erhalten.

WIDGET UND ERFOLGE
Das Widget zeigt deine Serie, die heutige Runde und den freien Speicher. Unter „Erfolge“ siehst du, wie viel Platz du schon frei gemacht hast, und sammelst Abzeichen.

DEINE FOTOS BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Fotosieb hat keinen Server und kein Konto. Gespeichert werden nur Messwerte, keine Bilder und kein erkannter Text. Favoriten und Fotos in eigenen Alben schlägt Fotosieb nie vor.

Fotosieb ist kostenlos. Es gibt kein Abo, keine Werbung und kein Tageslimit.

name: Frame Desk
description:
Pinclave takes screenshots off your camera roll and turns them into store pages you can ship. Name the project, pick store sizes, portrait or landscape, a base language, then import from Photos or Files. Apply a style once. The editor is for headlines, mockups, fill, layout, elements and layers; preview shows Get, then you reorder and export. A panorama can Preview as slices and Split back.

Projects, designs and exports stay listed so you can continue editing. Brand kit and Ideas keep the look. Add language puts headlines on the selected locale. When Photos access is off, Open Settings is on the card, with Choose files next to it.

Nothing needs an account. Work stays on this iPhone.

name: FUGS Connect
description:
FUGS Connect lets you control a Canon EOS R5 Mark II from your iPad or Mac over Wi-Fi. Leave the camera on the tripod, compose on the big screen and shoot remotely.

Designed around what a photographer needs on location for architecture, interior and industrial work.

LIVE VIEW
• Live view on a large screen, 1× / 6× / 15× magnification
• Tap to focus, focus peaking, histogram, grid lines
• Full-screen mode: just the image, zoom and shutter

SHOOTING
• Shutter speed, aperture, ISO, exposure compensation, white balance, Picture Style
• HDR / exposure bracketing: 3, 5, 7 frames, presets
• Self-timer and interval shooting, bulb
• Focus bracketing

MOVIE
• Start/stop recording, remaining time
• Recording format, size, frame rate, compression; Canon-style status bar

GALLERY
• Shots on the card appear on your iPad instantly; JPEG, RAW and video filters
• Ratings (written to the camera too), compare, histogram
• Download, save to Photos, delete from card
• On Mac: copies every new shot to a folder of your choice while it's written to the card

THE CAMERA'S MENU
• Shoot, AF, Playback, Wireless and Setup tabs in the camera's own colors

English and Turkish. No account, subscription, ads or data collection. Everything stays on the local network between you and the camera; no internet required.

Compatibility: Canon EOS R5 Mark II. The camera and iPad/Mac must be on the same Wi-Fi network (outdoors, your phone's personal hotspot is enough).

Canon and EOS are trademarks of Canon Inc. FUGS Connect is not affiliated with Canon.

name: Furrowmark
description: ಶೀತರಕ್ಷೆ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ; ಒಳಾಂಗಣ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ, ನೇರ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ, ಕಳೆಯುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ಕಾಲವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ. ಬ್ಯಾಚ್ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ಹಂತವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಕುರುಹು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ — ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಈ ಫೋನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

name: Gem Mosaic: Ocean Puzzle
description:
Pick up gems by colour, drop them into trays and watch a pixel picture of the sea come to life.

Gem Mosaic is a relaxing colour sorting puzzle with a twist: every level is a mosaic. Tap a group of gems of one colour, send it to a tray, and the gems fly onto the cells that need that colour. Fill every cell before the timer runs out.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a group of same-coloured gems to pick it up
• Tap a tray to move the gems there
• Gems of the right colour fly onto the picture by themselves
• Plan ahead: trays are limited and the clock is ticking

FEATURES
• 2,000 levels: fish, whales, turtles, octopuses, ships, islands, crowns and more
• Bright candy-coloured pixel art with glossy gems
• Super hard levels: one big ocean scene played in four parts
• Boosters when you are stuck: magnet, brush, extra time and an extra tray
• Daily rewards and Gem Pass with prizes for every level
• Short sessions, easy to learn, hard to put down
• Plays in 14 languages

Gem Mosaic is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases (coins, boosters, Gem Pass and ad removal).

Questions or ideas? Write to us from the Support page. We read every message.

name: Genset: Generator Hours
description:
When the power goes out, the last thing you want to do is hunt for a notebook. Genset puts generator run hours, service schedules, fuel estimates and expenses in one place. It works completely offline and is designed for owners, workshops, offices and small businesses.

TRACK EVERY RUN
Start and stop a generator’s timer with one tap. The timer remembers its start time when you close the app. Add missed runs by hand, adjust the hour meter, and manage separate profiles for each generator.

PLAN MAINTENANCE
Schedule oil changes, filters, coolant, belts and other service by running hours, calendar days or both. See what’s due soon and what’s overdue. Mark work complete to record the meter, cost, workshop and notes and start the next service interval.

KNOW WHAT YOU SPEND
Estimate fuel use from running hours, consumption rate and the fuel price you enter. Log fuel purchases, parts and labour. Compare monthly hours, sessions, operating costs and cost per hour, with daily usage, six-month trends and a breakdown by generator.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS LOCAL
Reminders are scheduled on your device when you enable them. Your records stay in a local database. Copy a backup, restore one when needed or erase your data in Setup. There are no accounts, ads, analytics, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: Gilded Peaks Solitaire
description:
Find your rhythm in a warm, uncluttered take on TriPeaks solitaire. Play an exposed card one rank above or below the waste, connect King and Ace, and clear all three peaks.

• Fresh random deals whenever you want
• A solvable daily climb with a daily completion streak
• Undo until you save the result
• Optional hints, best runs and personal best times
• Larger cards and a full-size exposed-card list
• Local game records, no game account required

Some daily deals may repeat. Ordinary gameplay works offline. Ads and purchases require internet access. An optional one-time purchase removes all ads and makes hints free. Hints are also free when no ad is available.

Limited developer usage data helps improve the app. Settings includes controls to turn collection off and request deletion. Ad privacy choices are separate.

name: Gilded Pyramid Solitaire
description:
Pair two cards that add up to 13, clear the pyramid, and come back tomorrow for a new daily deal.

Gilded Pyramid Solitaire is the classic Pyramid card game in warm ivory, deep teal, and gold. The rules take a minute to learn: tap two exposed cards that total 13 to remove them. Kings are worth 13, so they clear on their own. Remove every card in the pyramid to win.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- Play: a fresh random deal whenever you have a few minutes.
- Daily deal: one deal per day, the same for everyone on that date. Every daily deal has a solution.
- Win the daily deal on consecutive days to build your streak.

CLASSIC RULES
- Ace counts as 1, Jack 11, Queen 12, King 13.
- Pair cards in the pyramid with each other or with the top card of the waste pile.
- Turn cards from the stock one at a time, and go back through the stock up to two more times per game.
- How to play is always available in Settings.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT
- Unlimited undo, all the way back to the first move.
- Hints point out a move when you need a fresh look at the board. Unlock a hint by watching a rewarded ad, or use hints freely after removing ads.

YOUR PROGRESS
- Track your wins, best time, and daily streak.
- See your time and move count after every game, and share the result with a friend.
- Statistics stay on your device. No account or sign-in required.

ADS AND PURCHASE
This game includes ads. An optional one-time purchase removes all ads and makes hints free. Purchases can be restored from Settings.

name: Glint: Dot Puzzle
description:
Glint is a match-three game drawn in dots.

Swap two pieces to line up three or more of a kind. Every piece is a small glyph of lit dots: a diamond, a ring, a cross, bars, a wedge, a block. A match scatters into sparks and sends a ripple across the board, and long chains set the whole world stirring.

SIXTY LEVELS, SIX WORLDS
The path runs through Dawn, Tide, Ember, Frost, Void and Prism, ten levels in each. Every world is a place drawn in dots behind its levels, with its own palette, its own pieces, its own music and its own blockers. Boards change shape as you go. Reach a score, collect a kind, or break the frost, for up to three stars.

SPECIALS AND COMBOS
Four in a line makes a Beam. An L or a T makes a Pulse. Five in a line makes a Prism. Swap two specials together and they combine. Swap on the beat of the music for a little more.

A NEW GLINT EVERY DAY
The daily glint is the same level for everyone, with a twist that changes the rules for the day. A weekly challenge opens every Monday. Keep a streak, and compare best scores with friends on Game Center if you like.

OFF THE PATH
Endless runs after the last level. Zen, with no moves to count and nothing to reach. Blitz, sixty seconds for points. And each month opens a seasonal world of its own, with pieces drawn just for it, for as long as the month lasts.

SMALL THINGS
A pet made of dots lives on the edge of the board and answers your play. Long chains are kept as photos in Best moments. Now and then a piece drops in shiny, for the album. Boosters are earned with stars, never bought. Turn on Weather in the world and the worlds take on the sky where you are.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. Nothing to buy. Nothing tracked. It plays offline. Your progress syncs through your own iCloud.

name: Glow Up Pal
description:
Glow Up Pal is a warm, friendly calorie and nutrition tracker with something extra: Glow goals for the nutrients that support healthy skin and healthy aging.

LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
- Search thousands of foods with full nutrition from USDA FoodData Central, built in and working offline
- Scan packaged food barcodes
- Describe a meal in plain words, like "2 eggs and toast with butter", and check the matches before you log
- Quick add, recent foods and copy yesterday's meals

GLOW SCANNER
- Scan a packaged food barcode to see its Glow rating from 0 to 100
- See what makes up the rating: nutrition quality from the public Nutri-Score inputs, processing level (NOVA), additives some experts recommend limiting, and a bonus for skin-friendly nutrients
- Each flagged additive comes with a plain one-line note and its source (EU, EFSA, WHO)
- Pick your allergens and get a clear banner when a product lists one
- Better choices: similar products with a higher Glow rating
- Scan history, and log any scanned product to your diary in one tap
- Product data from Open Food Facts; always check the package label

CALORIES AND MACROS
- A daily calorie goal based on your age, height, weight and activity
- Protein, carbs and fat rings that fill as you eat
- Weight log with a trend chart, day streaks and a weekly report

GLOW GOALS
- Daily rings for vitamin C, vitamin E, vitamin A, zinc, selenium, omega-3, protein and water
- One Glow score from 0 to 100 that shows how today is going
- Smart tips like "Low on vitamin E today, a handful of almonds gets you to about 60%"
- See which foods each nutrient came from, with 7-day charts
- Targets based on NIH daily recommended amounts for your age and sex, with sources in the app

HYDRATION
- Tap to add a glass or bottle; tea, coffee, juice and sparkling water count too
- A daily water goal from your weight and activity
- Gentle reminders that stop once you reach your goal

APPLE HEALTH AND WIDGETS
- Optionally read steps, active energy, workouts and weight from Apple Health, and save the food and water you log
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for calories, Glow score and water

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your diary stays on your iPhone. Barcode lookups send only the barcode number to Open Food Facts, and better choices send only the product category. Your allergen list stays on your phone.

Glow Up Pal shares general wellness information. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition.

name: Go Yap: Daily Content Creator
description:
Want to make content where you just talk to the camera, but freeze up every time you hit record? Go Yap helps you build the confidence to talk on camera.

FILM A VIDEO EVERY DAY
Record straight from the app, then share it to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or wherever you post. Every day you post keeps your streak alive.

SET YOUR GOAL
Pick how many days in a row you want to post and when you want to post by. Go Yap keeps you on track with reminders, a countdown on your lock screen, and streak milestones along the way.

GET BETTER WITH LESSONS
Choose a topic and something to work on, then film a short practice video. Review it three ways: the full video, audio only to hear your voice, and muted to see your movement. Take notes on each, and watch yourself improve take after take.

A CAMERA BUILT FOR TALKING
Teleprompter, countdown timer, grid, level line, flash, and recording lengths up to 10 minutes.

MEET GOYAP
Goyap is your goldfish sidekick. He gives you a new tip every day to help you sound more natural on camera.

WIDGETS
Keep your streak, Goyap’s tips, and your next lesson right on your home screen.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your videos stay on your phone. No account, nothing uploaded.

Start talking. Start posting.

name: Gongweft
description: Gongweft — ਆਪਣੀ ਬੈਠਕ ਜਾਂ ਕੰਮ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਦਾ ਵਿਰਾਮ ਘੰਟੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਖੰਡੇ ਅੰਤਰਾਲ, ਹੌਲੀ-ਹੌਲੀ ਵਧਦੇ ਵਕਫ਼ੇ, ਚੁੱਪ ਦੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਤੇ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਸੈੱਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਛਹ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਬੋਲ ਆਵਾਜ਼ਾਂ, ਫੁੱਲ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਟਾਈਮਰ; ਕੋਈ ਖਾਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਇਸੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: Gowell
description:
Gowell är appen för dig som är ambassadör för Gowell, den sockerfria och koffeinfria drycken med 13 vitaminer, mineraler och Q10. Här har du allt du behöver för att dela Gowell med folk du känner, och full koll på vad det ger.

DIN KOD OCH DIN LÄNK
Du får en egen kod som ger dina kunder rabatt på flak i gowellshop.se. Kopiera koden eller länken med ett tryck och skicka den till vänner, familj, laget eller klassen.

FÄRDIGT MATERIAL ATT DELA
Bilder och filmer från Gowell, klara att dela direkt till Instagram, TikTok eller ett meddelande. Texten följer med, och materialet är redan märkt som reklam.

FÖLJ DINA FLAK OCH DIN PROVISION
Se länkbesök, väntande och godkända flak och din provision på ett ställe. Du får gratisflak när du har sålt 5 och 10 flak, och provision från flak 11, enligt programvillkoren.

DIN RESA SOM AMBASSADÖR
En kort första vecka med en liten sak om dagen, milstolpar och märken som visar hur långt du har kommit.

FÖR FÖRENINGAR OCH KLASSER
Föreningar och skolklasser kan vara ambassadörer tillsammans och samla in pengar till laget eller klassresan.

STEG FRÅN APPLE HÄLSA
Om du vill kan appen visa hur många steg du har gått i dag, med data från Apple Hälsa. Det är frivilligt, appen läser bara antal steg och stegen stannar i telefonen.

TRYGGT OCH ENKELT
Logga in med e-post eller mobilnummer och lösenord, och öppna appen med Face ID om du vill. Du bestämmer själv om du syns på topplistan. Du kan radera ditt konto direkt i appen.

Bli ambassadör genom att ansöka i appen. Du godkänner programvillkoren när du ansöker. Utbetalning av provision sköts av Gowell AB utanför appen. Appen säljer ingenting och har inga köp i appen.

RAISE. YOUR. STANDARD.

name: Guangzhou Guide Bangla
description:
Explore Guangzhou with ease! ভ্রমণ, হালাল খাবার, হোটেল, পাইকারি বাজার ও shopping-এর সম্পূর্ণ গাইড-সব এক অ্যাপে!

গুয়াংজুতে আসুন, সরাসরি গাইড হিসেবে পাশে পাবেন চীনে অধ্যয়নরত বাংলাদেশি ছাত্র মিনহাজকে , আমি এই অ্যাপের ডেভেলপার, উপভোগ করুন সহজ ও আনন্দময় Guangzhou ভ্রমণ এক অ্যাপে!

গুয়াংজু গাইড বাংলা চীনের গুয়াংজুতে আসা বাংলাভাষী ভ্রমণকারী ও ব্যবসায়ীদের জন্য একটি সহজ গাইড। সব তথ্য বাংলায় লেখা, সঙ্গে চীনা নাম ও ঠিকানাও আছে।

খাবার: হালাল ও দক্ষিণ এশীয় রেস্টুরেন্ট, এলাকা ও হালাল অবস্থা দিয়ে ফিল্টার
হোটেল: ইউয়ানে আনুমানিক দাম, সানইউয়ানলি ও শিয়াওবেই বাজারের কাছে 
দর্শনীয় স্থান ও শপিং: ক্যান্টন টাওয়ার, পাইকারি বাজার ও শপিং মল
বার ও রাতের জীবন: পাব, বার ও ক্লাব
মেট্রো: প্রধান লাইনের অফলাইন রুট খোঁজা
ট্যাক্সি কার্ড: এক ট্যাপে ড্রাইভারকে চীনা ঠিকানা দেখান
বাক্যাংশ বই: বাংলা উচ্চারণসহ ম্যান্ডারিন বাক্য ও অডিও
জরুরি সাহায্য: গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নম্বর ও দেখানোর মতো চীনা বাক্য
দরকারি অ্যাপ: উইচ্যাট, আলিপে, পেমেন্ট ও সিমের পরামর্শ

কোনো লগইন বা অ্যাকাউন্ট নেই। প্রিয় তালিকা শুধু আপনার ফোনে থাকে। মূল গাইড অফলাইনেও চলে।

হোটেলের দাম আনুমানিক, মেট্রো মানচিত্র লাইভ নয়, আর হালাল তথ্য শুধু দিকনির্দেশনার জন্য। রেস্টুরেন্টে গিয়ে যাচাই করে নিন।

Guangzhou Guide Bangla is a simple city guide for Bangla-speaking travelers and business visitors in Guangzhou, China. Everything is explained in Bangla, with Chinese names and addresses beside it.

Food: halal and South Asian restaurants, with filters by area and halal status
Hotels: estimated prices in yuan, near the Sanyuanli and Xiaobei trade markets
Sights and shopping: Canton Tower, wholesale markets and malls
Bars and nightlife: pubs, bars and clubs
Metro: offline route finder for the main lines
Taxi Card: show the driver the Chinese address in one tap
Phrasebook: Mandarin phrases with Bangla pronunciation and audio

name: Habits: Streak Tracker
description:
Habits is a simple, private habit tracker that helps you build good routines and quit bad ones, without ads, accounts or a pricey subscription.

TRACK ANY HABIT
• Daily, specific weekdays, every few days, or a number of times per week or month
• Count habits like "8 glasses of water" or "20 pages"
• Timer habits with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen
• Quit habits: count the days since you stopped smoking, sugar or late-night scrolling
• Morning, afternoon and evening sections, plus areas like Health or Work

STAY ON TRACK
• Streaks, badges and a gentle way to restore a broken streak
• Multiple reminders per habit
• Notes and mood for each day
• Pause habits while you're on holiday without losing your streak

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Weekly, monthly and 3-month insights
• Year heatmap of every day you showed up

WORKS EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: tick off habits without opening the app

name: Halo Authenticator
description:
Halo Authenticator generates time-based one-time codes (TOTP) for accounts that use two-step verification. See the current code, its countdown, and a preview of the next code by default.

• Scan a QR code with the camera, import a QR image from Photos, or enter a setup key or otpauth link.
• Generate verification codes offline, with no Halo account required.
• Tap to copy a code, or search, sort, edit, and delete your saved entries.
• Keep setup keys encrypted on your device. You can also hide codes until you tap them or while recording your screen.

Setup keys aren’t included in device backups. Keep the recovery codes provided by each service, and set up and verify your accounts on your new device before erasing the old one.

name: Hide Quickly! - Hide & Seek
description:
A 3D game where you run from Mom and hide around the house.

■ Easy rules
Don't let Mom find you! Stay safe for 60 seconds to win. If she catches you, or opens your hiding spot, you lose.

■ Run, jump, crouch
Slide on the left side of the screen to walk. Use the buttons to jump and crouch. Crouch to crawl under the table or hide behind the sofa. Jump on the bed and bounce like a trampoline.

■ 10 hiding spots
Closet, under the blanket, bathtub, curtain, toilet, fridge, toy box... Stand in front of a numbered spot and press the button to hide inside. But stay in one place too long and Mom will come to check. When you hear her footsteps, make a run for it!

■ Two views
Look down on the whole house like a dollhouse, or see through your own eyes in first person. Switch anytime with one button. In first person, you can peek out through a gap while you hide.

■ Mom is scary (but funny)
She comes home shouting "I'm home!" When she spots you, she yells "Did you do your homework?!" and chases you with a slipper. If she steps on toy blocks: "OUCH!" Escape her, and she falls asleep right there.

■ Upright or sideways
Play with your phone held upright or sideways.

name: Hit Factor Estimator
description:
Hit Factor Estimator turns a stage briefing into a plan. Count the paper and steel, set the hits you expect and the time you can shoot it in, and see your hit factor before you walk the stage.

WHAT IT DOES
• Handgun, PCC, Rifle, Mini Rifle, Shotgun and Action Air, with Major and Minor scoring locked where the discipline fixes it
• Paper targets, 5-point and 10-point steel, misses, no-shoots and procedurals
• Builds your stage time from your own draw, splits, transitions, movement and reloads, or takes a time you enter
• Shows what a C, a D or a penalty costs you in seconds on that stage, and when a makeup shot pays
• Hit factor at one and two seconds faster or slower
• Your stage percentage and stage points against the winner's hit factor
• Save stages to a match and see your total points, time and estimated match percentage
• My times: save your own splits, transitions and reloads for each discipline
• Stage notes, and plans you can share with your squad
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking: your stages stay on your device

SCORING
Follows the current IPSC scoring values: paper A 5, C 3, D 1 for Minor and A 5, C 4, D 2 for Major; steel 5 points (10 where the briefing says so); misses, no-shoots and procedurals −10 each. Hit factor is points divided by seconds.

ONE PRICE
Pay once. No subscription and nothing to buy inside the app.

Estimates only: official scores come from the match officials, and the rulebook and your match briefing always take priority. Hit Factor Estimator is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Practical Shooting Confederation.

Terms of Use: https://grithone.com/hit-factor/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://grithone.com/hit-factor/privacy/

name: Hits Frecuencia Latina
description:
Una señal creada para quienes buscan vivir la música y la cultura desde una frecuencia diferente.
Sonido, identidad y conexión en constante evolución.
Más que una señal, un movimiento.

Hits Frecuencia Latina es la app para escuchar esa señal en vivo desde tu iPhone o iPad. Mira la canción que suena, sigue la radio con la pantalla bloqueada y quédate cerca de la cabina.

Qué puedes hacer:
• Escuchar la transmisión en vivo
• Ver el título, el artista y la portada cuando están disponibles
• Pausar y reanudar desde la app, la pantalla bloqueada o el Centro de control

• Abrir WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook e Instagram de la estación
• Usar el temporizador de 15, 30, 45 o 60 minutos
• Cambiar entre modo claro y modo oscuro
• Compartir la estación

Sonido, identidad y conexión, en la palma de tu mano.

name: HLTerminal for Hyperliquid
description:
Find quiet focus in HLTerminal for Hyperliquid, a calm, minimal balance-scale puzzle game crafted for thoughtful offline play.

Place weighted stones onto the left and right pans of a precision balance scale. Watch the beam tilt live in proportion to the weight difference, adjust your placements with a tap or smooth drag-and-drop, and feel the gentle bloom animation when both sides settle into equilibrium.

FIVE CHAMBERS, FORTY HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
- Chamber 1 · First Balance: Warm up with weights 1–6 and guided coach tips as you learn the core rhythm.
- Chamber 2 · Raise the Span: Heavier stones up to weight 12 arrive alongside Limited Tray puzzles where selected stones must remain unused.
- Chamber 3 · Twin Stones: Linked twin pairs travel together and always rest on the same pan.
- Chamber 4 · Double Tide: One pan carries a ×2 tide multiplier, doubling the effective weight of every stone placed on it.
- Chamber 5 · Locked Garden: Combine fixed Locked anchors and left-only Fragile glass stones with all previous rules.

EARN THREE MARKS ON EVERY LEVEL
- Balance Mark: Level both pans while meeting the required pebble count.
- Precision Mark: Solve the puzzle in the minimum possible number of moves.
- Calm Mark: Balance the scale without using a Hint.

BUILT FOR PEACE OF MIND
- 100% offline gameplay — play anywhere with no Wi-Fi or cellular connection required.
- Free, unlimited solver-backed Hints, full Undo move stack, and instant Reset on every level.
- Marks Ledger tracks your totals across all 5 chambers with one-tap Improve replay on incomplete levels.
- Thoughtful accessibility with Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels on pebbles and pans, non-color rule indicators, and Reduce Motion support.
- No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, and no in-app purchases.

name: Holiday Atlas
description:
Want to know who's off, and when? Holiday Atlas shows public holidays for every country you care about and tells you right away whether your date is a working day there.

DATE CHECK
Pick a single day or a date range. For each country you see whether it's a working day, a holiday or a weekend – and which holiday it is. The app follows each country's own weekend and knows about make-up working days.

UPCOMING HOLIDAYS
The next 90 days across all your countries in one list. The same holiday in several countries is a single row.

CALENDAR AND FULL YEAR
A month view with dots in your countries' colors and the whole year on one screen. See at a glance when holidays cluster and when things are quiet.

COUNTRIES AND REGIONS
245 countries and territories and 589 regions: states, provinces, cantons. Bavaria is not Berlin, and Catalonia is not Madrid.

HOLIDAYS IN APPLE CALENDAR
One switch creates a dedicated calendar with the holidays of your countries. The app keeps it up to date and never touches your other calendars. It's optional – everything works without it.

SHORTCUTS AND SPOTLIGHT
Check a date or find the next holiday without opening the app.

WORKS OFFLINE
All data is inside the app. On a plane, abroad without roaming, anywhere.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics. The app collects no data.

FREE AND PRO
The free version has every feature for 3 countries and up to 3 regions in each. You can swap countries at any time. Holiday Atlas Pro is a one-time purchase with no subscription: unlimited countries and regions.

ABOUT THE DATA
Holidays for 2026–2028; new years arrive with app updates. Dates of some lunar-calendar holidays are estimates and are marked as such. Source: the open-source python-holidays project.

Support: support@shuplik.com

name: HolmSalver
description: HolmSalver is a tilting-tray puzzle. Drag the tray or tilt your phone so eight kinds of animals roll into a hole of their own kind. Light ones slide fast, heavy ones shove their neighbors, and a steep tip can spill them off the rim. Twelve boards add posts and shifting wind. Combos, time left, and spills decide your stars. Best scores and stars stay on this phone.

name: Home of Sports
description:
Welcome to our Home of Sports app!

We’re glad you’re here.
With our app, you’ll have everything you need for your workouts and our gym right at your fingertips.

Discover our offerings, plan your workouts, and stay up to date.

We want to support you as best we can on your journey toward your personal goals :-)

We’re glad you’re part of our community

You can sync this app with Apple Health App. If you enable this connection, any workout in the Health app with automatically be added to your Activity Calendar.

name: Hoop Anywhere: AR Basketball
description:
Put a real-size basketball hoop anywhere: on your living room wall, in the garden or at the office. Swipe up to shoot and see how far you can go.

HOW IT WORKS
• Place the hoop on a wall or the floor with your camera (AR)
• Swipe to shoot. Farther shots score more: 1, 2, 3 or 4 points
• The same spot pays less each time, so keep moving
• Clean swishes and bank shots earn bonus points

WAYS TO PLAY
• Time Attack: score as much as you can in 60 seconds
• Streak Mode: one miss and it's over
• World Tour: travel across 360° courts and beat each target
• Party: 2-4 friends take turns on one phone
• Weekly Event: a new court and rule every week

KEEP COMING BACK
• Daily missions and day streaks
• 11 achievements and Game Center leaderboards
• Share your best basket as a clip and challenge friends

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock special balls, hoops and 360° courts with one-time purchases.

PRIVACY
No personal data is collected. The camera image is used only on your device to place the hoop.

Requires an iPhone with ARKit.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://gezerlabs.dev/hoop-basket/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://gezerlabs.dev/hoop-basket/privacy.html

name: Huevo -
description:
A color swatch comparison tool designed specifically for the unique folding interaction of the iPhone Duo.
By adjusting the angle of the folding hinge, you can control the color difference (ΔE) tolerance threshold in real time, dynamically filtering out color swatches that fall outside the acceptable range. Simply open or close the device to continuously adjust the ΔE threshold, allowing for an intuitive comparison of color deviations between a reference swatch and a test sample.

- Calculates color difference based on the CIEDE2000 standard.
- Tolerance parameters are driven by the hinge angle—an interaction exclusive to the Duo.
- Side-by-side comparison view (when fully unfolded).
- Displays Lab values ​​and ΔE difference readings for individual color swatches.
- Export annotated screenshots and CSV files containing color difference data.
- All images are saved locally; no data is uploaded to the cloud.

Ideal for ink proofing, print color calibration, quality control, swatch comparison, and color engineering reference.

On standard iPhone models, you can still import color swatches, calculate color differences, view data, and export results; however, the tolerance threshold must be adjusted via a manual slider, lacking the dynamic, hinge-linked control experience. The core interaction of continuous, angle-based adjustment is available exclusively on the iPhone Duo.

name: Ilé Ońsà
description:
Ilé Ońsà is the private online home of the Ilé Ońsà, Akeètàn, Ojà Baálè extended family: one place for the whole family, wherever we live.

Membership is by invitation only. A family admin sends you an invitation by email or text; tap Join and you are in. There are no passwords: to sign in again, enter your email or mobile number and tap Yes in the message we send.

Kept in the family:

Brought to you by Kola Abimbola, the Ajagunna Ogun Agbaye.

name: Ink Press
description:
Roll the cube. Choose when to stamp.

Each inked side prints onto the empty tile beside it—and then that face is empty. Turn the cube to line up a coral circle, mint bars, or a gold cross with its matching outline. One press can leave several marks at once.

• 24 compact puzzles across three board sizes
• Diagonal swipes and direction buttons
• Preview dots show where the ink will land
• Unlimited undo and quick restart
• Progress and best move counts saved locally
• English and Simplified Chinese
• Optional sound effects and haptics

Play offline. No account, ads, or analytics.

name: InkLex
description: Build an ink lexicon offline.

name: Inkognito: Hidden Letters
description:
Every page is a drawing in ink. Somewhere in it there is a letter — and the paper is lying to you.

Put the torn page back together. Slide a mirror until half a drawing becomes a whole one. Turn the rings of a safe. Fold the page, move the lamp, stack coloured films, close a creature's jaws. When the letter shows, pick it. In the later notebooks it is a whole passcode, typed on a keypad that will not sit still.

WHAT IS FREE
• Notebooks 1, 2 and 3, complete: 60 pages.
• The first 3 pages of each of the other 12 notebooks.
• A new page every day.

WHAT THE ONE PURCHASE UNLOCKS
• All 15 notebooks: 300 pages, every future notebook included.
• Unlimited hints.
• Family Sharing.
There is nothing else to buy. No ads before or after you pay, no subscription, no energy, no timers on the notebooks.

CALM MODE
A switch that removes everything that hurries: no timers, no streaks, no shaking or flashing, mistakes cost nothing, fewer choices, and the instruction for each page always on screen.

ALSO
• A secret word hidden in every notebook, and an ink colour for finding it.
• Rush: an optional 90-second mode with a leaderboard (hidden in calm mode).
• iCloud keeps your progress across your devices.
• In English, Brazilian Portuguese and 30 other languages.

name: INSPECT by Castle
description:
INSPECT puts your quality case work in your pocket. It is the mobile companion to the INSPECT quality management system, built for inspectors and facility teams who do their work on the warehouse floor, not at a desk.

SEE WHAT NEEDS YOU
• A dashboard of open, escalated, overdue and awaiting-review work at a glance
• Your facility's queue, sorted and filtered the way you work
• Due dates, priority and escalations on every row

DO THE WORK WHERE THE PARTS ARE
• Start, hold, return, escalate and complete work units
• Submit stock verifications: good, bad, mixed or no stock, with counts
• Complete inspection tasks and answer checklist questions
• Take photos of parts and defects with the camera, or attach them from your library
• Add notes and log your time, with a running session timer

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Push notifications when a case is assigned, escalated or updated
• Open the case straight from a notification
• RFIs, Field Wires and P Cases with their full history and attachments
• Create a new P Case to report an issue to Quality

BUILT FOR THE FLOOR
• Unlock with Face ID
• Photos keep uploading in the background and retry on a weak signal
• Unsent work is saved as a draft on your device
• Designed for both iPhone and iPad

An INSPECT account is required. Accounts are created by your organization's INSPECT administrator; there is no sign-up in the app. If you do not have an account, contact your administrator.

name: Invoice Maker: Print & Scanner
description:
Create professional invoices in minutes, then scan, save and print, all in one app.
Invoice Maker: Print & Scanner combines an invoice generator, a document scanner and a mobile printing hub, so you can run your business straight from your iPhone.

WHY THIS APP?
• Invoice Maker: create invoices, estimates and receipts from clean, professional templates
• Template Library: A4 business layouts plus 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt formats
• Live Editor: items, taxes, discounts, logo and signature with an instant live preview
• Document Scanner: turn paper receipts, bills and contracts into sharp digital copies
• Print Anywhere: print to Wi-Fi network printers and Bluetooth LE thermal receipt printers
• PDF Export & Share: one tap to export a crisp PDF or send it by email and chat
• Business Overview: paid, outstanding and overdue totals with a monthly revenue trend
• Files Hub: every invoice, estimate, receipt and scan organized in one place

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a template: invoice, estimate or receipt
2. Add your client, items and tax; the live preview updates as you type
3. Print it, export a PDF, or share it in one tap

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Professional invoice templates: Classic, Modern, Minimal, Executive and more
• Thermal receipt formats for 58mm and 80mm POS printers
• Estimates and receipts, not just invoices
• Printer setup: connect Wi-Fi and Bluetooth printers in seconds
• Paid / outstanding / overdue tracking at a glance
• Works offline: your documents stay on your device

PRINT & SCAN, NOT JUST INVOICES
Need to print a document or scan a contract? The app doubles as a scanner and printing app: scan any paper to PDF, enhance it, and print from your phone to any supported printer.

INVOICE MAKER PRO
Free to start. Invoice Maker Pro unlocks every Pro template, removes ads and lifts the monthly limits. Pro is available as an auto-renewable weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.union-kit.com/privacy.html

name: Ironwise: AI Personal Trainer
description:
Know exactly what to lift today. Ironwise is an AI personal trainer that plans every workout for you: every exercise, warm-up, set, rep, weight and rest time, adapted to your last session, your sleep and the equipment in your gym.

PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD, DONE FOR YOU
• Double progression built in: more reps first, then more weight.
• Hit every rep? The weight goes up. Felt hard? It holds. Missed twice? It eases off.
• Uses your gym's real plates and dumbbells, so every weight is one you can actually load.
• Every change explains itself in one plain sentence.

A PLAN THAT FITS YOU
• Full Body, Upper/Lower, Push/Pull/Legs and more, built from your goal, schedule and gym.
• Skip a day and the rotation waits for you.
• Machine taken? Pick an alternative with a suggested weight, just for today or for good.
• Start and end pictures for every exercise.

LIVE WORKOUT TRACKER
• Log weight and reps in one tap and rate each set Easy, Right or Hard.
• Rest timer that keeps running when your phone is locked.
• Plate helper, new records and a summary of every muscle you trained.

IRONWISE PRO
• AI coach: ask why a weight changed, swap an exercise or shorten a session. Every change waits for your tap.
• Readiness check-in: sleep, HRV and Apple Health adjust today's weights.
• Muscle heat map: see which muscles you trained, front and back.
• Progress: strength charts, goals, records, hard sets per muscle and a weekly report every Sunday.
• Nutrition: calorie, protein and vitamin targets, and meal estimates from a description or a photo.
• Build your whole plan with the AI coach in setup.

Ironwise Pro is $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Your plan and workouts stay free. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Ironwise reads (never writes) sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, workouts and body weight from Apple Health, only with your permission.

Ironwise gives general fitness and nutrition guidance, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting if you have a health condition.

Terms of Use: https://omer19telli-blip.github.io/ironwise/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://omer19telli-blip.github.io/ironwise/privacy/

name: Jalur Pergi
description:
Jalur Pergi membantu anda merancang perjalanan pelbagai pengangkutan tanpa risiko kelewatan yang tidak dijangka.

Semasa anda memasukkan setiap perhentian, aplikasi ini mengira semula selang masa di setiap pertukaran dan menampilkan buffer kelewatan secara langsung. Anda dapat melihat secara visual bila masa tiba akan terkundi akibat tambah perhentian atau tukar moda pengangkutan.

Kanta Masa di tengah paparan memaparkan jumlah ruang yang tersedia untuk setiap senario, dengan penanda jelas untuk bahagian yang memerlukan perhatian. Anda boleh menyimpan setiap keputusan masa sebagai senario, kemudian membandingkan dua versi untuk memilih yang paling selamat.

Bina perjalanan yang boleh dipercayai dari kereta pertama hingga destinasi akhir, dengan keyakinan yang sama pada setiap peralihan.

name: Johanvia Express
description:
Experience seamless travel booking with Johanvia Express, the ultimate bus ticketing app for Tanzania. Whether planning a business trip or a leisurely getaway, our app makes it easy to book and download tickets anytime, anywhere.

Key Features:
Book Bus Tickets – Find and reserve your preferred seats with just a few taps.
Download Tickets – Access your tickets instantly and travel hassle-free.
User-Friendly Interface – A smooth and intuitive booking experience.
Reliable & Secure – Travel with confidence on trusted routes.

Simplify your journey with Johanvia Express – where convenience meets luxury on the road!

name: JPMPBEU
description: This tool is well-suited for managing daily income and expenses alongside personal projects. Whether you are preparing for a professional certification, learning a language, or setting up a workspace, you can create a dedicated project for each endeavor. Track all related income and expenses continuously, and monitor your total spending, refunds, and net expenditure at any time. If a single payment serves multiple purposes, you can split the amount across different projects, with real-time tracking of allocated versus unallocated funds. Refunds can be linked to their original transactions, and existing daily entries can be categorized into projects in bulk. Gain insights into where your resources have gone through project comparisons, expense breakdowns, cash flow analysis, and budget progress tracking. Before concluding a project, address any unclassified or potentially duplicate entries; once archived, the detailed records remain accessible, and you can reopen the project at any time if further entries are required.

name: Juri’s Journey: Kana Game
description:
Travel across Japan with Juri and learn to read hiragana and katakana, one town at a time.

Each town on the map teaches one row of kana. Meet each character with a memory trick, trace it stroke by stroke, play a quick mini-game, then face the town's yokai in a lantern-catching boss battle. Beat the boss and the town is yours: a stamp for your book, a souvenir for Juri, and real Japanese signs you can now read.

HOW EACH KANA IS LEARNED
- Meet it: a picture memory trick, the sound, and a real word that uses it
- Trace it: stroke order checked as you draw
- Play with it: read a cafe menu, pick sounds by ear, build words
- Say it: speak the word and Juri listens
- Recall it: write it from the sound alone

BOSS BATTLES
Every town ends with a yokai boss. Kana fall as lanterns; tap the right one before it reaches you. Each boss has its own twist, from sound-only rounds to hiragana and katakana twins. Missed a kana? It comes back as a pink ghost lantern later, so the tricky ones get extra practice.

KEEP COMING BACK
- Daily errands with a streak and a weekly rest day
- Endless mode for your high score
- Stamp challenges in every town
- A journey book of cards, stamps and souvenirs
- The Mix challenge: hiragana and katakana together, against twin dragons

TWO WORLDS, 20 TOWNS
Hiragana World runs from Asakusa to Wakayama. Katakana World runs from Sapporo to Kagoshima. 92 kana in all, every one with its own audio.

FREE TO START
The first three towns are free. One purchase unlocks the whole journey: every remaining hiragana town and all of Katakana World. No subscription, no ads, no account.

From Learn with Juri, the Japanese channel on YouTube.

name: Kalimat: Arabic Crosswords
description:
Arabic crosswords in Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha), with a calm newspaper design.

Solve authentic Arabic crossword grids with carefully written clues in correct, classical Arabic. A new daily puzzle that everyone solves together, and levels from easy to expert to train your mind and grow your vocabulary.

WHAT YOU GET
• Daily puzzle: a fresh grid every day, the same for every player. Keep your streak going.
• Four levels: easy 7×7, medium 9×9, hard 11×11 and expert 13×13.
• A pure Arabic keyboard with no autocorrect, built for fast solving.
• Hints when you need them: reveal a letter or a word, or check your answers.
• Works offline: every puzzle is inside the app.
• Progress saves automatically, so you can pick up any puzzle where you left off.
• Dark mode, and full support for iPhone and iPad.

RESPECTFUL ADS
Kalimat is free. A small banner sits at the top of the screen and a short ad appears only after you finish a puzzle. Nothing interrupts you mid-solve. Remove every ad for good with a single purchase, shared with your family through Family Sharing.

YOUR PRIVACY
No account and no sign-in. Your progress stays on your device, and there is no analytics.

name: Klassyn
seller_name: ADAM CODES TEKNOLOJI VE YAZILIM DANISMANLIGI LIMITED SIRKETI

Klassyn is the school app for teachers, parents and students. It brings the daily work of a school into one English-language app, so staff and families are not juggling separate tools for attendance, homework and messages.

For teachers
• Take attendance so families can see absences in the app the same day
• Set homework and review submissions, including photos of student work
• Run exams and record results
• Write report cards
• Share announcements and message parents or students
• See the weekly timetable

For parents
• See the weekly plan, attendance and announcements
• Follow homework and exam results
• Read report cards
• Message teachers

For students
• Check the weekly plan and tonight’s homework
• Submit homework, including photos
• Sit exams and see results and report cards
• Message teachers

name: Klavio Chords
description:
Klavio listens to your piano. You play a chord, the app shows the pressed keys and tells you its name. No cable, no sheet music, just the microphone of your iPhone or iPad.

LISTEN
Just play. The app recognises the chord and suggests what sounds good next. Orange keys stay down, blue keys are new. That way you reach the next chord with as little movement as possible.

LEARN
Seven short lessons take you from your first three chords to your first song. The app listens and tells you whether the chord is right. Every step can be skipped, and nothing is ever marked as a hard mistake.

CHORDS
Read "Dbmaj7" or "C7/E" somewhere? Type the chord or pick root and chord type. You see the easiest shape with finger numbers, the two-hand version and every inversion, and you can play each one back.

PROGRESSIONS
More than 50 well-known chord progressions from pop, jazz, blues, neo-soul and liquid drum & bass, playable in any key. Plus your own: type them in or save what you just played.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Made for acoustic upright and grand pianos.
• International note names (B, Bb) or German ones (H, B).
• Beginner view in plain language, advanced view with scale degrees.
• Everything stays on your device: no account, no ads, no tracking, no internet connection needed.

For best results put the device on the music stand in a quiet room.

name: Klomvijn
description:
Klomvijn is een klompenwerkplaats met twee banken en een kast. Op uithollen stel je diepte, wand, neus en vocht in, en lees je pasvorm en gewicht. Op beschilderen stel je lagen, lak, motief en droogtijd in, en lees je glans en vochtvastheid.

In de kast meet je eerst de voet, kies je het hout en zet je een motief op de verfbank. De voetlat maakt van lengte en breedte een begin voor de holbank en zegt of dat begin in het venster valt. De houtkast heeft zes houtsoorten; het geschatte gewicht op de holbank volgt de soort, het venster blijft op het kale gewicht. Het motiefboek heeft acht beschilderingen.

Eén stap tegelijk. Geen levens, geen timer, geen reclame en geen account. Wat je bewaart blijft op dit toestel.

• Voetlat, houtkast en motiefboek staan op de eerste pagina
• 64 stappen uithollen — hol de klomp en lees het gewicht
• 78 stappen beschilderen — zet de verf en lees de glans
• De plank bewaart alleen de stappen die je zelf laat staan
• De baan gaat op volgorde; een stap afronden opent de volgende
• Opmerkingen vanaf de eerste pagina blijven op het toestel

Klomvijn verzamelt niets en verstuurt niets. Geen analyse en geen reclame. Als je de app verwijdert, is de werkplaats weg.

name: Koupia : caisse et suivi salon
description:
Koupia est l'outil de suivi des salons de coiffure et des barbiers. L'app accompagne ton compte Koupia : connecte-toi avec les identifiants de ton salon, ou crée ton salon en quelques secondes.

À la caisse, un coiffeur enregistre sa prestation en trois gestes : son nom, le service, le moyen de paiement. Toi, tu suis tout en temps réel.

• Aujourd'hui : le chiffre du jour, les passages en direct, la semaine et le mois
• La caisse sur un iPad ou un iPhone, et même une caisse personnelle pour le coiffeur qui encaisse depuis son téléphone
• Une notification à chaque prestation, et le récap de la journée chaque soir
• L'historique, coiffeur par coiffeur : passages, pourboires, produits vendus, services les plus demandés
• L'équipe, le catalogue et ses prix, les appareils autorisés à encaisser
• Les avis Google de ton salon
• Sur l'Apple Watch : les chiffres du jour d'un coup d'œil, ou la caisse au poignet
• Widgets sur l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé
• Ton salon aux couleurs de ton choix

Un téléphone ou une tablette devient une caisse après validation par le gérant.

name: LastShore
description:
SURVIVE. BUILD. SAIL HOME.   When a violent storm tears your boat apart, you wash ashore on an uncharted island with nothing but your instincts. In Last Shore, every sunrise brings new challenges as you scavenge the land, master the elements, and construct a vessel capable of carrying you back to civilization.   

GATHER & SURVIVEMonitor Your Vitals: Keep a close eye on your health, hunger, thirst, stamina, and body temperature as you brave the island’s dynamic day-and-night cycle.   Scavenge the Wild: Comb sandy beaches and dense tropical forests for sticks, stones, coconuts, plant fibers, and raw materials.

name: Lčovice
description: Aplikace obce Lčovice obsahuje důležité informace o obci. Najdete v ní informace o veškerém dění v obci, potřebné kontakty, aktuality a mnoho dalšího. V aplikaci naleznete nezbytné odkazy, úřední hodiny obecního úřadu, ale i kam se vydat za kulturou a sportem. Aplikace nabízí kontaktní formulář, rychlé psaní e-mailu či snadné volání.

name: Learn Linux Commands & Bash
description:
Learn Linux commands and Bash one short lesson at a time, then prove it: timed practice exams for CompTIA Linux+ (XK0-006) and the questions that come up in sysadmin, DevOps and SRE interviews.

Learn Linux turns the command line into a 5-minute daily habit. Short interactive lessons, exam-style quizzes and drag-and-drop exercises where you build real commands take you from your first ls to shell scripts, permissions, processes, networking and troubleshooting.

THREE COURSES
• Commands & Bash — navigating the file system, files and permissions, pipes and redirection, grep, sed and awk, processes, packages, and Bash scripting
• Linux certification — the CompTIA Linux+ (XK0-006) objectives: system management, services and user management, security, automation and scripting, and troubleshooting
• Interview prep — the Linux questions asked in sysadmin, DevOps and SRE interviews, explained so you can answer them in your own words

HOW IT WORKS
→ Short lessons: each one takes under 5 minutes
→ Build the command: drag the pieces into place to write real commands
→ Exam-style quizzes with an explanation for every answer
→ Skills check: find your level before you start
→ Timed practice exams: 90 questions in 90 minutes, with your score per domain
→ Mock interview: practise answering the questions out loud before the real one
→ Streaks, stars and a progress map to keep you going

FEATURES
• 240+ lessons and 1,200+ exercises in each language
• 400+ practice exam and interview questions in each language
• Countdown to your exam date
• Available in English and Spanish
• Dark mode
• Start free: the first section of each course and the skills check are free

Learn Linux is built for people who want to use the terminal with confidence at work, in an interview or on exam day — through practice, not passive watching.

Linux® is the registered trademark of Linus Torvalds in the U.S. and other countries. CompTIA and Linux+ are trademarks of CompTIA, Inc. Learn Linux is an independent study tool, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Linux Foundation, Linus Torvalds or CompTIA. Practice questions are original and are not real exam questions.

SUBSCRIPTION
Learn Linux Premium unlocks every section and the full practice exams. It is available as an auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The exact price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID settings.

name: Level Counter: Dice & Stats
description:
Keep the whole table on one iPhone. Track levels and bonuses separately, see each player's strength, and roll a six-sided die without leaving your game.

MADE FOR A SHARED TABLE
• All two to six players on one screen, with stable positions and individual colors.
• Direct level and bonus controls, including negative bonuses.
• Editable player names and undo for accidental changes.
• A visible D6 with the last result kept on screen.

YOUR CHARACTERS, YOUR CARDS
Tap race and class icons to choose a labeled option. Record additional traits or add your own labels. Choose the target level for your game as a reference.

The app is a manual companion for physical tabletop play. It does not enforce every card effect, validate all race/class combinations, award levels automatically or decide who wins.

READY FOR GAME NIGHT
Changes save locally on your device. Reopen the app to return to your table. No account or internet connection is required for the counters and dice.

Choose Comic or Tavern appearance. An optional opening animation reveals the players; skip it, disable it or use Reduce Motion.

Interface languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Turkish and Vietnamese.

The initial release is free, with no advertising, analytics, tracking or in-app purchases. It is an independent tabletop companion, not a digital edition of a card game.

name: Levi Booking Staff
description:
Levi Booking Staff is the app for owners and staff of properties that sell rooms on Levi Booking. Accounts are issued by each property; there is no public sign-up.

OVERVIEW
• Dashboard: bookings, occupied rooms and today's revenue
• Daily room timeline for quick room assignment

BOOKINGS
• Receive new bookings, confirm or decline
• Create walk-in bookings at the front desk
• Check in by scanning the guest's QR code, check out, extend stays

ROOMS
• Track room status: vacant, occupied, needs cleaning

GUEST CHAT
• Shared property inbox: receive messages and send photos or videos to guests
• Instant notifications for new bookings and new messages

MANAGEMENT
• Reply to guest reviews
• Cashbook and revenue reports
• Role-based permissions for each staff member

name: LIFO: Life Stories
description:
From your first memory to your final breath, write a human life through choices.

LIFO is an offline text life simulation game where every yearly focus and pivotal fork in the road shapes an indelible portrait of a life.

■ A Multidimensional Life Shaped by Choices
· Health, Happiness, Knowledge, Relationships, Resources, Resilience, Creativity, Self-Determination, Belonging, and Life Meaning — 10 core dimensions shift with every decision.
· Experience over 2,000 life situations spanning early childhood care, school years, first careers, adult responsibilities, and quiet elder reflections.

■ Portrait of a Life
· When a lifetime ends, receive a symbolic portrait and a complete chronicle reflecting the journey you led.
· Review your timeline and stats, then begin anew down untraveled paths.

■ Complete Privacy & Pure Offline Play
· No account required, no internet connection needed.
· All life chronicles remain strictly on your device.

name: Live Earth: See the world live
description:
See the Earth as it is right now.
Live Earth puts a living planet in your room and opens a window onto over 250 places: live video, spatial scenes, and the whole planet from orbit.

THE GLOBE IS ALIVE
The Earth floats in front of you, lit by the real Sun, with day and night where they are right now. Satellite clouds refresh every hour, the aurora glows where tonight's forecast expects it, city lights come on at dusk, and the Space Station crosses the planet live, 400 km up.

OPEN A WINDOW ANYWHERE
Turn the globe and tap anywhere. A lens shows the cameras nearby: lakes and mountain passes in Norway, volcano craters in Hawaii, frozen roads in Lapland, beaches in Galicia, telescopes in the Atacama Desert and on La Palma, the Caribbean in Honduras, lighthouses on the Great Lakes. Pick one and a portal opens in your room onto that place, as it is this minute.

• Live video: traffic crossing the Bay Bridge, cars winding along Lake Mjøsa, snow on Donner Summit
• Over 200 stills that open as spatial scenes you can lean into
• Earth itself, seen whole from a weather satellite 36,000 km up, refreshed every 10 minutes
• Golden Hour: follow sunrise and sunset around the world as they happen
• Turn on Depth and live video opens up in 3D, with depth estimated on your Apple Vision Pro

WHERE DO YOU WANT TO BE?
Browse shelves that change through the day. Golden Hour, Live Video, Step Into the Picture, Water & Harbors, Snow & Mountains, Volcanoes, Big Sky, Cities Alive and Roads Through Nowhere are there for every mood. Search for a place, a region or a country, or tap Surprise Me and go somewhere it's daytime right now.

YOUR SPACE, OR YOUR WINDOWS
In Spatial mode the globe and the portal have the room to themselves, anywhere you place them. Or switch to Window mode and keep a portal open next to your other apps, like a window you can always look out of.

HONEST ABOUT THE DATA
"What you're seeing" shows where every layer comes from and how fresh it is.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Depth is estimated on device.

Cameras belong to their operators, among them Statens vegvesen, Caltrans, Fintraffic, the U.S. National Park Service, USGS, NOAA, ESO and MeteoGalicia, and each is credited in the app, with its terms or licence. Globe data comes from NOAA, NASA and GEBCO. Live Earth is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them. Cameras can go offline, and at night many show little, so Live Earth points you to places in daylight.

An internet connection is required.

name: LiveDrive: Sürüş Günlüğü
description:
LiveDrive, araçla yaptığın yolculukları arka planda kaydeder ve her sürüşü neon bir rota hikâyesine çevirir.

SÜRÜŞÜNÜ KAYDET
• Başlat'a dokun, telefonu cebine koy. Ekran kapalıyken de rota kaydedilir.
• Toplam mesafe, sürüş süresi, mola süresi, ortalama ve en yüksek hız.
• Trafikte ve ışıkta beklemekle gerçek molayı ayırır; mola eşiğini sen belirlersin.

ROTANI YENİDEN YAŞA
• Geçmiş sürüşlerini 3 boyutlu haritada oynat: araç rotayı baştan sona kateder, molalarda durur.
• Rota yollara oturtulur, başlangıç ve varış adresleri otomatik bulunur.
• Tüm sürüşlerin tarihe göre geçmişte durur.

PAYLAŞ
• Instagram hikâyesi, gönderi ya da WhatsApp için tek dokunuşla rota kartı: harita, mesafe, süreler ve aracın.
• Başlangıç ve varıştan 500 metre gizlenir; evin ve işin belli olmaz.

İSTERSEN TOPLULUK
• Hesap açmak zorunda değilsin. Açarsan profilini paylaşıp diğer sürücülerin sürüşlerine göz atabilirsin.
• Paylaşım varsayılan olarak kapalıdır; tek tek sürüşleri gizleyebilirsin. Engelle, şikâyet et ve hesabını uygulamadan sil.

GİZLİLİK ÖNCE GELİR
• Sürüşlerin varsayılan olarak yalnızca telefonunda durur.
• Reklam ve takip yok.
