name: Long Backgammon · Narde
description:
Long backgammon (narde, nardi, nardy) is the classic dice board game where luck meets calculation. Play backgammon online with opponents around the world, with a friend nearby via Bluetooth without internet, two players on one phone, or against a smart computer. Free, with no ads.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Backgammon online — fast matchmaking, Elo rating and stats. After a game, rematch in one tap.
• Backgammon via Bluetooth — two phones side by side, no internet needed. Friends show up on a radar: invite them with a tap.
• Two-player backgammon on one phone — taking turns, like at a real board.
• Backgammon vs computer — 5 levels, from beginner to expert. Expert+ is a neural network trained on thousands of games. Plays offline.

BACKGAMMON WITH FRIENDS
Create a private room and send a friend the link or the code. Play a single game or a match to the number of points you choose, with classic scoring (mars and koks). Turn time and who moves first are up to you.

RATING AND FAIR DICE
Your Elo rating grows with every win and is saved in your Apple or Google account — it comes back on a new iPhone. After an online game you can check every roll: the dice are fair, and it is easy to see.

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR TASTE
Boards, checkers, dice and borders: wood and nacre, felt and carbon, carved 3D reliefs with lions, tigers and dragons, country flags on checkers. Light and dark themes.

ELITE DICE, STICKERS AND GAME REVIEW
Elite dice with effects on doubles: lightning, dragon, fireworks and more. Stickers right on the board — both players see them. A move hint from Expert+ in games against the computer: arrows and win chances. Game review: mistakes, the best move and odds for every move.

POLISHED DETAILS
Smooth roll and move animations, sound and haptics, your own avatar or photo and nickname, move hints and undo, auto‑roll, portrait and landscape — on iPhone and iPad. Illustrated rules and an interface in 19 languages.

FAIR AND AD‑FREE
The app is free. No ads, no tracking. In the shop, if you like: the basic set of designs and chat in online games, elite dice, packs of stickers, hints and reviews, premium. The game is complete without it.

HOW TO PLAY LONG BACKGAMMON
Each player has 15 checkers, all stacked on the “head” — the first point. Both players move in the same direction, around the board, and checkers are never hit: a point held by the opponent is simply closed. Only one checker may leave the head per turn (except doubles 6-6, 4-4 and 3-3 on the first move). You cannot build a block of six checkers unless at least one opposing checker is ahead of it. Once all 15 checkers are in your home, you bear them off. The first to bear off wins: 1 point for a plain win, 2 for mars (the opponent bore off nothing) and 3 for koks (the opponent still has checkers on the head). Not to be confused with standard backgammon, where checkers move toward each other and hit.

Roll the dice — and may fortune favor the bold!

name: Love For Later
description:
Your words, for every chapter ahead.

Love For Later lets you record the stories, advice, and love your family will want to hear again, and make sure each message reaches the right person at the right moment. Record a video for a graduation years from now. Tell the story of how you met. Leave a letter to be opened later. Your family keeps your voice, your face, and your words.

RECORD IN YOUR OWN VOICE
• Record video or voice, or write it down
• Pick a topic and glance at simple prompts while you record, so you never wonder what to say
• Add your own notes so you remember every detail you want to share
• Recordings save on your phone first, then upload, so a weak signal never costs you a take

MESSAGES THAT ARRIVE RIGHT ON TIME
• Seal a message until a date you choose
• Milestone Messages for birthdays, graduations, weddings, first homes, and first babies
• Messages for after you pass. A trusted person you choose confirms the time has come, and your messages open 48 hours later. Your trusted person never sees what you recorded.

YOU CHOOSE EVERY RECIPIENT
• Add your family and choose exactly who receives each message
• Senders record. Recipients open what was left for them in their Vault.
• Add young children by name and birthday so their messages are ready for the day they arrive. Children never need an account.

ONE VAULT FOR EVERYTHING LEFT FOR YOU
• Everything recorded for you, in one place
• See what is still sealed and when it opens
• Read along with transcripts of recorded messages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your recordings are shared only with the people you choose
• No ads. We never sell your information.
• We never clone your voice or pretend to be you
• Report any message, or leave a family at any time
• Download everything you have recorded, and delete your account from Settings whenever you want

WISHES AND LETTERS FOR LATER
Leave your wishes and personal letters in your own words. Wishes are personal guidance for your family. This is not a legal will.

Love For Later is for adults 18 and older. Free to download and use.

Questions? support@loveforlater.com

Terms: https://loveforlater.com/terms

name: LumaLex
description:
LumaLex samlar smarta kort, korta lektioner och praktiska skrivverktyg i en lugn studieapp på svenska. Bygg förståelse i din egen takt – utan konto, annonser eller onödigt brus.

**DINA KORT, DIN RYTM**
Skapa egna kortsamlingar eller börja med utvalda ämnen som svenska nyanser, engelska för studier, natur och klimat samt studieteknik. Vänd kortet, formulera svaret själv och markera hur säkert det kändes. Din utveckling sparas lokalt varje dag.

**FYRA SKRIVVERKTYG**
• Sammanfatta långa texter och hitta kärnan.
• Förbättra formuleringar så att språket blir tydligare.
• Översätt korta meningar och begrepp med en inbyggd studieordlista.
• Granska vanliga skrivfel och läs förklaringen bakom varje förslag.

**ETT BIBLIOTEK SOM FÖRDJUPAR**
Utforska redaktionella lektioner om minne, Östersjön, privatekonomi, svensk grammatik och skrivande. Varje lektion har en tydlig sammanfattning, viktiga poänger och en snabb kunskapskontroll.

**DAGLIGA VANOR**
Sätt ett rimligt repetitionsmål, följ veckans aktivitet och lås upp märken när du bygger hållbara studievanor. Ett par minuter räcker för att komma vidare.

**DIN INTEGRITET**
LumaLex kräver inget konto. Dina kort, utkast och framsteg sparas på din iPhone. Inga annonser, ingen spårning och ingen försäljning av data.

LumaLex är ett studiehjälpmedel. Granska alltid viktiga texter och slutsatser mot originalkällor.

name: Lumen Fold: Bend the Light
description:
Fold the phone and the light bends at the crease. Lumen Fold is a calm daily puzzle made for iPhone Duo: open the hinge, guide a beam of light through a dark cave, and wake every crystal.

ONE PUZZLE A DAY, PLUS NINE MORE
Every day brings a new puzzle for everyone, and nine more once you've solved it. The week climbs: Monday is a single fold with one twist to read, and by Sunday it's four or five numbered crystals, shades, fog and obsidian.

PUZZLES TO THINK ABOUT
Bending the beam is easy. Planning the route is the puzzle:
• Prisms split the light; red glass tints it
• Mirrors to turn, switch mirrors to flip, and hinged mirrors that lean as you fold
• Brittle quartz that shatters under a steady beam
• Numbered crystals that hold only in order, and twins that must wake together
• Relay crystals that fire their own beam across the seam
• Wormholes, drifting and approaching crystals
• Obsidian that costs a light, and shades that put out every crystal you're holding
• One-way folds that only close, and fog that hides the far side

Every puzzle is checked to have a fair way through.

CALM, WITH A LITTLE DANGER
Three lights per puzzle, an optional countdown that tightens through the week, and a cave that brightens as you go, with deep-water ambience and a marimba that climbs as crystals hold.

LEARN AS YOU GO
Each new piece is taught in a short lesson the first time you meet it.

ON ANY IPHONE
Made for the iPhone Duo hinge. On other iPhones, turn on Drag to Aim and drag to bend the light.

NOTHING TO SIGN UP FOR
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your streak lives on your phone.

name: Lumo: AI Camera & Photo Filter
description:
Lumo is an AI camera that helps you take great photos without any skills. Pick a style, take the shot, and AI handles the lighting, color and look, so every photo comes out the way you pictured it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a style before you shoot: film, oil painting, anime, claymation and more.
• Press the shutter. Your finished photo is ready in about 30 seconds.
• Save it, share it, or give it a different style anytime.

STYLES FOR EVERY MOOD
• 12 styles made by Lumo: Film 1998, Oil Painting, Anime Still, Cyberpunk Night, Claymation, Watercolor, Renaissance, Pixel Art, B&W Editorial, Space Explorer, Comic Book, Miniature World.
• Find styles other people created and save your favorites.
• With Lumo Pro, create your own: describe the look in plain words, add example photos if you like, and Lumo makes a cover for it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The photo you take is never saved to your library. Only the finished photos you choose to save are.
• Your original is encrypted and only used to create and restyle your photo. Delete all originals or your account anytime in the app.

FREE AND PRO
• Free: your first 5 photos at full quality, then 1 free photo every week. Free photos carry a small Lumo mark.
• Lumo Pro: 100 photos every month, no watermark, every Pro style, and create your own styles.
• $9.99 per month, or $59.99 per year with a 3-day free trial (up to 15 photos during the trial).

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

name: Lumora Trekking
description:
Lumora is the ultimate companion for outdoor explorers, landscape photographers, and trekkers. Combining a professional camera with real-time 3D LUT color grading, a full Photoshop Camera Raw-style photo editor, and an offline wilderness trail navigation cockpit, Lumora empowers you to capture and conquer every summit with total confidence.

KEY FEATURES:

1. OUTDOOR CAMERA & LIVE COLOR SCIENCE
- 26 specialized 3D LUT looks across 5 collections: Trekking & Nature, Muse & Dreamy, Vintage Film 35mm, Hong Kong Retro, and Cinematic.
- Real-time LUT preview in camera with customizable intensity slider.
- Zero-shutter-lag ProRAW and high-resolution capture with level gauge and multi-lens switching.
- Outdoor Trekking Stamp: automatically overlay live GPS coordinates, elevation, compass bearing, and trail name onto your photos.

2. PROFESSIONAL RAW PHOTO EDITOR (Camera Raw Style)
- Light & Tone: Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, and Blacks.
- Color & White Balance: Temperature, Tint, Skin-protecting Vibrance, and Saturation.
- Presence & Detail: Mountain De-Haze, Sky Recovery, Midtone Clarity, Texture, and Sharpness.
- Effects & Analog: Lens Vignette, Procedural 35mm Film Grain, and Split Toning (Shadow & Highlight Color Grading).
- Non-destructive workflow: original photos are preserved separately with editable recipes.

3. TRAIL DISCOVERY & OFFLINE TOPO NAVIGATION
- Discover iconic and wild trekking trails across 13+ countries, sorted dynamically by distance from your current location.
- 100% Offline Topo Packages: Download interactive elevation profiles, water sources, shelters, and summit waypoints.
- Digital Trail Compass & Bearing Cockpit: live needle guidance pointing straight to the next milestone without cellular data or internet.
- Off-trail alerts: proactive warning when deviating more than 200m from the trail.
- Driving directions to Trailhead: navigate directly to the mountain base starting point.
- Emergency SOS Toolkit: 1-tap exact GPS coordinate copying, SMS emergency dispatch, and local mountain rescue hotlines.

4. 100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE-FIRST
- No accounts, no sign-in required, and zero third-party tracking SDKs.
- All image rendering, LUT processing, and navigation calculations run strictly on-device via Apple Metal and Core Image.

Privacy Policy: https://manhwaron-prog.github.io/thinguyen.io/privacy.html
Terms Of Use: https://manhwaron-prog.github.io/thinguyen.io/terms.html

name: Machikado Photo Booth
description:
Take ID photos that meet Japanese size rules at home with your iPhone, just like stepping into a photo booth on a street corner. Made for the My Number card, Japanese passport, residence card, driver's license and résumé — from shooting to saving and printing at a convenience store.

■ A photo booth experience
・Pick a purpose, open the curtain and follow the guide
・Street scenery that changes with the time of day, with selectable booth colors
・Turn the animations off to go straight to shooting

■ Shooting guide
・Live hints for face position, size and tilt
・Self-timer and auto capture
・Or create a photo from your library

■ Spec check
Checks face size (top of head to chin), top margin, centering, face direction, shadows, brightness and resolution, and points out what needs attention.

■ Finishing
・Replace the background with plain white and other solid colors
・Crop in millimeters with automatic tilt correction
・Natural skin smoothing for résumés (face shape unchanged)
・Official uses such as passports limit retouching to necessary adjustments only

■ Save and print
・Digital files for online applications (600 dpi JPEG)
・L and 2L print layouts that can mix different sizes on one sheet, with cut lines
・Print L or 2L at convenience stores in Japan

■ Supported sizes
・Passport 45×35 mm
・My Number card 45×35 mm
・Residence card 40×30 mm
・Driver's license 30×24 mm
・Résumé / job hunting 40×30 mm
・Custom (20–70 mm)

■ Pricing
Shooting, finishing and the spec check are free to try. Saving and sharing photos requires a one-time in-app purchase (no subscription).

All photo analysis and processing happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

name: Madar: Prayer Times & Weather
description:
Madar brings your prayer times, your day's weather and your adhkar together in one calm design, where the whole day turns around your prayers.

PRAYER TIMES
• A countdown to the next prayer, and an orbit you turn with your finger to move through the day.
• Prayer times for the whole year, in Hijri and Gregorian, with any month shared as a PDF.
• Several calculation methods, the Asr school, and minute adjustments for each prayer.

WEATHER
• Temperature and sky at each prayer.
• The week's weather, the day hour by hour, wind, rain and UV index.

QIBLA
• A mihrab that fills with light when you face the Qibla.

ADHKAR
• Morning, evening, after-prayer and sleep adhkar, in fully vowelled Arabic with pronunciation, meaning, virtue and source.
• A daily moon that fills as you read, and keeps your streak.
• A tasbih counter with a daily goal.

REMINDERS
• For each prayer: before, at and after its time, with a reminder of its own for Jumu'ah.
• Reminders for fasting Mondays and Thursdays and the White Days.

ON YOUR SCREEN
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• A Live Activity counting down to the next prayer.
• An Apple Watch app with the orbit, prayer times, adhkar and tasbih, plus complications for your watch face.

name: MaDot - Blur Before You Send
description:
You know the drill. You take a screenshot, scribble over it with your finger, hit send… then zoom in and realize half the phone number is still showing.

MaDot is built for exactly that moment. Open a picture and it does the first sweep for you: phone numbers, emails, long ID-style numbers, license plates, IP addresses, QR codes, barcodes, faces — even the row of profile pictures in a chat screenshot. They’re found and covered automatically. All you do is take a quick look and send.

【ONE TAP IS ALL IT TAKES】
· Tap a line of text to cover it; tap again to uncover
· Long-press to pick a single word, or drag to box any area
· Drag the corners to resize, long-press a mask to move it
· A magnifier follows your finger so every edge lands exactly right
· Tilted street signs and slanted text? The mask tilts right along with them
· One tap in the corner hides every mask, so you can peek at the original

【PRIVACY, BUT MAKE IT CUTE】
Solid block, mosaic, blur, big pixels, emoji, sticker wall, rainbow bars, caution tape, stamps, ink blots, scribbles, asterisks, gibberish… more than a dozen styles to choose from. Faces get an emoji by default, and you can tap to swap it for any emoji you like. Want full control? Grab the brush and paint it over yourself.

【LEAVES NO TRACE】
· Detection and masking all happen on your iPhone. Your photos never touch a server
· Saved copies have location, device and other EXIF data removed
· Add your own watermark, like “For verification use only”
· No ads. No analytics. No tracking

【DO A WHOLE STACK AT ONCE】
· Select several photos and mask them in order. Save one and the next opens on its own
· Stitch scrolling screenshots into one long image, with the overlaps trimmed away
· Pick MaDot from any app’s share sheet, no app-switching needed
· Edit right inside the Photos app with the built-in extension
· Long-press the home screen icon to mask your latest screenshot or the image on your clipboard
· Hook up a keyboard and ⌘Z, ⌘S and ⌘C all work

【MASK A SECRET, RAISE A PONY】
Masking a little boring? Raise ponies while you do it. Every mask in an image you save, share or copy becomes a pony in your stable. The more you mask, the more skins you unlock: Black Knight Pony, East Sea Dragon King Pony, Queen of Egypt Pony, Nine Colors Pony and more. The safer your secrets, the busier your stable.

Share screenshots freely. Keep your secrets to yourself.
MaDot: mask first, then send.

name: Magnet: Manifest Your Dreams
description:
A dream fades if you only think about it. It gets clearer when you write it, say it and picture it every day.

Magnet is a habit app for people who want to practice the law of attraction every day. Set your biggest goal in one sentence, then write it, say it and picture it as if it has already happened, as part of your daily routine.

FEATURES
• Write 100 times and the 369 method: write your sentence every day and Magnet counts how many times you wrote it
• Say it out loud: say your affirmation and the microphone counts it automatically (PLAYER)
• 68-second visualization: a timer for picturing the moment you have already achieved it
• Dream island: choose the home, car and things you want and see them together on one island every day
• Biggest goal and deadline: count the days left and break your goal down by period
• Gratitude journal and a letter to your future self
• Dream photo widget on your Home Screen: your dream photos change every 15 minutes (PLAYER)
• Personalized reminders: morning and evening notifications made from your dream, affirmation and days left (PLAYER)
• Lounge: talk with people who share the same dream in the community and chat rooms. Asset verification badges, checked by the operator with documents and video, appear next to nicknames

PLAYER SUBSCRIPTION
• PLAYER Monthly: auto-renewing monthly subscription. The price is shown in your local currency in the app before you buy
• Unlocks unlimited goals, daily personalized reminders, unlimited Lounge conversations, the dream photo widget, counting by voice and your full history
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions
• Without a subscription you can still set 1 goal, write affirmations and use part of the Lounge

PRIVACY
Your goals, affirmations, journal, dream photos and answers in the intro are stored only on your device and are not sent to our servers. We store on our servers only what is needed for sign-in, the Lounge and asset verification. We do not track you for advertising.

NOTE
Magnet is a tool that helps you keep your dreams and goals in mind and act on them every day. It does not guarantee any particular result. Posts in the Lounge are not investment advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Service Terms: https://imagination5671.github.io/magnet-policy/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://imagination5671.github.io/magnet-policy/privacy.html
Contact: More > Contact us in the app

name: Mầm Non Số
description:
Mầm Non Số là sổ liên lạc điện tử giữa gia đình và trường mầm non dùng nền tảng mam-non.com. Tài khoản do nhà trường cấp cho phụ huynh, giáo viên và nhân viên.

HÔM NAY CỦA CON
Mở ứng dụng là thấy con đã đến lớp lúc mấy giờ, nghỉ có phép hay đã được đón về. Có nhiều con học cùng trường thì mỗi bé một thẻ riêng.

THỰC ĐƠN TỪNG BỮA
Bữa sáng, phụ sáng, bữa trưa, bữa xế do bếp của trường đăng, kèm lưu ý dị ứng. Chia sẻ thực đơn cho ông bà qua Zalo, Messenger bằng một chạm.

THÔNG BÁO CỦA TRƯỜNG
Họp phụ huynh, khám sức khoẻ, ngày hội… đến thẳng điện thoại bằng thông báo đẩy.

NHẮN CÔ
Nhắn tin riêng với cô chủ nhiệm, gửi ảnh, dặn thuốc. Mỗi cuộc trò chuyện có nút Báo cáo và Chặn; báo cáo được nhà trường xem trong 24 giờ.

HỌC PHÍ
Xem phiếu học phí từng tháng, khoản nào đã đóng, khoản nào đến hạn, mã chuyển khoản của trường.

CHO GIÁO VIÊN VÀ QUẢN LÝ
Giáo viên thấy sĩ số có mặt của lớp mình; quản lý thấy từng cơ sở. Toàn bộ công việc điểm danh, nhật ký, bảng tin lớp làm ngay trong ứng dụng.

MÀN HÌNH CHÍNH VẪN XEM ĐƯỢC KHI MẤT MẠNG
Bản cập nhật gần nhất được giữ trên máy.

RIÊNG TƯ
Ảnh và hồ sơ của bé chỉ hiện cho phụ huynh của bé, giáo viên của lớp và quản lý trường. Không quảng cáo. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: MANANA
description:
See what gold is worth in your own currency, by the gram, ounce or tola, and how today's price compares with its recent highs and lows.

Compare gold across currencies, alongside silver, platinum and palladium.

Keep a record of the bars, coins and jewellery you own. Enter the weight and purity to see the fine gold, what it's worth today and how that compares with what you paid.

Set a goal for the gold you'd like to have by a date, note prices you'd like to see again, and look back at what buying a fixed amount each month would have added up to.

Prices are shown for reference only and do not constitute investment, financial or trading advice.

name: Maryamado
description:
Maryamado is the internal app the estate staff use to manage maintenance.

• Technical-room checklists, also offline
• Issues with priority, before/after photos and voice memos
• Work orders on equipment: scheduling, start, completion and spare parts
• Equipment cards with nameplate data read from a photo, history and datasheet
• Tasks, spare parts and stock, meter readings
• Shared calendar with notifications

The app is reserved for staff: signing in requires an activation code from the administrator, then a personal PIN (with Face ID).

name: Masterline Connect
description:
Masterline Connect is the free app for homeowners, businesses and plants that use a Masterline service company for compressed air, heating and cooling, plumbing or electrical work.

WITH YOUR SERVICE COMPANY
Enter the customer code from your company to:
- Request service: pick the trade, the problem, how soon, and which equipment.
- Chat with the office, with photos. You get a notification when they reply.
- See your next visit and know when the tech is on the way.
- Approve quotes and pay bills on your company's secure pay page.
- Keep a list of your equipment.

FIX IT SAFELY
36 free step-by-step checks across heating and cooling, plumbing and electrical, and compressed-air operator checks. Each one tells you when to stop and call a pro.

PRO PLANS (optional)
- Pro ($4.99/month or $39.99/year): equipment reminders and the full set of guides.
- Pro + AI Tech ($14.99/month or $119.99/year): a safety-first AI technician for every trade that answers your questions and looks at photos.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

name: Masterline HQ
description:
Masterline HQ runs a multi-trade service company from the phone and the office. Compressed air, heating and cooling, plumbing and electrical work all live in one account, and each person sees the trades they work in.

ONE COMPANY, EVERY TRADE
- Turn on the trades your company does. Techs who work in more than one trade switch with one tap.
- Every job, machine and checklist is tagged with its trade, and the office can filter by trade.

FOR THE TECH IN THE TRUCK
- My day: today's jobs in route order, with directions, the customer, the equipment and its history.
- Work orders: talk instead of typing. Voice notes are sorted into the work order for you to check.
- Photos, parts used, time, readings and signatures on site.
- Quotes on the spot, with good, better and best options the customer approves online.
- Invoices the customer pays by card from a link.

TOOLS FOR EACH TRADE
- Compressed air: controller fault codes, service intervals, sizing and leak cost tools, and a parts cross-reference.
- Heating and cooling: refrigerant tracking, readings and tune-up checklists.
- Plumbing and electrical: wire, breaker, voltage drop, drain, vent, water heater and gas pipe calculators with the code section.
- Ask a Tech: an AI troubleshooting assistant for air and HVAC, labeled as AI.

FOR THE OFFICE
- Dispatch board, calendar, customers, equipment, service agreements, price book, inventory and purchase orders.
- Messages with customers who use the free Masterline Connect app.
- Reports, commissions and timesheets, plus QuickBooks and Xero sync.
- The full office on the web at hq.masterlinesoftware.com.

PLANS
Solo and Company plans with an add-on for each extra trade. Sign up at hq.masterlinesoftware.com.

name: Mathoo
description:
Mental math, a few minutes a day.

Mathoo teaches arithmetic and everyday math from the very basics, in short lessons that feel like a game. Every wrong answer comes with the method, so you learn how, not just what.

A WRONG ANSWER IS WHERE THE LESSON STARTS
Miss a question and Mathoo walks through it step by step, using the exact numbers you were asked. For 15% of 1,560: find 10%, halve it for 5%, add the two. The question comes back at the end of the lesson for another try.
• Each lesson opens with a one-screen idea and a worked example.
• No timer unless you turn one on. A hint is always one tap away.
• Type the answer, pick it, put numbers in order or match pairs.

ONE PATH, FROM 1 + 1 TO PERCENTAGES
89 short lessons in ten skills: number sense and rounding, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, percentages, real-life math, and measurement and conversions. Start at the beginning, take a ten-question check to find your level, or open any lesson you like. Nothing is locked.

A 60-SECOND DAILY CHALLENGE
One fresh set of questions every day, at three difficulty levels. Get your rating, then send the challenge code to a friend or the family group chat: they play the very same set, even offline.

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• Accuracy and speed for every skill, week by week.
• A 12 × 12 grid of times-table facts that fills in as you master each one.
• The questions you miss most, with a button to practise exactly those.
• A daily goal, a streak, badges, levels and three mini-games that open as you improve.
• Optional reminders, and your whole history saved as a spreadsheet whenever you want it.

MATH YOU USE
Discounts, tips, change, splitting a bill and finding the better deal, in Philippine pesos or US dollars. A conversion card keeps 30 everyday unit conversions, each with a shortcut you can do in your head.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in. Nothing about you is collected.
• Progress stays on your device. Delete my data in Settings removes everything.
• Works offline. The app goes online only when you tap Check for updates, to download lesson files.
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.

Mathoo is made by ITDC Systems.

name: Measurielle
description:
Measurielle turns your iPhone into a drafting bench for measurements. One big live number sits on a ruler; turn the dimension dial to choose what you measure, and watch the result roll digit by digit into any unit.

THE BENCH
• Rotary dimension dial: Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, Speed, Time and your own custom dimensions — it clicks into place with haptic detents.
• Tap the big number for a calculator keypad with inline arithmetic: type 12×3 or (2.5+1.25)÷2 and convert the result.
• Drag the engraved ruler scrubber to nudge the value by a step you choose.
• Swap units in one tap; the converted value rolls into place.
• "How it was calculated" shows the exact arithmetic, e.g. 5 mi × 1609.344 = 8046.72 m, including temperature offsets.
• A dimensional view shows how big a value really is: bars to scale next to everyday objects, squares for area, cubes for volume and a thermometer for temperature.
• Every unit of the dimension listed at once — tap one to make it your target.

INSTRUMENTS IN THE DRAWER
• Compare: put 2–4 quantities side by side with normalised bars and ratios.
• Formulas: build your own calculations with variables a, b, c… (+ − × ÷ ^ brackets and square roots), test them, save them and run them any time. Comes with BMI, fuel cost and paint coverage examples.
• Saved: keep labelled measurements ("Sofa width 212 cm") with notes, search, filter and sort, and see each one in every unit.
• Favourites: star unit pairs and they appear as chips on the bench.
• History: every committed conversion is logged automatically; search it, restore it or clear it.
• Categories: browse all built-in units and factors, or define your own dimension with units given as a factor of a base unit (for example cups, tablespoons and teaspoons).

EXACT AND HONEST
Built-in conversions use exact international definitions (1 in = 2.54 cm, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg) and US customary volumes, with your choice of decimal places and digit grouping.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED, WORKS OFFLINE
There is no sign-up and no login: the app opens straight to the bench. Everything works without a connection. Optional private cloud backup keeps your measurements, history, favourites, custom dimensions and formulas safe and in sync using an anonymous identifier — no account, no sign-up, no login. Turn it off at any time, sync on demand, or delete the backup from Settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Export your data as JSON or CSV whenever you like.

Designed with light and dark drafting themes, Dynamic Type-friendly labels, VoiceOver support and Reduce Motion support.

name: Modaza Pizza & Burger Gladbeck

Dein Lieblingsessen aus Gladbeck, schnell und einfach aufs Handy: Bestell bei Modaza direkt beim Restaurant, ganz ohne Umweg. Dein Geschmack. Deine Modaza-Momente.

name: Moonreader's Eye: ESP Test
description:
Five crest cards lie face down. Only one is the Moon Crest.
After the shuffle, touch the card you feel is the Moon. How many can you find in 10 tries? An ESP game that tests your intuition.
The more you play, the more you unlock "Moonlit Tales," stories of the five heroes of Moonstep Saga.

TWO TRIALS
- Intuition Trial: find the Moon Crest among five shuffled cards. 10 rounds
- Hard Trial: name the crest on every card (Moon, Flame, Bolt, Snow, Iron). 5 points per round, 50 points over 10 rounds

MOONLIT TALES (82 tales, Japanese / English)
- Tales of the Five: hit while a hero is your guide to collect their Moon Shards and unlock their story, Night 1 through Night 10 (5 heroes x 10 tales)
- Record Tales: special tales unlock by how many you hit out of 10 (2 to 10), by your Hard Trial score (12 to a perfect 50), and by a perfect reading of all five cards
- There are even tales for 10 out of 10 and a perfect 50: by pure chance, about a one-in-ten-million night

FEATURES
- The five heroes (Rei Tsukikage, Raiga Kuren, Suzune Shiraha, Shigure Kurogane, Sakuji Tsukise) take turns guiding you, with over 2,300 lines
- Pure chance averages 2 out of 10 (10 out of 50 in the Hard Trial). The results screen shows how likely your score or better is by luck alone
- Titles by score; tracks your personal bests, trials played, and score distribution
- While you choose, the screen shifts into a quiet Focus Mode so only the cards remain
- Japanese / English

Card positions are shuffled with a cryptographic random generator every time.
Test your luck each day, and unlock the next tale.

name: MotorSim 3D
description:
MotorSim 3D lets you explore 100 car engines and 16 motorcycle engines in an interactive 3D simulator with sound generated in real time.

Choose a model from the catalog, start the engine, and use the throttle. Rotate the view to see pistons, valves, turbochargers, and exhaust flow in motion. Use slow motion to follow each phase of the engine cycle.

Compare inline, V, W, and boxer layouts, including naturally aspirated and turbocharged engines. Explore two-stroke and four-stroke motorcycles, including desmodromic and ShiftCam designs. Where installation data is available, select a vehicle variant to see how the engine, drivetrain, and exhaust are arranged.

Open the dyno and vary the engine speed to plot estimated torque and power curves. You can also build a custom engine and adjust its layout, dimensions, and sound.

Engine geometry, timing, sound, and dyno curves are simulations for educational use.

The interface and engine catalog are available in English and Italian. Switch languages under Display → Language.

name: Moxu
description:
Moxu is a scenic motorcycle time-trial game where each ride is a chance to chase a cleaner medal time. It brings a clock of your own, a road with a mood, and a garage that grows from the runs you finish.

The experience feels like a quiet drive with a little bite. Tilt the phone and the bike leans through coastal spray, pine shade, red rock, and a last ridge in gold light. A clean pass feels light. A messy one simply asks for another try. Medals turn those tries into something you can look back on, and your fastest time stays ready when you want to beat it.

What you take with you is personal and easy to return to. Medal points open the next road, from an easy coastal loop toward longer, tighter courses. Coins from finishes and challenges unlock three bikes and the upgrades that change how they hold a bend. Smaller goals sit between the big clocks: a first finish, a gold run, a long clean stretch. You come back for one more corner, on a time that belongs to the ride you just took.

Just you and the road is the difference. Six scenic courses, steering by a tilt of the phone or the on-screen arrows, a short side boost when the straight opens, and a garage you earn by riding. The pace stays yours.

- Enjoy a fresh run on tracks that open as your medal points grow, beginning with an easy coastal loop and rising toward longer, tighter courses.
- Feel the difference as coins from rides and challenges unlock bikes and upgrades in the garage, with three machines you can tune before the next start.
- Discover your best times again whenever you want another attempt, with the finishes and medals from rides you have already completed waiting for the next clock.

name: Multigravity
description:
Multigravity is a native mobile companion for developers running local AI coding agents and the open-source mgy gateway on macOS, Linux, or Windows.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time Agent Streaming: Follow multi-turn sessions, collapsible tool actions, step rails, inline code diffs, syntax-highlighted code blocks, LaTeX math, tables, and Mermaid flowcharts on mobile.
• Interactive Approvals & Decisions: Answer structured multi-question prompts (AskQuestion) and approve or decline workflow scripts, file writes, and terminal commands right from your phone.
• Multi-Agent Workflows & Swarm: Inspect workflow phases, concurrent sub-agents, execution logs, and agent collaboration boards in real time.
• Live Terminals & Background Tasks: Track running commands, long-running dev daemons, scheduled tasks, and active MCP tools/skills from one unified board.
• Quota & Token Monitoring: View multi-account quota meters with pace indicators and token usage summaries at a glance.
• iPhone & iPad Native Experience: Optimized iPhone navigation and two-column iPad split layout, Live Activities support, offline Demo Mode, and local-first security with zero cloud tracking.

TRY DEMO MODE IMMEDIATELY
Tap "Try Demo Mode (No Computer Required)" on launch to explore realistic multi-turn chats, workflows, approval gates, tables/charts, background tasks, and quota views without pairing a computer.

name: Multimedia Memo Notebook
description:
Keep the things you want to find again: an idea, a photo, a short video or a voice memo.

• Write and edit notes.
• Take or import photos and videos up to 60 seconds long.
• Record and play voice memos.
• Add captions and mark favorites.
• Find captures with search and filters.
• Set optional local reminders.
• Protect access with Face ID or Touch ID on compatible devices.

Your text and media stay on your iPhone, with no user account or server synchronization.

Export your captures and media in a JSON backup, up to 100 MB. Import adds captures without replacing existing ones. Scheduled reminders are not included. Exported files are readable and unencrypted: keep them in a private location.

30 captures are free with all features included. Deleting a capture frees a place.

An optional one-time purchase unlocks unlimited captures for life, with no subscription.

name: Multipitch Atlas
description:
Fully bolted multipitch climbs in 18 countries across Europe, Morocco and Turkey

Each route has the approach, pitch grades, descent, gear, best season and bail options. Routes link to their sources and guidebooks.

- Find routes by grade, length, area and month.
- See every route on a map, with approach tracks.
- Save routes for offline use at the crag.
- Send GPX approach tracks to your maps app.
- Sport crags nearby for rest days.
- Free account: keep a want list and climbed list, post reports and find partners for the same routes.
- Notifications for replies and partner requests.

name: NeedleSkipProbe
description: NeedleSkipProbe är för hemsömnad när ett stygn hoppar. Ange nål, tråd, tyg och spänning som misslyckades, och nästa försök på samma tyg. Kontrollen godkänner eller avvisar nästa försök: trikå vill ha kulspets, denim under 90 avvisas, en böjd nål måste byta storlek, och en lös spole rättas inte bara med övertråden. Det är en jämförelsekontroll, inte en maskinreparation. Spara paret och öppna det senare under Sparade sömmar.

name: NEXTYYX MAX
description: Research digital assets at your own pace as you approach or enjoy retirement. Browse assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, search by name or symbol, and narrow your results by network or category. Open an asset to review its details and return to recent searches when you want to pick up where you left off. Save a personal profile that reflects your risk tolerance and retirement needs, and update it as your priorities change. No account is required. Choose a light, dark, or system appearance and share asset details when you want to discuss your research with someone you trust.

name: Nice to meet you: BizCard
description:
Nice to meet you is the business card you always have with you.

Open the app and your QR code is on the screen. The other person points their camera at it and your name, phone, e-mail and company land in their contacts. They do not need the app, an account or an internet connection.

ONE CARD FOR EVERY ROLE
Most of us are more than one thing: founder of one company, mentor at a foundation, advisor to another. Add each role once and swipe to the one that fits the conversation. Every role has its own title, organization, website, color and QR code. Your name, phone and photo are entered only once.

WHAT IT DOES
• Shows a QR code that saves you as a contact
• Keeps a separate card for each role, each in its own color
• Shares your card as a contact file through AirDrop, Messages, WhatsApp or e-mail
• Puts your QR code on the Home Screen with a widget
• Opens the right card from the Lock Screen with one tap
• Turns the screen brightness up while the code is showing, so it scans quickly
• Works without a connection

READY IN 30 SECONDS
Type your name and your first role. Your card is ready. Add a photo, a website, LinkedIn or more roles whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no server. Everything you enter stays on your iPhone and is shared only when you show your code or send your card.

Available in English and Turkish.

name: No Peeking! Shower Panic
description:
You're in the shower, and someone is peeking in the window!
Tap the window and SLAM the blinds shut!
The peeking person goes flying far into the sky.
But not everyone should be shut out!

■ Someone peeking? SLAM!
When someone with a camera shows up, tap that window.
Too slow? SNAP! They take a photo, and you lose 1 heart.
You have 3 hearts. Don't lose them all!

■ Some visitors must not be shut out
The delivery person, a duck and a cat come by too.
Visitors without a camera are fine. Just let them go.
Shut the blinds on them by mistake, and you lose a heart!

■ All kinds of people peeking
Pigeons, giraffes, drones, friends on each other's shoulders, even UFOs.
More and more windows, and even the drain in the floor!

■ Super items for tight spots
A steam bomb, a giant duck and an iron shutter chase them all away at once.

■ 13 odd characters
Even a proud dog standing with paws on hips takes a shower!?
Each character reacts in its own way when photographed. Always covered in fluffy foam.

■ About 30 seconds per round
How many can you chase away before you get photographed 3 times?
The longer you last, the faster and busier the peeking gets.
Beat your best and compete on the Game Center leaderboard!

■ New characters and items with coins
Earn coins by chasing away the peeking people and with a bonus at the end of each round. You can also earn coins by watching ads.

name: Nockbook
description:
Au pas de tir, notez vos flèches. À la prochaine séance, retrouvez vos repères.

Nockbook rassemble vos scores, vos impacts en cible, vos photos et vos réglages de visée. Un carnet de tir à l’arc sur iPhone, iPad et Apple Watch, sans compte à créer.

UNE SAISIE QUI SUIT VOTRE RYTHME
Touchez un score ou glissez sur la cible pour placer votre flèche. Une loupe déportée vous aide à viser sans masquer l’impact avec le doigt. Les scores reprennent les couleurs des anneaux, sur blason simple ou trispot. Choisissez de 1 à 10 flèches par volée, avec 6 par défaut.

VOS VOLÉES AU POIGNET
Lancez une séance depuis l’Apple Watch en choisissant distance, blason et nombre de flèches. Glissez entre les groupes de scores, annulez la dernière saisie, passez à la volée suivante ou terminez la séance. La montre retrouve la séance consultée sur l’iPhone ; vous choisissez sur quel appareil saisir. Les scores conservés hors connexion sont transmis à la reconnexion.

UN CARNET FACILE À RELIRE
Retrouvez vos séances dans une liste compacte, illustrée par vos photos ou vos impacts. Le récapitulatif donne la priorité au score et au tableau coloré des volées. Corrigez une séance, ajoutez des photos ou rouvrez-la pour reprendre le tir. Comparez les séances de formats compatibles et observez vos groupements.

LE BON REPÈRE DE VISÉE
Associez chaque réglage à votre arc et à sa distance. Déplacez l’œilleton sur une règle graduée, ajustez par pas de 0,1 ou saisissez la valeur au clavier. Gardez vos favoris, distinguez les réglages validés de ceux à tester et conservez vos notes techniques.

PRÉPAREZ LA PROCHAINE SÉANCE
Planifiez vos entraînements et compétitions avec un lieu, une carte Apple et un rappel facultatif. Suivez vos flèches de progression FFTA et consultez les guides pratiques de réglage et de préparation du matériel.

UN CARNET QUI VOUS APPARTIENT
Les données restent sur vos appareils. Exportez vos résultats en PDF ou créez une sauvegarde complète avec vos médias. Pas de publicité, pas d’abonnement. Le carnet fonctionne hors connexion ; les cartes et les liens externes nécessitent Internet.

Les scores et impacts sont saisis manuellement : les photos ne sont pas scannées. La saisie détaillée prend en charge les blasons anglais pleins et les trispots compatibles ; les autres formats se notent par score global. Six flèches est un choix d’entraînement, pas une règle universelle de compétition.

Nockbook est indépendante de la FFTA. Le suivi des flèches de progression ne remplace pas leur validation par votre club. Les guides complètent les notices du matériel et les conseils de votre encadrant.

name: Noctalk: Sleep Talk Recorder
description:
What do you say in your sleep? Leave your phone by the bed and Noctalk listens all night. In the morning you get only the moments that matter: sleep talk, laughing, snoring, coughing and possible teeth grinding.

ONLY THE REAL MOMENTS
Noctalk learns your room. A fan or air conditioner becomes the new silence within minutes, so you wake up to real moments, not hours of static.

READ WHAT YOU SAID
Sleep talk is turned into text right on your phone, so you can read your funniest lines at a glance.

YOUR MORNING SUMMARY
See when each sound happened on a night timeline, filter by talk, snore or grind, and hear the best moments first.

TRENDS OVER WEEKS
Follow how your snoring, grinding and talking change across the last 14 nights.

SHARE THE FUN
Turn something you said into a card and send it to friends, or share the sound itself.

MADE FOR THE BEDROOM
A dark screen while it listens, a delayed start so you can fall asleep first, auto stop and three sensitivity levels. Your recordings stay on your phone.

Noctalk is not a medical device and does not diagnose anything. If you are worried about your sleep, talk to a doctor.

Privacy Policy: https://fabrika-sunucu.vercel.app/noctalk/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Nouvelle Équipe
description:
Met de Nouvelle Équipe app heb je al je werk binnen handbereik. Kies uit diensten in de horeca, logistiek en

begint. Werk dat bij jou past, gewoon vanaf je telefoon.

name: Odoo POS Native App
description:
Odoo POS Native App connects your Apple device to an existing Odoo 16 Community point of sale and provides native LAN receipt printing.

REQUIRES YOUR ODOO SERVER
An accessible HTTPS Odoo 16 Community installation, a POS user account, and the pos_native_print addon installed by your administrator are required. This app does not include a hosted Odoo service. Odoo 17, Odoo 18, and Enterprise-specific features are not supported by this release.

SIGN IN AND CHOOSE YOUR POS
Enter your server, username, password, and database when needed. Choose an authorized point of sale and optionally make it the default for this device. Managers configure user-to-POS assignments in Odoo.

CASHIER AND KITCHEN PRINTING
Send receipt images to configured LAN ESC/POS printers over TCP. Keep kitchen category assignments in Odoo and send added or cancelled kitchen items to their assigned destinations.

DEVICE PRINTER SETTINGS
Adjust a printer's address, port, printable dot width, and cutting option on this device. Test the saved connection with a synthetic receipt or reset to Odoo defaults. Save on device keeps these adjustments local; Reset returns to server defaults. Cashiers cannot change shared Odoo printer settings.

DISCOVER AND MANAGE PRINTERS
Start a local-network search for reachable printer candidates, or enter an address manually. Discovery does not verify printer compatibility. POS managers can explicitly add or edit shared Odoo printer defaults and map cashier or kitchen printing to the current POS. Review affected points of sale before saving shared defaults. Managers may also review and sync a saved device override to Odoo; nothing is uploaded automatically.

BEFORE USING PRINTERS
Your device must be able to reach the printer on its network. Allow Local Network access and keep the app in the foreground while printing. Printer compatibility depends on its model, firmware, and ESC/POS implementation; validate your hardware before operational use. This release does not provide Bluetooth or USB printing or cash-drawer commands. Network search starts only when requested.

Delivery status reports the network send, not confirmation that paper printed. Check an uncertain delivery before intentionally reprinting.

name: OEP-Photo
description:
OEP Photo is a secure identity verification and photo management application designed for both individual users and service operators to quickly verify profile information and update official portrait photos.

Whether you are an individual citizen updating your own profile records or an authorized operator assisting users in the field, OEP Photo makes the verification process fast, effortless, and highly secure.

Key Features & Capabilities:

• Dual Use (User & Operator Friendly)
Designed with a clean, guided interface suitable for individual self-service updates as well as high-volume operator assistance at registration desks and verification centers.

• Instant QR Code Session Scan
Simply point your camera to scan the provided session QR code. The app instantly connects with the secure server to retrieve the associated profile details without any tedious manual typing.

• Clear Profile Information Review
Verify existing profile information—such as full name, NID number, parent details, date of birth, and contact number—directly on screen before proceeding with updates.

• Smart On-Device Liveness Verification
Equipped with advanced on-device facial detection to guarantee authenticity and prevent photo spoofing (such as printed pictures or screen replays). Users are guided through simple, intuitive visual prompts to confirm live presence.

• Automatic Portrait Capture
No need to guess angles or lighting. Once the facial positioning and liveness checks are satisfied, the app automatically captures and crops a high-quality portrait meeting official standards.

• Safe & Encrypted Data Transmission
Your verified photo and session tokens are transmitted directly to the central database through encrypted HTTPS connections, ensuring that personal information remains private and protected at all times.

How It Works:
1. Scan your session QR code using the built-in scanner.
2. Review the displayed profile details on your screen.
3. Tap "Update Photo" and position your face inside the camera guide.
4. Complete the simple live verification instructions.
5. The verified portrait is automatically captured, uploaded, and updated in your records!

name: Onn Vehicles
description:
Onn Vehicles keeps your car and motorcycle maintenance, fuel fill-ups, and GPS rides organized in one private garage.

GARAGE & VEHICLE RECORDS
• Track cars and motorcycles with custom photos (including subject cutouts), registrations, VIN/engine details, and tyre specs.
• Log odometer and engine-hour readings with full reading history.
• Automatic estimated odometer updates from recorded GPS trips.

MAINTENANCE & REMINDERS
• Build repeating service schedules by distance, calendar time, or engine operating hours.
• Set fixed milestones, inspection limits, reminder lead thresholds, and snooze upcoming items.
• Record workshop visits and attach notes to keep complete service history.

FUEL & ECONOMY TRACKING
• Log full-tank and partial fill-ups with regional distance/fuel units and local currencies.
• Automatic full-to-full fuel economy calculation with optional manufacturer reference comparison.
• On-device receipt text recognition for supported PETRONAS and Setel receipts.

GPS TRIPS, LIVE ACTIVITY & CARPLAY
• Record rides with route maps, speed, elevation, ascent, and motorcycle lean angle.
• Track active rides on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island via Live Activity, or start/stop from CarPlay.
• Review interactive speed and elevation timelines, trim trip ends, export GPX files, and create shareable stat cards.

PRIVATE BACKUPS & SYNC
• Export and import full JSON backups (including rules and vehicle photos) or CSV service history via Files.
• Free tier includes up to 3 vehicles, 15 fuel entries, and 15 GPS trips.
• Optional one-time Pro lifetime unlock adds unlimited vehicles, fuel logs, GPS trips, custom garage title color sampling, and automatic private iCloud sync.

name: Oopsnap: World's Easiest Game
description:
Shoot or wait. That is all you need to do. Easy, right?

Oopsnap is a quick attention game built around one decision at a time. Read the prompt inside the camera lens and choose whether to tap or let the ring finish.

The first frames are simple. Then the pace changes. A sign you saw earlier can matter later, and a new rule can change what the next prompt means. Stay focused and build your longest run.

• Tap anywhere in the play area, or wait when the prompt asks you to.
• Follow changing rules, remember signs, and react to the timer's shifting pace.
• Start a fresh run for free whenever you want, with a changing opening order.
• Earn an extra life for a streak of ten correct decisions, up to three streak rewards per run.
• After a mistake, use an optional life to keep your score, with up to three rescues in a run.
• Play in English or Turkish on iPhone and iPad.

Optional life packs are consumable in-app purchases. The current version stores progress and lives on the current device; cross-device wallet sync is not available. The game does not use your real camera.

How far can you go?

name: OptiPit
description:
OptiPit aduce într-un singur loc informațiile despre vehicule și colaborarea cu service-ul auto.

Pentru proprietari:
• Administrează vehiculele și consultă istoricul tehnic disponibil.
• Urmărește mentenanța, expirările și vizitele la service.
• Solicită programări, consultă devizele și transmite deciziile tale.
• Păstrează fotografii și documente asociate vehiculului.

Pentru echipele service:
• Consultă programările și lucrările în desfășurare.
• Gestionează recepția vehiculelor, devizele și etapele intervențiilor, în limitele rolului tău.
• Atașează documente și fotografii și consultă informațiile necesare lucrărilor.

Pentru companii cu vehicule:
• Accesează vehiculele companiei și informațiile operaționale disponibile prin funcțiile Fleet.
• Consultă programările, devizele și documentele, conform accesului acordat contului.

Aplicația necesită conexiune la internet și cont OptiPit. Funcțiile disponibile depind de rol, de accesul acordat și de serviciile activate pentru contul sau organizația ta. Nu se fac achiziții în aplicație.

name: Orbit Bloom: Ring Rush
description:
Drag up and the ball moves to an outer orbit. Drag down and it moves inward. Doors come around the ring: be inside a door's band when you reach it and you pass. Miss one and the run ends.

Pass through the centre line of a door and the gauge fills 1.5×. A full gauge sets off a Bloom: the ball races around the ring and clears the doors by itself.

10 THEMES
Each theme changes the background, the doors, the ball and its trail, the sound effects and the music.
- Bloom: quiet slate, thin lines
- Neon: night grid floor and glowing mountains
- Paper: cut-paper discs, clouds and hills
- Abyss: deep water, light shafts and kelp
- Forge: lava cracks and rising embers
- Frost: aurora and snowy peaks
- Terminal: falling 0s and 1s on an old screen
- Candy: pastel dots and icing hills
- Desert: dusk dunes and far pyramids
- Storm: rain, clouds and lightning
Themes open as you play: passes, centre-line passes and Blooms add up across runs.

MUSIC THAT FOLLOWS THE RUN
Every theme has its own song. A long streak adds instruments, and a Bloom lifts the song.

- One finger, anywhere on the screen
- Short runs, one tap to play again
- Sound, music, vibration and drag sensitivity in Settings
- English and Korean, following your device language
- No ads, no purchases, no account, no internet needed

name: Oruvella
description:
Oruvella helps small appointment-based businesses keep their day organised. Manage bookings, client enquiries, deposits and business records in a calm, focused workspace.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
Review today's appointments, upcoming bookings, enquiries and deposits.

PLAN YOUR CALENDAR
Browse your month, see booked appointments and review available times. Create bookings with service durations and pricing.

KEEP BOOKINGS TOGETHER
Search clients and services, manage confirmations and cancellations, and track deposits and outstanding balances.

MANAGE YOUR BUSINESS RECORDS
Organise income and expenses into folders and export spreadsheet-ready CSV records. Core booking tools and CSV exports are free.

MONTHLY PDF REPORTS WITH PRO
An optional monthly or yearly Pro subscription unlocks formatted monthly PDF reports with summaries and itemised appointments and ledger records. Preview and print reports generated on your device. Creating a shareable PDF link requires cloud sign-in and your explicit confirmation to upload. Anyone with the link can view that report.

Core booking features work without a cloud account. Local bookings and optional cloud records are separate workspaces. Automatic monthly generation and email delivery are not included.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple account settings. Restore Purchases and Manage Subscription are available from the Pro plans screen. No free trial.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: OstraZune
description:
Swipe up.

Sink.

OstraZune is one slow descent.
Five stations hang on the line.
Each one holds something.


5 M · DIVE LOG

Every dive, written down.
Site. Date. Max depth.
Bottom time. Visibility.
The buddy beside you.

Totals settle as you log:
dives, deepest, average visibility,
who you dive with most.

Metres or feet. Your choice.


15 M · BREATH TRAINER

CO₂ tables and O₂ tables.
Slow rings to follow.
Soft pulses at each change.
A few ticks in the last three seconds.

Your best static hold is kept.
Every finished table is listed.

Dry land only.
Sit or lie down.
Never in or near water.
Stop if you feel unwell.
It is a pacing timer, nothing more.


30 M · PEARL SORT

String the necklace.
Smallest pearl on the left,
largest on the right.
Tap two to swap, or drag.

Strands grow longer.
Pearls grow alike.
A wrong clasp costs five seconds of air.


45 M · BUBBLE POP

Your air drains.
Pop rising bubbles to win it back.
Quick pops build a chain, up to ×8.
Pearl bubbles are worth more.

Leave the jellyfish alone.
Three stings and the dive is over.


60 M · DIVE LOCKER

Sonar sounds, on or off.
Haptic taps, on or off.
Depth units. Records.
A clean slate when you want one.


THE TIDE SLATE

Each day a new slate drifts down.
A small true story of the sea:
the ama of Ise, how nacre forms, why red fades first.
Beside it, the week's tide target for Pearl Sort.


QUIET WATER

Everything stays on this phone.
It works offline.
No account. No ads. Nothing to pay for inside.
New slates arrive when you're connected.
Nothing about you is sent up.

Every sound is drawn live from sine waves.


The pearl beds are waiting.

name: Ozark Mountain Propane
description:
Welcome to the Ozark Mountain Propane mobile app, your trusted companion for managing your fuel needs. Our app puts the power of fuel management in your hands.

Key Features: 

- Request Fuel Deliveries: You can request fuel deliveries to your residential or commercial location at your convenience. 

- Account Management: View your account history, and stay updated on your fuel deliveries. 

The Ozark Mountain Propane mobile app is designed to make your life simpler by providing quick and easy access to essential services.

name: PaceHour
description:
PaceHour is a calm, minimal step counter with a coach that spreads your goal across your day.

Open it and you know where you stand in two seconds: your steps, your goal, how many are left, and whether you are ahead or behind.

A COACH THAT DOES THE MATHS
• Tells you the pace that gets you to your goal by the end of your active hours
• Shows how many steps to take this hour
• Three modes: Steady spreads the goal evenly, Flexible follows your usual day, Gentle gives more leeway and fewer reminders
• Never asks for an unreasonable catch-up. If a goal is out of reach, it says so

REMINDERS THAT DO NOT NAG
• Only when they help, with your real numbers
• Quiet hours, active hours and a daily maximum that you choose
• Rest days never break a streak

ON YOUR WRIST AND HOME SCREEN
• A full Apple Watch app that works without your iPhone nearby
• Complications and Smart Stack widgets
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including steps for this hour

WALKS, CHALLENGES AND A LITTLE BOOST
• Time a walk and see it on your Lock Screen
• Seven, fourteen and thirty-day personal challenges, with no leaderboards
• Short on time, energy or motivation? Answer one question and get one small next step
• Guided breathing for while you walk or when you need a lift, from our breathing app Sospiro

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• Your steps are read from Apple Health and worked out on your device
• TechTherapist runs no server that receives your health data

PACEHOUR PREMIUM: ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The step counter, coach, reminders, widgets and Watch app are free. A single lifetime purchase adds:
• Weekly, monthly and yearly trends with heatmaps
• Insights into your usual day, consistency and records
• Month and year recaps as stories, compared with the time before
• Goal reviews that suggest a new goal and explain what it would change
• More challenges, colour themes, app icons, widget and complication options, and CSV export

Try every Premium feature free for 7 days. No payment and nothing to cancel: it simply ends.

PaceHour is for walking motivation. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

Privacy Policy: https://pacehour.mytechtherapist.co.uk/privacy
Terms of Use: https://pacehour.mytechtherapist.co.uk/terms

name: Pasaprecio: PDF Quotes
description:
Pasaprecio is an app for independent contractors and tradespeople: plumbers, electricians, painters, masons, welders, and repair technicians. Build a quote or estimate on your phone and send it to your client as a PDF.

A COMPLETE QUOTE
Add labor and material items with quantity, unit, and price.
Apply a discount, a tax rate you set, and a deposit as a percentage.
Set how many days the quote is valid, and add terms and a note for the client.

TEMPLATES BY TRADE
Start from a plumbing, electrical, or painting template.
Each one comes with the usual items for that kind of job. You set the prices.

A PDF READY TO SEND
The PDF is created on your phone and shared through the system share menu: WhatsApp, email, or any app you choose.
It shows your business details, the client's details, the line items, and the totals.

CLIENTS AND CATALOG
Save each client once and pick them when you build a quote.
Keep a catalog of your jobs and materials with their prices, and add them with one tap.

TRACK EVERY QUOTE
Mark each quote as draft, sent, accepted, or declined.
The app flags a quote once it has expired.
Duplicate an earlier quote for a similar job.

YOUR BUSINESS AND DEFAULTS
Enter your business details and your defaults once: currency, tax, deposit, validity, and terms.
Currencies: UYU, ARS, USD, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN, BRL, PYG, BOB, and EUR.

ACCOUNT AND SYNC
Sign in with your email or with an account you already have.
Your data syncs with your account, and the app works offline.
Light and dark mode. Available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
You can delete your account and your data from Settings.

PLEASE NOTE
The PDF Pasaprecio creates is a quote. It is not an invoice or a tax document.

Support: https://pasaprecio-olivera.web.app

name: Peilo – Bearing Compass
description:
Peilo turns your phone into a hand-bearing compass. Lay it flat and it shows a 3D compass. Raise it and you see the camera image with a sight line: sight the target, read the degrees.

TAKE BEARINGS WITH THE CAMERA
Hold the phone as if taking a photo and line up the sight line with a lighthouse, a buoy or a church tower. Peilo shows the bearing in degrees and as a compass point, with a compass band below that turns with you. If you tilt the phone slightly to the side, the value stays correct.

BEARING AND BACK BEARING
The back bearing sits right next to the bearing, as a number and as a small compass graphic. No mental arithmetic with plus or minus 180 degrees.

HOLD THE BEARING
One tap freezes the value, so you can copy it into the logbook or onto the chart at your own pace.

3D COMPASS
Lying flat, Peilo shows a metal compass with a turning card, sighting pin and glass dome. At north, east, south and west you feel a short click.

TRUE OR MAGNETIC
Peilo calculates the magnetic declination for your position from the World Magnetic Model. You choose whether heading and bearing are shown true or magnetic.

POSITION AND ALTITUDE
Latitude, longitude and altitude are always in view, in degrees, minutes and seconds or in decimal degrees, altitude in metres or feet.

RED LIGHT FOR THE NIGHT
Night mode turns everything red, including the camera image, so your eyes stay used to the dark.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Free: 3D compass, heading, position and altitude, night mode.
Full version as a one-time purchase, no subscription: taking bearings with the camera, holding a bearing, back bearing.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads. Your location is used only on the device and is not transmitted. The camera image is not stored.

In nine languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

Note: Peilo does not replace a certified hand-bearing compass or navigation equipment. Accuracy depends on your phone's compass sensor, its calibration and metal nearby.

name: PetroMedia
description:
PetroMedia is the client area for businesses whose websites are designed, built and looked after by PetroMedia, a UK web design studio. Sign in with the email address you use for your PetroMedia account and everything about your website is in one place.

YOUR WEBSITE AT A GLANCE
• Whether your website is up, with its uptime over the last 90 days
• Its security certificate, domain renewal date and latest nightly backup
• What we've changed recently, in plain English
• How fast it feels to your visitors

RESULTS AND ENQUIRIES
• Visitors over 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or 12 months, counted without cookies
• How people found you, and how many called, messaged or emailed
• Every message sent through your website's contact form, with a notification as soon as one arrives

AMENDMENTS
• Ask us for a change to your website and attach photos, videos or documents
• Follow it from Received to Done and live, and reply to us from the notification

NOTIFICATIONS YOUR WAY
• Choose which updates come by email, by notification or both
• Every notification is kept in the app's notification centre

WIDGETS
• Keep your website's status, this week's visitors or new enquiries on your Home Screen or Lock Screen

SIGN IN WITHOUT A PASSWORD
• We email you a six-digit code, or use a passkey or Sign in with Apple

The app is for existing PetroMedia clients: you'll need a client area account to sign in. Anyone can check the live status of the websites and apps we look after from the sign-in screen. To become a client, visit petromedia.co.uk.

name: PhezvaniTorqel
description: Rotational moulding calculator: part and powder, cycle, heat transfer, mould design, material, multi-arm machine and part cost.

name: PhoneTV
description:
PhoneTV shares your iPhone screen with a compatible TV on the same local network. Availability depends on the TV model, firmware and network. Use the free connection check before purchasing.

Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi. A wired TV also works when connected to the same router.

name: Photo Cleaner: Sortwell
description:
Sortwell clears the photos and videos that are easy to let go of, and sends the ones you want to keep to your Windows PC before you delete them.

SEND TO YOUR PC FIRST
Install the free Sortwell for Windows, scan the code it shows, and your iPhone and PC are connected. Mark photos in any review and send them. They go straight to your PC over your own Wi-Fi, encrypted, and land in folders by year and month. Then delete them from the iPhone when you are ready.
No cable, no cloud account, no sign-up.

CLEAR THE OBVIOUS
• Exact duplicates: copies are found and one original is kept.
• Similar shots: photos taken seconds apart are grouped and the best one is suggested. Look at the others before you decide.
• Large videos: the biggest files in your library, largest first.
• Screenshots: all of them in one place.

SWIPE TO DECIDE
Go through items one at a time. Swipe left to mark for deletion, right to keep, and undo if you change your mind. Everything you marked is deleted together, in one step that iOS asks you to confirm. Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

ASK IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type a request such as "videos over 200 MB from 2023" or "screenshots from last year" and review just those. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence turned on, the sentence is read on the device. On other iPhones the same field works by keywords.

MONTH BY MONTH
Walk through any month of your library, newest first or largest first, and see how much space each month takes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The scan runs on your iPhone. There is no account, no ads and no tracking. Your photos leave the iPhone only when you send them to your own PC.

SORTWELL FOR WINDOWS
The free companion shows any photo folder by year and month. With Pro it also receives photos from your iPhone and sorts a messy folder into date folders, with undo. Pro is bought once, in this app; scanning the code unlocks it on the PC. Download it at https://hawkmason.com/sortwell

FREE AND PRO
Scanning and looking through the results are free, and you can delete up to 50 items without paying. Sortwell Pro removes that limit and adds sending to your PC. Pro is available as a weekly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

From okamotodesigns, built by a working lighting designer and programmer.

name: PintLanza
description:
PintLanza is a free pint-price guide for holidays in Lanzarote. Compare estimated drink prices, happy hours, bar votes and atmosphere tags in Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise, Playa Blanca, Arrecife and towns across the island. Find out what's on tonight too: live music, quiz nights, karaoke, sports on the big screen and festive nights at bars across the island.

A banner at the top of the app says: “Prices are estimates, check at the bar for confirmation.” Every price is labelled estimated.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
The app has four tabs: Home, Map, Events and Favourites.

• Home — search bars, towns or drinks. Use Where I'm staying to pick your hotel or resort and see the nearest bars, with 250 m, 500 m, 1 km, 2 km and Any distance chips and approximate walk times (your choice stays on this phone only). Home also has Happy hour now, Upcoming events, a price gauge from Bargain to Pricey (estimated), Featured bars, filters, and a cheapest-first list of 380+ bars. Location is optional: it is used live on your phone only, and is never stored or sent. If you turn location off, pick a town, or use Where I'm staying.
• Map — see bars on a map. Pins show the cheapest listed pint (estimated).
• Events — see what's on at bars across Lanzarote: live music, quiz nights, karaoke, sports screenings, Christmas and New Year nights and more. Pick a day to see tonight's or this week's events, with the bar, the time and a link to it in the app. Upcoming events also show on Home.
• Favourites — save bars on your phone. This tab also holds the pub crawl planner, plus local happy hour reminders and price alerts for bars you follow. Reminders and price checks run on your device; there is no server push. Add bars to a crawl, have them ordered by walking distance, see an estimated total spend, save the crawl on your phone, open it in Maps, or share it.
• English or Spanish, and prices still work offline from the copy saved on your phone.

You can tap + Add a price on Home, or Update a price on a bar page. These open the website's anonymous price form in an in-app browser. No account is needed.

PRICES ARE ALWAYS ESTIMATED
Every price is labelled estimated. Figures come from bars' own websites or public menus, area averages, and visitor updates on pintlanza.com, and may be out of date. A price marked as set by the bar or updated by visitors is still shown as estimated until you see it at the till. PintLanza does not invent prices.

DRINKS AND TOWNS
Compare estimated prices for lager, cider, Guinness, wine, cocktails, shots, spirits and craft beer, in sizes such as pint, caña and jarra. Coverage is the whole island of Lanzarote, including Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise, Playa Blanca, Arrecife, Puerto Calero, Playa Honda, Teguise, Famara, Haría and more.

PRIVACY
There are no accounts, no tracking, no ads and no analytics SDKs. No account needed to use the app. Favourites, pub crawls, Where I'm staying and reminder choices stay on your phone. Location is never stored. Votes, tags and "I'm interested" taps send a random device ID, stored only as a one-way hash; otherwise the app sends just an anonymous install count.

Map and hotel list: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

PintLanza is for adults aged 18 or over. Please drink responsibly. Listings are a price guide, not a recommendation, and PintLanza is not affiliated with the bars listed unless a listing is clearly marked as a paid featured placement.

name: PooDuo
description:
What's said on the loo stays on the loo.
Just you, your phone, your Duo and a flush.

Everyone takes their phone to the loo. Your mate too. Until now you've both been scrolling alone in there. PooDuo puts you on the same break. Poo + Duo. The naming meeting was brief.

SAME TIME, DIFFERENT TOILETS
Send a mate your invite code. Once they accept, they're your Duo. Next time nature calls, tap "I'm on the toilet" and your 10 minutes start. If your Duo's in at the same time, you'll see each other. Send a chat request; if they accept, you're talking. Plenty to catch up on. Odd place to do it.

THE FLUSH GETS THE LAST WORD
When time's up, or you're up early, everything on screen washes away. The chat closes for both of you and never reopens. No history to scroll back through.

KNOW WHEN YOUR DUO SITS DOWN
If you've both switched notifications on, you'll get a heads-up when your Duo taps "I'm on the toilet". Whether your bowels can accept the invitation is another matter.

SAME BOWEL CLOCK?
Be in there at the same time as your Duo for at least a minute and it counts as a crossing. Keep crossing paths and the little gold poo by their name fills up. Reach eight and you basically share a calendar. Stats shows who you cross paths with most. Friendship has some peculiar milestones.

ONE FOR THE GROUP CHAT
Every session ends with a card you can share. No names, times, dates or countries on it. Send it to a mate. Let them ask.

THE DULL BUT IMPORTANT BIT
- Sign in with Google or Apple. No new password to remember.
- No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no location permission.
- There's an age check at sign-up. An automatic filter catches contact details, swearing and signs that someone is under 18, with human moderators behind it. Report and block from any message or your Duo list.
- Delete your account in Settings whenever you like.

Chat history is never shown to anyone again. For safety and report review, messages stay on the server for up to 25 hours and in our provider's backups for up to 30 days; anything reported is kept for the review.

name: Pray to Scroll: Pray First
description:
Free. No ads. No account. No tracking.

Knees before feeds.

Pray to Scroll puts a short prayer between you and your most distracting apps. Open Instagram and Pray to Scroll steps in first: take a breath, pray, then press and hold Amen. Your app opens, and it stays open for as long as you chose. Pray first. Scroll after.

HOW THE PRAYER GATE WORKS
• Pick the apps that pull you in: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Snapchat, Facebook, Reddit, Threads, Pinterest, or your own.
• Set up the gate in about a minute with Apple's Shortcuts app. Pray to Scroll walks you through every tap and shows a check mark once each app is protected.
• When you open a gated app, Pray to Scroll opens first. Pray, hold Amen, tap Continue, and the gate stays quiet for 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes.
• Need it now? Once a day, an emergency pass lets you straight through for 5 minutes, counted honestly in your stats.

SCROLL THE WORD
After you pray, scroll something good. Scroll the Word is a full-screen feed of Bible verses you swipe through one at a time, just like the apps you know, except it leaves you fuller, not emptier. It's the healthy thing to scroll.

FOUR WAYS TO PRAY
• Quick prayer: 30 seconds, one prompt, Amen.
• Guided: 1 to 3 minutes through Adoration, Confession, Thanksgiving and Supplication.
• Verse + prayer: read today's verse one line at a time, then pray it.
• Pray for someone: choose a person from your prayer list or your contacts, pray for them, then send "I just prayed for you" if you'd like.

PEOPLE AND ANSWERED PRAYERS
Keep a list of the people you love and what they're facing. Pray to Scroll suggests whoever you haven't prayed for in a while. When God answers, mark the request answered and it moves to your Answered Prayers wall, a record of faithfulness to come back to.

A HABIT THAT GROWS
• A daily streak, with one free streak freeze every week.
• Milestones at 3, 7, 14, 21, 30, 50, 100 and 365 days.
• A calendar of your prayers, minutes prayed, people prayed for, and every time you prayed instead of scrolling.
• Challenges: 7-day Fresh Start, 21-day Habit, 40-day Social Media Fast and Pray for 30 People.

PRAYER CIRCLES
Invite friends with a six-character code and encourage each other on a weekly board of prayers and streaks. There's no chat and no profile. A circle sees only the nickname you choose, your weekly prayer count and your streak.

ALSO INSIDE
• A verse for every day of the year from the World English Bible
• A private prayer journal with search
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Gentle reminders, including a heads-up when your streak is at risk
• Beautiful share cards for milestones and verses

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your prayer list, journal, streaks and settings stay on your iPhone. There's no account to create, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and we never sell your data. Prayer Circles are optional and use Apple's iCloud.

FREE, FOR REAL
Every feature in Pray to Scroll is free. No trial, no paywall, and no paying to pray.

A note on how it works: the Prayer Gate runs on an automation you create in Apple's Shortcuts app. It pauses your apps with a prayer rather than locking them at the system level, and you can switch it off anytime.
