name: Prefa by Farber
description:
Sit down for Greek Prefa (Πρέφα), a game of bidding, tricks and careful defence against two computer opponents.

FAIR AND STRONG OPPONENTS
The bots use only what their seat may know: their own cards, the cards played, bids and clues revealed during play. They never peek at your hand, the hidden talon or another player's discard. They sample possible deals, calculate how they play out and choose what scores best in Kassa and kapikia.

YOUR TABLE, YOUR RULES
Choose a starting Kassa from 10 to 90. Switch Kontra / Rekontra on to allow doubling and redoubling. Decide whether three passes mean a new deal or a no-trump round in which everyone tries to avoid tricks.

EVERYTHING AT A GLANCE
• A scorecard with Kassa, kapikia and the rules of the match
• Table hints for your turn, following suit and playing trumps
• “The rest are mine” finishes a deal when all remaining tricks are guaranteed
• Personal statistics for contracts, defence, all-pass rounds and matches
• Clear cards, with Greek indices when playing in Greek
• Portrait and landscape layouts on phones and tablets

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Your game is saved automatically, so you can return and continue your match later.

HOW TO PLAY
Three players use 32 cards: ten each and two in the talon. Bid for six to ten tricks; the winner takes the talon face down, discards two cards and names a contract. Defenders play or pass. A lone defender may play alone or invite the other defender. Follow suit, or trump if you cannot. Empty the Kassa and finish with the most kapikia to win.

description:
One Bible verse a day, for the whole family.

Psalmoo gives you one verse to open each day, with a short reflection to think about and a one-line prayer. The whole Bible is inside to read, and all of it works offline.

ONE VERSE, OPENED EACH DAY
Every date has its own verse, waiting under a paper cover. Tap to open it and read it, and the day's goal is done.

All 66 books in two public-domain translations, the World English Bible and the King James Version. Switch between them on any page and you stay at the same verse. Search every verse for a word or a phrase, choose from five text sizes, and read on light or dark pages.

A PAPER VILLAGE THAT GROWS
Open the day's verse and a new piece lands in your village: a farmhouse, a well, a sheep pen. Keep reading and streak rewards appear on their own. Fill all 30 spots and the village is kept for good. Miss a day and nothing you have built is taken away. Nothing is for sale and nothing is random.

BIBLE TRIVIA, WITH NO RUSH
Rounds of ten questions at three levels. Every answer shows where to find it in the Bible, with a link that opens the passage. Play Daily Trivia, or send a challenge code to a friend so they play the very same questions, even offline. No lives, no timers and no daily limits.

ALSO INSIDE
• Favorites and private notes.
• Collections of verses for comfort, strength, gratitude, hope and more.
• Gospel of the Day on the Philippine Catholic calendar, if you turn it on.
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose.
• Share cards for a verse, your village, a badge or a trivia score.
• Points, levels and badges, all earned by using the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in. Psalmoo collects no data.
• Favorites, notes, the village and your activity stay on your device.
• The app goes online only when you tap Check for updates, to download new verses and questions.
• No ads, no purchases, no chat.

Psalmoo is made by ITDC Systems.

name: PSE KIDS Giáo viên
description:
Ứng dụng hỗ trợ Giáo viên, bếp, tài xế xe bus:
• Điểm danh học sinh (hỗ trợ offline khi mất mạng, tự đồng bộ khi có mạng lại qua hàng đợi queue.ts).
• Trả trẻ (kiểm tra CCCD/ảnh người đón hợp lệ).
• Ghi nhật ký chăm sóc (ăn, ngủ, vệ sinh).
• Đăng album hoạt động, gắn thẻ học sinh.
• Tiếp nhận và xác nhận cho học sinh uống thuốc.
• Vận hành chuyến xe bus đưa đón (GPS thời gian thực).
• Quản lý xuất/nhận đồ dùng, vật tư lớp học.

name: PSE KIDS Nhà trường
description:
Ứng dụng hỗ trợ Ban giám hiệu / Quản lý trường:
• Dashboard tổng quan theo ngày: sĩ số, tỷ lệ đi học/vắng, học sinh chưa điểm danh, học sinh còn tại trường.
• Phê duyệt đơn xin nghỉ học và danh sách đăng ký người đón hộ.
• Theo dõi và xử lý các cảnh báo khẩn cấp.
• Quản lý danh sách các lớp học.

name: PSE KIDS Phụ huynh
description:
Ứng dụng dành cho Phụ huynh học sinh hỗ trợ:
• Theo dõi điểm danh đến lớp và thông tin người đón về.
• Xem nhật ký trong ngày và thực đơn ăn tuần của con.
• Xem album ảnh hoạt động (chỉ ảnh có con mình).
• Biểu đồ phát triển, chiều cao, cân nặng.
• Gửi đơn xin nghỉ học, đăng ký ủy quyền người đón hộ.

• Xem vị trí xe bus đưa đón theo thời gian thực (chỉ khi con đang trên xe).
• Hỗ trợ quản lý nhiều con ở các trường khác nhau.

name: PTAT SE
description: PTATSE organizes your personal income and expenses into a clear, single-page seven-day ledger—perfect for daily tracking, catching up on missed entries, or conducting weekly reviews. Simply tap a date to enter an amount, select the transaction type, category, and account; once saved, you can view the daily subtotal, the net balance for the week, and your current account balances. For multiple small transactions, you can perform calculations (addition/subtraction) before recording them as a single entry or splitting them by category. When catching up on past entries, you can lock the date and queue up multiple transactions, posting them all at once. Frequently used entries can retain their category and account settings for quick, repeated use. The weekly review provides a breakdown of expenses, income sources, and overall cash flow, with the option to expand and view specific transaction details. By entering your actual account balances, you can compare them against your recorded figures, investigate any discrepancies, and gain a clear understanding of where every cent has gone.

name: Pulsuhr
description:
Pulsuhr macht deine Apple Watch zum Bluetooth-Pulsgurt.

Gemacht fürs Indoor-Training mit Zwift und MyWhoosh: Starte die Messung auf der Uhr, und dein iPhone gibt den Puls als Standard-Bluetooth-Pulsgurt frei. Jeder Empfänger, der einen Brustgurt lesen kann, findet ihn: Mac, PC, iPad, Apple TV oder Radcomputer. Nach dem ersten Koppeln verbindet er sich von selbst wieder.

• Eine Zahl, ein Knopf, keine Einstellungen
• Läuft im Hintergrund weiter, auch mit gesperrtem iPhone
• Nichts wird in Health gespeichert, deine Ringe bleiben unberührt
• Keine Konten, kein Internet, keine Werbung

Warum das iPhone? Die Apple Watch selbst kann keinen Bluetooth-Pulsgurt anbieten. Das iPhone übernimmt das für sie.

name: PurrLog — cat health diary
description:
PurrLog is a calm health diary for your cat. A daily check-in takes 30 seconds: appetite, water, litter, activity. PurrLog learns your cat's own normal and gently tells you when something is worth watching — or worth a vet's attention.

30-SECOND CHECK-INS
Four taps a day, with notes and photos.

PERSONAL BASELINE
PurrLog builds the norm of your cat, not the book average. Deviations surface before they become obvious.

INSIGHTS, NOT DIAGNOSES
Insights gently say "watch this" or "ask your vet". PurrLog never diagnoses — it helps you notice what to discuss with a veterinarian.

SOUND DIARY
Coughs, sneezes, wheezing — record the sound; the analysis runs fully on-device. PurrLog notices when episodes become more frequent.

WEIGHT AND PHOTO ESTIMATE
Weight dynamics from manual entries, plus an experimental on-device photo-based estimate.

ONE-TAP VET REPORT
Passport, check-in history, weight and events fold into a tidy PDF report with your clinic branding.

GARDEN AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Your cat garden grows with daily care; achievements mark brushing streaks and milestones.

FAMILY
Invite your family — notes and sounds are visible to everyone.

REMINDERS
Vaccines, parasite drops, nail trims — recurring reminders keep the plan on track.

PRIVACY
Data is stored on the service's server in Russia. No trackers, no analytics. You can delete the account with all data right in the app.

PurrLog is completely free — everything is unlocked, history covers three months. It is not a veterinary service and does not replace a vet.

name: Purrlyze: Cat Health Tracker
description:
Purrlyze is a calm daily journal for your cat. Log food, water and litter in seconds, watch weight over time and walk into the vet with clear records. No account needed, and your records stay on your iPhone.

Not a medical tool. Purrlyze records and organizes; it does not replace a veterinarian.

DAILY CARE
• Mark food, water, drinking, litter and a daily check-in with a tap, then look back at the week.
• Keep separate profiles for every cat, with photos and notes.
• Add a quiet note for play, grooming or time together.
• Record a 5-second sound clip, add a label you choose and keep it in a sound archive. Purrlyze does not interpret meows.

WEIGHT AND TRENDS
• Record weigh-ins in kilograms or pounds and see the line over months.
• See how it changes and keep a file you can show your vet.

CARE DATES AND MEDICATION
• Keep vaccines, parasite care and other dates, with optional reminders and repeat intervals you set.
• Save medication plans exactly as your vet wrote them: times, start and end dates, stock count and a log of what you gave. Purrlyze never suggests a dose.
• Keep a litter log and a place for lab results you enter yourself.

READY FOR THE VET
• Choose the questions you want to ask, work through them during the visit and keep the answers.
• Create a PDF summary of the last 90 days and share it with your vet.
• Make a care card PDF with feeding preferences, for a sitter or a boarding stay.
• Keep documents such as lab reports, prescriptions and vaccine records on your device.

FACE CHECK AND GUIDE
• Look at ears, eyes, muzzle and whiskers with a published Feline Grimace Scale guide, add a photo and keep your own notes. The result is your observation, not an assessment by the app.
• Search an offline guide to toxic plants, foods and household products, with sources such as ASPCA lists (not affiliated with the ASPCA). A plant that is not listed is not proof that it is safe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads and no tracking.
• Cat records, photos and recordings stay on your device. You decide when to export a PDF or a backup file, and you can restore a backup later.
• Memories keep records of a cat who has passed, with reminders turned off.
• Available in English, Turkish, German, Spanish and Portuguese.

PURRLYZE PRO
Purrlyze Pro is an auto-renewing subscription that unlocks the app: daily check-ins, weight, care dates, medication plans, the vet visit tools, the face check and the guide. Records you already have can always be viewed, exported as a PDF and backed up, even without a subscription.
• Purrlyze Pro Weekly: 1 week, 2.99 USD per week
• Purrlyze Pro Yearly: 1 year, 39.99 USD per year
Prices are in US dollars; the store shows the price for your country before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings under Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://purrlyze.com/privacy/

Purrlyze is not a medical device. It does not give medical advice and does not replace a veterinarian. If you are worried about your cat, contact your vet.

name: Puzzle Heaven: 13 Puzzle Games
description:
Thirteen puzzle games in one app!

Puzzle Heaven brings together thirteen puzzle games, each with its own kind of fun. One coin wallet works across every game, and many games let you turn your own photos into puzzles.

■ Games inside
· Marblify – color a gem picture with glass marbles
· Dominify – match dominoes to reveal a picture
· Dunify – pour sand to build a sand art picture
· Knotify – link yarn and knit a picture row by row
· Mowify – mow stripes into the lawn in one stroke
· Purlify – finish cozy knitted artworks
· Rinsify – scrub off grime to reveal the art
· Skylumi – paint the night sky with a drone light show
· Brickolo – build mosaics from bricks
· Pinweave – wrap thread around pins to draw string art
· Reel to the Stars – idle fishing from the sea to space
· Honey Horde – grow your hive in an idle bee game
· Meow Yard – welcome visiting cats to your yard in a cozy idle game

■ Make puzzles from your photos
· Pick just the part of a photo you want and turn it into a puzzle
· Photos are converted only on your device and are never uploaded

■ Handy features
· One shared coin wallet for every game
· Keep playing on a new phone: progress and photo puzzles are saved to iCloud
· Portrait and landscape
· 한국어, English, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文

Puzzle Heaven is free to play and contains ads between rounds, optional rewarded ads, and in-app purchases such as coins, Remove Ads and Unlimited Photo Puzzles.
The Remove Ads 1-month subscription renews automatically each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your App Store account settings.
Please use only photos you took yourself or have permission to use.

Privacy Policy: https://geunsoolee.github.io/puzzleheaven/privacy_en.html

name: Qani
description:
Qani — yaqin atrofdagi salon, restoran, klinika va ustalarni xaritada toping va bir necha soniyada bron qiling. Navbatda turish va qo'ng'iroq qilish shart emas.

• Xaritada toping
Atrofingizdagi joylarni xaritada va ro'yxatda ko'ring: masofa, reyting va ish vaqti bir qarashda.

• Qulay vaqtga bron qiling
Xizmat, mutaxassis, kun va vaqtni tanlang. Restoranlarda mehmonlar soniga mos stolni, ustalarga esa so'rov yuboring.

• Tez qidiring
Kategoriyalar, qidiruv va filtrlar: hozir ochiq, reytingi yuqori, eng yaqin.

• Reyting va sharhlar
Haqiqiy mijozlar fikri, rasmlar va narxlarni ko'rib tanlang, o'zingiz ham sharh qoldiring.

• Bronlaringiz bir joyda
Kelgusi va o'tgan bronlarni kuzating, holat o'zgarsa bildirishnoma oling, kerak bo'lsa bekor qiling.

Ilova o'zbek, rus va ingliz tillarida ishlaydi. Hisobni ilovaning o'zida o'chirish mumkin.

Topasiz: go'zallik salonlari, sartaroshxonalar, restoran va kafe, klinikalar, dorixonalar, sport va fitnes, SPA va massaj, ta'lim markazlari, avto xizmat, ustalar va hokazo.

name: Qatrah - قطرة
description:
Qatrah is the companion app for the Qatrah smart water system installed in your home. See your roof and ground tank levels live, check the pump, and get alerts when municipal water arrives, when your supply may not last until the next delivery, or when a possible leak appears.

• Live tank levels and pump status
• Automatic pump control with dry-run protection (with the installed Qatrah system)
• Water arrival, shortage and possible-leak alerts
• Daily and monthly consumption in litres
• Next-delivery forecast learned from your home's history
• Activity log (laundry, car wash, guests…) to improve forecasts
• AI water assistant: ask about your tanks and usage in Arabic or English, and get answers with charts (enabled per account)
• Several family members can follow the same home
• Full Arabic and English support, including right-to-left layout

A Qatrah system must be installed at your home, and your account is created by our team. Learn more or request a quote at water.automata-jo.com.

name: QikCal: Calorie Tracker
description:
QikCal is an offline calorie tracker and food diary for everyday meals. One App Store purchase includes every feature; there are no subscriptions, in-app purchases, or ads.

Search 159,000 foods in the QikCal Food Library. Choose a listed serving or enter grams, then keep a clear record of what you ate. QikCal works offline and stores your diary on your iPhone.

• Search 159,000 foods, with common-name aliases
• Choose a listed serving or adjust portions by grams
• Track available calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, and fiber
• Add a personal food entry when you need one
• Keep recent foods and favorites close at hand
• Save a meal with its portions and log it again in a tap
• Copy yesterday's meal list or edit entries later
• See a seven-day summary and share a recap only when you choose
• Set an optional daily guide and local reminder
• Export or delete your diary in Settings

No account is required. QikCal includes no analytics or advertising SDK and does not send your diary to a server. Diary data is stored locally and excluded from device backups.

Food energy and nutrient values are estimates per 100 g. Some records have missing values; ingredients and preparation can change the values for a real meal. QikCal is a food diary, not medical advice. For nutrition guidance about a medical condition, consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional.

name: Qreate Pro
description:
Run your whole Discord server from your phone, in seconds.

Tell Q what you want in plain words: a welcome flow, a verification gate, a ticket desk, a raid lockdown. Q reads your channels and roles, puts together a plan, and shows you exactly what would change. Tap Apply and it is live. Changed your mind? Undo it.

From your phone you can:
• Chat with Q, by text or by voice
• Set up roles, channels and features, then apply or undo them
• Turn features on and off and change their settings
• Read and answer support tickets
• Review scenarios before they go live
• See how your server is doing at a glance
• Decide how much Q may do on its own

Built for people who run real communities. You stay in charge, Q does the legwork.

Qreate is an independent product and is not made or endorsed by Discord.

name: Quadrask
description: Quadrask ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ «ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ» ਅਤੇ «ਤੁਰੰਤ» ਦੋ ਸਵਾਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਰ ਖਾਣਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡਦੀ ਹੈ: ਹੁਣੇ ਕਰੋ, ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾਓ, ਸੌਂਪੋ ਜਾਂ ਹਟਾਓ। ਨਵੇਂ ਕੰਮ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ «ਬਕਾਇਆ» ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਖਿੱਚ ਕੇ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਦਲੋ, ਥੋਕ ਨੀਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਕਰੋ, ਖਾਣੇ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਅਤੇ ਨਤੀਜੇ ਦੇਖੋ, ਟੈਗ ਨਾਲ ਛਾਂਟੋ, ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵੇਖੋ। ਸਾਰਾ ਡੇਟਾ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸ ਫ਼ੋਨ 'ਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਐਪ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦੇ ਹੀ ਕੰਮ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

name: Quiet Heist
description:
Welcome to Quiet Heist, a charming and brain-teasing grid-based pathfinding puzzle game!

Step into the shoes of a sneaky little raccoon master thief. The goal is simple: reach the golden door and grab the treasure. But the path is blocked by heavy wooden crates and patrolling guards. You must carefully plan your steps, navigate around the obstacles, and find the safest route to your prize. With limited moves and a ticking clock, every step counts!

Ready to plan the perfect heist? Download Quiet Heist now and start sneaking!

name: Quizmanjaro
description:
Quizmanjaro is a live quiz race for the whole room. Everyone answers the same question on their own phone, and every right answer moves their climber up a mountain on the iPad. The first to reach Uhuru Peak wins.

The nearer the top you get, the slower you climb and the further you fall, so nobody is out of it until the end.

NOTHING TO INSTALL ON PHONES
Players scan the QR code on the iPad, type a name and pick an animal. Any phone with a web browser will do. To show the race on a TV, use AirPlay screen mirroring.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Right answers climb: three steps in the rainforest, two on the moorland, one near the summit.
- Two wrong in a row and you slide back down.
- The fastest right answer earns a Quickfoot bonus step.
- Fall well behind and the Lower Trail shortcut helps you catch up.
- Every climber moves at once after each answer, with the reveal, the climb and the summit moment on the big screen.
- A podium finish with fireworks, then Climb again with the same players.

OVER 7,000 QUESTIONS
Sixteen categories, from History and Geography to Film, Music, Food & Drink, Science and Sport, plus two-answer comparison questions. Play Mixed or pick one category, and choose easy, medium, hard or a climb that gets harder as you go. Questions you have already seen on this iPad are kept back.

FREE TO PLAY
Two climbers, up to 10 questions, Classic Climb.

THE FULL GAME (ONE PURCHASE)
- Up to 20 climbers
- Family Climb: longer to answer, a safety rope for every climber and family-friendly questions
- Close Race: steps and slides that keep the pack together
- Summit Showdown, longer climbs and more ways to play
Buy it once and every game is the full game. Restore purchase brings it back on another device signed in to the same Apple Account.

Made for family evenings, parties and quiz nights. Quizmanjaro needs an internet connection on the iPad and on the phones.

Privacy: players need no account; each game, with its names and answers, is deleted 24 hours after it ends. See quizmanjaro.com/privacy.

name: QuizRing: Trivia & Flag Quiz
description:
Guess the flag, name the capital, beat the clock. QuizRing is a fast trivia game with 10 questions and 10 seconds each.
Build a streak to multiply your score, take on the Daily Challenge and face real players in live 1v1 duels.
Flags of 196 countries, map shapes, capitals, history, science, sports, film, music and more.

GAME MODES
• World: flags, map silhouettes, capitals, currencies, neighbors and population of 196 countries
• General Knowledge: history, science, sports, arts and literature, technology, nature and landmarks, film and music
• Mixed: every topic in one round
• Pick a Category (Pro): play only the topic you love
• Daily Challenge: the same 10 questions for everyone, one try a day. Share your emoji result card with friends
• Duel: real-time 1v1 trivia through Game Center. Quick match or invite a friend and watch your opponent's score live

HOW A ROUND WORKS
• 10 questions, 10 seconds each
• Answer correctly in a row for x2 and x3 streak multipliers
• 3 lives in solo play
• Lifelines: 50:50, Freeze time and Skip

COMPETE AND COLLECT
• Weekly league: climb from Bronze to Silver, Gold and Diamond
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements
• Collection album: every flag you answer correctly is added to your album

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Practice mode with flashcards for flags and country maps
• Untimed questions with a short explanation after every answer
• A great way to learn world geography and capitals

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Around 2,600 questions
• Solo modes work offline
• Available in 11 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Arabic, Japanese, Korean and Chinese
• No account needed. Go Pro to remove ads

QUIZRING PRO
QuizRing Pro removes ads and unlocks Pick a Category and category duels, unlimited practice questions and 3 lifelines every day (one of each). Pro is offered as a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. A pack of 10 lifelines is also available as a one-time purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store Account Settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://functional-thrill-31c.notion.site/QuizRing-Terms-of-Use-415f8e9da76b810f9f74e6f2f8483585

name: Rada Solution
description:
RADA · Рабочее место — корпоративное приложение для сотрудников компании RADA. Всё, что нужно в работе, собрано в одном окне: переписка, звонки, задачи, клиенты и ИИ-ассистент.

Что есть в приложении:
• Главная — что ждёт вашего ответа, план на сегодня и быстрый вход во все разделы.
• Чат компании — общий чат, группы отделов и личные сообщения, голосовые звонки коллегам.
• Rada ChatGPT — ИИ-ассистент с базой знаний компании: ответит на вопрос, поможет с документом, разберёт файл.
• AGENDA — задачи, календарь, канбан, диаграмма Гантта и отчёты.
• CRM — лиды, сделки, клиенты, дизайнеры и дилеры. Ссылки на лид из уведомлений открываются прямо в приложении.
• Management — цели команды, задачи и контрольные точки.
• Заявки в службы — ИТ, ремонт и обслуживание, конструкторское бюро, подбор персонала.
• Уведомления о новых сообщениях и событиях.
• Загрузка и отправка файлов с телефона.

Каждый сотрудник видит только разделы, к которым ему открыт доступ. Вход — по рабочей учётной записи компании.

Приложение предназначено для сотрудников компании RADA. Чтобы получить доступ, обратитесь к руководителю или в ИТ-службу.

name: RAP CARGO
description:
RAP CARGO provides shipment tracking and logistics service information for customers shipping from China to Ghana.
• View your shipments, transport milestones, volume and freight information.
• Track domestic express parcels before they reach the China warehouse.
• View recorded vessel positions associated with containers.
 Estimate freight charges and check bills and payment status.
• Read announcements, find warehouse information and contact support.
• Switch between English and Chinese.
Sign-in is required for personal shipment and billing information. Freight estimates and arrival times are for reference and subject to confirmation. Map tracks show recorded positions and do not represent a complete actual voyage.
Support: 1533318783@qq.com

name: Razzle: The Morning Paper
description:
Spill it tonight. Read it at 6 AM.

Razzle is the morning-after paper for your night out. Start a crew, get everyone in, and start the night. All night, people drop what happens: a note, a photo, a voice note or a 7-second video. Only you see your own drops. At 6 AM your crew's drops make the paper: a one-off magazine about your night, with a cover, headlines, the best quotes and the awards.

The paper never says who sent what. Drops are anonymous, so the tea flows.

GET EVERYONE IN
• Start a crew for a night out or a trip.
• Friends join with a QR code, a short code, a link, or by holding phones together.
• Your crew stays together, so you can reignite the night with the same people any time.

DURING THE NIGHT
• Drop notes, photos, voice notes and 7-second videos. Nobody sees them until morning.
• A group chat for finding each other. The chat isn't anonymous, and the paper can quote it.
• An optional beer counter for the crew.

THE MORNING AFTER
• Your paper arrives at 6 AM, in the style you picked: a 1960s photo weekly or a 1980s glossy.
• Anyone in the crew can take something down for everyone.
• Save a copy to your photos or as a PDF.
• Share a teaser to your Story. The full paper stays in Razzle, for your crew.

ONE ACCOUNT, YOUR PEOPLE
Razzle is part of My Cliques. Your account, your friends and your groups are the same in Razzle, Chances and I'm Bored.

SAFE TO PLAY
Report anything or anyone, block people, and delete your account from the app at any time.

Razzle is for adults 18 and over.

name: Referneec Global
description:
Referneec Global supplies commercial vehicle seating, seat components and repair kits for distributors, workshops and vehicle programmes.

Browse the product catalogue by product family, brand or OEM reference. Review product photographs, primary part numbers and cross-references, then add selected products to your enquiry cart and send one combined enquiry to the Referneec team through WhatsApp.

The app also provides:
• Company announcements and important update alerts.
• Comments on company updates, subject to moderation.
• Company events and a photo gallery.
• Six interface languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, French and Portuguese.
• Direct access to the Referneec website inside the app.
• A secure administrator area for Ivy to manage products, OEM references, updates, events, photos, customer contacts and comments.

Product images, drawings and specifications are for reference. Confirm the vehicle model, seat label, original part number, fitment and availability with Referneec before ordering.

name: Reisefieber
description:
Noch wie lange bis zum Urlaub?

Reisefieber zählt die Tage, Stunden und Minuten bis zu deiner nächsten
Reise – in der App, auf dem Homescreen und auf dem Sperrbildschirm.

DER COUNTDOWN
Ein großer Ring zeigt, wie viel Zeit noch bleibt, und ein kleines Flugzeug
wandert vom Buchungstag bis zum Abflug einmal herum. Darunter laufen
Stunden, Minuten und Sekunden mit.

WIDGETS IN VIER GRÖSSEN
Leg dir den Countdown auf den Homescreen oder auf den Sperrbildschirm. Dann
siehst du beim Entsperren, wie nah der Urlaub schon ist.

MEHRERE REISEN
Plane so viele Reisen, wie du möchtest. Die nächste steht vorn, die anderen
warten in der Liste.

DEIN TITELBILD
Wähle eines der mitgelieferten Motive oder nimm ein eigenes Foto. Mit Zoom
und verschiebbarem Bildausschnitt sitzt es genau richtig.

ERINNERUNGEN
Auf Wunsch meldet sich die App sieben Tage und drei Tage vor der Abreise.
Beides kannst du einzeln ein- und ausschalten.

ALLES BLEIBT AUF DEINEM iPHONE
Kein Konto, keine Anmeldung, keine Server. Reisefieber überträgt keine
Daten – weder an uns noch an Dritte. Es gibt keine Analyse-Werkzeuge, keine
Werbung und keine Bibliotheken fremder Anbieter. Was du einträgst, bleibt
auf deinem Gerät.

Kostenlos, ohne Werbung, ohne In-App-Käufe.

---
„Reisefieber", das Logo und die Titelbilder sind Kennzeichen von Jennifer
Wedermann (Reisefieber Wedermann) und werden mit Genehmigung verwendet.
Herausgeber der App ist Leon Hollmann; das Reisebüro ist nicht Anbieter
der App.

name: RideLogix
description: Keep a local record of your motorcycles: service intervals, fuel, costs, parts, and each ride. GPS tracks are optional; the odometer distance is what you confirm, and manual rides work offline. RideLogix has no account. Export GPX, a backup, or CSV when you want a copy. Route planning needs a network connection and is not offline navigation. Service reminders follow the intervals you enter, so check them against the owner's manual.

name: Rihtem
description: Rihtem ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਦੇ ਹਰ ਦਿਨ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਥੀਮ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ—ਗਹਿਰਾ ਕੰਮ, ਮੀਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਸਨ, ਸਿਰਜਣਾਤਮਕ ਕੰਮ ਜਾਂ ਆਰਾਮ—ਅਤੇ ਥੀਮ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਕੰਮ ਸੁਝਾਉਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਦੀ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਲਿਖ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਿਆਰ ਟੈਂਪਲੇਟ ਚੁਣ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਇੱਕ ਦਿਨ ਨੂੰ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਵਜੋਂ ਬਦਲ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਸਪੁਰਦਗੀ ਅਤੇ ਫੋਕਸ ਦੇੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਾਰਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਇਸੀ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ, ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾਓ, ਬੰਦ ਕਰੋ—ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਓਥੇ ਹੀ ਰਹੇਗਾ।

name: Rillbloom: Water Pipe Puzzle
description:
Tap a tile and it turns. Join the bamboo pipes and the water runs from the spring to every flower. When the last flower opens, the level is done.

Rillbloom is a calm connection puzzle set in Japanese gardens.

LIVING WATER
The water does not wait for the end. It flows with every tap as far as the pipes reach, and drips where a pipe is left open, so you can read the board by watching it.

SOLVED BY LOGIC, NEVER BY LUCK
Every level has exactly one solution, and it can always be found without guessing. A hint shows the next certain step and tells you why.

1000 LEVELS, 20 GARDENS
Each finished level plants flowers in your garden. Every fifth level you choose a new piece for it: a lantern, a bench, a little bridge. Fifty levels complete a garden, and the four seasons come round five times.

MORE TO PLAY
- New things to learn along the way: stones, bridges, two springs, ice, valves, blue and gold water.
- A daily puzzle with a streak, and a calendar to catch up on days you missed.
- Zen mode: endless boards with no counter, on squares or on hexagons.
- Seasonal weeks with their own garden decorations.
- A flower book of everything you have grown.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Supported by ads; one purchase removes the banner and the ads between levels for good.
- The puzzles play offline; the internet is only used for ads and purchases.
- No account.
- Ten languages.

name: Rizqspace · Programme 40 jours
description:
Rizqspace est un programme de 40 jours pour aligner votre rizq : le travail, les clients, l'argent, la famille, la santé, la paix du cœur.

Le principe : ce que vous recevez reflète ce que vous êtes. Le programme vous aide à changer l'intérieur, un peu chaque jour, pour que l'extérieur suive.

40 ÉTAPES, UNE PAR JOUR
Chaque étape se lit en quelques minutes et vous laisse des actions concrètes à faire dans la journée. Les 40 étapes sont réparties en cinq parties : L'Éveil, La Loi, Le Coran décodé, La Pratique, Le Retour.

LE MATIN ET LE SOIR
• Le matin : un rappel pour poser votre intention, à l'heure que vous choisissez.
• Le soir : trois bienfaits de la journée, avant de dormir.

LE VENDREDI, LE MIROIR DE VOTRE SEMAINE
Ce que vous avez accompli : les actions faites, les étapes lues, les jours complets.

LE JOUR 40
Le miroir de vos 40 jours, une carte à partager, puis un nouveau cycle si vous le souhaitez.

CHAQUE PAROLE AVEC SA SOURCE
Chaque verset porte sa sourate et son numéro, chaque hadith son recueil et son numéro.

LA CONSTANCE COMPTE
Chaque action rapporte des RZQ, et chaque jour d'affilée les augmente, jusqu'à ×2. Votre pièce monte avec eux, du fer jusqu'à la légende, et le classement de la semaine vous place parmi les autres membres.

ENSEMBLE
Des discussions entre membres et des événements, en présentiel et en ligne.

GRATUIT, PUIS RIZQSPACE +
Les 14 premières étapes, vos actions de chaque jour et le classement sont gratuits. Rizqspace + ouvre les étapes 15 à 40, les discussions entre membres et les événements.
• 7 jours d'essai gratuit, puis 9,90 € par mois ou 39,99 € par an.
• L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Le paiement est débité sur votre compte Apple. Vous gérez ou résiliez l'abonnement dans les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://samisammari.com/rizqspace/conditions/
Politique de confidentialité : https://samisammari.com/rizqspace/confidentialite/

name: Rommilumi – Rummy
description:
Settle in at the green felt table: in Rommilumi, your cards sit in a wooden rack, with classic face cards and real card sounds bringing each game to life. Play one-on-one Rummy against the computer or real opponents online, following German rummy rules.

CHOOSE YOUR OPPONENT
Play against the computer on easy, medium or strong difficulty. Head online to find a real opponent. If no one is available, the computer takes their place so you can still play a game.

GERMAN RUMMY RULES
The game uses 110 cards: two standard 52-card decks plus six jokers. Each player starts with 13 cards. Build runs and sets, and make your first meld with at least 40 points. You can then add cards to melds and swap jokers. Going out by melding your entire hand at once (known as “Rommé auf die Hand”) counts double.

MAKE THE TABLE YOUR OWN
Choose from five card designs: Gold & Red, Crown, Color Choice with five card-back colors, Mandala and Susi. Your cards stand in a wooden rack on green felt, with traditional face cards and the familiar sounds of real cards.

PLAY WITH A TAP OR A DRAG
Tap cards or drag them with your finger. Sort your hand by suit or rank to keep track of your runs and sets.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Rommilumi is free to play with ads. You can remove the ads with a purchase. No account is needed, and your game progress is stored only on your device. The app is available in German and English.

No real-money gambling.

name: Rørhåndboka 2027
description:
RÖRHANDBOKEN
Varje år ger Rörentreprenörerna Norge ut en ny och uppdaterad version av Rørhåndboka på cirka 650 sidor, tillsammans med denna tillhörande app. Rørhåndboka är ett uppslagsverk som används av rörläggare, lärlingar, yrkesarbetare, konsulter och driftstekniker. Den innehåller fackmässiga lösningar för utförande och montering av rörinstallationer, samt riktlinjer för elektriska installationer.

Rørhåndboka innehåller även rutiner för förebyggande av HMS i samband med rörinstallationer, inklusive säker jobbanalys och första hjälpen. I tillägg innehåller handboken formler och exempel för nyttiga beräkningar, vikter, omräkningstabeller för energi och tryck, monteringsmått, symbolsamling och mer.

Appen baseras på den årligen reviderade utgåvan av handboken och speglar pappersversionen.

Huvudinnehåll i appen och pappersutgåvan:

Sanitetsinstallationer

Värme- och kylanläggningar – värmepumpar

Sprinklersystem, bostadssprinkler, vattendimsystem

Manuella släckutrustningar

Gasvärmeregler

Tryckluftsanläggningar

Isvattenanläggningar

Elektriska arbeten

Utvändiga sanitetsanläggningar

Företag, hälsa, miljö och säkerhet

Beräkningar, vikter

Symboler, enheter, omräkningstabeller

Rörtyper och fogmetoder

Integritet och informationssäkerhet

Kalender

Första hjälpen-sidor

Rørhåndboka Pluss
Detta är den kompletta utgåvan av Rørhåndboka och finns endast digitalt på www.kompetansbiblioteket.no
. Den inkluderar alla kapitel för utförande, projektering och administration.

Rørhåndboka Pluss ger dessutom tillgång till Handbok om vattenskador från Mycoteam samt äldre utgåvor. Besök vvskunnskap.no för mer information och beställning.

name: Rowmini
description:
تطبيق Rowmini هو المنصة السحابية الموحدة للتوظيف المباشر، وبرامج التدريب الجامعي الميداني والعملي، وفحص وتوثيق الشهادات الرسمية، وإدارة شؤون الموظفين والفرق التقنية.

أبرز المزايا والخدمات المتاحة للجميع وللفرق:
• بوابة التوظيف وبنك الكفاءات المفتوح (متاح للجمهور العام): استعراض الشواغر الوظيفية المعلنة، التقديم الفوري أو الانضمام لبنك الكفاءات، وتتبع مراحل التوظيف تفاعلياً (تأكيد المقابلات، تسليم التقييم العملي، وتوقيع العروض الوظيفية إلكترونياً).
• التسجيل العام للتدريب الجامعي والعملي: إمكانية التقديم المباشر لطلبة الجامعات والخريجين الجدد وإنشاء حساب متدرب مع بطاقة متدرب رقمية، تتبع الساعات التدريبية المعتمدة، تسليم المشاريع، وتوقيع اتفاقيات السرية إلكترونياً.
• فحص الشهادات الرسمية: أداة عامة للتحقق الفوري من موثوقية شهادات الخبرة والتدريب الجامعي عبر الرمز المرجعي الرسمي.
• بوابة الموظفين والفرق: تسجيل الحضور والانصراف الذكي (من المقر أو عن بُعد)، عداد الوردية اليومي، متابعة المهام، طلبات الإجازات والشهادات الرسمية، واستعراض قسائم الرواتب والإشعارات الفورية.

ملاحظة: التطبيق مجاني بالكامل (100% Free) ولا يتضمن أي مشتريات أو اشتراكات رقمية مدفوعة.

name: S Tide Beacon
description: S Tide Beacon は、夜の港に潮標を置いて墨潮の歩みを遅くする一人用の守門ゲームです。空いた格子に潮標を置き、同じ格の二枚を融かして高位の標にします。水門が持てば縁が青く光り、残量が戻ります。墨潮が門に触れると水門が割れ、波札は決壊に変わります。図鑑で灯火、寒流、墨毒、風帆を編成し、対読では読秒のあいだに自分の盤へ設置します。巨影討伐では共有の体力と会心率を見ながら召喚します。記録は端末に残り、離れて戻っても港の格子はそのままです。

name: Sales Trend App
description:
Sales Tracking App is the field app for the sales-force platform. Your company sets up its team, customers and routes on the web console; your sales reps use this app to run their day in the field.
 
FOR FIELD REPS
• Check in and out for attendance with a selfie and GPS location
• See today's beat plan: the route and customers you are meant to cover
• Log customer visits with photos, notes and outcome
• Book orders from your company's product catalogue
• Add new customers with a shop photo and exact location
• Submit expense claims and leave requests
• Follow your monthly performance score against the targets your company sets
 
FOR MANAGERS
• Visit dashboard: planned vs completed visits, timings and distance
• Team performance scorecard
• Approve leave and expense claims on the go
 
LOCATION ONLY DURING WORKING HOURS
Location is recorded only between check-in and check-out. Tracking stops the moment a rep checks out.
 
An account is required. Accounts are created by your company administrator, so ask your manager for access. Businesses can request a demo at salestrend.in.

name: Salinity
description:
Salinity is a logbook for reef aquarium water tests that tells you, in plain words, how your tank is doing.

Log a test in under a minute. Every reading is graded Ideal, Acceptable, Poor or Unsafe for the livestock you actually keep, so a soft coral tank and an SPS tank get different answers from the same number. When something is off, Salinity says what to do about it and how fast.

KNOW YOUR TANK AT A GLANCE
• One sentence and one picture tell you how the tank is doing today.
• Ten core parameters: salinity, temperature, pH, alkalinity, calcium, magnesium, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate and phosphate. Add potassium, iodine, strontium, silicate and copper if you test them.
• Charts with your ideal range drawn in, and a second parameter alongside to compare.
• A weekly grid that shows a number drifting before it becomes a problem.

RANGES THAT FIT YOUR LIVESTOCK
• A catalogue of over 190 fish, corals, invertebrates and macroalgae, with care notes and photos.
• Checks that your animals get on, and whether your tank is big enough for each.
• Add your first SPS coral and your target ranges tighten to suit it.

AFTER A MONTH, IT LEARNS YOUR TANK
• Works out how much alkalinity, calcium and magnesium your tank uses each day.
• A heads-up when a parameter is heading out of range.
• The daily dose that holds your tank steady.

TOOLS THAT DO THE SUMS
• Dosing calculator with recipes for mixing your own two-part.
• Salt mix: grams of salt for a batch of new water.
• Top-off: learns your evaporation and warns before the reservoir runs dry.
• Doser: log what you dose and get a setting for your dosing pump.

STAY ON TOP OF THE CHORES
• Reminders for tests, water changes, filter socks, test kits going out of date and anything else you add.
• A journal for water changes, new livestock, equipment and progress photos, with then-and-now compare.
• Timers for your test kits, on the Lock Screen.

STARTING A NEW TANK?
• A fishless cycle guide that follows your ammonia, nitrite and nitrate and tells you when the cycle is complete.
• Plan your livestock while you wait, and check it all gets on before you buy.

AND
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
• Siri: "Log alkalinity in Salinity".
• Import ICP lab results.
• Metric or Imperial, light or dark.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
There is no account, no tracking and no advertising. Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. Export it to a spreadsheet or back it up to a file whenever you like.

SUBSCRIPTION
Salinity is a yearly subscription, and the first month is free. The price is shown before you confirm. Payment is taken from your Apple Account when the free month ends, and the subscription renews each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in Settings → your name → Subscriptions. If your subscription ends, nothing is deleted: you can still view and export everything you logged.

Terms: https://raztras.github.io/salinity-app/terms/
Privacy: https://raztras.github.io/salinity-app/privacy/

Salinity is a logging aid, not professional or veterinary advice. Test kits can be wrong and every tank is different.

name: ScionMonthDeck
description: ScionMonthDeck hjälper odlare att välja grundstam, ympkvist och månad före ympning. Affinitetsmatrisen stoppar olämpliga par, månadsfönstret filtrerar metoder, och diameterjämförelsen visar match-loose-tight-mismatch. Planen sparas i den här telefonen.

name: Seasonal Pug Forecast
description:
Whether started with one question: is it nice enough to take our dogs on a walk? Other weather apps kept annoying me, so here they are, fixed.

• Rain at 1 a.m. put a cloud on a sunny day? Gross. Weather icons now run from sunrise to sunset.
• Looking ahead at highs/lows is nice, but what happens when the high is at 1am and the low is at 2pm? Planning a nice afternoon walk shouldn't be so difficult. Future days provide a short summary just like your least favorite WeatherPerson would report. "Warm in the morning, then freezing and breezy in the afternoon".. no thanks, I'll keep my furry butt inside WITHOUT having to read the hourly first. 
• Feels-like temperature in one spot, air / "real" temperature everywhere else. Now it's feels-like everywhere (or "real", if you're an advanced android or immune to wind damage).
• Compare and configure weather providers and storm models based on what looks best for your location and interests. Optionally use your own paid API keys for supported providers if you prefer their forecasting.
• Thinking of a vacation in Iceland in January, or Thailand in September? Create a plan and see what the weather has looked like on those dates over the last 1 to 50 years. Share it with a friend or partner (or don't, I won't tell).
• Ugly layout? Ugly colors? Units? Configure (mostly) everything you can get your grubby little paws on.
• Like pugs? Great, the icon changes seasonally and contains real photos of a real, very hungry and grumpy, Pug. Don't like pugs? Have fun with your other apps, nerd.

No account, ads, or tracking. Ever. The codebase is, and always will be, open-source and fully transparent. Want to steal it and charge money for it? I can't stop you, but implore you to donate proceeds to an animal rescue or shelter near you.

Data: Open-Meteo and MET Norway (CC BY 4.0), NOAA, the National Weather Service, the National Hurricane Center, Apple Weather. Credits in Settings.

name: SEO AI Overview Checker
description:
SEO AI Overview Checker is the mobile app for the self-hosted SEO AI Checker panel. Follow your sites' classic SEO health and their visibility in AI search from anywhere.

WHAT YOU CAN SEE
• Site health score and issues ranked by priority, each with how to fix it
• Google rankings and keyword history
• Whether Google AI Overviews cite your site
• Whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity mention your brand
• Comparison with competitors and your Share of Model in AI answers
• Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals performance scores
• On-page SEO, robots.txt, sitemap, security header and WHOIS checks
• What improved and what got worse recently, sorted by impact

HOW IT WORKS
The app connects to your SEO AI Checker panel's address and you sign in with your account. Data is read directly from your own panel server. The panel is open source: install it on your own server or connect to a panel that invited you. Switch to the web panel with one tap for detailed actions.

PRIVACY
No ads and no advertising ID. The app uses Firebase only for crash reports and anonymous usage statistics. You can delete your account at any time from the app's Settings screen.

Note: Using the app requires a reachable SEO AI Checker panel and an approved account.

name: SERENDY: Idol Territory Arcade
description:
The neon music city has gone silent, and the seven members of the idol group SERENDY are trapped.
Draw lines, claim territory and dodge the monsters. Their rescue is at your fingertips.

■ CLAIM THE CITY, LINE BY LINE
Leave the safe edge, draw a line and close it to claim that land.
Don't let the monsters touch you while you draw.
Claim enough of the board to clear the stage. Cut a big piece in one line for a challenge star.

■ 200 STAGES, 20 DISTRICTS
Slime, ice, lava, lightning, mirrors, webs, portals and more.
Every district ends with a shape-shifting boss. Break it with five weapons and the attack gauge.

■ RESCUE THE MEMBERS, COLLECT PHOTOCARDS
Bring VEGA, ORLA, ISLA, NOLA, SERA, AZRA and LYRA home.
Fill your binder with 101 photocards and collect posters.

■ TWIN DECK BONUS MODE
Tap album songs and stage songs with two thumbs. EASY, MEDIUM and HARD. EASY has no fail.

■ JUKEBOX
Play 7 album songs and 20 stage tracks, and browse music video shots.

■ EVERY DAY
Three challenge stars on every stage, a Daily Stage and the Beat Roulette.

■ GOOD TO KNOW
Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases (gold packs, starter pack, ad removal, heart box).
Photocard albums are opened with in-game fan points or gold and contain random cards. Draw rates are always shown in the game. After 30 albums in a row without LUCKY DRAW or better, the next one is LUCKY DRAW or better.
Available in 13 languages.

name: Shoogle the Sheep
description:
Shoogle the Sheep is a push-your-luck party game with a Scottish accent. Give two woolly sheep a shoogle (a shake), toss them into the fank and score how they land. Keep shoogling to pile up points, or bring them in and bank them before you get Fleeced!

HOW IT PLAYS

- Flick the sheep up the screen, shake your phone or press Shoogle! to throw.
- Every landing has a name and a score: Cowpit (on its back), Stannin' (on its feet), Neb-doon (on its nose), the rare Hurdie-sit, and doubles worth four times as much.
- Points sit "on the hill" until you bring them in. Land the two sheep on opposite sides and you are Fleeced: the hill is lost.
- First to 100 wins. Or play Ae Shot: one turn each, and the best bank wins.
- A close call replays itself in slow motion, so you can see just how near it was.

PLAY TOGETHER

- Pass and play: 2 to 6 players on one phone. Once you have signed in, it needs no internet.
- Play your pals online: make a room and send them a link, or let them scan its QR code. Each of you plays on your own phone, and a pal can join straight from a web browser.
- Play a stranger: a quick game against another shepherd. There is no chat, and a stranger sees a name the game picks for you unless an adult changes that.
- Make it a match: best of 3 or best of 5.
- Online matches count towards weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards. Nobody is shown by name until they switch it on.

MAKE IT YOURS

- Dress your shepherd and your sheep, and choose the field you play in.
- Earn Shillings by playing online and spend them on looks: a tam for your sheep, green wellies, a broody hen at heel. Shillings cannot be bought.
- Seasonal looks for Halloween, Christmas and lambing time.

GOOD TO KNOW

- No chat, no friend requests and no way for a stranger to find you again.
- No random prizes and no loot boxes: every look shows what it is before you get it.
- In the app you sign in with Apple or Google, so your sheep and what it has earned come with you to any device.
- Free to play, with one advert after a game and never during play.
- Optional purchases, made by an adult: the Croft Pass, a single payment (no subscription) that removes adverts for everyone at your table, and a few extra looks.

Ready to shoogle? Dinnae get Fleeced!

name: Şifreli Bulmaca
description:
Bir kelimeyi bulduğunda gizli cümlenin bir parçası açılır. Aynı numarayı taşıyan kutular aynı harfi paylaşır. Açılan harflerden yararlanarak sıradaki ipucunu çöz ve cümleyi tamamla.

Şifreli Bulmaca, Türkçe ipuçlarıyla oynanan bir kelime oyunudur. İlk bölümlerde kısa ve gündelik kelimelerle başla. İlerledikçe daha uzun cümleler ve daha düşündürücü ipuçlarıyla karşılaş.

1. Plan the session. Create an activity, choose the organizer's time zone, and set the planned start and end. Search the offline catalog by name or catalog number to select a star, cluster, nebula, or galaxy.

2. Add your teams' observing sites. Enter the coordinates, local time zone, and times each team can attend. Set a minimum altitude and use the compass and horizon editor to mark buildings, trees, or ridges that block the view. Mark which teams must be able to observe for the session to go ahead.

3. Find the shared window. Read the longest continuous window and the total shared time. Move the timeline cursor to see each site's local date, time, and the target's altitude and direction at the same instant. Tap a gap in the All sites row to see which teams are limited by twilight, obstructions, altitude, or attendance, and where information needs checking.

4. Compare and reschedule. Drag the activity interval to try a different start, or use Find a better time to look for an earlier or later slot without changing the session length. Use Compare to check other dates and targets against the saved attendance. Apply a result or create an alternative so you can revisit the original plan.

5. Give each team its observing time. Save a snapshot of the plan and share PDF time cards for one site or for all sites. Each card pairs the shared UTC window with that site's local date and time, UTC offset, and where to look at the start.

Open Orion over East Asia to try a complete example with three sites. Then set up a session with your own teams. The catalog, calculations, and saved plans work offline, with no account required. Export and restore a backup from within the app.

Visibility estimates use geometric twilight and the horizon and attendance you enter. Check weather, clouds, and local lighting separately.

name: Solar: The Solar System
description:
Solar is a solar system simulator built to be checked rather than admired.

Thirty-two bodies, positioned from the JPL Standish element tables and rotating on the axes the IAU WGCCRE report gives them. Every number on screen is computed from those sources on your device rather than typed into a screen, and where two sources disagree, the app says so instead of hiding it in a tolerance.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Watch the system run. Scrub the clock from real time to a century a second, jump to any date, and run the whole thing backwards.

Switch gravity. Choose between the Standish rails and a full N-body integration, with energy, momentum and angular-momentum drift shown on screen as it runs — because someone who cannot tell which model they are looking at cannot trust either one.

Find what is off screen. Focused on Earth, the Moon is sixty Earth radii away and simply not in frame. A pointer at the edge of the screen says which way it is and how far, which nothing else on screen can.

Stand on the surface. Real mission photographs from the five worlds ever photographed from their own ground — Venus, Earth, the Moon, Mars and Titan — and an honest explanation for every world with none.

Make it habitable. What it would actually take to live on Venus or Mars, derived rather than asserted: energy balance, atmospheric escape, the mirror area you would have to build.

See real terrain. Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter elevation on the Moon, with craters that shade correctly through the terminator. When the screen out-resolves the data, the app says that is what happened rather than letting you conclude the Moon is smooth.

Watch deep time. The Sun at 71 per cent of today's brightness when Earth formed, and the habitable zone sweeping outwards for four and a half billion years since.

Read Earth's time zones against where the Sun actually is, which turns out to be a good way to see that a time zone is a decision rather than a measurement.

HOW ACCURATE, PLAINLY

Heliocentric positions are good to roughly 20 arcseconds over 1800 to 2050. That is the published error of the Standish tables themselves, and about 14,000 km at one astronomical unit: enough to answer "hit, escape or stay" with confidence, and not enough to claim a flyby distance to the kilometre. Moon positions come from mean elements and are good to about a degree. This is not an eclipse-grade ephemeris and does not pretend to be. The interface says which is which, where it matters.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING

No accounts, no subscriptions, no advertising, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Solar collects nothing about you and works offline. The one thing it ever fetches is the surface photographs, straight from NASA, at the moment you open them.

• Speakers on your Wi-Fi are found automatically

FREE
30 tunes, including Autumn Leaves, All the Things You Are, Blue Bossa, Stella by Starlight, Solar, So What, Footprints and the blues, with every chart, diagram, key and fretboard feature, and chord playback.
