name: SteepAndSwirl
description:
Dial in the milk tea and iced coffee you make at home. Start with Brown Sugar Assam, Jasmine Milk Tea, or an Iced Oat Latte, or enter your own recipe. Set your cup size, serving count, and syrup level to get a batch sheet with the amounts in milliliters and grams.

Follow the brew steps and use the steep timer for tea. If you leave the app, you can return to your active session and see the time remaining. Rate each batch, jot down what you tasted, and compare two batches of the same recipe side by side. Each tasting keeps its original ingredient amounts so you can see exactly what changed. Your recipe book and tastings are available offline.

name: STICKFURY: Naya Games
description:
A missing friend, a suspicious shipping logo and a door that would not listen. Milo follows the trail with his fists, improvised weapons and very little patience.

STICKFURY combines fast stickman combat with comics and dry dialogue. Chain punches and kicks, launch enemies into the air, throw knives and switch between melee weapons and firearms. Temporary weapons taken from enemies can help you through the next group.

• Ten stories: 100 levels with five rooms each.
• Group combos, aerial combat and spectacular finishers.
• Fight across workshops, docks, offices, galleries and more.
• Choose weapons, masks, headwear, gloves and shoes.
• Eight languages with bundled voices and comics.

STORY 1 IS FREE
Play all ten levels and fifty rooms of the first story for free. One optional permanent purchase unlocks stories 2–10 together. Levels still unlock in order. No subscription.

OPTIONAL EXTRAS
Gold packs speed up equipment purchases. Infinite Ammo is a separate permanent purchase for your own firearms: normal reloading still applies. It does not include free weapons, gold or paid stories. Weapons found on enemies remain temporary.

Combat works offline. Purchases and restoration need the App Store and an internet connection. Permanent purchases can be restored using the same Apple Account; local progress and consumed gold do not automatically transfer.

The game includes stylized violence and finishers. Blood effects can be toggled in settings.

Support: naya_games@hotmail.com

name: StickyAlarm: Notes & Reminders
description:
Sticky note reminders that actually ring.

StickyAlarm is a recurring alarm to-do list that looks like a board of sticky notes. Add a task, set a time, and choose how you want to be reminded. For the things you can't forget, switch on an alarm.

THREE WAYS TO BE REMINDED
• Notification: a gentle banner and sound
• Alarm: rings like an alarm clock for tasks that matter
• No alert: keep the time on the note without a sound

RECURRING REMINDERS AND ROUTINES
Repeat any note every day, on certain weekdays, every month, or every few days. Perfect for habits, medicine, chores, bills and daily routines. Mark a repeating note done and it moves to its next date, so tomorrow's reminder is never lost.

KEEP LINKS AND VIDEOS ON YOUR NOTES
Paste a link to a video, an article or an online document and keep it right on the note, so what you need is one tap away when your reminder goes off.

A CHECKLIST THAT FEELS PERSONAL
Choose from six paper colors, handwriting-style fonts and paper themes like Cork Board and Night Sky. Notes tilt, stick and peel like the real thing.

SEE WHAT YOU FINISHED
Mark a task done and it moves to your Done wall, so you can look back at what you finished today and this week. No streaks and no guilt.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account needed. Your notes stay on your iPhone.

FREE TO START, PLUS WHEN YOU WANT MORE
Unlimited notes, recurring reminders and alarms are free. StickyAlarm Plus adds extra handwriting styles, themes and more. Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. You can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://stickyalarm-legal-asifzaz.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://stickyalarm-legal-asifzaz.vercel.app/terms
Support: https://stickyalarm-legal-asifzaz.vercel.app/support

name: Stillmark FX Desk
description: ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದেবರಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಕರೆನ್ಸಿ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ದರಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮಂತೆ ನವೀಕರಿಸಿ. ಒಂದು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಕರೆನ್ಸಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರವಾಸದಾಗಿ ದಿನವಾರು ಖರ್ಚು ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಹಳೆ ದರಗಳನ್ನು ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಯಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಸಿ, ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಡೇಟಾ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಮುಚ್ಚಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ತೆರೆದರೂ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ.

name: StillRoom: Cozy Focus & Sleep
description:
Step into a quiet miniature world of your own. StillRoom blends atmospheric illustrated rooms, spatial binaural soundscapes, and gentle focus & sleep rituals across Mac and iPhone.

TAP THE ROOM TO SHAPE THE SOUND
• Window: cycle Clear, Drizzle, or heavy Storm with organic distant thunder — or crack the window slightly in the Mixer to shift between warm indoor glass acoustics and crisp outdoor rain.
• Brass Desk Lamp: cycle Dim, Warm, or Bright lighting, or turn on the 4-7-8 clinical sleep breathing light.
• Cup / Hearth: toggle train rail cadence, fireplace crackle, spacecraft cabin hum, or deep ocean currents.
• Turntable: toggle warm spatial-reverb vinyl Lo-Fi melodies (Midnight Jazz, Kyoto Felt Piano, Starlight Celesta, Forest Harp).

BUILT FOR BOTH DAYTIME FOCUS & NIGHTTIME SLEEP
• Focus Journey (25m / 50m): watch a warm horizon glow arrive in the final 90 seconds, ending with a soft wind-chime bell.
• Sleep Fade-Out (30m / 60m): pairs the 4-7-8 breathing lamp with a smooth 5-minute fade-out of both audio and lighting. Background audio keeps playing smoothly on locked iPhones.
• Pure Mode & Saved Mixes: hide all controls for distraction-free focus ambiance, and save your favorite combinations.

FAIR ONE-TIME PRICING — NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Free forever with zero ads: Midnight Express & Pinewood Cabin worlds, 2 vinyl tracks, all timers, 4-channel fine mixer, 1 saved favorite, and iPhone lock-screen background audio.
• StillRoom Pro ($6.99 one-time universal purchase for Mac & iPhone, Family Shareable): unlocks Orbital Deck, Midnight Ramen, Abyssal Sub (plus future worlds), all 4 vinyl records, and up to 8 saved mixes.

name: Subz- Find a Sub
description:
Game at 7. You're one short. Subz gets your roster filled before warmups.

Built for Denver rec and league volleyball, Subz connects captains who need a player with people who want more court time.

NEED A SUB?
• Star the players you trust and ask them all at once
• Or post the open spot so anyone at your level can offer to play
• Pick who plays by comparing profiles side by side, or let the first yes take the spot
• Extras wait on a waitlist and move in automatically if someone drops
• See who's in at a glance

WANT TO PLAY MORE?
• Set your skill level, positions, and the nights you're usually free
• Only hear about games that fit you
• Find pickup games on your open nights
• Get a reminder on game day so you never miss a match

REACHED HOW YOU LIKE
Choose push notifications or email for sub requests and replies. You're in control and can change it anytime.

Free to use. Sign in with Google or Apple, so there's no password to remember.

name: Sudoku.exe: Retro Worlds
description:
What if a sudoku grid could take you somewhere else?

In Sudoku.exe, the rules stay the same: nine rows, nine columns, nine boxes, one single solution. Everything else changes. The scenery, the music, the shape of the numbers. One game above the clouds, the next by a lagoon, by day or by night.

The game is a nod to the 64-bit console era: bold colors, toy-like buttons, even a retro screen effect with fine scanlines.

Play at your own pace
• Five levels, from Easy to Master, plus Extreme with the Season Pass.
• Puzzles created on your phone, as many as you like, each with a unique solution.
• Undo, erase, and Notes mode to keep track of your ideas. Notes you no longer need can clear themselves.
• A break, a phone call, the game closed: your grid, notes and time are waiting for you.
• A few hints per game, from five on Easy to two on Expert and Master.
• Adjustable visual helpers: row and column, box, matching numbers, duplicates, completed numbers.

Three mistakes? It happens. Nobody is perfect. If you let the game flag mistakes, the third one ends the game, and a second chance hands it back to you without erasing your grid.

One puzzle a day
The Daily Challenge brings a new puzzle every day, the same one for everyone. The monthly calendar keeps track of the challenges you complete.

Your progress
Experience with every win, levels, your best time on each difficulty, flawless wins and days played in a row. And badges, earned by playing.

A collection of worlds
Two worlds are free: Sky Islands and Turquoise Lagoon. Each comes in three versions. POP, still scenery. SUPER, the same world in motion. COSMIC, scenery that reacts to your game around the grid. Day or night, your choice. Each world also brings its own music, and its own numbers in a light or dark style.
Five more worlds are waiting: Atlantis City, Lands of Egypt, Neon Circuit, Enchanted Woods and Amazon Rainforest.

Season Pass and World Packs
The Season Pass unlocks every world of the season and the Extreme level. A World Pack unlocks one world of your choice, with its music and numbers. These are one-time purchases, no subscription, and “Restore purchases” brings them back.

Your console, your rules
Separate music and sound effect volumes, reduced motion for a calmer game, English or French.

A real break
No account. No ads. The game works offline and your progress stays on your phone. For once, the glowing rectangle in your pocket asks nothing of you.

In short: one puzzle, one world, and all the time you need. Enjoy the game!

name: Sunny Shelter
description:
A new little one arrived at the small shelter below Sunny Hill today. At first it curls up in a corner and will not meet your eyes, but with meals, gentle pats and a warm bath, it slowly opens up.

Sunny Shelter is a cozy shelter management game about caring for dogs and cats and finding each of them the right family. As the Director, you run the shelter with your caretakers and tend Sunny Hill outside.

■ A shelter where the caretakers get to work
· When a meal, petting, bath, checkup or play bubble pops up over a little one, a caretaker hurries over
· Tap a bubble to have that care done first and faster. Tap a little one to give it a gentle pat yourself
· Hanbom (care), Osol (grooming) and Yunseul (checkups) work alongside volunteer Daon and play caretaker Nuri
· As the shelter's reputation grows, more little ones and families come by

■ Open hearts, new families
· Each time a heart opens a little more, the little one's look and story are revealed line by line
· Read each visiting family's profile and introduce them to the little one that fits the home they hope for
· See the little one off at the door when it leaves with its new family. Before long, a letter arrives from the new home

■ Growing Sunny Hill
· Build and upgrade the Veggie Patch, Treat Kitchen, Sunny Café and more to keep the shelter running
· Place flower beds, play tunnels, a seesaw, a melon-field lookout and other decorations, and neighbors stop by to look
· Expand the land to discover hidden spots and the stories that go with them
· Seasons change, night falls and rain comes

■ A day on the hill
· Little ones whose hearts have opened run around the hill and make best friends
· Visitors roll a ball for a dog to fetch, and cats tidy their claws at the scratching post
· Neighbors drop by with favors and leave gifts. When the hill gets lively, a village festival begins
· On clear nights, make a wish on a shooting star

■ Good to know
· Free to play. Watch an ad only when you want a doubled reward; a short ad sometimes appears during breaks
· Join Sunny Supporters (monthly or lifetime) for no ads during breaks and instant ad rewards. You can play to the end without buying anything
· No account needed. Progress is saved on this device
· Each little one's artwork is downloaded the first time you meet them. After that you can play offline
· Time passes slowly at the shelter while the app is closed (up to two hours)
· The little ones never get worse, and there is no time limit. Take it slow
· Text in Korean, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Survenue Yield
description:
An empty stretch of land by the river awaits its first decision, and only you know what will rise on every tile. In Survenue Yield, every building changes the world around it: a quiet home flourishes beside trees but suffers from the clang of a nearby forge. Buildings arrive one at a time in a predetermined order, and you can always see the next three. A clever move improves the surrounding area while claiming space that another building might need later. Every placement demands careful planning, like a surveyor studying a blueprint. Each new land presents its own puzzle, and together they become a capital city shaped by your decisions.

Key Features

* Preview exactly how much each neighboring tile will gain or lose before committing to a placement.
* Watch a humble home grow into a mansion as one perfectly placed building triggers a chain reaction across the neighborhood.
* Forge smoke drifts with the wind, and only living greenery can stop its spread.
* Festival tents draw crowds, delight nearby homes, and disappear after a few turns.
* Snowdrifts, rocks, slopes, and waterways determine where buildings can stand.
* Special decrees rewrite exactly one rule, such as silencing the forge’s hammering near a garden.
* After construction, read a newspaper spread revealing what really happened on your city streets.

Return to that empty land by the river. Now you know that every tile has a purpose, and every decision comes at a cost. Complete all twelve lands flawlessly, and a golden citadel will rise above your capital’s skyline. It appears only for those who can think three moves ahead. Sacrifice only what you must, claim everything else, and prove that this capital is rightfully yours.

name: SVSD Lunch
description:
Know what's for lunch at your kid's school, and never miss a day they planned to buy it.

SVSD Lunch shows today's lunch the moment you open it: every choice, with the sides that come with it. Below is the whole week, and the arrows go ahead to the weeks the district has already posted.

JUST ASK SIRI
• "What's School Lunch today?" Or tomorrow, or Friday.
• "Look up School Lunch," then say any date, like December 1st.
• "What's the School Lunch menu next week?"
• "Search School Lunch," then name a dish, like pizza, to hear the next day it's served.
• "Buy School Lunch on Friday." Siri asks when to remind you.
• "Am I buying School Lunch tomorrow?"
• "Which days am I buying School Lunch?"
After telling you a day's lunch, Siri offers to mark it as a buying day, so one question can do both. You can also pick your kid's choice, change a reminder or cancel a day without opening the app.

REMINDERS FOR BUYING DAYS
Tap Remind on the days your kid will buy lunch and choose when to hear about it: the night before, the morning of, or both. Pick which choice they're getting and the reminder says so. If the district changes the menu and a day no longer has lunch, you'll get a notification.

EVERY SCHOOL IN THE DISTRICT
Choose from the district's elementary, middle and high schools. Middle and high school menus show the daily special and every open station, from the Grill to On the Go.

ALSO
• Search for a dish from your Home Screen to find the day it's served.
• An optional morning notification with each school day's lunch.
• Shortcuts actions for your own automations.
• Shows the last menu it loaded when you're offline.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your school, buying days and reminders stay on your device.

SVSD Lunch is an independent app. It isn't made by, affiliated with or endorsed by the Snoqualmie Valley School District. Menus come from the district's published lunch menus and can change; check with your school for prices, allergens and meal accounts.

name: Swim Analyst
description:
Swim Analyst macht aus dem Ergebnisdienst eines Schwimmwettkampfs eine Auswertung für Trainerinnen und Trainer.

Adresse des Ergebnisdienstes eingeben, die eigenen Schwimmerinnen und Schwimmer antippen, fertig. Die App liest Meldeergebnis, Startlisten, Protokolle und LENEX-Dateien selbst und holt neue Ergebnisse mit „Aktualisieren“.

• Ablauf: wer wann in welchem Lauf auf welcher Bahn schwimmt, mit Countdown bis zum nächsten Start
• Bilanz: beste Zeit je Start gegen die Meldezeit, Finals und Medaillen des Teams
• Athlet: alle Rennen, Streckenverlauf aus den Zwischenzeiten, Entwicklung über mehrere Meisterschaften
• Leistungsreserven: wo ein Rennen Zeit liegen lässt, gemessen am Profil der acht Schnellsten und an deren eigener Streuung, mit einem konkreten Hinweis fürs Training
• Vergleich im Team: Finalgrenze, Punkte, Reaktion, Tempoabfall und Abstand zur DSV-Norm, mit 95-%-Intervallen und Filtern nach Runde, Lage, Strecke und Gruppe
• Wahlweise Vergleich mit der Deutschen Spitze aus gespeicherten Deutschen Meisterschaften
• International: das Ergebnisbuch einer Weltmeisterschaft als PDF importieren und mit Finals und Halbfinals vergleichen. Die Datei bleibt auf dem Gerät.
• PDF-Auswertung für das ganze Team, eine Gruppe oder eine Person, zum Teilen mit dem Trainerteam

Jede Kennzahl ist an echten Rennen geprüft: Die App zeigt nur, was bei derselben Person vom Vorlauf zum Finale wiederkehrt. Start, Unterwasserphase und Wenden misst sie nicht einzeln, denn die Protokolle enthalten dafür keine Daten.

Funktioniert mit Ergebnisdiensten, die mit EasyWk erstellt werden, und mit LENEX-Dateien. Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Datenerfassung: Alles bleibt auf dem Gerät.

name: SwingTrace
description:
How far can a paper star turn before it brushes the glass? If two hanging pieces cross paths in a top view, will they actually touch? SwingTrace helps you find out before you cut a cord or hang a piece.

Build a layout for a shop window, display cabinet, art installation, or classroom project. Enter the outlines of your pieces, their hanging points, cord lengths, and how far they can rotate. Add glass or a back panel wherever you need to check clearance.

• Inspect a pose. Turn a piece and watch the top and height views update together. See the nearest points, the gap, and where contact can happen.
• Explore the angles. Tap a cell in the heat map to check a specific angle combination, then replay it in both views.
• Try a different cord. Lock the hanging point, set a target gap, and find cord lengths that meet it within the modeled rotation range.
• Compare your options. Save a trial as a new plan and see how its minimum clearance compares with the original.

Open the built-in window study to see how changing one cord can turn a contact into a 20 mm gap. Start a blank plan when you’re ready to enter your own measurements.

Your plans and calculations stay on your device. SwingTrace works offline on iPhone and iPad without an account.

name: Table et Matière
description:
Table et Matière est une boutique d’arts de la table pour les particuliers, les restaurants et les hôtels. Retrouvez vingt références de porcelaine, de grès, de cristal et de couverts en acier, réunies en cinq collections.
Pour votre tableChoisissez une assiette à l’unité, complétez votre service de verres ou réunissez les pièces d’une table dressée. Les fiches détaillent les matières, les dimensions et les conseils d’entretien. Ajoutez vos pièces au panier, ajustez les quantités et retrouvez vos favoris, vos adresses et vos récapitulatifs de commande dans votre espace personnel.
Pour les professionnelsPréparez l’équipement d’une salle ou le renouvellement d’un service. Consultez les tarifs par quantité, calculez le montant TTC selon le nombre de pièces et enregistrez vos devis pour comparer plusieurs sélections. Des échantillons sont proposés sur certaines références.

name: Task TwaBo
description:
Task TwaBo – Plan your tasks, organize your week

Stay on top of your tasks and bring structure to your week with Task TwaBo. A simple and flexible app that helps you manage tasks, organize your schedule, and keep track of the time you need.

All data is stored locally on your iPhone or iPad. No cloud storage service or internet connection required! No Face ID required. No account needed.

ORGANIZE YOUR TASKS
- Easily create your own tasks.
- Group tasks into categories to keep everything organized.
- Add notes and an estimated duration to your tasks.
- Edit your tasks whenever you need to.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
 -Choose which tasks to schedule for each day.
- Set a preferred start time for your tasks.
- Easily move and organize tasks within your weekly schedule.
- View the estimated duration of each task.

STAY ORGANIZED
- View your daily schedule in the Today tab.
- View your complete weekly schedule in the Week tab.
- Manage all your available tasks in the All Tasks tab.
- View the total scheduled time for each day and for the entire week.
- Check off tasks as soon as they are completed.

name: Tawaf - Umrah Guide
description:
Tawaf is a companion for Shia pilgrims performing Umrah. It takes you through
the whole trip, from the month before you leave to your farewell tawaf, and
it works with no connection.

STEP BY STEP
Each rite of Umrah Mufradah in order: ihram, tawaf, the prayer of tawaf,
sa'y, taqsir, tawaf al-nisa' and its prayer. Every step shows a short
checklist of recommended acts with the supplication on screen.

RULINGS OF SAYYID SISTANI
Summaries of the rulings for each step, with their ruling numbers, carried
inside the app: miqats, ihram and what it forbids, tawaf and its doubts,
sa'y and taqsir.

SUPPLICATIONS AND ZIYARAT
The supplications of Umrah and the ziyarat of Makkah from Adab-o-Ziyarat,
shown as printed, with English translation. The ziyarat of Madinah from
Mafatih al-Jinan: the Holy Prophet, Sayyida Fatima, the Imams of al-Baqi',
Hamza and the martyrs of Uhud.

YOUR WHOLE TRIP
Flights, hotels with dates and directions, a day-by-day itinerary, passport
and visa details, photos of your documents behind your phone's lock, and
contacts with tap to call.

COUNTDOWN AND REMINDERS
A plan for the month before, the last week and the day before you leave,
with optional reminders.

TOOLS
Tawaf and sa'y counter. Prayer times by the Shia Ithna-Ashari method. Qibla
compass. Packing and check-out checklists. Search.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything you enter stays on your phone.

Tawaf gives guidance, not a fatwa. For your own situation, ask a scholar or
the office of your marja.

name: Ternium
description:
Ternium é uma plataforma digital de formulários e pesquisas colaborativas.
Permite criar, preencher e gerenciar formulários de forma simples, segura e rápida, diretamente pelo aplicativo ou pela web.

Ideal para empresas, equipes e profissionais que precisam coletar dados, realizar inspeções ou aplicar questionários personalizados.
Os formulários podem incluir textos, imagens, assinaturas e anexos, com suporte a funcionamento offline e sincronização automática com a nuvem.

Principais recursos

Criação e preenchimento de formulários dinâmicos

Coleta de dados com fotos, geolocalização e assinaturas

Funciona online e offline

Sincronização automática e armazenamento seguro

Interface intuitiva e em português (Brasil)

Gerenciamento de conta
O cadastro é gratuito e pode ser feito diretamente no aplicativo ou no site oficial inspectapp.com.br.
Para excluir uma conta ou solicitar remoção de dados, basta abrir um ticket de suporte no site e seguir as instruções.

Privacidade e permissões.
O app não coleta informações pessoais sem consentimento.
Uma verificação de Bluetooth pode ser solicitada por dependência técnica de terceiros, mas nenhuma funcionalidade depende dele.

name: The Baldor Group
description:
The Baldor Group app puts the Central Florida housing market right in your hand, with a dedicated local guide beside you from the first search to the closing table.

Your Search, Your Way: Set your must-haves, from neighborhood and price range to home style, and see matching properties the moment they appear.
A Direct Line to Your Agent: Message Bobby and the team in the app. Share homes you love, send questions, and keep every conversation in one place.
Save and Compare: Tap to favorite listings, build your shortlist, and revisit the homes that stood out as your plans take shape.
Instant Alerts: Get notified as new homes hit the market or when a property you’re watching changes, so you can act with confidence.
Selling Made Simple: Thinking of listing? Reach out directly from the app to talk through your goals and next steps.

Whether you’re settling near the theme parks, the lakes, or the quiet suburbs, The Baldor Group is ready to help you find your place in Central Florida.

name: The Hub: uñas y pestañas
description:
The Hub es un estudio de uñas, pestañas y cejas en Xanadu Plaza, La Aurora (Daule). Con la app reservas tu cita en minutos, sin escribir ni esperar respuesta.

RESERVA EN MINUTOS
• Elige el servicio, el día y la hora que te quedan mejor.
• Mira los horarios libres al momento.
• Si no hay espacio, entra a la lista de espera y te avisamos cuando se libere uno.

TUS CITAS EN UN SOLO LUGAR
• Revisa tus próximas citas o cancélalas desde la app.
• Agrégalas a tu calendario.
• Recibe recordatorios antes de cada cita.

BENEFICIOS
• Tarjetas de sellos y puntos que canjeas en el estudio.
• Invita a tus amigas con tu código.

SERVICIOS
Manicura y pedicura en seco con drill, semipermanente, kapping gel, extensiones de polygel, lifting de pestañas, laminado de cejas, henna y depilación.

¿Dudas? Escríbenos por WhatsApp desde la app.

name: The Last Beacon
description:
Year 3187. Of the twelve hyperspace Beacons of the Cendra Cluster, eleven have gone dark. Only the Last Beacon remains, on Nyx: if it goes out, every colony will be cut off forever.

You are the Admiralty's Emissary. With the help of IRIS, your ship's artificial intelligence, you must cross eight worlds, recover the three Keys of Harmony and face the Silent Choir before it is too late.

The Last Beacon is an interactive gamebook: you read, you choose, and the story changes with you.

• Over 200 paragraphs and 22 different endings: victory, defeat… or worse • Eight worlds to explore, from the red mines of Ardesia to the oceans of Talassa and the mists of Brumaria • Twenty animated characters, each speaking with their own voice • Voice narration with a typewriter effect • Dice-based skill checks, inventory, credits and health to manage • Space battles against pirates during hyperspace jumps • Animated scenes and videos for the key moments of the adventure • A codex of the characters, worlds and endings you have discovered • Multiple save slots that you can duplicate and rename • English and Italian

The right choice is never obvious. Every resource counts. Can you relight the Last Beacon?

name: Thistmere
description:
A thoughtful welcome awaits at the winter palace.

Thistmere is a quiet, tactile logic game inspired by the warmth of Scotland’s Hogmanay. Jump a thistle over its neighbour into an empty socket, collecting the thistle between. Leave exactly one thistle on the golden threshold to complete each welcome.

• 24 distinct puzzles across three chapters
• Carved walnut, emerald velvet and sculpted thistle tokens
• Free undo, optional guidance and replayable star records
• Three hands-on lessons with separate practice progress
• Local saves, pause and resume, and independent sound settings
• Music starts switched off; enable it whenever you wish
• Progress stays on this iPhone. No account or in-app purchase

The palace, story and puzzle rules are original fiction. First-footing and Hogmanay provide cultural inspiration; this is not a reconstruction of a traditional Scottish board game.

Designed for iPhone in landscape orientation.

name: Throw Food For Animals
description:
Toss a snack down the lane and see who comes running.

• Feed 120 animals across ten regions, from Meadow to Cloud Plateau
• Land the yellow feeding spot to bring out rare, epic and legendary visitors
• Build habitats, grow crops and train your arm to throw farther
• Take on one Daily Throw each day and climb the Game Center leaderboards

SANCTUARY PASS
Your first throw is free. The Sanctuary Pass unlocks the whole game:
• Weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial
• Yearly subscription
• Lifetime, a one-time purchase

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://mikel2602.github.io/terms/

name: TIBET PRAY
description:
TIBET PRAY is a quiet daily practice companion from the roof of the world.

Open it and you get one thing: today's deity, and a simple way to practice.

DAILY PRACTICE
• Today's deity — eight enlightened figures rotate through the week, each with its mantra, meaning and vow
• 108-bead mantra counter — tap to count, the bell rings at 108
• Sitting timer — 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 minutes with meditation sound that fades in and out
• Guided breathing — 4-7-8, box breathing and more, with spoken guidance

LAMPS & WISHES
• Offer butter lamps before today's deity; the lamp field lights up as you offer
• Write a wish on the wish wall — kept on your device, private by default

SOUND LIBRARY — 144 ORIGINAL TRACKS
• 31 sutra chants · 31 meditation drones · 31 guided breathing tracks · 51 ritual sound effects
• A new "today's pick" every day, four categories, background music and effects switches

THANGKA GALLERY
• 118 high-resolution thangka paintings, pinch to zoom, swipe to browse

RAINBOW BRIDGE
• A quiet place to remember a pet who has passed — write their name, leave a candle

TWELVE STORIES
• Short readings on compassion, patience and letting go

LANGUAGES
• 81 languages, English by default, with right-to-left support

PRIVACY
• No account required. Recitations, lamps and wishes stay on your device.
• No ads, no third-party analytics SDKs, no tracking.

TIBET PRAY is a cultural and devotional experience. It does not provide medical advice, and it is not affiliated with any religious or political organisation.

name: Ticksure
description:
Ticksure is a checklist runner for the routines that have to be done the same way every time: locking up the house, opening or closing a shop, packing a camera bag, a weekly review, onboarding a new team member.

Write the checklist once. Then run it whenever the routine comes round, one switch at a time, and keep an honest log of how it went.

BUILD CHECKLISTS THAT FIT THE JOB
- Group items into sections such as Kitchen, Doors & windows or Before doors open.
- Give any item a note: the hint you'd tell someone doing it for the first time.
- Flag the steps that must never be missed as critical.
- Pick a colour tag, drag items to reorder them, even between sections.
- Duplicate a checklist to make a variation, archive the ones you only need now and then, and drag the board into your own order.

RUN IT, SWITCH BY SWITCH
- Focus mode shows one item in big type with large Check and Skip buttons, so you can work through it while your hands are busy.
- Full list mode shows every item with its own toggle, so you can check things off in any order.
- Add a note to any item while you run.
- Critical items can't be skipped without a reason, and a run can't be finished while a critical item is still open.
- A live progress strip and a running clock show where you are.

A LOG THAT TELLS YOU SOMETHING
- Every finished run is saved with its start and finish time, what was checked, what was skipped and why, and your notes.
- History shows how many runs you've done in the last seven days, your average time, and the share of runs that cleared with nothing skipped.
- See how often each checklist is run, and which items get skipped the most, so you can fix the steps that keep slipping.
- Filter the log by checklist and open any run to see its full summary.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
- Run as guest straight away, no sign-up needed.
- Or create an account with email and password to keep your checklists and runs synced across devices.
- Guests can attach an email account later from the Hangar and keep everything they've built.
- Works offline. Changes sync when you're back online.
- Delete your account and all of its data at any time from the Hangar.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
- Two themes: Runway Day and Night Ops for dim rooms and early starts.
- Crisp click sounds and haptics, each with its own off switch.
- Supports VoiceOver labels and Reduce Motion.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your checklists and runs are visible only to you.

name: Tomoshibi - AI Kanji Journal
description:
Your day, in a single character.

Tomoshibi (Japanese for "a small light") is a journal that turns each day into one kanji. Write a few lines about your day, and AI chooses the Japanese character that best captures it. The character then appears in brush calligraphy on washi paper, lit by a candle.

You do not need to know Japanese. Every kanji comes with its reading, its meaning in English, and the reason it was chosen for your day.

■ A FEW LINES ARE ENOUGH
Write what happened or how you felt, in your own words. Short entries are fine.

■ AI CHOOSES TODAY'S KANJI
One character for the day, with its reading, meaning, and the reason behind the choice. Recently used characters are avoided, so each day brings a different one.

■ A QUIET CALLIGRAPHY MOMENT
Once the character is chosen, a brush begins to move. Then a candle is lit in the dark, and today's kanji comes into view. You can skip the video, and sound can be turned on or off in Settings.

■ YOUR MONTH IN KANJI
Each day's character is placed on a calendar. Look over a month and you can see what kind of days it held. Swipe through past entries one day at a time.

■ READ IT BACK LIKE A LETTER
Open a past entry and the kanji fades back while your words rise onto the paper line by line. Longer entries turn like sheets of letter paper.

■ YOUR JOURNAL STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
• Entries are stored only on your device. No account is needed.
• The text of an entry is sent to AI (OpenAI) only when a kanji is chosen. It is not stored on our server.
• You are asked for consent before anything is sent. If you decline, you can still write and read your journal.
• You can back up your journal to a file and restore it.

■ GOOD TO KNOW
• A kanji can be chosen up to 3 times a day.
• Available in English and Japanese, following your device language.
• A banner ad is shown at the bottom of the screen.

The calligraphy video was generated with AI.

name: TopGrade
description:
TopGrade är en professionell app för kvalitetskontroll av ulltopp (wool top). Du mäter varje parti, får automatisk klass (AA/A/B/C) och skyddar höggarnsorder från nedklassad råvara.

VAD APPEN GÖR
• Registrerar Hauteur-längd (mm), kortfiberhalt (%) och noppor (st/g)
• Beräknar slutklass enligt den striktaste metriken (lägsta delklass vinner)
• Markerar om partiet är godkänt för höggarn (endast AA/A)
• Blockerar nedklassade partier från höggarnsorder
• Dirigerar B/C-partier till medelgarn, blandning, filt, export eller kassation
• Sparar data lokalt och skapar delbar kvalitetsrapport

SÅ HÄR ANVÄNDER DU APPEN (STEG FÖR STEG)

1) ÖVERSIKT
Öppna fliken «Översikt». Här ser du klassfördelning, höggarnsklar vikt (kg), öppna order och senaste partier. Tryck «Starta ny partikontroll» för att gå direkt till registrering.

2) NY PARTIKONTROLL
Öppna fliken «Kontroll».
• Fyll i partinummer, leverantör och vikt (kg)
• Ange Hauteur (mm), kortfiberhalt (%) och noppor (st/g)
• Se live-förhandsvisning av klass och höggarnsstatus
• Valfritt: inspektör och anteckning
• Tryck «Spara partiklassning»
Partiet sparas i lagret med slutklass AA, A, B eller C.

3) LAGER
Öppna fliken «Lager».
• Sök på parti/leverantör
• Filtrera på Alla / AA / A / B / C / Höggarn
• Tryck ett parti för detaljer (mätvärden, status, anteckning)
• Svep för att radera vid behov

4) HÖGGARNSORDER
Öppna fliken «Höggarn».
• Tryck + för att skapa order (orderkod, kund, Nm, behov i kg, lägsta klass AA eller A)
• Öppna ordern
• Under «Tillgängliga partier»: tryck ett parti för att koppla
  – AA/A som uppfyller kravet kopplas
  – B/C eller för låg klass BLOCKERAS med tydligt meddelande
• Under «Tilldelade partier»: svep för att frigöra
• Tryck «Stäng order» när produktionen är klar (kopplade partier markeras förbrukade)

5) NEDKLASSAD DESTINATION
Öppna fliken «Mer» → «Nedklassad destination».
• Välj ett B/C-parti
• Ange destination: Medelgarn / Blandning / Filt / Exportparti / Kassation
Så får nedklassad topp alltid en tydlig väg – den går aldrig till höggarn.

6) KVALITETSSTANDARD
«Mer» → «Kvalitetsstandard».
• Justera trösklar för AA/A/B
• Använd testfälten för att förhandsberäkna klass
• Spara – tillgängligt lager omräknas efter nya trösklar

7) BLOCKERINGSLOGG & RAPPORT
• «Mer» → «Blockeringslogg»: se misslyckade höggarns-kopplingar
• «Mer» → «Kvalitetsrapport»: läs sammanfattning och dela via systemets delningsmeny

FÖR VEM
Textil-QC, spinnplanerare och råvarulager som behöver stabil höggarnskvalitet och spårbar hantering av nedklassad topp.

OBS
Ingen inloggning krävs. All data sparas på enheten. Appen är på svenska och fungerar offline.

name: TradeSystem Connect
description:
TradeSystem Connect is the free app for homeowners and businesses.

WITH YOUR SERVICE COMPANY
Enter the customer code from your company to:
- Request service: pick the problem, how soon, and which equipment.
- Chat with the office, with photos. You get a notification when they reply.
- See your next visit and know when the tech is on the way.
- Approve quotes and pay bills on your company's secure pay page.
- Keep a list of your equipment.

FIX IT SAFELY
Free homeowner checks: dead outlets, a tripping breaker, a clogged drain, a running toilet, no hot water, leaks and more. Each one tells you when to stop and call a pro.

PRO PLANS (optional)
- Pro ($4.99/month or $39.99/year): equipment reminders and the full set of guides.
- Pro + AI Tech ($14.99/month or $119.99/year): a safety-first AI plumber and electrician that answers your questions and looks at photos.

name: Traumfaden
description:
Traumfaden ist ein ruhiges Traumtagebuch, mit dem du deine Träume direkt nach dem Aufwachen festhalten kannst. Viele Erinnerungen an Träume verblassen schnell, darum bietet dir die App eine einfache, unaufdringliche Oberfläche, um deine nächtlichen Erlebnisse bequem aufzuzeichnen.

Du kannst jedem Eintrag einen Titel geben und deine Erinnerungen notieren. Zusätzlich lassen sich Gefühle und Motive als Tags hinzufügen, zudem kannst du zwischen normalem Traum, Klartraum und Albtraum unterscheiden. Alle deine Einträge findest du übersichtlich in deinem Traumbuch, entweder in der Zeitlinie oder im Kalender. Über die Suche kannst du gezielt nach Wörtern, Gefühlen oder Motiven suchen, um alte Einträge wiederzufinden. Auf der Muster-Seite siehst du deine vergebenen Tags und erkennst so wiederkehrende Themen in deinen Träumen.

Die App verzichtet auf überflüssige Funktionen und hält den Fokus auf dem Erinnern und Bewahren deiner nächtlichen Gedanken.

name: Trend Local
description:
Trend Local connects local content creators with the businesses around them. No agencies, no cold DMs: just people nearby who want to work together.

FOR CREATORS
- Swipe on local businesses. When you both say yes, you are matched and can chat right away.
- See local spots on the map and save the ones you want to pitch.
- Keep private notes on every business and plan collabs before a trip.
- Track each collab from first chat to finished post.

FOR BUSINESSES
- Search local creators by name, niche or city, closest first. Nobody close yet? Widen the search with one tap, all the way to all of Texas.
- Post a campaign and let creators near you find it.
- Local posts reach local feeds, which brings nearby people through your door.
- Match, chat, and agree on the details in one place.

SAFE BY DESIGN
- Every creator is reviewed by our team before businesses can see them.
- Report or block anyone from their profile or your chat.
- Your exact location is never stored.
- Delete your account and everything in it anytime from Settings.

Now live in Texas.

name: Tumblethim Play
description:
Маленький лис. Сцена, полная возможностей.

Помогите Пипу пройти 24 миниатюрные театральные головоломки. Поворачивайте направляющие платформы, настраивайте пружины и прокладывайте маршрут, чтобы собрать три фрукта и добраться до занавеса.

Важен каждый шаг. Платформы опускают Пипа на один ряд, а пружины перебрасывают через два. Фрукт засчитывается только при приземлении, поэтому очевидный путь не всегда оказывается лучшим.

• 24 продуманные сцены в трёх актах.
• Репетируйте маршрут, наблюдайте за результатом и меняйте план.
• Собирайте клубнику, виноград и цитрусы.
• Освойте правила в трёх учебных уроках с отдельным прогрессом.
• Пользуйтесь подсказками и повторяйте попытки без обратного отсчёта.
• Сохраняйте прогресс локально и настраивайте музыку, звуки, вибрацию и движение.

Весь игровой процесс доступен без интернета. Язык интерфейса по умолчанию — английский. Русский используется, если предпочтительный язык устройства — русский или выбран регион «Россия».

name: UPN to SEPA
description:
UPN to SEPA turns the UPN QR code on Slovenian payment slips (položnice) into a SEPA (EPC) QR code that banking apps such as Revolut can read. Pay a bill in seconds without typing the IBAN, amount and reference.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the UPN QR code with the camera, or import it from a photo, screenshot or PDF.
2. Check the details and save the SEPA QR code to the “Revolut UPN” album in Photos.
3. In your banking app, start a new payment, pick the saved picture and confirm. In Revolut: New payment → QR icon in the search field.

WHY
• Recipient, IBAN, amount, reference and purpose are filled in for you.
• IBAN and reference checks (SI12, SI99, RF) catch typos.
• A warning when you convert the same bill twice.
• A list of every scanned bill, so you can reopen any QR code later.
• Open a bill straight from Mail: tap the PDF → Share → UPN to SEPA.
• Quick start from a widget, Control Center or the Action button.
• Bills without an amount: enter it in the app or in your bank.

PRIVACY
The app collects no data. No account, no ads, no analytics. Everything is processed on your phone, and bill details stay inside the app.

The app does not make payments; you always confirm the payment yourself in your banking app. UPN to SEPA is not affiliated with Revolut or any bank.

Made by CNJ d.o.o., Ljubljana, Slovenia.

name: Vakitçi: Prayer Times & Qibla
description:
Vakitçi was built to fix what users complain about most in prayer apps: no ads, no sign-up, and you never miss the adhan.

NO ADS, EVER
Prayer times, adhan, qibla, widgets, dhikr, prayer tracking and basics are always free for everyone.

ADHAN GUARANTEE
Continuously checks notification permission, sound, Focus, Lock Screen and scheduled adhans, and fixes problems with one tap. A real Fajr alarm that rings even in silent mode.

DIYANET TIMES, OFFLINE
District times for Türkiye and Europe are stored on-device and calculated within ±1 minute when offline.

3 MUEZZIN VOICES & FULL CONTROL
Per-prayer sound, preview, sleep mode, silent early reminders, master sound switch.

PRAYER TRACKER
Mark each prayer. If you haven't, we gently ask "Did you pray?" before the time ends; tap "Prayed" right on the notification. Weekly and monthly history, streaks, qada tracker.

NEW TO ISLAM & TASKS
A step-by-step path: shahada, articles of faith, pillars, wudu, Al-Fatiha, your first prayer. Daily good deeds: feed animals, give charity, visit elders, say a kind word… Watch your good-deeds tree grow.

DHIKR WITH RECORDS
Haptic counter, targets, daily records and your own dhikr.

HADITH & DUA OF THE DAY
The same hadith for everyone each day; duas in Arabic with transliteration and meaning, with a daily notification at the time you choose.

ALSO
Qibla compass, Hijri calendar, holy-night and Eid reminders, 30-day timetable, Home and Lock Screen widgets, Dynamic Island countdown, Apple Watch app and complications. Available in English, Turkish, German, Dutch, French and Arabic.

SUPPORTER PACK (one-time, no subscription)
Extra muezzin voices, 30/90-day history, your own tasks and dhikr, qada tracker and themes. Family Sharing for up to 6 people.

Privacy: no data collected; your location never leaves your device.
Terms of use: https://vakitci.tarikdavulcu.com/terms.html

name: Vault Keep
description:
Vault Keep – Secure Your Private World
Keep your important belongings organized, protected, and easy to find with Vault Keep, a personal storage management app designed for privacy, security, and everyday convenience.
Whether you're storing important documents, personal diaries, jewellery, spare keys, or other valuable belongings, Vault Keep helps you remember exactly where everything is kept while protecting sensitive information through secure authentication.
Key Features
Secure Authentication
	•	Protect access with a personal 6-digit security PIN.
	•	Use Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices.
	•	Manage authentication preferences in a dedicated Security Center.
	•	Add an extra layer of protection with two-step verification.
Private Belongings Vault
	•	Organize important personal belongings in one place.
	•	Save item names, categories, descriptions, and storage details.
	•	Easily add, edit, view, or delete belongings.
	•	Search and filter records for quick access.
Smart Storage Locations
	•	Record where your belongings are stored.
	•	Organize items by rooms, drawers, lockers, and compartments.
	•	Keep detailed location information for easy retrieval.
	•	Update storage locations whenever belongings are moved.
Reminders & Activity
	•	Create reminders for important belongings.
	•	Keep track of storage updates and recent activities.
	•	Stay organized with scheduled item checks.
Personal Security Dashboard
	•	View your protected belongings at a glance.
	•	Monitor authentication and vault security status.
	•	Quickly access essential records and storage information.
	•	Enjoy an elegant, easy-to-navigate interface.
Privacy-Focused Experience
Vault Keep is designed with personal privacy in mind. Your belongings and storage records are managed locally on your device, with authentication features that help prevent unauthorized access.
No account registration or third-party service is required.
Your Personal Space, Organized and Protected
Stop forgetting where you placed your important belongings. With Vault Keep, you can organize your private storage locations, manage personal records, and access important information whenever you need it.
Download Vault Keep and bring organization, convenience, and security to your everyday life.

name: Veriq - Flow
description:
Veriq is a 3D casual puzzle game that combines color sorting with sliding block mechanics for players who enjoy relaxing spatial brain teasers. Unlike standard tile-matching games, Veriq bridges two interdependent gameplay layers where a vibrant colored sand painting at the top steadily drains into uniquely shaped containers sliding across a sliding-block board at the bottom. Designed for commuters and puzzle enthusiasts seeking a focused, pressure-free mental exercise, the game turns every container movement into an active pipeline that gradually clears the canvas above while freeing up essential room below.

The core loop requires you to drag shaped containers such as I, L, T, and O blocks along a grid so they line up directly beneath matching sand streams flowing from the painting frame above. As sand pours into the correct opening, the container fills up, lifts out of the board upon reaching full capacity, and permanently releases all its occupied grid cells to expand your maneuvering space. With no countdown timers, score penalties, or random mixing mechanics, you can study the layout at your own pace, execute single-finger drags, and use unlimited undos when you want to rethink your strategy.

The game features specialized 8x8 standard boards and 4x5 tutorial levels, accompanied by smooth particle simulations that render cascading sand physics and top-surface highlights. As you progress through handcrafted stages, you will encounter multi-segment color columns, complex interlocking shapes, and upper layers that temporarily block lower routes, requiring careful planning to establish clear pathways from top to bottom. Veriq includes a built-in hint system, persistent stage progress saving, haptic feedback options, and a dedicated gallery to view completed artwork collections without time constraints.

name: VFNO1
description: This app provides tools for organizing and managing information on iPhone. Users can browse, add, edit, filter, and maintain records, as well as view information through structured lists, charts, and summary views. Additional features include activity history, workspace tools, and local data storage, offering a convenient way to manage and review information.

name: VilShop
description:
VilShop is a free shop app for kirana, medical, hardware and other village and town shops in India.

BILL AT THE COUNTER • Tap or search items, sell loose quantities, give a discount • Cash, UPI, card or udhaar — stock drops with every sale • Numbered bills you can share on WhatsApp

UDHAAR BOOK • Every customer's balance, worked out from every bill and payment • Limits, money received and old udhaar written in • WhatsApp reminders with your shop's UPI ID

ITEMS AND STOCK • Start from a ready list for your kind of shop • Prices, MRP, cost, photos and barcodes • Stock in, damage and counts, each in the item's history • Low-stock alerts every evening

YOUR TEAM • Add your family and staff by mobile number or a code • Owner, admin, store staff, cashier, stock keeper and delivery — each sees only what they need • Run more than one shop and switch between them

REPORTS • Today's and the month's sales, cash and UPI • Udhaar to collect, best sellers and margins • A summary of the day's sales every night

Your shop's data is yours: only you and the people you add can see it, and you can delete your account at any time.

name: VioletHill
description:
Starch handshake: a saved harvest lot copies its dry, intermediate, or moist class, and the kitchen hides techniques outside that class.

• Compare cultivars: filter violet flesh, violet skin only, or both, then set two records side by side before you order slips.
• Log a hill: save the planted cultivar, slip date, spacing, and vine note, then add a harvest lot with tuber count and weight.
• Choose a unit: weights stay in grams, and the bed list shows pounds or kilograms.
• Open a technique: read minutes, vessel, and numbered steps, or the note on why that starch fits.
• Expand an accompaniment: read its flavor note and texture role on the same technique sheet.

Cultivar records, technique cards, and accompaniments ship inside the app and open with no network. Hills, harvest lots, and the weight unit are stored only on this device. There is no account, and the app does not fetch catalog rows.

• Open Not a Yam: separate a purple sweet potato from a true yam, and violet flesh from violet skin alone.
• See matching cultivars: leave a technique and show atlas rows that share that card's starch class.

Cooking method only. The board matches a pan to starch class and does not score calories or nutrients.

name: Voice Range App
description:
Find your vocal range in under a minute. Voice Range App listens as you sing your lowest and highest notes, then shows your range on a piano keyboard, your voice type and the famous singers whose range matches yours.

VOCAL RANGE FINDER
• Sing low, then sing high — the app's pitch detector finds every note
• See your exact range, like E2–C5, and how many octaves you cover
• Learn your voice type: soprano, mezzo-soprano, alto, tenor, baritone or bass
• Find out which celebrity singers have a range like yours
• Re-test any time and watch your range grow

PITCH TEST: HOW GOOD IS YOUR EAR?
• A quick higher-or-lower ear training game
• Measures how small a pitch difference you can hear, in cents
• Find out if you might be tone deaf, or if your ear is sharper than you think
• A fun way to build relative pitch, whether you have perfect pitch or not

NOTE FINDER
• Sing or hum and see the note instantly
• A live singing tuner shows if you're sharp, flat or right in tune
• A simple vocal pitch trace so you can watch yourself hold a note

VOCAL WARM UP
• Short singing warm-ups: five-note scales, arpeggios and octave jumps
• Built around your own vocal range, so every note is reachable
• Gentle feedback on every note, like a pocket vocal trainer
• Great before choir, singing lessons, karaoke or a performance

COMPETE
• Game Center leaderboards for the widest vocal range and the sharpest ear
• Share your range and voice type with friends

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your voice is analyzed on your phone only. Nothing is recorded, saved or uploaded, and there's no account to make.

Whether you're a beginner learning to sing or a singer checking your voice before a gig, Voice Range App is the quickest voice test, vocal range test and note finder on your phone.

name: Volt Rider: Mars Survival
description:
Rogue robots have taken over Mars. Your robot pilot takes the wheel to reclaim three sectors. Touch and drag to drive. Every weapon fires automatically.

• Three sectors — Mars Base, Red Quarry and Reactor Core. Final bosses arrive at 5, 6 and 7 minutes respectively; defeat the boss to clear each sector.
• Carry your gear forward — Clear a sector to unlock the next. Continue directly from the results screen to restore HP and keep your loadout.
• Normal, Hard and Nightmare — Start with Normal or Hard. Clear Sector 3 to unlock Nightmare.
• Three cars — TS rams enemies, TX uses a wing-door shockwave, and TY fires a piercing light-bar laser.
• Twelve upgrades — Car, lightning coil, orbiting cells, charge pad, motor, battery, magnet, autopilot chip, reactive shield, escort drone, cryo pulse and self-repair. Sector caps rise from level 5 to 7 to 9. Overclocks unlock from Sector 2, keeping upgrades available deeper into the campaign.
• New threats — Aiming robots, self-destructing robots, tougher bosses and telegraphed ion storms.
• Battlefield supplies — Recharge at chargers and turn the fight with Overdrive and Freeze pickups.
• Fully offline. No ads, login or in-app purchases.
• Korean, English and Japanese.

Records, sector unlocks and settings stay on your device. The current battle resets if the app is fully closed; unlocked sectors and best records are retained.

name: Wachprofi: Sachkunde 34a
description:
Pass the German security guard exam (Sachkundeprüfung, § 34a GewO) on the first attempt. Wachprofi prepares you for the written and the oral part of the IHK exam – in German, like the exam, with help in your language.

WHAT YOU GET
• 587 practice tasks from all 9 subjects: public safety and order, trade law, data protection, civil law (BGB), criminal law and procedure, accident prevention, weapons, dealing with people, security technology
• Tasks with one or two correct answers, scored like the real exam
• Mock exam like the IHK's: 82 tasks, 120 minutes, pass with 60 of 120 points, weighted by subject
• Oral exam practice: 100 examiner questions with key points and a model answer
• Every task explained, with the legal reference, e.g. "§ 127 Abs. 1 StPO"
• 150 legal terms explained in simple words: Notwehr, Besitzdiener, Jedermann-Festnahmerecht and more
• Help in English, Turkish, Arabic, Russian and Ukrainian

YOUR COACH
• After every wrong answer you learn why exactly your choice is wrong
• "Often confused": Notwehr, Notstand or Selbsthilfe? The terms side by side
• A daily plan up to your exam date and your chance to pass
• Tasks you get wrong come back until you know them

CHECKED CONTENT
Every task is written from the statute (GewO, BewachV, BGB, StGB, StPO, WaffG, GDPR, BDSG, DGUV Vorschrift 23 and others) and checked against it in separate passes. Tasks a check had doubts about are not in the app.

GERMAN STAYS FIRST
The exam is in German only. So the German task is always on top and the translation below it, hidden with one tap. You learn the content and the German legal terms at the same time.

FAIR, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Free: tasks from every subject, one mock exam, all legal terms and questions for the oral exam. A one-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscription, no ads, no account. Everything stays on your device.

NOTE
Wachprofi is an independent study app and is not affiliated with any Chamber of Commerce (IHK), the DIHK or any authority. The real exam tasks are confidential; all tasks in the app are our own practice tasks. Statutes: gesetze-im-internet.de. Legal status: 15 November 2026.

name: What color?
description:
Point the camera, tap a spot and get the name of the colour. What colour? was made to help people with colour blindness, and it has become a painting assistant for miniature painters too.

THE COLOUR'S NAME, THE WAY PEOPLE SAY IT
Instead of a code, the app answers the way a person would: "Dark blue, leaning purple".
• The colour family, what it is like (light or dark, vivid or greyish) and a familiar name that helps you picture it.
• When a colour sits on a boundary, it says so: "between blue and purple".
• Live crosshair, frozen image or a photo from your library, with zoom and a loupe to hit the exact spot.
• Large text, nothing relies on colour alone, and VoiceOver announces every reading.

FOR MINIATURE PAINTERS
• Finds the closest paint among about 900 Citadel, Vallejo and Army Painter paints.
• Build collections of the paints you own, or add paints from any brand by measuring a swatch. With a collection open, everything uses only its paints.
• "Is this the right paint?": point at the brush, the palette or the pot and see whether it's that one, close or not it.
• "Is my highlight or shade right?": compare it with the base, live, one-handed.
• "How do I paint this colour?": a four-step recipe (base, shade, layer and highlight), with a sculpted preview showing all four paints together on armour, fur, cloth, skin or stone.
• When no paint gets there, the app suggests a mix, and the Measure mix screen tells you how much of each paint to add until it matches.
• Ready-made recipes: classics for skin, leather, bone, cloth, stone and hair, with a painting tip. Create and save your own recipes too.
• White calibration on a sheet of paper for more accurate readings.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON THE PHONE
Works offline. No photo or image ever leaves your phone. No ads, no account, no data collection.

WHAT TO EXPECT
A phone camera is not a measuring instrument. Use strong, neutral light and calibrate on white when the light changes. Very similar paints can be confused.

Citadel is a trademark of Games Workshop Ltd., Vallejo is a trademark of Acrylicos Vallejo S.L. and The Army Painter is a trademark of The Army Painter ApS. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them. Paint colour values are community-maintained approximations.

name: What If Finance
description:
Enter income, recurring expenses, savings and planned purchases, and the forecast runs anywhere from 6 months to 10 years. One chart holds total balance, cash and savings. Drag across it to read any single month. The summary lists the end total, the lowest cash point, the average monthly net and the first month of shortfall. Inflation, savings return and forecast length are set per scenario.

Each change gets its own scenario: a rent increase, a new job, a car with loan and running costs, a vacation. The original stays untouched. Duplicate, edit, switch the active one, then compare up to four on a single chart. Data stays on the device.

name: Wintwine
description: Wintwine તમારા માટે ખાનગી વિજય નોંધ છે. એક નાની જીત લખો અને તેને તમે કયા પ્રયાસથી પહોંચ્યા તે સાથે જોડો — શરીર, મન, કામ, સંબંધ, સર્જન અથવા પૈસા જેવા દિશામાં. તમે લખેલા શબ્દો લેબલ અને તારીખ સાથે સાચવાય છે. ઉદાસ અથવા શંકાવાળા દિવસે તમે પહેલાં લખેલું કંઈક રેન્ડમ પસંદ કરીને વાંચી શકો, પ્રક્રિયા સહિત. અઠવાડિયાની સમીક્ષા, આકારોની તુલના અને માઇલસ્ટોન જુઓ. રોજિંદી યાદ, ડેટા નિકાસ અને હજારો ઇન્ટરનેટ વગરની સ્થાનિક સંગ્રહ — બંધ કરીને ફરી ખોલો તો પણ સૂચિઓ ચાલુ રહે.

name: Wishler: Wishlist & Gifts
description:
Stop asking "What do you want for your birthday?" — and stop answering "Nothing."

Wishler is one list for everything you'd love to get, from any shop. Send one link, and the people who love you finally know what to give.

NO MORE GUESSING
• Add a wish in seconds: type what it is or paste a link from any shop. The photo comes with it, and the details fill in for you to check.
• Say exactly which one — size, colour, model — and leave a note for the giver.
• Mark up to three wishes "Really want it" so friends see what matters most.

NO MORE DUPLICATE GIFTS
• A friend taps "I'll get this one" and it's taken, so nobody else buys the same thing.
• The surprise stays: you never see who is getting you what.
• Friends open your list in any browser — nothing to install to pick a gift.

BIG WISHES, TOGETHER
• Let friends chip in on a bigger gift and watch the bar fill up.
• The money goes straight from your friends to you. Wishler holds none of it and takes nothing.
• Start a secret pot for a friend and collect for a gift they never even put on their list. They won't see a thing.

FOR THE DAY ITSELF
• Friends can record a short video greeting for your birthday.
• A Birthdays page shows whose day is coming up among the people you follow.
• Keep a list for your child, so grandparents know exactly what to bring.
• Need an idea for someone else? Swipe through this week's gift picks.

Download your list any time.

Wishler is free. Make your list, send the link — and get the gift you actually wanted.

name: Wordio: Word Puzzle & Brain
description:
Step into the ultimate word discovery adventure with Wordio! Swipe horizontally, vertically, and diagonally across smart 3D letter grids to uncover themed target words, unlock intersecting letter clues, and crack each stage's locked Mystery Word.

KEY FEATURES:
• Smart Word-Grid Gameplay: Progress smoothly from crisp 5x5 warm-up boards up to rich 13x13 master grids.
• Intersecting Clues & Mystery Words: Every word you solve reveals intersecting letters on remaining clues—crack the longest Mystery Word for bonus rewards.
• 10,000-Stage Journey Map: Travel through 1,000 themed tours across Space, Nature, Ancient History, Oceans, Cuisine, and Science.
• Royal Lucky Wheel & Daily Quests: Spin for diamonds, gold coins, and helpful boosters.
• Live Apple Game Center Leaderboards & Cloud Backup: Compete globally on Highest Stage, Total XP, and Words Found while keeping your progress backed up safely.
• 20 Native Languages & 100% Offline Playable: Play anytime, anywhere without needing Wi-Fi.

name: WortGuard
description:
WortGuard je profesionálny nástroj pre rmutovačov a pivovarskú kontrolu kvality. Pomáha archivovať každú varnú šaržu: teplotnú krivku rmutovania, koncentráciu mladiny (°Plato) a intenzitu varu. Ak je odchýlka pôvodného extraktu mimo tolerancie, aplikácia zamkne šaržu a ZAKÁŽE uvoľnenie do kvasenia.

ČO APLIKÁCIA ROBÍ
• Domov – prehľad dnešných šarží, čakajúcich kontrol, zamknutých odchýlok a trendu Δ°P
• Šarže – vytváranie, úprava, filtrovanie a archivácia varných dávok
• Brána – kontrola uvoľnenia do kvasenia (povolené len pri šarži v tolerancii)
• Nastavenia – predvolený cieľ °P, tolerancia, limity intenzity varu a meno operátora

AKO POUŽÍVAŤ – KROK ZA KROKOM

1) Otvorte záložku Domov
Uvidíte štatistiky smeny a trend odchýlok. Klepnutím na „Nová šarža“ vytvoríte nový záznam, alebo cez „Otvoriť bránu kontroly“ prejdete na uvoľnenie.

2) Vytvorte šaržu (Šarže → + alebo Domov → Nová šarža)
Vyplňte:
• kód šarže
• štýl piva
• meno rmutovača
• predvarový a povarový extrakt (°P)
• cieľový extrakt a toleranciu ±°P
• objem na začiatku/konci varu (hl) a čas varu (min)
Pridajte stupne teplotnej krivky (cieľ °C, merané °C, minúty). Môžete použiť „Šablóna štandardného rmutu“.
Klepnite na Uložiť. Aplikácia automaticky vypočíta intenzitu varu a odchýlku °P.

3) Skontrolujte detail šarže
V zozname Šarže otvorte záznam. Zobrazí sa krivka, koncentrácia, intenzita varu a stav brány:
• Čaká – v tolerancii, ešte neuvoľnené
• Uvoľnené – povolené do kvasenia
• Zámok – mimo tolerancie, vstup do kvasenia zakázaný

4) Uvoľnenie cez Bránu (najdôležitejší krok)
Otvorte záložku Brána → vyberte šaržu v pickeri.
• Ak je |namerané − cieľ| ≤ tolerancia: tlačidlo „Uvoľniť do kvasenia“ je aktívne. Pridajte poznámku a potvrďte. Zapíše sa čas uvoľnenia.
• Ak je odchýlka mimo tolerancie: uvoľnenie je BLOKOVANÉ. Šaržu treba upraviť (opraviť °P / proces) alebo potvrdiť zámok. Do kvasenia sa nedostane.

5) Nastavenia štandardov
V záložke Nastavenia nastavte predvolený cieľ °P, toleranciu a pásmo intenzity varu. „Prehodnotiť všetky šarže“ znova vyhodnotí neuvoľnené dávky podľa nových limitov.

DÔLEŽITÉ PRE POCHOPENIE FUNKCIE
WortGuard nie je sociálna sieť ani obsahový katalóg. Je to lokálny pracovný denník rmutovne s kontrolnou bránou kvality. Dáta sa ukladajú v zariadení. Nie je potrebný účet, prihlásenie ani internet na základné použitie.

Pre koho: rmutovači, majstri výroby, laboratórna/kvalitná kontrola v pivovare.
Jazyk rozhrania: slovenčina. Podpora: iPhone, iOS 15.0+.

name: Xentra - Corex
description:
Xentra brings your approvals and everyday requests to your iPhone. It is an app for Corex Holding employees and requires a corporate account.

MY APPROVALS
• Every approval step waiting for you, in one inbox, with a pending count on the home screen.
• See when each step reached you and how long it has waited. Overdue steps are highlighted.
• Approve or reject from the list, with a comment or reason, or open a travel request or suggestion, read its details and attachments, and decide there.
• Delegate a step to a colleague when your role allows it.

TRAVEL AND VISA REQUESTS
• Create a request with destination, dates and travellers, attach documents and save it as a draft.
• Submit it for approval and follow each step: who it is waiting with, who decided and when.
• Filter by type and status, check status history and cost approval, and cancel a request if plans change.

SUGGESTION SYSTEM
• Share an improvement idea and add a photo taken on the spot or files.
• See a warning before you submit if similar suggestions already exist.
• Get a tracking number and follow your idea through manager and committee review.
• Managers decide from their review queue; committee members score suggestions and record the committee's decision.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Notifications about your work appear while the app is open.
• Switch organisation at any time. English or Turkish, with a system, light or dark theme.

Sign in with corporate single sign-on in a secure system sheet; your password is entered only on the corporate sign-in page. No adverts, no in-app purchases, no tracking.

Need help? Contact the IT service desk at sm@corexholding.com.

name: Yes, Dear: Count
description:
Yes, Dear Count keeps the official tally of every order you get at home, and of every “Yes, dear” you answer.

Press the big button each time an order comes in. Your recruit answers out loud for you, the mascot reacts, and the count goes up.

• One tap to log an order, or pick the exact one: take out the trash, do the dishes, go shopping…
• Spoken replies: “Yes, dear”, “Right away, my love”, “Order received. Over.”
• Climb the ranks from raw recruit upwards and earn medals along the way
• Stats by day and by week, record days and streaks
• The Official Obedience Report, ready to share… if you dare
• Your own order types, and CSV export of everything
• Choose who gives the orders: wife, husband, partner, mum, boss or anyone you like

PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• No ads
• 20 more replies
• Two new voices: the Butler and the Sergeant
• Home-screen widget: log an order without opening the app
• Five alternative app icons
• Three extra report designs: Diploma, Service record and Receipt

The free version shows a small banner on the Log, Stats and Medals screens, never on the counter. Your orders stay on your iPhone: no account, no sign-up.

A loving joke for couples. Handle with a sense of humour.

name: Yulevanta
description:
Yulevanta is a cozy Christmas gift workshop puzzle game. Gifts travel along the factory conveyor—tap the sorter to send each one into the matching packing bin before time runs out.

Play through 50 levels across five festive chapters, complete daily orders, unlock special gifts, and build your gift collection. Simple one-tap controls, warm holiday visuals, and offline play make it perfect for quick festive sessions.

Features: • 50 handcrafted sorting levels
• Daily Order challenge
• Special gifts, combos, and star ratings
• Gift Collection & progress save
• Music, sound, and haptics controls
• Fully offline — no ads, no account required

name: ZOAEXVK
description:
ZOAEXVK is an iPhone app for following U.S. stocks, reading financial news. Go from a headline to the company behind it, then explore its price history, financial statements, and upcoming events.

**Follow stocks and market news**  
Browse quotes for selected U.S. stocks, explore interactive price charts from one day to one year, and save the symbols you follow to your watchlist. Read financial news with clearly labeled publishers, open articles in the built-in reader, and save stories for later.

**Research companies**  
Explore company profiles, key statistics, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow. Track earnings dates, dividends, and stock splits, or look through past earnings, reported institutional and fund holdings, and company press releases.

**Practice trading with a market replay**  
Start with $10,000 in virtual cash. Place market and limit orders, advance through replay sessions, and see how fills and price changes affect your holdings and buying power.

**Keep a finance notebook**  
Write down what you learn and attach photos to your notes. Use the compound growth calculator to explore how savings could grow over time, or calculate the break-even price per share after fees.

name: Zoukuny Connected
description:
Zoukuny Connected to zamknięta strefa kursantów zouka brazylijskiego z naszych zajęć w Warszawie.

Po każdych zajęciach znajdziesz tu podsumowanie: nagranie, sekwencję z liczeniem, nomenklaturę i muzykę.
• Ćwicz z odtwarzaczem: zwolnione tempo, lustro, pętla od–do i przewijanie co 5 sekund.
• Porównaj się: nagraj swój taniec albo wybierz film z galerii i zobacz go obok nagrania z zajęć.
• Filmy grupy w zbiorach, z wyszukiwaniem i ulubionymi.
• Kalendarz zajęć, dni wolnych, warsztatów, imprez i praktisów; obecność zaznaczysz jednym przyciskiem.
• Tablica grupy, czat grupy i rozmowy prywatne.
• Fiszki z nomenklaturą, piosenki do ćwiczeń, drill na tydzień.
• Asystent AI odpowie na pytania o zajęcia (po Twojej zgodzie).
• Ostatnie podsumowanie działa bez zasięgu – przeczytasz sekwencję w szatni.

Dostęp mają tylko kursanci przyjęci do grupy przez instruktora. Posty i filmy kursantów sprawdzają instruktorzy; każdą treść możesz zgłosić, a osobę zablokować.

name: ZUMIQ
description:
ZUMIQ helps you practice math step by step, from 1st to 8th grade.

• Snap a photo of an exercise: the AI tutor reads it and guides you with questions, without giving away the answer.
• Made a mistake? It finds the step where it happened and helps you fix it.
• Explain your reasoning out loud with your voice.
• Watch animated step-by-step explanations and practice with similar questions.
• Daily and weekly challenges with verified problems, and an island map that fills with stars.
• Exam study guides with a day-by-day plan and a practice test.
• Matches only with friends approved by the family, with no chat.
• Family dashboard and web panel: progress by topic, common mistakes, time spent and PDF reports.

PLANS
Start free. Then choose Basic, Plus or Family (up to 3 children), monthly or yearly with 2 months free. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and the subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

PRIVACY
Minimal data (nickname and school grade), no ads and no tracking. Photos are deleted automatically and audio is never stored. The tutor is an AI and can make mistakes.

Terms of Use: https://zumiq.site/terms
Privacy Policy: https://zumiq.site/privacy

name: Двор: зомби на двоих
description:
Головоломка, в которую играют вдвоём или втроём. Ночью двор завалило снегом, а из-за гаражей забрели зомби. У каждого свой дворник и один и тот же двор. Кто первым расчистит проезды и выпустит все машины — тот и победил.

ДВОР НА ДВОИХ И ТРОИХ
Два-три iPhone рядом, интернет и общая сеть не нужны — телефоны соединяются напрямую (Wi‑Fi и Bluetooth должны быть включены). Дворники соперников видны размыто и еле заметно: понятно, как быстро они продвигаются, но не видно, как именно решают. Сверху — полоска гонки: сколько машин уже выехало у каждого. Каждая выпущенная вами машина подкидывает сугроб во двор соседа — но только туда, где двор ещё можно решить. Раунд за раундом копится счёт.

Вы — дворник Михалыч. До утра нужно расчистить проезды, чтобы жильцы успели на работу, в школу и в поликлинику. А зомби мешают.

ЗОМБИ ХОДЯТ ПО ОЧЕРЕДИ
После каждого вашего хода зомби делает шаг к дворнику — стрелка над ним заранее показывает куда. Это не реакция, а расчёт: заманите, обойдите, закопайте сугробом или выпустите машину — она собьёт всех на пути.
• Сонные — недомутировавшие, через три шага падают и засыпают
• Шатуны — три шага, потом садятся отдохнуть на ведро
• Бегуны — не устают никогда
• Бабушки с тележками — ходят туда-обратно и перегораживают проезд

ТОЛКАЙТЕ СУГРОБЫ
Ведите дворника свайпом. Сугроб можно только толкать — тянуть нельзя, два подряд не сдвинуть. Задвиньте сугроб на люк теплотрассы — он растает, а тепло растопит соседний лёд и прогреет застывшую «девятку».

ВЫПУСКАЙТЕ МАШИНЫ ВОВРЕМЯ
У каждой машины стрелка на крыше: путь свободен — коснитесь, и она уедет. Каждый ход — минута утра, над машиной время, когда хозяину пора ехать. Все успели — три звезды.

ТРЕНИРОВКА ОДНОМУ: 90 ДВОРОВ, ШЕСТЬ РАЙОНОВ
Первые зомби · Шатуны и гололёд · Бабушки с тележками · «Девятка» не заводится · Бегуны · Осада. Первый двор — обучение, перед ним короткий комикс.

ДВОР ДНЯ
Один двор на всех каждый день. Решили — поделитесь результатом.

МОЙ ДВОР И ЖИЛЬЦЫ
За звёзды украшайте свой двор: скамейка, кормушка, снеговик, гирлянда, кот Барсик и ёлка. Знакомьтесь с жильцами — у каждого своя причина спешить.

Подсказка всегда под рукой, ходы можно отменять. Все дворы проверены решателем — у каждого есть решение.

Без регистрации, все данные остаются на устройстве. В игре есть реклама; одно видео отключает её на 2 дня.

name: Леди Зона
Семейный казан: бюджет семьи
description:
«Семейный казан» — простой учёт доходов и расходов для семьи. Казан — общий котёл: всё, что семья заработала и потратила, видно в одном месте.

ОБЩИЙ БЮДЖЕТ НА ДВУХ IPHONE
Отправьте мужу или жене ссылку-приглашение. После этого вы ведёте один бюджет вдвоём: запись с одного телефона обычно появляется на втором в течение минуты.

ЗАПИСЬ ЗА НЕСКОЛЬКО СЕКУНД
Крупная клавиатура для суммы, категория одним касанием, отметка «на кого» и комментарий. Вчерашнюю трату можно записать задним числом.

ПОНЯТНЫЙ ОБЗОР МЕСЯЦА
• Сколько пришло, сколько ушло и сколько осталось
• Подсказка, сколько можно тратить в день до конца месяца
• Лимиты по категориям: сразу видно, где деньги на исходе
• Расходы по каждому члену семьи: папа, мама и до трёх детей

АНАЛИТИКА
• Куда ушли деньги по категориям
• Доходы и расходы за полгода на одном графике
• Средний расход в день, крупнейшая трата, сколько удалось отложить

НАСТРОЙКА ПОД СВОЮ СЕМЬЮ
• Имена членов семьи
• Свои категории: добавляйте, переименовывайте, скрывайте лишние
• Готовые категории для семьи с детьми: школа и садик, кружки и секции, подарки и тои
• Выгрузка месяца в файл CSV для Numbers или Excel

ВАШИ ДАННЫЕ ОСТАЮТСЯ У ВАС
• Без регистрации, рекламы и аналитики
• Записи хранятся на вашем iPhone и в вашем личном iCloud
• Бюджет видят только те, кому вы отправили приглашение
• Приложение не подключается к банкам и не просит доступ к контактам и геопозиции

Суммы ведутся в сомах. Для общего бюджета на обоих iPhone нужен вход в iCloud.

name: إطلالتي: عباية ومكياج وتسريحة
description:
إطلالتي… كل ما تحتاجينه لتجهيز إطلالتك في مكان واحد.

◆ إطلالة كاملة بلمسة واحدة
اختاري المناسبة (عرس، عيد، دوام، طلعة) ونقترح لك عباية ومكياج وتسريحة متناسقة، ثم عدّلي ما تريدين.

◆ العباية
٢٠ تصميماً مصوراً: غيّري لون العباية والشيلة والفستان الداخلي والحذاء، وشاهدي الأمام والخلف مع التكبير. أرسلي ورقة التصميم مباشرة لخياطتك.

◆ المكياج
جربي أحمر الشفاه وظلال العيون والبلاشر والآيلاينر، أو إطلالات جاهزة على ثلاث عارضات.

◆ التسريحة

name: 던던
description:
던던은 혼자서도, 함께도 쓰는 가계부예요.

■ 말하듯이 적으면 기록돼요
「택시비 5500원 우리집」처럼 생각나는 대로 적으면 금액·가게·날짜·가계부를
알아서 나눠 담아요. 칸을 하나씩 채울 필요가 없어요.

■ 캡처·알림·문자에서 찾아줘요
결제 내역을 캡처해두면 던던이 읽어서 기록 후보로 만들어요. 맞는 것만 골라
담으면 끝이에요. 사진 속 글자는 아이폰 안에서 읽어요.

■ 함께 쓴 돈은 정산까지
가계부를 함께 쓰면 누가 얼마를 냈는지 모이고, 누가 누구에게 얼마를 보내면
되는지 한 줄로 정리해줘요. 정산을 요청하면 상대방에게 알림이 가요.

■ 한 달을 한눈에
어디에 얼마를 썼는지, 지난달보다 얼마나 달라졌는지, 무지출 데이는 며칠이었는지
돌아볼 수 있어요.

■ 원하는 기록만 모아서
여행, 경조사, 반려동물처럼 따로 보고 싶은 기록을 모음으로 묶어요. 조건을 정해두면
새 기록이 알아서 들어와요.

■ 연말정산도 미리
카드 소득공제와 연금 공제를 더해 올해 돌려받을 금액을 미리 계산해요. 체크카드를
얼마나 더 쓰면 한도를 채우는지도 알려줘요.

■ 개인 가계부와 공유 가계부를 따로
혼자 쓰는 가계부와 같이 쓰는 가계부를 나눠 둘 수 있어요. 공유한 기록만 다른
멤버에게 보여요.

광고가 없고, 쓴 내용을 분석에 쓰지 않아요.

name: 뭐 먹었더라?

• 파일로 기록 백업 및 복원하기

name: 작명노트 - 아기 이름 짓기, 개명
description:
아기 이름, 이제 근거를 보면서 고르세요.

작명노트는 출생신고와 개명에 쓸 수 있는 이름을 찾는 작명 도구입니다. 추천한 이름마다 어떤 기준으로 몇 점을 받았는지 모두 보여 드리고, 한자가 대법원 인명용 한자표에 있는지 바로 확인해 드립니다.

■ 이름 추천
· 성, 성별, 생년월일(선택), 돌림자, 넣고 싶은 글자와 피하고 싶은 글자로 이름 후보 30개
· 실제로 많이 쓰는 이름과 이름에 많이 쓰는 한자로 추천
· 형제·자매 이름과 겹치거나 헷갈리는지도 알려 드립니다

■ 한자 고르기
· 한글 이름을 이미 정했다면 어울리는 인명용 한자 조합을 점수순으로
· 돌림자처럼 정해 둔 한자는 고정해서 계산

■ 이름 풀이
· 지금 쓰는 이름이나 후보 이름을 획수(원획), 수리 4격, 음양, 발음오행, 자원오행, 사주 오행 보완으로 풀어 봅니다

■ 인명용 한자 검사 (무료)
· 2024년 6월 11일 시행된 대법원 인명용 한자표 기준
· 그 한자를 그 음으로 쓸 수 있는지, 두음법칙(李 리·이)까지 확인

■ 계산 근거 공개
· 점수마다 이유를 한 줄씩 보여 드립니다
· 학파마다 다른 기준(발음오행 ㅇ·ㅎ 배속, 진태양시, 자시 기준)은 설정에서 고를 수 있습니다
· 24절기는 천문 계산으로 구했고 한국천문연구원 발표와 1분 안에서 맞습니다

■ 희귀성과 두 글자 성
· 남궁, 황보, 제갈, 선우 등 두 글자 성과 희귀성도 한자를 직접 골라 계산합니다

■ 가족과 함께
· 이름 카드 이미지로 가족에게 보내고, 마음에 드는 이름은 보관함에 모아 비교하세요
· 가족 공유로 배우자도 함께 씁니다

■ 가격
· 무료: 추천 결과 상위 3개, 이름 풀이 1회, 인명용 한자 검사와 보관함
· 평생 이용권 ₩9,900: 모든 결과와 이름 풀이를 기간 제한 없이. 구독이 아닙니다.

■ 개인정보
· 회원가입이 없고, 입력한 이름과 생년월일은 기기 안에서만 계산하고 저장합니다.

점수는 전통 작명 기준을 계산해 보여 주는 참고 값이며 앞날을 예측하지 않습니다.

name: 페이지톡
description:
모든 일의 시작은 대화입니다.
페이지톡은 회사 직원들이 메신저처럼 편하게 쓰는 업무 대화방입니다.

사내 대화방
· 회사 전체 방과 부서·업무별 방에서 직원끼리 이야기합니다.
· 나를 부른 말, 답을 기다리는 물음을 놓치지 않게 알려 줍니다.
· 회사 관리자가 초대하거나 승인한 직원만 들어옵니다. 내가 들어간 방만 보입니다.

AI 업무 보조
· AI 보조가 답의 초안을 쓰고 대화를 정리해 직원을 돕습니다. 판단과 마무리는 사람이 합니다.
· 업무와 관계없거나 부적절한 요청에는 AI가 답하지 않고 담당 직원에게 넘깁니다.

고객 상담 연결(관리자)
· 회사가 지정한 관리자는 홈페이지로 들어온 고객 문의와 AI 상담 내용을 같은 앱에서 보고 이어서 답합니다.
· 고객은 문자로 받은 「이어 보기」 주소로 하던 대화를 열고, 답이 오면 알림을 받습니다.

이용 안내
· 회사 업무용 앱입니다. 회사 메일로 가입을 요청하면 회사 관리자가 승인한 뒤 쓸 수 있습니다.
· 계정은 앱 안 「내 계정」에서 언제든 직접 지울 수 있습니다.
· 만 14세 미만 어린이를 대상으로 하지 않습니다.
· AI 답이 이상하면 답 아래 「신고」를 누르면 담당 직원이 바로 이어받습니다.

선택 접근 권한(허용하지 않아도 쓸 수 있습니다)
· 알림: 새 말·새 일이 왔을 때 알려 드립니다.
· 사진: 대화에 사진을 붙일 때 폰의 사진 고르기 화면을 엽니다.

name: 편한캘린더 : 두 줄 캘린더
description:
필요한 기능만 담아, 매일 편하게 쓰는 나만의 캘린더입니다.

• 원하는 색상으로 일정을 구분하고, 여러 날 이어지는 일정은 달력에 연결해서 표시 할 수 있어요.
