• 등록한 일정은 목록에서 순서 변경이 가능해요.
• 알림과 다크 모드 지원
• 원하는 기간의 일정을 백업 파일로 내보내고 다른 기기에 추가.

일정은 내 기기에 저장됩니다.

name: インコ帳 - セキセイインコの体重・見守り記録
description:
インコ帳は、セキセイインコの体重と様子を毎日つける見守りアプリです。

小鳥は具合の悪さを隠すといわれます。
いちばん早く気づけるサインは、毎日の体重の小さな変化。
インコ帳は、毎朝はかった体重を「ふだん」とくらべて、変化をお知らせします。

■ 体重を「ふだん」とくらべる
体重はグラム単位（0.1g）で記録。直前7日間の平均を「ふだん」として、今日の体重との差を表示します。
ふだんより5%へると注意、10%へると「早めに病院へ」のお知らせ。3回つづけて減ったときも気づけます。
グラフには「ふだん」の線が入るので、変化がひと目でわかります。

■ きょうの見守り
羽をふくらませている、フンがいつもと違う日がつづく、室温が寒い・暑い、メスの産卵がつづく、換羽中。
気になることを「きょう」の画面にまとめて表示します。
生まれた日を入れると、ヒナ・若鳥のうちは室温の目安を高めにします。

■ 1日の記録
様子（おしゃべり・げんき・ふくらんでる など）、フン、放鳥時間、室温、換羽、産卵、写真、メモ。

■ ことば帳
おぼえた言葉や鳴きまねを、はじめて聞いた日といっしょに残せます。いくつおぼえたかもひと目で。

■ おせわの目安
ケージの大掃除・止まり木やおもちゃを洗う・爪切り・水浴び・健康診断。前回と次の目安がわかります。

■ 朝のお知らせ
「体重をはかろう」と、その日が目安のおせわを、朝に1通でお知らせ。はかり終わった日は出ません。

■ 多頭飼いにも
何羽でも登録して、画面の上の名前から切りかえられます。

■ 安心して使える
記録と写真は iPhone の中だけに保存されます。アカウント登録はありません。

■ 料金
すべての機能を無料で使えます（画面の下に広告が表示されます）。

※ 体重・室温・おせわの間隔・お知らせは一般的な目安です。具合が気になるときは、鳥をみられる動物病院に相談してください。

name: こえのたね — 日本語音声入力
description:
こえのたねは、買い切りで使える日本語音声入力と日本語キーボードのアプリです。

【声で入力】
本体アプリでモデルとマイクを準備しておくと、ほかのアプリの入力欄で「こえのたね」キーボードを使って音声入力を始めたり止めたりできます。大きなプレビュー画面で、何を言ったかを見ながら入力できます。待機が切れているときは、本体アプリからマイクを準備してから入力欄に戻してください。

【その場で修正】
大きなキーで、かなフリック、漢字変換、英数字や記号を入力できます。キーが大きいので、入力欄の中で迷いにくいキーボードです。ひらがなを変換せずに確定することもできます。よく使う言葉は辞書に登録でき、辞書ファイルの取り込みや共有もできます。

【端末内で処理】
音声認識はAppleの端末内モデルを使います。モデルの準備が終わっていれば、通信を切った状態でも音声入力とフィラー除去を使えます。音声や入力内容を開発者のサーバーに送る機能はありません。初回にモデルを取得するには通信が必要です。

【文章を整形】
対応している端末では、Apple Intelligenceの端末内モデルで文章を整形できます。機種、OS、Apple Intelligenceの設定、モデルの準備状況によっては使えないことがあります。

【使う前に】
iOS・iPadOS 26以降が必要です。音声入力には、キーボードの追加、フルアクセス、マイクの許可、モデルの準備が必要です。フルアクセスは、本体アプリとキーボードのあいだで開始・停止の要求や認識結果を共有するために使います。

買い切りで、利用料もAPIキーも不要です。認識結果の正確さや句読点の補完は保証できないので、送信前にチェック推奨です。

name: スパッと！だんめんず 小学校受験の図形・断面図
description:
りんごを たてに切ったら、どんな形？ キウイを よこに切ったら？
「スパッと！だんめんず」は、果物・野菜・立体の3Dを自分の手で切って、切り口（断面）をたしかめる学習アプリです。小学校受験のペーパーでよく出る「切り口」「つみき」「図形」「てんびん」の問題を、絵ではなく、動かせる3Dで練習できます。

■ きってみる
棚から好きなものを選んで、たて・よこ・ななめ、または指でなぞった向きに「スパッ」。切る位置もスライダーで動かせます。りんごの芯、キウイの種、れんこんの穴、メロンのわたまで、中身も本物そっくり。切り口は「だんめんず」カードになり、大きくして見比べられます。
くだもの12種類・やさい13種類・かたち（立体）11種類の、ぜんぶで36種類。

■ スタンプラリー
6つのエリア・30ステージのマップを進みながら、12種類の問題が少しずつまざって出ます。正解するとその問題のスタンプがもらえ、くり返すとふちが銀、そして金に変わります（スタンプはぜんぶで128こ）。

■ もんだいしゅう
「きりくち」「つみき」「ずけい」「てんびん」の4つのなかまから1種類を選んで、かんたん・ふつう・むずかしいで練習できます。苦手な種類だけをくり返したいときに。

■ 白黒でも出題
最後のエリアは、本番のペーパーに近い白黒で出題します。もんだいしゅうの画面や設定で、ほかの問題も白黒に切りかえられます（3Dの台や物まで白黒になります）。

■ 問題は12種類
【きりくち】どれに なる？／なにを きった？／おなじに きろう
【つみき】つみきは いくつ？／どう みえる？（上・前・横から）
【ずけい】くるっと かいてん／かがみに うつす／かさねると？／ぴったり ピース
【てんびん】おもさくらべ／いくつで つりあう？／どっちが さがる？

■ 答えたら、必ず「なぜ」を見せる
正解でも不正解でも、そのあとに本当に切って・ばらして・まわして見せます。つみきの数え問題では、かくれていたつみきを1こずつ数え直します。てんびんは本番のペーパーと同じ真横から見た形で、「おやくそく」どおりに物をおきかえて数えてから、てんびんを動かして見せます。まちがえた問題は「にがて」として、あとで出やすくなります。

■ 安心して使えるように
・問題文は音声で読み上げます。まだ字が読めなくても、ひとりで進められます（読み上げは設定で切れます）
・広告、アプリ内課金、外部へのリンクはありません
・アカウント登録は不要。学習の記録は端末の中だけに保存されます
・通信は行いません。オフラインで遊べます

対象：4〜7さい（年中〜小学1年生）
はじめは「きってみる」で自由に遊び、切り口が「わかってきた」ころに、スタンプラリーやもんだいしゅうへ進むのがおすすめです。

name: そなえメモ
description:
毎日のくらしに寄り添う、やさしい防災備蓄アプリ「そなえメモ」。 政府も推奨する「ローリングストック（食べながら備える）」を、無理なく楽しく続けられます。

【そなえメモでできること】

■ 1. 写真つきローリングストック & 半年前の1日リマインド ・名称、ジャンル、数量、保管場所、外観（カメラ撮影・アルバム選択）をかんたん登録 ・賞味期限の「約6ヶ月前の月の1日」にリマインドでお知らせ。カレンダーへの予定保存やワンタップ入れ替えにも対応 ・「キッチン・パントリー」「床下収納」「玄関」など、よく使う保管場所もワンタップで選べます

■ 2. 災害時の必要・推奨物品チェックリスト ・飲料水、非常食、携帯トイレ、救急セット、電源・明かりなどカテゴリ別に備えをチェック ・全体の準備率がひと目でわかり、ご家庭に合わせたカスタム項目の追加も可能です

■ 3. 複数の非常用持ち出し袋をまとめて管理 ・玄関用、車載用、子ども用など、用途別に何個でもバッグを登録できます ・チェックリストから選んで一括追加することも、フリー入力で記録することも可能です

■ 4. 安否確認・集合場所メモ・ハザードマップ自動表示 ・NTT（171 / web171）、ドコモ、au、ソフトバンクなど各社の災害用伝言板リンクと家族の連絡ルールメモを収録 ・学校や公園などの集合場所を検索して登録すると、国土地理院の周辺地図とハザードマップ（洪水・土砂災害・津波・高潮）を自動で重ねて表示します

■ 5. どなたにも見やすい文字サイズ切り替え ・ヘッダーから「標準・大・特大」の3段階をワンタップで切り替え可能 ・登録したデータや写真はすべてお使いの端末内に安全に保存されます

大切なご家族を守る第一歩を、「そなえメモ」から始めてみませんか？

name: といぷー日記 - トイプードルの写真日記
description:
といぷー日記は、トイプードルとの毎日を残す日記アプリです。
写真つきの日記と、トイプーならではのトリミング・健康の記録を1冊にまとめました。

■ 写真で毎日の日記
写真・きぶん・おさんぽ（回数と時間）・ごはん・歯みがき・うんち・涙やけ・体重・メモを、その日のページにまとめて残せます。
カメラでその場で撮ることも、アルバムから選ぶこともできます。
この7日間の散歩の時間や、日記をつづけて書いた日数も表示します。

■ 次のトリミングがひと目でわかる
プードルの毛は抜けかわらず、ずっと伸び続けます。
前回のカットからの日数と「毛の伸び」の目安、いつもの間隔から計算した次のトリミングの目安日を表示します。
カットのスタイル・お店・料金・仕上がりの写真も残せるので、次のオーダーのときに見せられます。

■ 体重の変化に気づける
体重をグラフで表示。1か月でぐっと減ったり増えたりしたときは、そっとお知らせします（パピーの成長中は増えても言いません）。

■ ワクチン・フィラリアの予定
狂犬病ワクチン・混合ワクチン・健康診断は前回から1年後、フィラリア・ノミダニのお薬はシーズン中に毎月。次の予定日がひと目でわかります。
お薬のシーズンは地域に合わせて変えられます。

■ 年齢と記念日
お誕生日から「人でいうと何さい」を表示。お誕生日や、うちに来た記念日が近づくとお知らせします。

■ お知らせ
予防とトリミングの日は朝に、日記をまだ書いていない日は夜に、そっとおさそいします。

■ 多頭飼いにも
2頭、3頭と登録して、画面の上の名前から切りかえられます。

■ シェア
日記のページを、写真入りのかわいいカードにしてSNSにシェアできます。

■ 安心して使える
記録と写真は iPhone の中だけに保存されます。アカウント登録はありません。

■ 料金
すべての機能を無料で使えます（画面の下に広告が表示されます）。

※ トリミングの間隔・予防の予定・体重のお知らせは一般的な目安です。お薬やワクチンの時期は、かかりつけの獣医さんの指示を優先してください。

name: ぱりっといちご飴
description:
果物を串に刺して、熱い飴にくぐらせて、指でくるくる回して冷ます。
「ぱりっといちご飴」は、夜の屋台でフルーツ飴をつくるゲームです。

◆ 注文どおりに串に刺す
いちご、シャインマスカット、みかん、巨峰、キウイ、パイン、ブルーベリー、姫りんご。お客さんの注文札を見て、果物を順番どおりに串に刺します。

◆ 飴の温度を見極める
鍋の飴はどんどん熱くなります。150℃前後でくぐらせると、ぱりっと固まる飴に。早いとべたべた、遅いと焦げて苦くなります。3日目からは温度計の数字が消えるので、飴の色と泡の細かさが頼りです。

◆ くるくる回して、厚みをそろえる
くぐらせた直後の飴はとろとろ。串の上を指でなでて回し続けないと、飴が下にたれてしまいます。かといって速く回しすぎると飛び散ってうすくなる。固まるまでの数秒で、まわりの厚みをそろえましょう。先から見た図で、飴のかたよりがひと目でわかります。

◆ 屋台を続けて、メニューを増やす
紅白飴、信号飴、ぶどう二色、南国飴、虹の飴まで12品。売上の目標に届くと次の夜が開きます。ぱりっ・つやつや・注文どおりがそろうと心づけがもらえます。作った本数と会心の一本は「飴のきろく」に残ります。

※登録不要・通信なしで遊べます。
※絵はすべてこのアプリのために描いたもので、実在のお店や商品とは関係ありません。

name: はり師・きゅう師 過去問｜アプ問 鍼灸国試対策
description:
はり師・きゅう師国家試験の対策に。
公益財団法人東洋療法研修試験財団が公表している第29〜34回の過去問（6回分・1080問）を、すべて自作の解説つきで収録。午前・午後180問のオリジナル予想問題5回分、14科目840問の4択問題、暗記カード300枚、混同注意60組で、基礎から国家試験レベルまで仕上げられます。

最初に「はり師／きゅう師／併願」を選ぶだけで、問題も合否判定も受ける試験に合わせて変わります。併願の方には、はり師・きゅう師それぞれの合否の目安を並べて表示します。

過去問の問題と正答は全6回、第34回は解説まで、予想問題の第1回、4択問題の星1、暗記カード、混同注意は、購入しなくても使えます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 過去問を解く
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【第29〜34回 6回分・1080問】
午前（専門基礎）・午後（専門）を回ごとに収録。症例問題も2問1組で読みやすく表示します。
・回ごとに時間を計って解く（制限時間つき・中断して再開できる）
・午前と午後の合計点で、はり師・きゅう師それぞれの合否の目安を表示
・はり師だけ・きゅう師だけを選ぶと、受けない方の理論の問題は出ません

【全問、「なぜ違うのか」まで解説】
正解の根拠だけでなく、誤りの選択肢一つひとつに「どこが違うのか」を書きました。解説はすべて書き下ろしで、出典の一覧も見られます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 予想問題で国家試験に備える
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【オリジナル予想問題 5回分】
午前90問・午後90問（はり師だけ・きゅう師だけなら午後80問）の予想問題を5回分収録。科目ごとの問題数や症例問題も国家試験に合わせて作っています。
・制限時間つきで解ける（途中でやめても続きから解ける）
・採点後は、科目ごとの得点と、午前＋午後の合計での合否の目安を表示
・全問に、誤りの選択肢一つひとつまでの解説つき
第1回（午前・午後）は購入しなくても解けます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 4択問題で基礎を固める
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【14科目・840問の4択問題】
医療概論、衛生学・公衆衛生学、関係法規、解剖学、生理学、病理学概論、臨床医学総論、臨床医学各論、リハビリテーション医学、東洋医学概論、経絡経穴概論、東洋医学臨床論、はり理論、きゅう理論の14科目を収録。
各科目を星1（基礎）・星2（本番レベル）・星3（応用）の3段階で、段階的に実力を伸ばせます。

【出題順と出題する問題を選べる】
「順番通り／ランダム」と「すべての問題／未習得のみ」を組み合わせて出題できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 覚える
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【暗記カード 300枚】
経穴の部位、東洋医学の用語、解剖・生理の要点などをカードで確認。「1問1答」「一覧」「赤シート」の3つの見方を切り替えられます。

【混同注意 60組】
まぎらわしい用語や経穴を組にして「見分け方」と「ひっかけ」を整理。過去問や4択問題の解説の下にも、関係する組が出てきます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 忘れない・弱点をなくす
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【二段構えの自動復習】
まちがえた問題は、その日のうちの「当日やり直し」と、忘却曲線に合わせた「復習ボックス」に自動で入ります。

【科目別の正答率グラフ】
科目ごとの正答率を低い順に表示。タップすれば、その科目の弱点だけを集中して解けます。

【弱点プリント（PDF印刷）】
まちがえた問題やブックマークした問題から、紙で解けるA4プリントを作成できます。

【付箋メモ・検索】
問題やカードに自分だけのメモを貼れます。用語・問題をまとめて検索できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 続ける
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【学習スタンプカレンダー】
解いた日にスタンプ。今日の学習数や連続日数、学習時間、直近14日のグラフも確認できます。

【トロフィー・全国ランキング】
連続学習や解いた問題数でトロフィーを獲得。Game Center で、全国のユーザーと正解数や予想問題の得点率を競えます。

【国家試験までのカウントダウン・集中タイマー】
国家試験までの日数をホームとホーム画面ウィジェットに表示。25分集中＋5分休憩のタイマーも使えます。

【iPhoneとiPadで記録を同期】
iCloudで学習記録を同期できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ パック（すべて買い切り・月額なし）
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【4択問題パック】
4択問題の星2・星3（14科目）

【予想問題パック】
オリジナル予想問題 第2〜5回（午前・午後）

【過去問解説パック】
第29〜33回の過去問の解説

【フル解放パック】
上の3つのパックに、着せ替えテーマ4種＋限定テーマを加えたセット

着せ替えテーマは1つずつ購入することもできます。

※過去問は、公益財団法人東洋療法研修試験財団が公表しているはり師・きゅう師国家試験の問題と、厚生労働省が公表している正答をもとに、出典を明記して収録しています。本アプリは厚生労働省・同財団とは関係のない個人が作成した学習用アプリです。
※本アプリは国家試験の学習用です。診断や治療の助言は行いません。

name: 中医诊脉小李子
description:
「中医诊脉小李子」是一款运行在 Apple Watch 上的中医体质参考工具，用一分钟的静心诊脉，把你的真实生理数据翻译成易懂的中医语言。

【诊脉】
把手表戴紧，安静坐下，点击「请小李子诊脉」。App 会通过 Apple Watch 的心率传感器实时采集脉搏数据，并结合心率变异性、静息心率、睡眠、站立与活动情况，推演出当下的脉象特征与体质倾向。

【你会得到】
· 脉象判读：迟、平、数、律不齐等脉象描述
· 体质参考：从气血、寒热、虚实等维度给出体质倾向
· 今日一贴：针对当前体质的一条日常调养建议
· 诊脉记录：每次结果保存在手表，并同步到 iPhone 随时回看

【脉象图谱】
内置二十八脉知识图谱，随时查阅每种脉象的描述与常见成因。

【数据与隐私】
所有健康数据只在你的设备本地读取与计算，不上传服务器，不收集个人信息，没有账号，没有广告。

【重要说明】
本 App 提供的内容基于公开中医理论与 Apple Watch 采集的生理数据自动推演，仅供健康参考与自我观察，不构成医学诊断、治疗方案或医疗建议。如有身体不适，请及时就医。

name: 每日小卡-365天年册日记
description:
有些日子不需要长篇大论，一两句话，就足够把那天留住。

「每日小卡」是一本用稚笔手写体写下的轻日记。每天一张小卡，把今天遇到的小事、吹过的风、冒出来的心情，认认真真收好。

【一笔一画，都有手写的温度】
内置原创手写字体「稚笔」，每一个字在纸面上都有自然的轻重与落笔微差，像真的拿笔写在纸上。

【挑一张纸，贴一枚心情】
横线纸、空白卡、黄色便利贴随心切换，再贴上一枚手绘心情贴纸，给这一天留个表情。

【挂在书架上，随时翻看与补写】
最近写下的小卡会挂在绳上，按住会透出微光，轻点就能翻面。月历书架把整月心情排得清清楚楚；哪天忙忘了也没关系，翻回过去任何一天都能补上。

【小卡打印机，分享这一天】
点一下右上角，小卡会从打印机里缓缓吐出、咔嚓撕下，存进相册或分享给想分享的人。

【把一整年，翻成一本年册】
这一年写过的所有小卡，会自动装订成一本可以指尖翻页的立体年册，还能一键导出高清 PDF 永久珍藏。

【桌面与锁屏小组件】
把今天的小卡放在主屏幕或锁屏上，抬头就能看见，轻点就能提笔。

【安静、私密、无打扰】
没有广告、不用注册账号、没有社交广场。所有小卡只存在你的手机与你个人的 iCloud 私有空间里，只有你自己能看见。

name: 沸点分离
description: 沸点分离为学习二元精馏图解法提供一个可编辑、可复核的计算工作台。 在塔板推演中输入相对挥发度、进料组成、塔顶和塔底目标、进料热状况以及回流比。应用据此构造平衡曲线和两段操作线，从塔顶交替求平衡液相与下一汽相组成。选择任意理论级，即可把图中的水平与垂直步骤对应到数字证据，核对进料切段和最后一级插值。 回流比较可在指定区间逐个重算候选方案，同时区分回流不足、夹点和可行分离。采用候选后，工作台会带入准确的回流比重新计算。组分衡算展示每单位进料的馏出、釜底及塔内循环量。 实验底稿冻结输入、操作线、逐级组成与时间。重开一份底稿后修改规格并另存修订，也可以复制计算摘要用于课堂练习核对。 采用恒定相对挥发度、恒摩尔流和全凝器假设。理论级包含再沸器，不计全凝器。本工具用于学习与数值复核，不是化工装置设计或操作指导。

name: 滤浪见潮
description:
滤去日常起伏，看见长期改变。

滤浪见潮是一款完全免费的离线趋势记录工具。记录体重、睡眠、运动配速、专注时长，或任何你在意的数字，让持续记录帮助你看清变化。

【看清趋势，理解起伏】
保留真实读数，同时展示近期与长期平滑趋势。支持查看14天、30天、90天及全部记录，切换原始数据对比，滑动图表查看不同日期的数值。数据充分时，还可查看每周变化与目标时间估算。

【记录自己的生活】
提供12种指标模板，也支持自定义名称、单位和目标方向。你可以选择越低越好、越高越好，或保持在目标区间，让记录贴合自己的需要。

【每一笔，都有上下文】
支持补记历史数据、设置测量时间、添加情境标签和备注，随时编辑或删除。同一天多次记录，可按首次、末次、均值或求和参与趋势计算。

【在波动中发现线索】
结合情境标签，查看较大波动的出现次数、样本量及后续实测变化。标签反映记录中的关联，不代表原因，帮助你带着更多信息继续观察。

【安静使用，安心保存】
无需登录，无需联网，无广告、无订阅、无内购。记录保存在设备本地，应用不会主动上传记录。支持JSON完整备份与恢复，以及CSV导出，方便自行保存和整理数据。

【选择舒服的样子】
深海夜潮、素笺浅海与跟随系统三种外观选择，搭配不同的平滑节奏，让日常记录更合自己的习惯。分别适配iPhone与iPad，清晰呈现你关心的信息。

从一个真实数字开始，给持续的改变一个清晰的刻度。

趋势和目标时间仅供日常观察，估算会随记录变化。请定期保存完整备份，卸载应用可能删除本地记录。

name: 生态演算
description: 生态演算为学习种群动力学的人提供一张可操作的双物种相平面。猎物增长、捕食接触、捕食转化与捕食者衰亡共同决定数量轨迹；点相平面可设置初值，时间游标会同步定位数量、变化率和曲线位置。经典捕食模型展示闭合循环，有限承载量模式则让你检查轨道如何接近平衡。平衡域计算零增长线交点、雅可比迹与行列式以及特征值，区分中性中心、稳定焦点和稳定结点。转化系数扫描解释有限承载量下何时存在正共存点，并可将选中的系数带回主实验。在指定时刻按比例增减任一物种后，演算会从该时刻的新数量继续，并保留无干预轨道作为对照。每份实验冻结初值、参数、干预和所有轨迹点；重开为新修订时旧结果保持不变，全部数量表格可以复制。模型仅供教学探索，不用于真实生态管理或放养决策。时长1至100，每次最多12个干预，数值超出范围会明确停止并提示。

name: 番迹动漫记
description:
How many series have you watched? Where did you stop? Which scene made you reach for a screenshot? FanJi gathers those scattered traces into an archive that is entirely yours.

● COLLECT, ONE TITLE AT A TIME
Search in English, Japanese or romaji, browse real AniList rankings for trending and top-rated titles, and import your existing watch list in one tap. Rare finds? Add them manually and pick a cover from Photos. Scores, status, episode counts and notes all live here.

● TRACK AT A GLANCE
Tap a card to log one episode, or tap a dot in the episode grid. Binge-watched a whole night? Log a batch at once. Rewatch counts, progress rings and auto-archiving on completion. See how many episodes you watched today and roughly how long it took.

● KEEP THE SCENES
Import a screenshot and offline OCR reads the subtitle for you. Add a note, a mood, and the title and episode it belongs to. A waterfall gallery respects each image's original ratio; the detail page reads like a collected card, and the scene wall opens full-screen for slow browsing.

● LOOK BACK
Quote of the day pulls from lines you have saved. On This Day resurfaces entries and moments from the same date in past years. A day-by-day timeline and an 18-week heatmap make your streak visible.

● YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no cloud, nobody else. Everything lives on this iPhone — nothing is uploaded or tracked. Export a JSON backup anytime and restore it on a new device. Available in Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese; switch languages in Settings.

For anyone who forgets where they stopped, wants to remember a single line, or simply wants to take watching anime seriously. FanJi will not nag you — it just quietly remembers.

name: 解梦记
description:
解梦记，是一本会“解读”的梦境日记。

醒来后的几分钟，梦忘得最快。打开解梦记，用语音说出你的梦，自动转成文字，也可以直接打字记录。再选一个醒来时的心情，几秒钟后，你会得到一份有两种视角的解读：

【周公解梦·传统本义】从《周公解梦》的取象思路，看这个梦在传统文化里的寓意。
【综合详解·现代心理学】结合荣格、弗洛伊德等视角，理解梦里的情绪与象征。
【核心象征与情绪】把梦拆成几个关键意象，并标记当下情绪。
【行动建议】给出贴近生活的小建议，仅供自我觉察参考。

更多功能
· 梦境日记：按最近、愉悦、平静、不安筛选，支持关键词搜索，随时回看。
· 梦境洞察：累计梦境、记录天数、本周情绪趋势，一眼看清最近的状态。
· 象征词典：飞翔、水、掉牙、被追、蛇、龙……常见梦象征一点即查。
· 清晰梦入门、噩梦转化练习、每日梦知识，帮你把记梦变成长期习惯。
· 梦境卡片：一键生成分享卡片，保存图片或复制文案。

隐私与说明
· 无需注册登录，不收集手机号、微信等身份信息。
· 梦境日记保存在你的设备上，可在「我的 > 注销并清除全部数据」中一键清空。
· 为生成解读，你提交的梦境文字会发送至 AI 服务处理，不用于其他用途。
· 无广告。

免责声明：解梦记的内容基于传统文化典籍与心理学常识整理，仅供文化参考与自我觉察，不构成医疗、心理诊疗、投资、婚姻或人生决策建议，也不代表对未来的预测。如长期受噩梦或睡眠问题困扰，请咨询专业医生或心理咨询师。

description:

name: PuppetCue
description:
Know who holds the puppet on every beat. PuppetCue helps puppet troupes, school drama clubs, and hand-puppet teachers plan who controls each part, rehearse handoffs, and turn the final plan into individual rehearsal cards.

Start with The Paper Aviary, a built-in scene with an editable cue sheet. Then create your own production and scene, add your puppeteers, and define control parts such as a bird's head, wings, or a puppet's arm. Tap a point on the paper stage to find the cue or handoff for that part.

1. Score the scene. Add cues to the timeline and assign each task to a left hand, a right hand, or both hands of the same puppeteer. Drag cues between tracks or enter exact beats. A cue from beat 4 to beat 8 frees that hand at beat 8. Lock a cue's entrance beat or hand assignment when it needs to stay in place.

2. Plan the handoff. Choose the outgoing and incoming hands, set the switch beat, and allow time for both hands to hold the part. Show when a part must be held or may be parked. The conflict list marks double bookings, unassigned hands, gaps in control, and handoffs with too little overlap.

3. Run the rehearsal. Step through the scene one beat at a time, or set a tempo and loop a difficult passage. Follow each puppeteer's current and next hand tasks. Set playback to pause on a conflict, then open its details to see which cues and hands are involved.

4. Compare and share. Duplicate a plan to try another assignment or an earlier pre-grip. Compare conflicts, overlap shortfalls, and peak hand demand before confirming the plan. Preview or share PDF rehearsal cards for one puppeteer or the whole crew. Each card includes the relevant cues, handoffs, and notes. Draft cards flag unresolved conflicts.

Rehearsals work offline with no account required. Create a backup of your workspace and restore it later from Files.

name: Remorae
description:
Remorae helps you build new habits by attaching them to routines you already have.

Like a remora fish that travels with a bigger host, each new habit rides along with something you already do every day. "After I pour my morning coffee, I write one thing I'm grateful for." It's called habit stacking, and Remorae makes it simple, calm and beautiful.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a host routine you already do: morning coffee, opening your laptop, finishing lunch, brushing your teeth.
• Attach one or more tiny habits (remoras) to it.
• Give each habit a "tiny version" for low-energy days, like "one sip" or "one page", so you never break the chain.
• Tap to complete. Your reef grows with every habit you finish.

FEATURES
• Habit stacks: group new habits around a cue you already follow
• Tiny versions: a 2-minute fallback for every habit
• Dawn, Daytime and Dusk times to organise your day
• Tides: weekly progress, a 12-week heatmap and 30-day strength for each stack
• Living reef: corals grow and pearls appear as your streaks build
• Streaks, best streak and 30-day completion rate for every stack
• History grid to see your consistency at a glance
• Starter library of proven stacks to begin in seconds
• Gentle local reminders at the time you choose
• Fully animated ocean design with calm haptic feedback

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline. No internet connection needed.
• No account required. Tap "Skip for now" and start right away.
• Optional sign in with Google to back up your reef and restore it on a new device.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Delete your account and cloud backup at any time from inside the app.

CAR RENTAL

MANDOOB SERVICES

PICKUP TRUCK
Move furniture, equipment, coffee carts or food carts. Set pickup and drop-off, pick a date and time, and book your truck.

TRANSPORTATION PACKAGES
Daily rides to school or work: one-way or round trip, the days and times you need, on monthly packages.

ALL IN ONE PLACE
• Follow every booking and request, with clear status and payment details
• Invoices and receipts in your account
• Upload your ID and driving licence once and reuse them
• Message our team from inside the app
• Full English and Arabic, right to left

Your account, documents and bookings are protected, and you can delete your account at any time from Profile.

name: 1Vault - Secure Docs & Photos
description:
Documents only you can open.

1Vault keeps your important papers (ID cards, passports, insurance policies, certificates, bills and receipts) in one private vault on your phone. Every file is encrypted on your iPhone before it is uploaded. We store only scrambled data and never hold a key that can read it. Not your files, not their names, not your notes.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
• Files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they leave your iPhone
• Names, tags and notes are encrypted too, so even a file called "Medical report" gives nothing away
• Your password is never sent to us. It unlocks your vault on the device itself

ADD DOCUMENTS IN SECONDS
• Take a photo of a document with the camera
• Pick photos from your library, or PDFs and other files from the Files app
• Organise everything in folders, with a list or grid view
• Add tags and notes to find things later

FIND ANYTHING
• Search by name, tag or note
• Search runs entirely on your iPhone, so the server never sees what you look for

UNLOCK WITH FACE ID
• Open your vault with Face ID or Touch ID instead of typing your password
• The vault locks itself when you leave the app

RECOVERY YOU CONTROL
• A recovery secret is saved to your own iCloud Keychain, so a new iPhone signed in to the same Apple Account can recover your vault with an emailed code and a new password
• An optional 28-character recovery code gives you a paper backup
• Because we can't read your vault, we also can't reset it. If you lose your password, your iCloud Keychain and your recovery code, nobody can open your documents. Not even us.

1 GB OF ENCRYPTED STORAGE INCLUDED

Questions? Write to support@1vault-app.com

name: A Little Tidier
description:
ind a little calm, one room at a time.

Follow simple objectives across eight cozy moments, from clearing the sofa to setting out tea and adding the finishing touches. Tap the objects you find, zoom in for a closer look, and use a hint when something is tucked away. Warm colors, soothing music, and gentle sound effects create a relaxing atmosphere as each room comes together.

Keep your completed moments in a personal album, compare the before-and-after views, and revisit your favorite scenes. Whether you enjoy spotting small details or watching a room feel a little more like home, there is something lovely in every corner.

name: Anatomia – 3D Atlas
description:
Anatomia is a 3D atlas of the human body for learning. The app is a gift for schools, universities and clinics, meant for education and training: free, without ads, without an account and without tracking.

THE WHOLE BODY
A male and a female reference model with more than 2,200 parts in 15 systems: skeleton, muscles, vessels, nerves, organs. Show and hide layers, tap single parts, rotate, zoom, search.

THE HEART FROM INSIDE
Chambers, atria, valves and papillary muscles as a model of their own, with a learning simulation of heartbeat, ECG and pressure curves.

THE BRAIN
437 structures: cortex, deep nuclei, cranial nerves and the large fibre tracts.

LEARN AND PRACTISE
Learning academy, quiz and guided tours. The clinical areas (laboratory, pharmacology, cases, OSCE) are learning simulations with example values.

THREE LANGUAGES
The interface is available in German, English and Albanian. Some anatomical names are still in English only.

WITHOUT A NETWORK
All 3D data are part of the app. It also runs without an internet connection.

IMPORTANT
Anatomia is a learning aid. The app is not a medical device and does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. External genitalia are hidden by default and can be shown for teaching.

SOURCES
The 3D data come from open scientific sources (among them BodyParts3D, Human Reference Atlas, Z-Anatomy). All sources and licences are listed in the app under "About" and on anatomie.site.

name: AnswerBase
description: Answer Base is a reading tool used to retrieve content from Q&A sites. It uses the Stack Exchange network as its data source, consolidating questions, answers, tags, and user profiles scattered across various technical sites into a clean interface: the homepage browses the question stream in four order: "latest/popular/high score/unanswered", the search page supports keyword, tag, minimum vote, and "adopted answer" combination filtering, and the tab page can browse all tags by popularity or alphabetical order and focus on their commonly used technical directions. Each question can view the complete text, all answers, related questions, and questioner information, and the code blocks, references, and links in the text will be correctly formatted. When encountering content worth keeping, you can bookmark, take notes, and generate drafts. The statistics page will use bar charts and circular graphs to display the reading activity, distribution of bookmark tags, and the popularity tags and community size of the selected site in the past seven days.

name: Arowmx
description: Arrowmx helps you review how your daily expenses have evolved over time. You can log income, expenditures, and account transfers by date, set milestones for life changes, and select specific accounts, categories, and timeframes for comparison. The app displays financial figures from before and after these milestones; you can expand any category to examine individual transactions. One-off expenses can be flagged separately, allowing you to toggle between viewing total costs and recurring expenses. By analyzing category variances, spending patterns, and cumulative balance charts—while also checking for any unverified entries—you can document your personal reflections as "observation notes" linked to specific transactions, ensuring that every review is backed by a concrete, traceable record.

name: Avoid wheels
description:
Pull one beam at a time. Keep the tower standing.

Challenge yourself in a 3D workshop puzzle where every move matters. Study the stack, choose a safe stick, and remove it without bringing the structure down. Protect marked red blocks, beat the move limit, and clear each blueprint before time runs out.

Features

100 handcrafted stages across 10 workshop chapters
Rotate and zoom to inspect every beam
Timed challenges and limited moves
Daily Blueprint Challenge for a fresh run each day
Material Archive to unlock new wood and metal styles
Clean English UI with sound and haptic feedback

name: Barabom Homecam: Pet Camera
description:
Turn a spare phone into a pet camera and keep an eye on your dog or cat at home.
Watch live in the Barabom Health Diary app you already use, and replay the moments you missed. No new camera to buy, and you can start for free.

■ Install on a spare phone, scan one QR code
Install Barabom Homecam on a spare phone and a QR code appears. In the Barabom Health Diary app on your phone, go to More → Homecam → Add camera and scan it. That's it. The spare phone needs no login or sign-up. You can also try it out on that phone alone before connecting.

■ Live view, wherever you are
On the subway or at work, open the Barabom Health Diary app to see what your pet is doing right now. Tap the mic button to let them hear your voice, and tap it again to stop.

■ Replay what you missed
The camera phone keeps recordings. Drag the timeline to a moment with motion and watch from there. You can also browse recordings by date on the camera phone.

■ Motion alerts
Get a notification in the Barabom Health Diary app when your pet moves. Set the motion sensitivity and alert hours for each camera.

■ Timed photos saved to the health diary
Pick days and times, like 8:00 AM and 7:30 PM, and the camera takes a photo at those times and saves it as a memo in that pet's health diary. Photos taken at the same time each day make changes easy to spot.

■ Watch together with family
Send an invite link in any messenger and your family can watch the same camera in their own Barabom Health Diary app. You can also see who watched and when.

■ Know first when it goes offline
Get notified when the camera phone turns off or loses Wi-Fi, when its battery drops to 20% while unplugged, and when it reconnects. Everyone who watches the camera gets these alerts.

■ Sound and recording, visible at home
Home audio is off at first. You hear it live only after it is turned on in the Barabom Homecam settings on the camera phone, and the camera owner can turn it off anytime from the Barabom Health Diary app. Recordings never include sound. While the camera is on, the camera phone shows "Camera on".
Video is not stored on Barabom servers. Recordings stay on the camera phone; only time-capture photos are saved as entries in the pet's health diary.

■ Built to stay on
By default, the camera phone sends video over Wi-Fi only (you can allow mobile data in settings). If the phone gets hot it lowers the quality on its own, and when storage runs low it deletes the oldest recordings first and keeps recording. Choose how long to keep recordings and the video quality in the camera phone's settings.

■ Start free, subscribe for more
With a Barabom Health Diary subscription:
- Record in high quality
- Connect more cameras
- Watch with more family members
- Keep recordings with no time limit
Subscribe in the Barabom Health Diary app under More → Profile.

■ Made for pet parents who
- worry about a dog or cat home alone
- want to see how a pet with separation anxiety spends the day
- have an old phone sitting unused in a drawer
- share pet care with family, or live with several pets

■ What you need
- A spare iPhone for the camera (iOS 16.4 or later)
- A charger and home Wi-Fi
- Your phone with the Barabom Health Diary app
Keep the Barabom Homecam screen on when using an iPhone as the camera. Pressing the side button or opening another app stops the camera.

The app is available in 한국어, English and 日本語. On the free plan a small ad appears at the bottom of the camera phone screen; subscribers use it ad-free.
Barabom Homecam is a home camera for watching your pets. It is not a replacement for professional security equipment.

name: BlendAbacus
description:
Create proportional formulas with two or more components, set a target mass in grams and calculate each component’s share. Save and edit formulas, compare batch multipliers, search your collection and combine identically named ingredients into a component ledger. Export your saved records as JSON.

Designed for home cooks and craft makers who already know their ratios. BlendAbacus scales mass proportions; it does not convert volumes or decide whether a formula is suitable for a particular use.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: BvEco Pixel World
description:
BvEco Pixel World is a cozy pixel-art world that comes back to life when you walk, cycle and pick up litter.

Your little world starts out gray and quiet. Every kilometer you walk or ride, and every piece of litter you pick up, makes it greener, brighter and busier. Skip a few days and it slowly fades back to gray, but it never dies. It is always waiting for you.

HOW IT WORKS
- Walking and cycling distance comes from the Health app, read-only. We never write to Health.
- Your total distance unlocks six zones: Meadow, Forest, Lake, Hills, Mountains and Coast.
- Pick up litter on your walk, then tap one button to log it. The first 5 pieces each day help your world; you can log more, they just stop adding health for that day.
- Animals move in as your world gets healthier: 24 real animals to find, each with a short fact you can read in your album.
- Rare animals ask for something special, like a long walk, a big bike ride, or a streak of healthy days.

MORE TO ENJOY
- A daily challenge that earns stars for decorations in your world.
- Litter types: hold the litter button to choose one, and see them in your Journal.
- Journal: your last two weeks of walking, cycling and litter at a glance.
- Home Screen widget with a "+ Litter" button.
- A day and night sky that follows your real time.
- Share a picture of your world.
- Gentle 8-bit sound effects you can turn off.
- Light or dark, following your iPhone's setting.

PLOGGING, MADE FRIENDLY
Plogging is picking up litter while you walk or jog. Pixel World gives that small good deed a place to show up: your world gets a little better every time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Free. No ads. No account. No in-app purchases.
- Everything stays on your iPhone. No server, no tracking, no third parties.
- You can erase everything at any time with Start over in Info.

STAY SAFE
Wear gloves or use a grabber. Never touch broken glass, needles or sharp objects. Stay away from traffic, and don't use your phone while cycling.

Cycling distance shows up if you use an Apple Watch or an app that saves rides to the Health app.

Pixel World is a game about small, steady habits. It is not a medical app and does not give health advice.

name: Caffinity
description:
Το Caffinity είναι ένα ήρεμο ημερολόγιο καφεΐνης για ανθρώπους που αγαπούν τον καφέ, το τσάι και το να νιώθουν καλά.

Κατέγραψε ένα ποτό σε δευτερόλεπτα και δες πόση καφεΐνη μπορεί να παραμένει ενεργή μέσα στην ημέρα. Το Caffinity χρησιμοποιεί μια προσωπική εκτίμηση ημιζωής με βάση την ευαισθησία σου, ώστε η καμπύλη να είναι χρήσιμη ένδειξη και όχι απόλυτος υπολογισμός.

ΤΙ ΜΠΟΡΕΙΣ ΝΑ ΚΑΝΕΙΣ

• Καταγραφή καφέ, τσαγιού, κόλας, ενεργειακών ποτών, κακάο, συμπληρωμάτων και δικών σου ποτών  
• Προβολή ημερήσιας πρόσληψης, εκτιμώμενης ενεργής καφεΐνης και καμπύλης  
• Εξατομίκευση ορίου άνεσης, συνηθισμένης ώρας ύπνου και ευαισθησίας  
• Πρακτική ώρα αποκοπής καφεΐνης για πιο ήρεμη χαλάρωση  
• Μοτίβα 7 και 30 ημερών, συνήθειες χρονικής στιγμής και ημέρες υπέρβασης  
• Δέκα πρακτικά δίγλωσσα άρθρα για καφεΐνη, ύπνο, ενυδάτωση και τελετουργία  
• Αναζήτηση, επεξεργασία, σημειώσεις, εξαγωγή JSON και γρήγορη καταγραφή  
• Επιλογή αγγλικών ή ελληνικών μέσα στην εφαρμογή

ΓΙΑΤΙ ΤΟ CAFFINITY ΕΙΝΑΙ ΔΙΑΦΟΡΕΤΙΚΟ

Το Caffinity δεν είναι ταμπλό βαθμολογίας. Δεν επιβραβεύει την περισσότερη καφεΐνη, δεν τιμωρεί ένα αργό φλιτζάνι και δεν προσποιείται ότι ένας αριθμός περιγράφει το σώμα σου. Σου δίνει μια καθαρή, απαλή εικόνα από αυτό που ήδη κάνεις, ώστε να προσαρμόζεις μόνος σου τις συνήθειές σου.

ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ

Το ημερολόγιό σου παραμένει στο iPhone σου. Το Caffinity δεν απαιτεί λογαριασμό και δεν ανεβάζει, δεν πουλά και δεν μοιράζεται τις καταγραφές σου. Οι ειδοποιήσεις είναι προαιρετικές και προγραμματίζονται τοπικά.

ΣΗΜΕΙΩΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΥΓΕΙΑ

Οι ποσότητες καφεΐνης είναι εκτιμήσεις και διαφέρουν ανάλογα με τους κόκκους, την παρασκευή, τη μερίδα, τα φάρμακα, την υγεία και τον μεταβολισμό κάθε ανθρώπου. Το Caffinity είναι εκπαιδευτικό εργαλείο παρακολούθησης, όχι ιατρική συσκευή. Αν είσαι έγκυος, αντιμετωπίζεις θέμα υγείας ή παίρνεις φάρμακα, μίλησε με επαγγελματία υγείας για την καφεΐνη.

name: Cat Tower: Kitty Defense
description:
Cats vs clockwork mice! Your cats ride a rolling wooden tower down the road while an army of wind-up mice tries to stop it. Every cat fights on its own. You choose who sits in which room, spend catnip on cat powers at the right moment, and upgrade your crew between battles.

ROLL THROUGH 6 LANDS
• 60 stages across meadows, moonlit woods, a forge, snowy peaks, a swamp and a harbour
• Rescue kittens along the road and add them to your crew
• Bosses with their own attacks, from the Drill Tank to the Rat King

BUILD YOUR CAT CREW
• 12 cats, each with its own attack and power: claws, slingshots, yarn, lightning, shields, healing and more
• Drag cats between rooms to put the right cat where the mice attack
• Level cats up with cards and coins, with new gear at levels 3, 5 and 8

UPGRADE YOUR TOWER
• Add floors and fit armour, a catnip garden, a turret or a nap room on each one
• Mount a crossbow or a fish launcher on the roof
• Unlock the Cat Tree tower

EVERY DAY
• Daily missions, a daily gift and a free chest every 4 hours
• Grow catnip in the greenhouse while you are away
• Endless mode after stage 10
• An optional Cat Pass with a free reward track every season

No ads. No energy timers. Plays offline. Your progress is backed up to your iCloud when you are signed in.

Cat Tower is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases, including random rewards (chests and card bundles). The game shows their contents and odds before you buy.

name: ChromaAudit: Palette Contrast
description:
Check the contrast relationships in an entire named palette. ChromaAudit gives designers a local desk for opaque sRGB colors, readable samples and practical foreground adjustments.

Audit a palette
Save 2–12 named colors using #RGB or #RRGGBB. Choose a 3:1, 4.5:1 or 7:1 target. Inspect every unique pair, the passing count and a failing-only filter. Pass/fail uses the full-precision result, before display rounding.

Inspect a pairing
Preview large and body text with the exact foreground and background colors. Swap their preview roles. Read WCAG 2.x checks for AA normal text, AAA normal text and AA large text or relevant non-text graphics.

Correct and keep
Request a foreground candidate by mixing toward black or white while holding the background fixed. The app chooses the qualifying candidate with the smaller RGB distance, checks the quantized result and lets you save it into the palette. If neither direction reaches the target, change the background or threshold. Export a text report for review.

Clear scope
This is a color-only calculation using WCAG 2.x relative luminance, not APCA or a full accessibility certification. It does not inspect websites, photos, screenshots, font size, semantics, focus, alpha, gradients or wide-gamut colors. RGB mixing is not a perceptually nearest-color search. Evaluate actual interface context and applicable exemptions separately.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: Clickapp: Mac Deck & Dock
description:
Turn your iPad or iPhone into a sleek, tactile wireless command deck for your Mac — free forever with a full customizable workspace, visual Mac app icons, media & emoji bar, and multi-finger touch gestures.

Clickapp connects directly to your Mac over your local Wi-Fi or USB-C network (zero cloud latency, zero subscriptions) so every tap launches apps, arranges windows, triggers keyboard shortcuts, inserts emojis, or controls audio in real time.

KEY FEATURES
• Modular 2×4 Workspace Deck: Large, crisp buttons with live running/frontmost indicators and drag-and-drop customization across spaces.
• Visual Mac App Picker: Browse all installed Mac apps with their real icons and add any app or Multi-Click macro in one tap.
• Quick Media & Emoji Floating Bar: Adjust Mac volume, mute audio, play/pause or skip tracks, and switch in one tap to quick emoji injection.
• Multi-Click Actions & Hotkeys: Combine multiple apps or custom keyboard shortcuts, Apple Shortcuts, URL bookmarks, and window tiling commands on any tile.
• iPhone Duo & Touch Gestures: Designed for iPad, iPhone, and foldable iPhone Duo screens with swipe navigation and multi-finger gesture controls.
• Light & Dark Themes: Choose between Dark Velvet and Light Lavender palettes.
• Local & Private by Design: Works directly on your own local network via Bonjour with a 4-digit pairing PIN.

FREE VS. CLICKAPP PRO (UNIVERSAL PURCHASE)
• Free Forever: 1 complete customizable workspace (8 tiles), Media & Volume bar, Emoji bar, and Touch Gestures.
• Clickapp Pro (Optional One-Time Universal Unlock): Unlocks up to 8 customizable workspaces (64 tiles) and the Live Mac Dock synced directly with your Mac — buy once and use across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with no subscriptions.

Requires the free Universal companion app Clickapp on Mac (macOS 14+), included on the Mac App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6835347266

name: Cog Roll
description:
Cog Roll is for the moment the bike is on the stand and the chain is on this cog. You write the chainring teeth, the cog teeth, the wheel diameter in inches, and the name of this gear.

This iPhone divides wheel times chainring by the cog, rounds half up to gear inches, then multiplies by 22 and divides by 7 for the rollout of one turn. The gear stays on this iPhone for you. Nothing is shared and no file is written.

There is no account, no network, no map, and no sample bike. Inches are used in every region. The rollout is arithmetic from the teeth you type. It does not tell you how fast to ride. The record is removed with the app.

name: COMTOO
description: COMTO is a tool for businesses, institutions, organizations, associations, and foundations. The tool allows for various activities such as sharing and viewing documents, sharing news, photos, and messages, posting ideas and requests, and much more. COMTO is particularly interesting for businesses and institutions with employees without a fixed workplace and off-desk workers.

name: Countera: Widget Counter
description:
Countera is a counter built for widgets and Shortcuts. Read and change your values from the Home Screen, the Shortcuts app or automations, without ever opening the app.

THREE KINDS OF ITEMS
• Counters — set the step, initial value, minimum and maximum. Values stop at the limits.
• True/False — name each state the way you like: “ON / OFF”, “Open / Closed”…
• Text — a lightweight variable or note you can set and read from Shortcuts.
Keep items in groups, reorder, duplicate, and delete with undo.

WIDGETS
Small, medium, large and Lock Screen. Show one item or a whole group. In interactive mode, tap the widget to count or flip a switch. Pick a background color per widget, including your own My Colors.

SHORTCUTS
Increase, decrease, reset and get a counter; set, toggle and get a true/false; set, append and get a text. Every action runs without opening the app and passes its result on. “Show in Dynamic Island” flashes any text for a few seconds.

STATISTICS
Turn on recording for a counter to see changes per hour, day, week and month, and how its value moved.

PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device. No account, no network, no ads, no tracking.

name: D'Belle Hair Studio
description:
Book your next appointment with D'Belle Hair Studio in a few taps.

With the D'Belle Hair Studio app you can:
- See every service with its price and duration
- Pick a time that suits you and book instantly
- Get a reminder before your appointment
- Cancel or rebook when your plans change
- Keep all your appointments in one place

Haircuts and styling, balayage and color, color correction, extensions and hair treatments. Install the app and book your next visit today.

name: Dartboard: Darts Scorekeeper
description:
Score cricket, cutthroat, 501 and 301 by tapping a real dartboard where each dart landed. Pay once: no ads, no account, no subscription.

Run the whole night on one phone, or give everyone a phone. A room connects phones over wifi or Bluetooth, so it works in a bar, a garage, or with phones on cellular.

Hold your finger on the board for a magnifier with a crosshair, so even a double lands where you aimed.

GAMES
• Cricket: close 15 through 20 and the bull. Marks turn into points on the same dart. Numbers that every player has closed are marked dead, so you can see what is still worth throwing at.
• Cutthroat: the same board with scoring inverted. Points go to everyone who has not closed, and the lowest score wins.
• 501 and 301: double out is on by default, and you can switch it off.
• Bull bonus: a house rule where the bull still scores and still closes, but is not a number you must close to win.

CHECKOUT SUGGESTIONS
In 501 and 301, a bar under the thrower shows a finish route, for example "16 — D8".

PRACTICE GAMES
• Around the clock: the 1, then the 2, all the way to the bull.
• Count-up: eight rounds, everything scores, nothing busts.
• Shanghai: the round is the target. A single, a double and a triple in one round wins.
• Bob's 27: start on 27 and work through the doubles. A hit adds double the number. Miss all three and it comes off.

ENTERING DARTS
• Tap the board where the dart landed, or switch to the number pad.
• Undo takes back the last dart, and steps back into the last turn after End turn.
• Big turns get a call-out: ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY, 140 PLUS, TON, WHITE HORSE, NINE MARKS.

A PHONE EACH
• One phone opens a room on New match. The others join over wifi or Bluetooth, or type the join code.
• No shared wifi needed. Bluetooth is for bars, garages and phones on cellular.
• Any phone can switch to a full-screen scoreboard to prop up beside the board.
• If a phone in the room dies, its players pass back to the host and the match carries on.
• Play again: after a match, the same players rematch in the same room, with seats rotated.

THE RECORD
Wins, MPR, three-dart average, best checkout, head-to-head and past nights, kept on your phone. Finished matches pass between the phones in a room, so your record includes games you played on someone else's phone. Practice games keep your best.

PRIVACY
No account. No ads. No analytics. No data collected. Buy it once and it is yours.

Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Daybit: Day Counter
description:
Daybit — the most beautiful way to count the days that matter.

The day you met, birthdays, trips, a big exam. Pick one date and it becomes a card.

■ Every milestone, one swipe away
Slide the rail beside the card to see 100 days, 1 year, and every anniversary at a glance.

■ Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
Small, medium and large widgets plus Lock Screen widgets. See the days left without opening the app.

■ Countdown to the second
As the day gets close, count down in hours, minutes and seconds. Live Activities on the Lock Screen, too.

■ Lunar dates and yearly repeats
Lunar birthdays are worked out every year for you. Get a reminder days before.

■ Memories for each day
Keep notes and photos for every day, and make photo stories.

■ To-dos
Trip packing lists, gift ideas — keep track of what to do before the day.

■ Make it yours
Gradient and illustrated themes, or your own photo.

No ads, no account needed. Your memories stay on your device.

Daybit Plus
- Up to 3 cards are free.
- Plus removes the card limit.
- Choose a one-time Lifetime purchase or an Annual subscription.
- The annual subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://ultra-street-e59.notion.site/Daybit-4131d3f8dc50818f9f40ca1cbd7fea11

name: DeckArchive
description:
DeckArchive is the companion for the collector who buys playing cards at a stall, in a field, with no signal and no reference books to hand. It turns the three or four marks you can actually see on a deck — the back, the ace of spades, a joker, a duty stamp — into a short list of houses and a decade, and it says plainly what still does not fit together.

The reference material is drawn from The World of Playing Cards, the collaborative archive of playing cards and their makers, distilled into the plates, stamps and working dates that matter at the moment of a purchase. A reading never pretends to be a certificate: every one carries a confidence figure and a note on what remains uncertain, because a made-up deck and an unusual printing can look very much alike on a trestle table.

Alongside the reading there is a shelf for your own decks, holding what you paid, what is missing and the state of the box, so that the shape of a collection becomes visible over time. Everything needed at a market is stored on the phone, and nothing about your collection leaves it.

name: Dotto - Pixel Art for Kids
description:
A pixel art app for kids: look at the example and paint the squares to copy it.

■ Look, count and match
・The example is always on screen. Pick a color and only that color stays bright in the example
・The row and column you are painting light up on the example
・The number under each color shows how many squares of that color are left. When they're all done, it turns into a check mark
・"Check" makes the squares painted in a different color blink
・Feeling stuck? Turn on "Hints" to show the example's colors faintly

■ Get a star for "Perfect!"
・Confetti the moment your picture matches the example
・Gold star without Hints, silver star with Hints
・Every picture goes into your album, and you can paint the same example again and again
・"Free draw" gives you a blank grid

■ 48 examples in 5 levels
・Easy 8x8 (12): heart, strawberry, star, fish, chick and more
・Medium 12x12 (12): cat, dog, rocket, car, watermelon and more
・Hard 16x16 (12): penguin, rainbow, dinosaur, train and more
・Very hard 24x24 (6): lion, owl, goldfish and more
・Master 32x32 (6): Mt. Fuji, castle, outer space and more
・Zoom in with two fingers to paint detailed pictures

■ For parents
・No ads, no in-app purchases, no links out of the app
・No data is collected or sent. Pictures are stored only on your device
・Saving to Photos is behind a parent check (a math question)
・Designed so a resting palm doesn't paint. Works with iPad and Apple Pencil

name: Drapsy
description:
Drapsy is a pastel boutique for your own clothes, hosted by a little coat hanger with a bow.

YOUR CLOSET, NO PHOTOS NEEDED
Add each piece in seconds: pick a cartoon garment (tees, shirts, trousers, skirts, dresses, jackets, shoes, bags and hats), a colour and a season. Mark favourites, add occasions, count how often you wear it and filter by category.

LAUNDRY DAY
Put pieces in the laundry and Drapsy leaves them out of suggestions. Washed and dried? Tap "Done!" to put them all back.

DRESS THE MANNEQUIN
Tap + and "Build an outfit" to mix tops, bottoms, dresses, layers, shoes and extras on a paper-doll mannequin. Name the look, pick an occasion and save it.

SURPRISE ME!
Can't decide? "Surprise me!" picks a random look from your clean clothes. Shuffle until you love it, then save it.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Drop a saved look on each of the next seven days. Tap "Wear today" to log an outfit, and switch on an optional 7:30 morning reminder.

WISHLIST
Keep a list of dream pieces with price and notes, see how many things you already own that they go with, and move a wish into your closet when you buy it.

STYLE KIT
• Weather: set the temperature and tap "Dress me!" for a look from your closet
• Sizes: women's, men's and shoe size charts (US, UK, EU)
• Care: what the laundry symbols on a care label mean

CLOSET STATS
See how many pieces you have per category, your closet value, cost per wear, most worn and never worn pieces.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline
• Your closet, looks, plans and wishlist are stored only on your iPhone
• No camera or photo access, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Account optional: tap "Just looking", or sign in with Google
• Erase your data or de

name: Duetag: Car Maintenance Log
description:
Duetag is a maintenance schedule and service log for your car that works out when each job will actually fall due. Tell it how often something needs doing, by distance, by time or both, and it projects the date from how far you really drive, for example "Oil change due in ~3 weeks (at 45,000 mi)".

HOW THE DUE DATES WORK
Every odometer number you enter counts: quick readings, fill-ups and service records. Duetag fits your average driving per day from the last year of entries and projects when each item reaches its mileage, then picks whichever limit comes first, the distance or the calendar. Until you have a week of readings it uses the weekly distance you give it. A reading lower than an earlier one, or one that would mean an impossible distance per day (usually an extra digit), is flagged before it can throw the dates off.

REMINDERS
Local notifications a few days before each projected due date, at the hour you choose. Overdue items notify once, not every day.

STARTER SCHEDULE
Oil and filter, tire rotation, brake check, engine and cabin air filters, coolant, battery test, wiper blades and inspection or registration, with general starting intervals. These are guidance only, not your vehicle maker's schedule. Check your owner's manual and edit them; you can add your own items too.

SERVICE AND REPAIR LOG
A month-by-month timeline of services, repairs, fill-ups, expenses and odometer readings, each with cost, shop, notes and an optional receipt photo from the camera or your library.

FUEL ECONOMY
MPG, L/100 km or km/L, measured from one full tank to the next. Partial fills are added to the next full tank, and a fill you forgot to log can be marked so it doesn't skew the average. Also cost per mile or kilometre and price per gallon or litre.

COSTS
Spending this year, over 12 months or all time, by category and by month, for one vehicle or all of them, in your local currency.

VIN DECODE AND RECALLS (US ONLY)
Tap to decode a VIN or check recalls using the public data of the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). This covers vehicles sold in the United States only. The recall list is for the make, model and year, so check your own VIN with NHTSA or a dealer to confirm whether your vehicle is affected. Nothing is sent until you tap, and then only the VIN, or the year, make and model, goes directly to NHTSA. Duetag is not affiliated with NHTSA.

EXPORT
A vehicle history PDF built from your own entries, handy when you sell the car, and a CSV of every entry for a spreadsheet, both through the share sheet.

UNITS AND VEHICLES
Miles or kilometres, US gallons or litres, and any of the three economy units. Keep separate schedules and logs for several vehicles.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no analytics. Everything you enter stays on your iPhone.

name: Escoba Internacional
description:
Escoba Internacional brings the classic Spanish-deck card game to your iPhone and iPad. Known as escoba, escova or scopa a 15, it's a family favourite from Buenos Aires to São Paulo to Naples.

Play one card each turn. If it adds up to exactly 15 with cards on the table, sweep them up. Clear the whole table and you score an escoba!

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer at Easy, Medium or Hard
• 2 or 3 players, or 2 vs 2 with a partner across the table
• Online with friends and family through Game Center: invite them from Messages, and bots fill any empty seats
• Play-any-time games that wait for each player's turn
• A monthly championship with a knockout bracket

FOUR LANGUAGES
• English, Español, Português and Italiano, switchable any time in Settings

CLASSIC RULES
• 40-card Spanish deck: Oros, Copas, Espadas and Bastos
• Points for most cards, most Oros, the 7 of Oros, the sevens, and every escoba
• Adjustable house rules: play to 15, 21 or 30, setenta or most sevens, mandatory capture, opening-table escobas and an optional turn timer

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Tap or swipe cards to play them
• Easy mode shows the running sum and which cards make 15
• Hold an opponent to see the cards they threw; swipe down to see what they last collected
• Leaderboards, avatars and a cheerful sweeping dog named Valentino

No ads, no accounts, no purchases. Just make fifteen and sweep the table.

name: Exclusivo Cutz
description:
Reserva tu próximo corte en Exclusivo Cutz en pocos toques.

Con la app Exclusivo Cutz puedes:
- Ver todos los servicios con su precio y duración
- Elegir la hora que te convenga y reservar al instante
- Recibir un recordatorio antes de tu cita
- Cancelar o cambiar tu cita cuando cambien tus planes
- Tener todas tus citas en un solo lugar

Cortes de cabello para adultos y niños, barba y corte con barba. Descarga la app y reserva tu próxima visita hoy.

name: Fastwave App: Intermittent
description:
Fastwave is a fasting timer and tracker built to do the job well. Pick a plan, tap start, and Fastwave times your fast, alerts you when you reach your goal, counts down your eating window and saves every fast to your journal. No account, no ads, and it works offline.

FASTING TIMER
• Live progress ring with time fasted, time left and the exact time you'll reach your goal
• Start now, or set the time you actually started
• Keeps counting when the app is closed or your phone restarts
• Correct start and end times at any time

PLANS FOR EVERY SCHEDULE
• 12:12, 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD (23:1), 24 and 36 hours
• Custom fasts from 8 to 72 hours
• Answer three quick questions to get a suggested starting plan
• Switch plans anytime, even in the middle of a fast

EATING WINDOW
• Countdown to the end of your eating window after every fast
• Optional reminder when the window closes

REMINDERS THAT MATTER
• When you reach your goal
• One hour before your goal
• When your eating window ends

FAST JOURNAL & STATS
• Every fast saved automatically, with a monthly calendar
• Add fasts you forgot to log, and edit or delete any entry
• Current and best streak, total fasts, hours fasted, average length and goal success rate
• Chart of hours fasted over the last 7 days
• Quick check-ins during a fast, with a chart for each one
• Finish each fast with a mood and a short note

BADGES
• Ten badges for streaks, milestones and longer fasts
• Progress shown for every badge you haven't earned yet

WEIGHT TRACKER
• Log your weight in kg or lb
• Trend chart and your change over the last 30 days

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking
• Everything is stored on your iPhone and works without internet
• Export all your data to CSV, or delete it in one tap

Fastwave is free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Fastwave does not provide medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting intermittent fasting, especially if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, have diabetes or another medical condition, take medication, or have a history of disordered eating.

name: FBM マリガンシミュレーター - 初手の確率計算
description:
マリガンシミュレーターは、デッキ構築型のカードゲームで「初手に目的のカードが来る確率」をすぐに確かめられるアプリです。デッキを作るときの「このカード、何枚入れれば初手に来る？」に答えます。

■ 初手7枚シミュレート
デッキ枚数・目的のカードの枚数・インクレスの枚数を入れるだけで、先攻（7枚）・後攻（8枚）それぞれで目的のカードを1枚以上引ける確率と、インクレスを何枚引くかの確率がわかります。

■ マリガンシミュレート
初手を引いたあとの残りデッキで、1枚〜8枚引き直したときの確率を一覧で表示します。何枚戻すかを決める目安に。

■ 2種類のカードの組み合わせ
「カード A とカード B を両方引く確率」「どちらか1枚でも引く確率」も計算できます。コンボのパーツ選びに。

■ 数字を変えるとすぐ反映
＋／− のボタン（長押しで連続）や数字の入力で、結果がその場で変わります。計算ボタンはありません。

■ 条件を保存・呼び出し
よく使うデッキの条件に名前をつけて保存し、いつでも呼び出せます。前回入れた数字も覚えています。

■ 結果を画像で共有
結果を1枚の画像にして、写真に保存したり X や LINE で共有したりできます。

■ 計算について
確率は超幾何分布（引いたカードを戻さない計算）で求めています。表示は確率の目安で、ゲームの公式ツールではありません。

name: FlickPioneer
description:
FlickPioneer is a fast, portrait-ready flick shooter built for quick sessions on iPhone. Stand in a neon festival lane, line up your aim, and launch cards or darts at oncoming cartoon monsters before they rush you down.

Choose your weapon and master two distinct throws: spinning playing cards for stylish mid-range flicks, and sharp darts for precise strikes. Switch loadouts mid-run, grab ammo pickups on the track, and keep your combo alive as the pace climbs.

Every run is about timing and accuracy. Track your score and high score, recover from empty-ammo stun, pause when you need a breath, and jump back in with clear on-screen controls—including a draggable fire button made for one-handed play.

Play offline with polished home, weapons, how-to, settings, and records screens. No account required—just flick, survive longer, and chase a new personal best every night under the lantern lights.

name: Floriva:Triple Merge
description:
Welcome to Floriva: Triple Merge, a fresh and captivating twist on classic match-3 and merge puzzle games!

Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world of blooming flowers and wooden tiles. The rules are simple, but the challenge is real: Tap and collect tiles from the board. When you collect 3 identical tiles, they merge into a higher-level tile (for example, three "1"s merge into a "2"). Your ultimate goal is to collect the required tiles shown at the top of the screen to clear the level. But be careful—you must manage your limited tray space at the bottom!

Ready to break the limits of classic puzzle games? Download Floriva: Triple Merge now and start blooming!

name: Flowspock
description:
Flowspock es la gestión ágil para equipos de personas y agentes de IA, ahora en tu iPhone y tu iPad.

Lleva el trabajo de tu equipo contigo: revisa lo que tienes para hoy, responde a lo que te piden y mueve las tareas sin abrir el ordenador.

MI TRABAJO
• Lo que tienes para hoy, lo vencido y lo que viene, ordenado por fecha.
• Cronómetro de tiempo con Live Activity en la pantalla de bloqueo y en la Dynamic Island.
• Widgets de inicio y de pantalla de bloqueo con tus tareas del día.

BANDEJA
• Menciones, asignaciones, revisiones y aprobaciones en un solo lugar.
• Responde, marca como hecha, pospone o archiva desde la propia notificación.
• Recordatorios en cada tarea, sincronizados con la web.

PROYECTOS
• Backlog, tablero, lista y calendario de cada proyecto, en Scrum o Kanban.
• Crea tareas en una línea, con plantillas, prioridad, responsables y fechas.
• Comentarios con markdown, adjuntos y fotos desde la cámara.

SPOCKY AI Y AGENTES
• Spocky AI mejora descripciones, convierte criterios en checklist, divide en subtareas y resume hilos largos.
• Sigue en vivo a los agentes que trabajan en tus tareas.

PARA EQUIPOS
• Varios workspaces con una sola cuenta, y una bandeja y un «Mi trabajo» que los reúnen.
• Los administradores ven la suscripción, los asientos y los miembros, e invitan a su equipo.
• Modo claro y oscuro, paletas de color y compatible con iPad.

Flowspock es un servicio para empresas: necesitas una cuenta de Flowspock. Puedes crear una gratis desde la app y empezar con 14 días de prueba.

Términos de uso: https://flowspock.com/terminos/
Privacidad: https://flowspock.com/privacidad/

name: Focentra
description:
Focentra is an immersive focus studio. There are no tab bars and no menus — the timer ring is the screen, floating in a slowly drifting atmosphere of light. Everything else is one gesture away.

ONE RING, NO CLUTTER
• Swipe up for Insights, left for Presets, right for History.
• Hold the ring for quick settings.
• While the timer is idle, drag around the ring to dial any length from 1 to 180 minutes.
• Thin glowing hints show the way when you're idle and fade away while you focus. With VoiceOver, they become regular buttons.

FOCUS YOUR WAY
• Single focus blocks with a label and tags ("what are you focusing on?").
• Pomodoro rhythms: focus, short break, long break and any number of rounds.
• Breaks can start automatically, and so can the next focus round.
• The timer runs on the clock, not on the screen: lock your phone, switch apps or relaunch, and it picks up exactly where it should, logging any rounds that finished while you were away.
• Optional background alerts when a phase ends, an optional gentle system chime, haptics and keep-screen-awake.
• +5 minutes, pause, skip a break, or end early. Sessions ended early are logged honestly.

ATMOSPHERES
Five full-screen animated themes: Aurora, Ember, Tide, Dusk and the bright Paper. Each one sets its own light or dark appearance. The animation is light on the battery and stops when Reduce Motion is on.

INSIGHTS
• A daily goal ring and your current streak.
• 7- and 30-day bar charts with your goal line.
• A 24-hour dial showing when you focus best.
• A weekly summary: total time, change from last week, completion rate, best day, average session and what you spent the most time on.
• Twelve achievements, from "First light" to "Fifty hours".

HISTORY & PRESETS
• Every session grouped by day, with search, filters (completed, ended early, tags), notes and tags. Edit or delete any entry, or log a past session by hand.
• Save presets you use often, shown in a swipeable carousel. Create, edit, duplicate, reorder and delete them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up and no login. Ever.
• Works fully offline. Your data lives on your iPhone.
• Optional cloud backup and sync uses an anonymous identifier. You can turn it off or delete the cloud copy at any time.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Export everything as JSON, or your sessions as CSV.

No account needed. A daily reminder can nudge you to start, and a 45-session sample history lets you explore every screen before you begin.

name: Found Footage · Y2K Camcorder
description:
Your day, as found footage.

Film 60 seconds of your day. At 6 PM, a tape is found: your last 24 hours, cut like footage someone dug out of a box. Post it as a TikTok or a Reel, so people find it.

MADE FOR TIKTOK AND REELS, EVERY DAY
• One tap saves the tape, copies a caption and opens TikTok or Instagram. A third button sends it to your friends.
• Vertical, a minute or less: the format TikTok and Reels are made for. Short enough to watch to the end.
• It opens on "THIS TAPE WAS FOUND" and the date. People know what they are looking at in one second.
• A new tape every day means something to post every day.
• Every tape ends on the same card, so the people who watch it can make their own.

A REAL CAMCORDER LOOK
• Y2K digital video: interlaced lines, blown highlights, colour bleed, noise in the dark.
• The date, the time and a draining battery, burned into the picture.
• Night vision, a hard light for parties, and sideways filming.
• The look is applied live. What you see is what goes on the tape.

THE RULES
• 60 seconds of battery per tape.
• 10 seconds per shot, at most.
• One redo per shot.
• No import. No editing.
• At 6 PM the tape is found and the battery recharges.

YOUR TAPES, ON A SHELF
Every tape goes on a shelf of VHS cassettes, labelled by date. Take one out and play it again.

FOUND FOOTAGE PRO
One payment. No subscription.
• 10 redos per shot
• Every tape stays on the shelf, not only the last 7 days
• Write a name on your tapes: it shows at the start of the film
• Choose the hour your tape is found

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server of ours. Your videos stay on your phone until you choose to post them.

name: FretRoute: Note Practice
description:
Practice fretboard note recall in a range you choose. FretRoute is an offline, tap-based trainer for fretted-string players who want deliberate repetition, custom tunings and saved progress.

Your instrument and range
Choose standard guitar, drop D, four- or five-string bass, re-entrant ukulele or mandolin courses. Or enter 2–8 open-string MIDI notes. C4=60. Select frets within 0–24, left-handed direction and sharp or flat names. The first entered string appears at the bottom. Short fifth-string banjo geometry is not supported.

Two focused drills
Name the note at a marked string/fret position, or find any visible position matching a requested pitch class. Equivalent octaves count in find mode. Choose 4–40 questions; shuffled passes spread practice across the selected positions. Nothing automatically expands your range.

Continue and revisit
The first answer is saved immediately, with feedback before you advance. Return to a run after closing the app. Focus the next run on previous mistakes in the same mode; if there are no mistakes, use the full selected board. Keep first-attempt accuracy and export a progress report. Each setup retains up to 100 runs.

Explore the board
Inspect a fully labeled fretboard and chromatic, major or natural-minor pitch references. Scroll wide ranges horizontally. Create a new setup when changing tuning or range after practice, preserving the meaning of old answers.

Scope
This trains note recall, not live playing accuracy. No microphone, audio playback, tuner, metronome, chord fingering, tablature or performance assessment.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: gaimalltr
description: Seamkure is a sizing and fit companion for buying clothes and shoes. It includes a size converter, a brand size predictor, a fitting-room checklist, an ease diagram for garment measurements and a tracker for return windows. A brand offsets screen shows which makers run small or large for you, based on your own fittings.

name: GliderVision
description:
GliderVision is a fun app for flying a glider with the Vision Pro. Each flight begins in the air, and the pilot controls the flight path with a stick and spoilers using standard hand gestures. The app also has DEMO scenarios that fly themselves. At any point during a demo, the user can take over and land.

The app does not simulate the glider in tow.

name: GLive HUNT — 3D-карты глубин
description:
GLive HUNT — приложение для рыбалки, охоты и отдыха на воде с объёмными 3D-картами дна водохранилищ, своими картами MBTiles и GenesisLive, точками, треками и маршрутами. Всё работает без интернета.

3D-водоёмы
Водохранилище целиком в объёме: русло, бровки, свалы, ямы, косы и отмели, вокруг — снимок местности. Наклоняйте, вращайте, приближайте до отдельной бровки. Подписи глубин, палитра глубин, отвес с глубиной под лодкой. Усиление рельефа ×12, ×20 или ×40 и тени рельефа — ямы и свалы читаются с первого взгляда.
В каталоге: Рыбинское, о. Онежское, о. Ладожское, р. Москва, Горьковское, Чебоксарское, Нижнекамское, Камское, Воткинское, Волгоградское, Угличское, Иваньковское, Обское, Вазузское, Истринское, Яузское, Можайское, Матырское, Веселовское, Пестовское, Учинское, Белоярское, р. Волга (Рыбинск – Юрьевец), р. Волга (Новочебоксарск – Камское Устье), р. Кама (Елабуга – Шуран), р. Ока, Финский залив, озёра Удомля, Песьво, Волго, Вельё, Езерище, карьер Кудиновский — и каталог пополняется. Водоём скачивается один раз и хранится на телефоне в защищённом виде.

Три режима карты
• 3D-водоём — объёмная модель дна;
• 3D-рельеф — карта на рельефе местности;
• 2D-карта — обычная плоская карта.
Подложки: спутник, OpenStreetMap, топографическая, подписи вкл./выкл.

Свои карты MBTiles
Загружайте свои карты в формате MBTiles: спутник высокого разрешения, карты глубин, топографические, охотничьи. Они ложатся поверх подложки — в 2D и на 3D-рельеф, до 3 карт одновременно, без интернета. MBTiles с рельефом дна показываются объёмно, с изобатами.

Карты из GenesisLive (Lowrance)
Загрузите архив GenesisLive (ZIP, RAR, 7z) — карта глубин построится прямо на телефоне, без компьютера и интернета: заливка глубин с рельефом дна, изобаты, подписи. Каждое пятно съёмки — отдельный участок с переходом к нему. Карту можно переименовать.

Точки: 266 иконок в 8 группах
Рыбалка, навигация на воде, охота, туризм и походы, причалы и сервис, сплавы, грибы и растения, общие. Поиск, фильтры по группам, заметки и теги, расстояние до точки, скрытие с карты. Точки видны прямо на 3D-рельефе дна.

Импорт и экспорт
GPX, KML, GeoJSON и USR (Lowrance). При импорте иконка подбирается по названию точки («коряга», «бровка», «щука»…), дубли склеиваются, повторы пропускаются. Экспорт всех или выбранных точек, маршрутов и треков.

Маршруты
Маршрут А → Б по прямой или в 3D-водоёме — по глубинам: задайте диапазон, и путь пройдёт в обход мелей и островов. Ведение по маршруту с оставшимся расстоянием, свой цвет каждого маршрута, список маршрутов.

Треки
Запись GPS-трека с паузой, скорость и высота в каждой точке, окраска трека по скорости, экспорт в GPX.

Навигация на воде
• режим движения: карта на весь экран, крупно скорость и курс;
• компас с кольцами дальности, азимут и пеленг на точку;
• линейка и ломаная линейка;
• север вверх или по курсу;
• на карте — 3D-лодка или человек;
• точность GPS, скорость, высота, копирование координат.

Подписка на 3D-водоёмы
Каждый водоём — на 1, 3, 6, 12 или 24 месяца, без автопродления, чем дольше — тем выгоднее. Напоминание за неделю до конца срока. Свои карты MBTiles и GenesisLive, точки, треки и маршруты — бесплатно.

Приложение не является навигационной системой. Данные глубин и высот носят ознакомительный характер.
Разработчик и правообладатель — Попов Алексей Андреевич. Документы: glive.pro/legal

name: GNEMA
description:
GNEMAは、白黒映画のワンシーンのような写真を楽しむモノクロカメラです。

SILVER・HARD・FADEの3つの仕上げと粒子量をダイヤルで調整。絞りによる周辺ぼかしや、28・35・50mm相当の画角も切り替えられます。「おすすめ」では映像の明るさと明暗差に合わせた3案から選べます。

縦向き・横向きの撮影に対応し、縦ロック中も端末の傾きでレイアウトが切り替わります。グリッドと中央のガイドは表示を切り替えられます。

写真はアプリ内に保存。リワード広告の視聴完了後、その写真を端末の写真ライブラリへ保存できます。アカウント登録は不要で、写真は端末内で処理されます。

・仕上げ、絞り表現、画角、露出、粒子量を調整
・写真一覧とスワイプでの写真閲覧
・撮影設定の記録と確認
・写真の個別削除、複数選択削除

映像フレームを現像し、長辺最大1440pxのJPEGとして保存します。絞りは周辺ぼかしによるシミュレーション、画角はデジタルクロップです。RAW撮影には対応していません。

name: Hanafuda Koi-Koi
description:
Play Koi-Koi, the classic Japanese hanafuda card game.

No video ads interrupting your matches — just a small banner at the bottom of the screen.

FEATURES
- 6-round matches against the CPU under standard Koi-Koi rules: build a yaku, then decide — call "koi-koi" or stop with "agari"
- Matches save automatically and can be resumed anytime
- Card faces based on an authentic 1910 illustrated plate, with an encyclopedia of all 48 cards
- Win matches to earn seasonal decorations (47 in total) for your tokonoma alcove, and unlock 20 medals
- Records screen with matches, win rate, and play time
- Japanese / English interface
- Portrait and landscape layouts
- Works offline (an internet connection is needed only for ads)
- All game data stays on your device

This app does not involve real-money gambling. Points in the game have no monetary value.

name: Hugo Ace Barber Shop
description:
Hugo Ace brings your barbershop experience to your phone. Explore the services and team at Hugo Ace Barber Shop in Jackson Heights, New York, and plan your next visit with ease.

BOOK YOUR VISIT
Browse services, choose your barber, check available appointment times, and book a visit that fits your schedule.

MANAGE YOUR APPOINTMENTS
Keep upcoming appointments in one place and manage or cancel your reservation from the app.

HUGO ACE CLUB
Access your loyalty profile, view your rewards, and share your referral with friends.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR CHOICE
Manage your account details and access account deletion from My Profile. Browse services and meet the team as a guest; sign in to book appointments and use account features.

The app is available in English and Spanish. All barbering services take place at our physical shop.

Visit us: 8106 Roosevelt Ave, Suite 204, Jackson Heights, NY.
Support: https://hugoacebarbershopnyc.com/support.html
Privacy: https://hugoacebarbershopnyc.com/privacy.html

name: IdentArchive
description:
IdentArchive is a companion to TVARK, the online museum of British television presentation. It is made for people who remember a channel by the way it announced itself: the globe that turned before the news, the stripe of colour that meant the adverts were over, the test card that waited patiently until programmes began again.

The app is built around the way television actually changed. Choose a channel and its branding history opens as a timeline, era by era, with the years each look was on air, the design team behind it and the story of why it was replaced. Every period keeps the clips that survived, so the same channel can be watched in the analogue age and again in the digital one, seconds apart.

Alongside the archive there is a private side. Any clip can be kept in a personal reel, and you can record the year you first saw it and a line about where you were. Sorted by that year, the reel becomes a small viewing history of its own, a record of when a logo first meant something to you.

Learning mode takes an era apart and shows what a three second ident is actually made of: the lettering, the palette read from the surviving frame, the movement that assembles the logo and the way it sits inside the broadcast raster. It is written for design students and for anyone who has ever wondered why a piece of television stays in the memory.

The off-air collection keeps the other end of the schedule: test cards, closedowns and continuity, so the night the television went quiet is documented too. All material is presented from the public archive at tvark.org, with the archive's own research and captions, for study and enjoyment.

name: Ingrediqa
description:
Ingrediqa turns your kitchen into a food lab. No account needed — open it and start exploring. Eighty everyday ingredients are laid out like a periodic table — each one an "element" tile with its own symbol, index number and energy per 100 g — so you can see at a glance what's in the food you cook with.

EXPLORE THE TABLE
• 80 common ingredients across ten groups: fruits, vegetables, grains, proteins, dairy, nuts & seeds, oils, sweeteners, herbs & spices and drinks.
• Search by name or symbol, filter by category, sort by energy, protein or fibre.
• Approximate per-100 g reference values for energy, protein, carbohydrates, sugars, fibre, fat, saturates and sodium.

POUR ANY PORTION
• Drag the liquid in the portion beaker to set grams — the energy ring and nutrient bars update as you pour.
• Quick portion buttons, a precise gram field and serving sizes for your own foods.

READ NUTRITION LABELS ON YOUR IPHONE
• Photograph a nutrition panel or pick a photo. Apple's on-device text recognition reads energy, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, sodium or salt and the serving size.
• See the recognised text, correct any value, and save it as your own custom food. Per-serving labels are converted to per 100 g automatically.
• No pack at hand? Try the built-in sample labels.

KEEP A SIMPLE FOOD JOURNAL
• Log foods by meal with grams, time and a note; edit or delete any entry.
• Daily totals ring against your own energy goal, protein progress and macro breakdown.
• 7- and 30-day history charts for any nutrient, with averages and your biggest sources.

COMPARE, SAVE, NOTE
• Compare two or three ingredients side by side, per 100 g or per portion.
• Star favourites to your shelf and keep lab notes on any ingredient.

OFFLINE FIRST, PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything works without a connection. Your data is stored on your iPhone.
• Optional private cloud backup keeps a copy under an anonymous identifier — no login, no account, no sign-up. Turn it off or delete the backup any time in Settings.
• Export a full JSON backup or your journal as CSV.
• No ads and no tracking.

Light and dark appearance, haptics, an optional daily journal reminder, and kcal or kJ.

Nutrition values are approximate reference values, not medical advice.

name: Jaén Encarga
description:
Jaén Encarga reúne en una app los comercios de barrio de Jaén: panaderías, pastelerías, comida para llevar, tiendas, peluquerías, clínicas, mascotas, talleres y servicios. Encarga lo que quieras para recogerlo o que te lo lleven, o reserva tu cita, sin llamadas ni esperas.

ENCARGA
• Catálogo de cada comercio con sus productos y precios, ordenado por secciones.
• Busca un comercio o un producto y filtra por categorías.
• Carrito con el total al momento, pedido mínimo y gastos de envío.
• Elige recogida en tienda o envío a domicilio y el día y la hora.

RESERVA
• Elige el servicio, el día en el calendario y una hora libre.
• Las horas pasadas u ocupadas no se pueden elegir.

MIS PEDIDOS
• Historial de encargos y reservas guardado en tu iPhone, con su código para enseñarlo en el comercio.
• Anula un encargo o una cita desde la propia app.

TU COMERCIO
• ¿Tienes un comercio en Jaén? Mira cómo aparecer en Jaén Encarga y escríbenos por WhatsApp.

Versión de demostración: los comercios que aparecen son ficticios, no se cobra nada y ningún comercio real recibe los pedidos. Jaén Encarga es un servicio de Noir Lab (Jaén).

name: Jarstep
description:
Jarstep turns every savings goal into a glass jar on a shelf. A weekend in Lisbon, a new bike, a rainy-day cushion: give each one a name, a target and, if you like, a date. Every time you set money aside, drop it into the jar and watch the level rise.

MAKE A JAR FOR EACH GOAL
Name it, set the target in your own currency, pick a deadline (3 months, 6 months, a year or any day on the calendar) and choose a jar colour. While you type, Jarstep shows what that goal will take per week and per month.

DEPOSITS AND WITHDRAWALS
Log each move with an amount, an optional note and the day it happened. Took something out for tickets? Record a withdrawal and the jar drains to match. Edit or remove any move later; Jarstep never lets a jar go below zero.

LITTLE MOMENTS AT 25, 50, 75 AND 100%
Every milestone gets a small celebration with a bright glass ping. When a jar is full, the lid pops off, and you can move it to the back shelf or keep it in view.

A PLAN THAT DOES THE MATHS
The Plan shows every jar side by side: time left, how much is needed per week or per month, whether you are ahead, on pace or behind, and the combined amount that keeps all your dated jars on time. Jars without a deadline show your recent pace and roughly when they will fill.

A HISTORY YOU CAN TRUST
History lists every deposit and withdrawal by month, with the running balance after each one. Filter by jar to see a single goal's story.

YOUR SHELF, YOUR WAY
Choose your currency, switch between three shelf themes (Linen Mint, Midnight Jar and Peach Shelf), and turn sounds or haptics on or off.

NO BANK CONNECTION
Jarstep never connects to a bank and never moves money. You record your own moves by hand, so it works with cash tins, savings accounts or envelopes alike.

ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Start saving as a guest in one tap. Create an account with email and password whenever you like, and guests can save their jars to an account later from the Pantry. Your jars sync through your private account and still work offline. You can delete your account and all of its data at any time from Pantry > Delete account.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your jars are visible only to you.

name: K-talk: Korea Trip Planner
description:
K-talk is a travel app for visitors to Korea. Answer five short questions and it builds a day-by-day plan with real places, meal stops and travel between cities. Everything is available in English, Korean, Japanese and Traditional Chinese.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Trip planner
Choose where you are going, your dates and airports, how many people, what you like and your pace. K-talk builds a plan that groups nearby places into the same day, adds lunch and dinner stops near where you will be, and keeps your first and last day realistic around your flight. You can choose public transport or a rental car.

• 48,000+ places across Korea
