Sights, restaurants, stays, shopping and festivals in every region, with photos, addresses in Korean that you can copy for a taxi driver, phone numbers and a link to Google Maps. Allow location to see what is closest to you.

• City-to-city transport, compared
Trains, express buses, intercity buses and domestic flights between 30 areas, listed from the lowest fare, with travel time, first and last departure and how many run each day. Fares and timetables are official figures published by Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (TAGO).

• Live stay and rental-car prices
See live prices for stays and rental cars for your dates, then book on the partner's site.

• SIM and beauty
Reference prices and booking links for eSIM and airport-pickup SIM cards, and personal color, hair and makeup and hanbok experiences. Olive Young tax-refund stores across Korea are listed too.

• Ask in your language
Ask the AI helper how to get somewhere, what to order or what to pack. Your question is sent to our AI provider to create the answer.

• Tickets
Keep screenshots of your QR codes and barcodes in one place. They stay on your phone only.

GOOD TO KNOW

• Travel times inside a plan are estimates based on straight-line distance. Opening hours and closing days can change, so please check important details before you go.
• Prices shown are for reference and may differ from the booking site's final price.
• K-talk does not sell tickets, rooms or transport. Booking links open the partner's website in your browser, and you buy from the partner. K-talk may earn a commission when you book through a link, at no extra cost to you.
• Travel information comes from the Korea Tourism Organization. K-talk is operated by PS Company, a private business. It is not a government app and is not affiliated with any government agency.

PRICE

Browsing places, saving them, booking links and your first trip plan are free. You can also ask the AI helper 3 questions for free. A 30-day pass ($9.99, a single in-app purchase, no automatic renewal) lets you replan as often as you like and ask 10 questions a day.

No sign-up. No third-party ads.

Terms of Use: https://ktalk.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://ktalk.web.app/privacy
Contact: kih8687@naver.com

name: KitchenLog
description:
Bring a little more order to your kitchen.

KitchenLog connects meal planning, ingredient inventory, shopping and cooking records in one place. Plan what to make, check what you already have, and keep track of how ingredients move through your kitchen.

PLAN YOUR MEALS
Organize breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks with daily and weekly plans. Set servings, reuse meal templates and create shopping requirements from your recipes.

BUILD YOUR RECIPE COLLECTION
Save recipes with cover photos, ingredient quantities and step-by-step instructions. Adjust servings, organize favorites and retain earlier recipe versions.

KNOW YOUR PANTRY
Manage ingredients by purchase batch, storage location and expiry date. Record receipts, actual use, returns and inventory adjustments with a traceable stock history.

SHOP WITH A CLEAR LIST
Group shopping items by ingredient category and calculate shortages against available stock. Confirm actual quantities and prices before receiving purchases into your pantry.

COOK AT YOUR OWN PACE
Follow focused cooking steps, manage multiple timers and resume unfinished sessions. Record actual servings, ingredient usage, ratings and notes when you finish.

UNDERSTAND FOOD WASTE
Log discarded ingredients by batch, quantity and reason. Review waste patterns and see where recorded ingredients are being lost.

REVIEW NUTRITION AND COST
Estimate nutrition from food-composition values and sources you enter. Review ingredient costs and per-serving estimates, with missing information clearly marked as unknown.

KEEP A KITCHEN JOURNAL
Save ingredient, process and finished-dish photos. Revisit cooking records and compare photos from previous attempts.

EXPORT YOUR RECORDS
Create kitchen reports, share PDF and CSV exports, and back up your records with attached photos.

Your core kitchen records work offline. No account is required. Optional local reminders help you keep track of planned meals and approaching expiry dates.

Nutrition estimates depend on the values, sources and quantities you enter. Cost summaries reflect recorded prices.

Promotional Text

Plan meals, track pantry batches, follow cooking steps and keep a photo journal. Turn everyday kitchen records into clearer shopping and less food waste.

Keywords

meal planner,pantry,recipes,grocery,cooking log,food waste,kitchen,inventory,meal prep,expiry

name: Levi Booking
description:
Levi Booking makes it quick and easy to find and book your stay at Levi Living properties.

FIND THE RIGHT PLACE
• Browse properties and room types with photos, amenities and prices
• Pick your check-in and check-out dates to see availability instantly
• Read genuine reviews from guests who have stayed

SIMPLE BOOKING
• Book in just a few steps, no in-app prepayment required
• Get booking confirmation by notification and email
• See the cancellation policy clearly before you book

MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS
• Track every booking in "My Rooms"
• A QR code for each booking for fast check-in at the front desk
• Cancel right in the app if your plans change

CHAT DIRECTLY
• Message your property before and during your stay
• Share photos and videos for easier communication

AFTER YOUR STAY
• Rate and review with photos to help future guests

You stay in control of your account and data: edit your profile, change your password or delete your account right in the app.

Levi Booking is intended for users aged 18 and over.

name: LIFT52
description:
LIFT52 plans your training, shows you how to do every exercise, and keeps a log of every workout.

GET A PLAN
Answer a few questions about your goal, your experience, how many days you can train, and how long each session can be. LIFT52 suggests a program and how hard to train. Every session is laid out for you: the exercises, the sets, the reps, and the rest.

NINE PROGRAMS
From two days a week to six: Full Body (2 or 3 days), Upper / Lower, Push / Pull / Legs, Arnold Split, Bodybuilding, Strength, Athletic, and In Season. Each comes in up to three intensities: Foundation, Standard, and Advanced. Choose your training days, change the intensity whenever you like, and swap any exercise for one that does the same job.

LOG YOUR WORKOUTS
Check off a set and the rest timer starts on its own. Your reps and weight from last time are already filled in, so you know what to beat. Add 30 seconds or skip the rest. Close the app mid-workout and pick up where you left off. When you finish, share a card of your workout.

336 EXERCISE GUIDES
Every exercise has written steps, form cues, illustrated positions, and a body map of the muscles it works. Tap a muscle on the body map to find its exercises, or switch to stretches for mobility work.

BUILD YOUR OWN ROUTINES
Put together your own sessions from all 336 exercises. Then run the routine check: eight checks for coverage, overlap, workload, sets, order, rest, reps, and length, each with a reason and a fix. Send a routine to a friend as a file or as text.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Home opens on your week: sessions done against your weekly goal, your next workout, and a bar for every week of your year. See which muscles you trained in the last 7 days, how your most-trained lifts have moved over eight weeks, and every workout in History. Rest days never count against you.

CALORIE AND PROTEIN TARGETS
Add a few details about your body and LIFT52 sets daily targets for calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Log your weight a few times a week. Every two weeks it checks your trend and adjusts your calories to keep you on pace. Use metric or imperial units. You can skip nutrition and still get your plan, or log your weight without any targets.

REMINDERS
Turn on reminders in Settings for training days, weigh-ins, and a weekly recap. They stay off until you turn them on.

YOUR DATA
No account needed, and it works offline. Your workouts, body details, and weigh-ins stay on your device. LIFT52 counts a few things anonymously, such as when a workout is saved, to see how the app is used. You can turn that off in Settings.

Nutrition targets are estimates for healthy adults, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before you start a new training or nutrition plan.

name: LoadVellum
description:
Plan device energy use for a cabin, trip or mobile workday. Create a power plan, enter battery capacity in watt-hours and efficiency, then add each device’s watts, daily hours and quantity. Review daily energy, combined load, usable energy, estimated days of use and continuous runtime. Compare saved plans and explore each device’s energy contribution.

Edit, search, delete and export records as JSON. Estimates use values you enter; LoadVellum does not measure equipment, account for startup surge or certify an electrical installation. Actual runtime varies.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: Menkyo Drill - Japan License
description:
**The exam is in Japanese. Train with your language and the Japanese original, side by side.**

Menkyo Drill helps learners prepare for Japan's driver's license written exam (karimen & honmen). Every one of the 120 original true/false questions pairs exact Japanese phrasing with English, Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese, and Portuguese translations and explanations.

■ Everything Free & Offline Forever
• 120 original questions across all 10 exam categories (signs, right of way, parking, expressways, mopeds, speed, overtaking, signals, crossings, safe driving)
• Instant 1-tap 5-language translation bar right on the home screen
• Automatic trap-word highlighter spots tricky Japanese qualifiers like 必ず, 絶対に, and に限り
• 50-question, 30-minute timed Mock Exam (90/100 pass bar) with category accuracy rings
• Smart Review Queue collects missed items until you answer correctly twice in a row

■ Zero Account & Distraction-Free Quizzes
Ads never appear during active drills, mock exams, or review sessions. Only a bottom banner appears on browsing tabs, removable permanently via one-time $0.99 IAP.
Note: Original practice questions based on Japanese traffic law; not an official NPA exam.

name: Moonmix: Sleep Sounds & Focus
description:
Moonmix is a sound mixer for sleep, focus and quiet moments. Pick the sounds you like, set the volume of each one and let them play together: rain on a tent with a crackling fire, ocean waves under brown noise, a cafe behind a soft piano.

70 SOUNDS IN 8 COLLECTIONS
• Rain & Thunder: light and heavy rain, rain on a roof, a window, a tent or an umbrella
• Nature: ocean, lake, creek, forest, wind, waterfall, fire
• Animals: birds, frogs, crickets, cicadas, whales, a purring cat
• Transport: train, car, airplane
• City & Instruments: cafe, crowd, fan, keyboard, wind chime, meditation bell, violin, harp, guzheng
• White, pink and brown noise
• Meditation: guitar, piano, flute
• Wooden Fish: ten temple knocker rhythms

MIX YOUR OWN
• Blend up to 8 sounds at once
• Set the volume of every sound separately
• Save a mix with a name and a cover; your most played mixes wait on the Home tab
• 19 ready-made mixes to start with: Ocean, Forest, Rain, Night, Cafe, Train Journey and more
• Share a mix as a link. Friends who have Moonmix can add it to their library

SLEEP
• Sleep timer with one-tap presets from 10 minutes to 8 hours, or your own duration
• The sound fades out slowly before it stops (10 seconds to 5 minutes)
• Bedtime reminder: a daily notification that starts your mix with a sleep timer when you tap it
• Gentle wake-up: a notification with soft birdsong; tap it and your mix fades in. It is a notification, so it cannot sound through silent mode or a Focus

FOCUS
• Focus timer with rounds of work and short breaks
• A notification tells you when each round ends, and the sound stops when the session is over

ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center
• Quick Play widget for the Home Screen
• Live Activity countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Siri and Shortcuts: play a mix, pause, start a sleep timer
• All sounds are inside the app and play without an internet connection

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light and dark appearance, with a choice of theme colours
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• English and Vietnamese

MOONMIX PREMIUM
A one-time purchase, not a subscription:
• All 70 sounds (26 of them are Premium; you can listen to each one for 30 seconds first)
• Six more theme colours
• Your own photos as mix covers
• iCloud sync for your mixes and covers

No account, no sign-up and no ads.

Questions or ideas? Write to ngocminhtrang2k4@gmail.com

name: Motorial Balance
description:
Motorial Balance is a personal digital garage for drivers who want to understand, organize and control the cost of owning a car. Fuel logs, expenses, maintenance schedules, service history and reminders live together in one place — on your iPhone, with no account.

KNOW YOUR CAR
• Add multiple vehicles with make, model, year, engine, transmission, fuel type, VIN and license plate
• Use a photo or a color-matched illustration for each vehicle
• Set a primary vehicle and keep its mileage up to date
• Browse a complete timeline of fill-ups, expenses, maintenance and repairs

FUEL LOG
• Record liters, price per liter, total cost, odometer and station
• Accurate consumption in L/100 km using the full-to-full method
• Partial fill-ups are handled correctly and added to the next full tank
• See consumption and fuel price trends over time

EXPENSES
• Color-coded categories: repairs, maintenance, insurance, parking and tolls, car wash, taxes and registration, tires and accessories
• Create your own categories with custom icons and colors
• Attach photos of receipts and documents

MAINTENANCE & SERVICE HISTORY
• Set service intervals by distance, time, or both — whichever comes first
• A maintenance forecast estimates when each task is due based on how much you drive
• Mark tasks as done to restart the interval
• Log repairs and inspections with labor, replacement parts, workshop, mechanic and photos

REMINDERS
• Date reminders for insurance, inspections, registration and seasonal tire changes
• Mileage reminders that alert you when a logged reading reaches your target
• Complete or postpone reminders in one tap
• Notifications are optional and scheduled locally on your device

INSIGHTS
• Total ownership cost and cost per kilometer
• Monthly spending chart and category breakdown
• Vehicle comparison, usage per month and yearly reports

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• Works fully offline — no account, no sign-up
• Mileage validation prevents accidental inconsistencies
• Export a JSON backup (photos not included) or a CSV of your records, and restore from a backup at any time

Start with a demo garage to explore every feature, then add your own car in seconds.

Your Car. Your Records. Your Control.

name: NANOXIS
description:
Explore nanotechnology with six scientific calculators for nanoparticle properties, quantum Confinement, diffusion, crystal structures, and nanoscale material analysis. Calculate, understand,
and explore scientific results with ease.

name: Nauti
description:
Nauti kokoaa yhteen kolme asiaa, jotka tavallisesti ovat eri sovelluksissa: tilan, reseptin ja hetken, jolloin kokkaus alkaa.

VARAA YHTEISKEITTIÖ
Selaa Helsingin huolella valittuja keittiöitä kaupunginosan, ryhmäkoon ja laitteiden mukaan. Näe tuntihinta, kapasiteetti, varusteet ja isäntä ennen ajan valitsemista. Tee kahden tai neljän tunnin varaus, aseta vierasmäärä ja pidä vahvistus viikkosuunnitelmassa.

KOKKAA PÖYTÄÄSI SOPIVA RESEPTI
Valitse kausireseptien joukosta metriset ainesosat, selkeät laiteohjeet ja käytännölliset vaihtoehdot. Muuta annosmäärää, ja jokainen mitta päivittyy heti. Ravitsemus, ajankäyttö ja vaihdot pysyvät näkyvissä ilman ylimääräistä säätämistä.

PYSY KOKKAUKSEN RYTMISSÄ
Kokkaustila näyttää yhden selkeän vaiheen kerrallaan. Valmiit ajastimet, lempeät vinkit ja edistymispolku pitävät kädet liikkeessä ja näytön siistinä. Keskeytä, nollaa tai palaa taaksepäin juuri silloin kun keittiö sitä pyytää.

SUUNNITTELE VIIKKO, ÄLÄ VAIN YKSI ILLALLINEN
Pidä tulevat keittiövaraukset, joustava ateriasuunnitelma, tallennetut reseptit ja kauppalista yhdessä paikassa. Rastita ostokset kaupassa ja tyhjennä lista, kun viikko on valmis.

KUIN KEITTIÖÖN TEHTY
Lämmin värimaailma, toimituksellinen typografia ja Nautille piirretyt kuvitukset luovat rauhallisen tilan ilman somevirran hälyä. Koko kokemus toimii suomeksi ja englanniksi.

YKSITYINEN OLETUKSENA
Ei tiliä, mainoksia eikä sosiaalista syötettä. Varaukset, suunnitelmat, ainesosat ja suosikit säilytetään vain iPhonessasi. Nauti ei pyydä pääsyä sijaintiisi, kameraan, yhteystietoihin tai mikrofoniin.

name: Nedfa: Nederlands leren
description:
Nedfa helpt je om na je taalcursus elke dag een beetje Nederlands te oefenen, van A2 naar B1. Een paar minuten per dag is genoeg.

THEMA’S MET AUDIO
Woorden, handige zinnen en korte gesprekken over het dagelijks leven: naar de huisarts, werk en privé, wonen, boodschappen en meer. Alles met Nederlandse audio, ook zonder internet.

SLIM HERHALEN
Kaartjes komen terug precies wanneer je ze bijna vergeet. Kies, luister, typ of vul aan.

ZEVEN SPELLEN
De of het, zinnen bouwen, werkwoorden, zinnen aanvullen, luisterdictee, gesprekken en een tijdrace. Verbeter je record.

ELKE DAG EEN BEETJE
Een dagdoel, een reeks, XP, stempels en een route met acht haltes van A2 naar B1. Zet een dagelijkse herinnering aan als je wilt.

OVERAL VERDER
Log in met Apple of Google en ga verder op je telefoon of op de website. Zonder account kan ook; je voortgang blijft dan op je telefoon. Je kunt je account en al je gegevens altijd verwijderen in de app.

name: nurie - Coloring for Kids
description:
A coloring app for young children: trace with your finger to color.

■ Easy for little ones
・With "Stay inside" on, color only goes inside the area where you started tracing. Turn it off to draw freely
・Three brushes: smooth "Paint", textured "Crayon" and color-changing "Rainbow", in three sizes
・Erase anything with the eraser
・Made a mistake? "Undo" puts it right back
・Tap "Done!" for a confetti celebration
・"Free drawing" gives you a blank sheet of paper
・Every picture goes into your album, and you can color the same picture as many times as you like

■ For parents
・No ads, no in-app purchases, no links out of the app
・No data is collected or sent. Pictures are stored only on your device
・Saving to Photos and erasing pictures from the album are behind a parent check (a math question)
・Designed so a resting palm doesn't draw. Works with iPad and Apple Pencil

■ 112 pictures
・Animals (50): cat, dog, rabbit, bear, elephant, giraffe, lion, dinosaur, unicorn, whale and more
・Vehicles (12): car, bus, train, airplane, rocket, bicycle, UFO and more
・Food (12): strawberry, cake, apple, banana, watermelon and more
・More (38): house, flower, rainbow, sun, robot, piano and more

name: Nゲージ レイアウト作成 - 線路と部品表
description:
Nゲージのレイアウトを、スマホで組んで確かめるアプリです。

部屋や台の大きさを決めて、線路を1本ずつつないでいくだけ。置けるか、輪がつながるか、買うものはいくらか、組む前に分かります。

■ 部屋や台に合わせて組む
・サブロク板などの大きさを選ぶか、部屋の形を指で直せます
・はみ出した線路は赤く出ます

■ つながるかが分かる
・輪が閉じたかを知らせます
・実物のつなぎ目で吸収できる、わずかなずれまで見ます

■ ポイント・複線・高架も
・ポイント、交差、複線、踏切、車止め
・高架で立体交差。橋脚の高さや坂の急さも分かります
・上から・斜めから・横から、見え方を切り替えられます

■ 買うものが一覧に
・部品表に、要る箱の数と値段の合計

KATO・TOMIXの線路に対応しています（非公式のアプリです。各社とは関係ありません）。

name: Okusuri Log - Pill Reminder
description:
Okusuri Log is a reminder and log app that helps you stop missing doses. It notifies you at the times you set and reminds you again, as many times as you choose, until you tap "Taken". Each dose you log goes on a calendar you can look back on. Every feature is free for your own medicines, and you can add family members such as parents or children with Premium (monthly, yearly, or a one-time purchase). No ads, no account, and no data leaves your device.

Reminds until you take it
- At each time, the notification shows the timing (e.g. after breakfast), the medicine and the amount.
- If nothing is logged, it reminds you again, e.g. every 30 minutes. You can set the count and interval for each medicine.
- Tap "Taken", "Later" or "Skip" right from the notification. Medicines due at the same time come in one notification.
- Option to deliver during Focus, and quiet hours that remind you without sound.

Any schedule
- Every day, certain days of the week, every few days, on days and off days, amounts that change in steps (tapering up or down), or only when needed.
- Set start and end dates, and as many times a day as you need.
- Add a photo and a note on color and shape to tell medicines apart. You can also scan the barcode on the box as a note.

Today at a glance
- The doses due now are shown large, and "Took all" logs them at once.
- Enter how many you have left, and it tells you when only a few days remain.
- Log "Taken" from the Home Screen widget without opening the app.

Look back
- A monthly calendar shows taken, skipped, not recorded and as-needed doses with colors and marks.
- Tap a day to log or fix doses later.
- A visit summary puts your current medicines and the last two weeks of records on one screen to show at a doctor's visit.

Family (Premium)
- Add as many family members as you like and swipe to switch between them.
- Register more than 10 regular medicines per person.
- Visit summary for any period (print or PDF), and a monthly report.
- Choose monthly, yearly, or a one-time purchase. Every plan unlocks the same features. No ads. Restore your purchase after changing devices.
- Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically. Cancel in your App Store account settings at least 24 hours before the period ends.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Free
- For one person (you): up to 10 regular medicines and any number of as-needed medicines, with reminders, follow-ups, logging, the calendar, the widget and export, all free.

Privacy
Your records are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere. They are not included in iCloud Backup either. To move to a new device, export a file and import it on the new one. No ads, analytics or tracking.

Note
This app is a tool for dose reminders and records. It does not give diagnoses or treatment advice. Always talk to your doctor or pharmacist before changing the amount or how you take a medicine.

name: Open pressure
description:
Open Pressure is a fast kitchen sorting challenge. Drag fruits, vegetables, dairy, and seafood into the right bins before the timer ends.

Clear every stage, climb through 30 levels, and earn stars for speed. Use Undo, Hint, and Shuffle when the board gets messy—and keep your kitchen calm under pressure.

What’s inside

Drag-and-drop food sorting across 4 categories
Timed stages with rising difficulty
Level progress, stars, and unlocks
Helpful tools: Undo, Hint, Shuffle
Light kitchen visuals with simple controls.

name: Pasujki – Toddler Matching
description:
Pasujki is a calm matching game for children aged 2 to 5.

Four pictures sit in the corners of the screen: animals, fruit, toys and things from home. A prompt appears in the middle: a picture, a color, a shape, a shadow or a pattern. Your child drags it to the corner where it belongs. The youngest players can simply tap the corner.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 8 worlds and 68 levels:
– The same: find the identical picture
– Colors: what is yellow, what is blue?
– Shapes: circle, star, heart, triangle
– Shadows: whose shadow is this?
– Patterns: stripes, spots, scales, fur
– Who goes with whom?: mothers and babies, who eats what, who lives where
– Weather and pairs: what you need in the rain, what goes together
– Make-believe: every answer is right here; it's all about imagination
• Levels get harder slowly: first only two pictures to choose from, then three, then four.
• Every finished level earns a sticker.

CALM, NO HURRY
Pasujki is slow on purpose. Animations are soft and unhurried, colors are pastel, and nothing flashes. Music plays quietly and can be turned off separately from sound effects. There are no timers, no penalty points and no streaks to keep up.
A mistake isn't a failure. The picture gently floats back to the middle, and after a second try the right corner softly lights up.

WHAT YOUR CHILD CAN PRACTICE
While playing, children get to practice noticing what is the same and what is different, recognizing colors and shapes, putting things into pairs and groups, and, when dragging, controlling small finger movements. No reading is needed to play.

FOR PARENTS
• No ads and no in-app purchases.
• No internet needed: the game works fully offline.
• We collect no data. Progress stays on the device only.
• The parents' area sits behind a parental gate. It holds the settings (music, sounds, text hints, unlock all levels, reset progress) and the privacy policy.
• Parent-facing text (the gate and the parents' area) follows the device language: English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese or Dutch.
• The game follows the iPhone's silent mode and goes quiet when you leave the app.

All illustrations and music were made specially for Pasujki.

name: PatentScopeWorkspace
description:
PatentScope Workspace is a patent search and technical intelligence tool designed for research and development, patent engineers, and intellectual property practitioners. You can complete the complete process from keyword search to technical map in one workbench: by combining title and abstract keywords, applicant, inventor, CPC classification number, authorization date range, and minimum claim array to create an accurate query. You can see the number of hits in real time and arrange the results in alphabetical order by latest authorization, earliest authorization, most cited, most claimed, or title.
In addition to searching, the application provides a technical map perspective: using a circular chart to view the proportion composition of each technology category, comparing the patent reserves of top applicants with a bar chart, observing the annual authorization momentum with a trend chart, and directly exporting chart images for archiving. Each patent is accompanied by a detail page that displays the abstract, classification path, citation and claim indicators, applicant file, inventor collaboration network, and associated patents.

name: PathWeft
description:
Plan work as a network of prerequisites. Give each task an estimated duration, connect the tasks it depends on and see which work is ready to start. PathWeft rejects circular and missing dependencies.

Complete ready tasks to unlock the next steps. Reopening a task also resets its dependent tasks. Review the longest remaining dependency chain, browse completed work, search, edit, delete and export your plan as JSON. Deleting a task removes its links. This is a local planning tool, without team sync or calendar scheduling.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: Pennyshelf
description:
Is the big pack really cheaper? Pennyshelf answers that every time.

Pennyshelf is a personal price book for groceries and household items. Note the prices you see on the shelf, and the app turns each one into a fair unit price — per 100 g, per litre, per roll, per piece or per 100 sheets — so you always know where your money goes furthest.

YOUR SHELF
Add the products you buy often, each with its aisle and the unit it is usually sold in. Every product shows its best unit price on a little hanging price tag. When the newest price you logged is also your best, the tag turns red. Search by name or filter by aisle in a tap.

LOG A PRICE IN SECONDS
Pick the store (or add a new one right there), type the shelf price and the pack size, choose the unit, set the day and mark it if it was on offer. The tag on the sheet works out the unit price while you type and tells you how it compares with your best so far. Mixed pack sizes are no problem: 500 g and 2 kg, 750 ml and 1.5 l are compared fairly.

PRICE HISTORY AND THE CHEAPEST STORE
Every product page shows a price history chart with each sighting in its store's colour, how far the latest price sits above your best, a ranking of stores by their most recent price, and the full price log. Tap any entry to correct or delete it.

COMPARE TWO PACKS
The Compare calculator answers "is the big pack really cheaper?" instantly. Enter two prices and sizes, and Pennyshelf shows which pack wins, by how many percent, and how much the difference adds up to. Nothing is saved, it just answers.

A LIST THAT KNOWS WHERE TO SHOP
Add products to your shopping list and it sorts itself by the store where each item is cheapest right now, with a rough total per store. Tick items into the basket as you go.

STORES
See every store you use, how many prices you have logged there and how many products it currently wins.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away with Browse without account, or create an account and sign in with email and password. Guests can later save their shelf to an email account without losing anything. Your data syncs through your private account space and keeps working offline. Choose your currency in Backroom.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your price book is visible only to you. You can delete your account and every product, store, price and list item from Backroom at any time.

name: Persuasion seat
description:
Short description
A fairy-tale physics puzzle where every swipe cuts a rope and gravity writes the rest of the story.

App Store description
Swipe. Cut. Watch the story unfold.

In a floating land of clouds and magic, stars, sweets, and little creatures are tangled in ropes. You are the rope mage — one careful cut can free them… or send everything tumbling the wrong way.

How to play

Swipe across a rope to cut it
Use gravity, swings, bounce, and buoyancy
Guide the star into the basket
Collect sparkles along the way
Think before you cut — order and timing matter
What awaits

100 handcrafted stages across 10 storybook chapters
Floating island home and painted chapter maps
Balloons, springs, fans, magnets, portals, and more
Soft fairy-tale art, sound, and haptics
No cluttered toolbars — just a full-screen puzzle world
One rope. One choice. A whole new tale.

name: Petualangan Barong Sekeloa
description:
Selamat datang di "Petualangan Barong Sekeloa Bersama Aya dan Timo" — aplikasi game edukasi budaya interaktif karya kolaborasi Fakultas Industri Kreatif Telkom University dan Komunitas Seni Sekeloa Bandung!

Aplikasi ini dirancang khusus untuk mengenalkan kekayaan warisan budaya Sunda, khususnya kesenian tradisional Seni Ulin Barong Sekeloa dan alat musik tradisional daerah, melalui cara bermain yang menyenangkan, interaktif, dan ramah anak.

FITUR UTAMA:

1. Buku Cerita Bergambar Interaktif (24 Halaman Penuh Warna)
Ikuti perjalanan seru Aya dan Kak Timo sepulang sekolah saat mereka mendengar tabuhan musik tradisional di Desa Sekeloa! Dilengkapi 24 adegan ilustrasi dua halaman (spread) berkualitas tinggi, efek membalik halaman buku 3D yang nyata, balon cerita yang mudah dibaca, serta iringan musik latar suasana khas Sunda.

2. Buku Mewarnai Digital (Drawing Book Pintar)
Asah imajinasi dan kreativitas seni anak melalui kanvas mewarnai digital!
- Tersedia 2 kategori utama: Karakter Barong Sekeloa (5 variasi pose) dan Alat Musik Tradisional Sunda (Bedug, Kendang, dan Gong).
- Fitur Kuas (Tap-to-Fill) untuk mewarnai cepat dan Pensil Pintar (Smart Scratch Coloring) yang menjaga goresan warna tidak keluar garis.
- Dilengkapi penghapus, tombol Undo/Redo, palet warna lengkap, penilaian hingga 3 bintang, serta fitur tangkapan layar untuk menyimpan hasil karya lukisanmu.

3. Mini Games Jigsaw Puzzle (6 Level Ketangkasan)
Latih daya ingat, fokus, ketelitian, dan logika pemecahan masalah anak dengan menyusun kepingan puzzle 3x3 bergambar adegan Barong Sekeloa dan musik tradisional. Kumpulkan bintang dan koin di setiap level serta gunakan fitur Bantuan saat dibutuhkan!

AMAN & NYAMAN UNTUK ANAK:
- 100% Bebas Iklan (Zero Ads)
- Tanpa Pembelian di Dalam Aplikasi (No In-App Purchases)
- Dapat Dimainkan 100% Secara Offline Tanpa Internet
- Tidak Mengumpulkan Data Pribadi Pengguna

Mari lestarikan budaya Nusantara sejak dini bersama Aya, Timo, dan Barong Sekeloa!

name: Phone Cleaner: ClearWhirl AI
description:
Make room for more.

ClearWhirl is a private photo and storage cleaner for iPhone. It reads your library on your iPhone, sorts it into folders you can understand, and never deletes anything until you say so.

FULLY OFFLINE. NOTHING LEAVES YOUR iPHONE.
• Works in airplane mode: the cleaning needs no internet
• Photos are analysed on your iPhone and are never uploaded
• No account and no login

NO ACCOUNT. NO LOGIN. NO ADS.
Open the app and start. Your photos are analysed on your iPhone and are never uploaded.

FIND WHAT YOU CAN LET GO
• Similar and duplicate photos, with the best shot kept and the space each extra would free shown on every card
• Blurry and dark photos
• Screenshots, receipts, payment screens, tickets, QR codes and documents sorted by what is really in them
• Large videos, and bursts

ASK IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type "boarding pass", "payment receipts 2026" or "contract" and get just that. Search understands what you mean, reads the text inside photos and screenshots, and can narrow by type, date and size. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence it uses Apple's on-device model to understand your words.

SMARTER ASK ON SUPPORTED iPHONES
Ask uses Apple's on-device model on supported iPhones (iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence turned on); on other iPhones Ask still works with on-device search. Nothing is uploaded.

YOU DECIDE
• Swipe: left to delete, right to keep, up to schedule a delete for later
• Review everything before it is removed, and keep anything you want
• iOS always asks you to confirm, and deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days

MORE WAYS TO MAKE ROOM
• Compress large videos
• Merge duplicate contacts (a backup is saved first)
• Find big files in folders you choose
• See what uses your iPhone storage
• Schedule a clean-up and get a reminder when it is ready
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and Live Activity widgets that show your storage and scan progress

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Analysis runs on your iPhone. ClearWhirl has no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Only the App Store itself, run by Apple, handles purchases, restores and subscriptions.

TRY CLEARWHIRL PRO FREE
Try free for 7 days, then subscribe monthly or yearly, or buy once (lifetime).

ClearWhirl frees storage. It does not speed up your iPhone, and it cannot clear other apps' memory.

Subscriptions: ClearWhirl Pro Monthly and Yearly start with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The trial turns into a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. The lifetime option is a one-time purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://clearwhirl.appikorn.com/privacy

name: PiggyBanks
description:
電卓にしか見えない、秘密のプライベート家計簿

・電卓偽装（暗証番号またはFace IDで解錠）
・目的別に分けられる複数の貯金箱（バンク）
・アカウント登録なし・完全オフラインで安心
・サクサク動くゼロ秒起動＆シンプル操作
・CSVエクスポート対応

name: Qovzuio
description:
Welcome! We look forward to providing you with a high-quality experience—we’re eager to hear your feedback.


Qovzuio is a calm, honest flashcard desk. You write the cards, you flip them, you say how well you knew each one, and a five-box Leitner schedule decides when every card comes back. Hard cards return today. Cards you know drift further away: tomorrow, then 3 days, then a week, then 16 days.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECKS
Create a deck with a title, a subject and a card colour (royal blue or gilt gold). Add cards with a question on the front, the answer on the back and an optional hint for the moments you need a nudge. Edit or delete any card or deck whenever you like. Use "Save and add another" to write a whole chapter in one go.

STUDY WITH A REAL FLIP
Study shows the cards that are due, one at a time. Tap to flip the card in 3D, peek at the hint if you need it, then rate yourself: Again, Hard, Good or Easy. Each button shows when you will see the card next, so the schedule never feels like a mystery. Missed cards move to the back of the session for another try.

A DAILY GOAL AND A STREAK
Choose a goal of 10, 20, 30 or 50 cards a day. The ring on your Decks page fills as you study, and reaching the goal keeps your streak going. Every deck shows its own mastery: the share of cards that made it to box 5.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
The Progress page draws your reviews for the last 14 days next to your goal line, with your recall rate, cards on the shelf, mastered cards, a picture of all five Leitner boxes and your best streak.

START IN SECONDS
Not sure where to begin? Add three starter decks with one tap: world capitals, Spanish basics and chemistry symbols. Then make them your own.

AN EMAIL ACCOUNT, OR SKIP
Create a free email account (name, email and password), or tap "Skip and start learning" and use the full app as a guest. Later, Settings > Save my data attaches an email account so your cards are kept with your account and can follow you to another iPhone.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your decks are stored with Google Firebase and stay usable without a connection; changes sync when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your cards are private to you, with no feed, chat or public profile. Settings > Delete account erases every deck, card, review and your profile, then removes the sign-in.

Small touches make it pleasant to come back to: a crisp paper flip, a warm chime for a good answer, a soft knock for "Again", a little fanfare when the daily goal is done. Sounds and haptics can be switched off in Settings.

name: QuoteCedar
description:
Create itemized estimates for freelance work. Add a client, currency, date and line items with quantities and rates. Apply a percentage discount before tax, preview the totals and share a plain-text quote through the system share sheet. Mark accepted quotes or return them to draft.

Search by title or client, edit records and export JSON. The register groups quoted and accepted totals by currency without exchange conversion. Tax rates are entered by you. QuoteCedar does not issue tax invoices, collect payments or provide accounting advice.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: Quran Audio
description:
قرآن مسموع للمكفوفين وكبار السن.

صُمم هذا التطبيق لمن لا يستطيع رؤية الشاشة: كل شيء بالصوت، وأزرار كبيرة واضحة تعمل مع VoiceOver.

المزايا:
• زر تشغيل/إيقاف كبير
• الآية التالية والسابقة، والسورة التالية والسابقة
• زر «أين أنا؟» يخبرك باسم السورة ورقم الآية
• أوامر صوتية: قل «سورة يس» أو «الآية التالية»
• الاستماع بدون إنترنت: نزّل جزء عمّ أو سورة أو القرآن كاملاً
• وضع «كلمة كلمة» للحفظ والتعلم
• يستمر التشغيل والشاشة مقفلة
• قرّاء: رعد محمد الكردي، عبد الباسط عبد الصمد، محمد صديق المنشاوي، وغيرهم

التطبيق مجاني، بدون إعلانات، وبدون تسجيل دخول.

Audio Quran for blind and elderly listeners: large buttons, VoiceOver support, voice commands, offline listening and word-by-word mode. Free, no ads, no sign-in.

name: Race Track Director: Tycoon
description:
A kart track, an empty field and a dream: build a Grand Prix circuit.

Race Track Director is a turn-based motorsport tycoon. Lay out your own circuit, grow it from a club track into a world-class venue, and run every race day live from race control.

BUILD YOUR CIRCUIT
• Drag corners into shape in the track builder, or start from a library of ready-made layouts.
• Every layout is judged on length, flow, overtaking and safety, with lap times for karts, bikes, GT cars and formula cars.
• Choose gravel, tarmac or hybrid run-off corner by corner, and buy more land to stretch the lap.
• Add pit garages, a paddock, race control, a medical centre, a media centre, hospitality, a campsite and grandstands.

RUN RACE DAY LIVE
• Watch every car on the map, lap by lap, at half, normal, double or quadruple speed.
• Qualifying is a live session: track limits, traffic, crashes and a provisional pole that keeps changing.
• Make the calls from race control: yellow flags, a virtual safety car, a safety car or a red flag.
• Time it well: a safety car opens a cheap pit window, and it can wipe out a leader's gap.
• Teams radio in with protests, near misses and "box, box".
• Every race tells a story: lead changes, breakdowns and last-lap fights.
• Longer races have pit stops, and after the chequered flag the field slows down and pulls into the pits.

WIN CHAMPIONSHIPS
• Fifteen fictional series, from regional karts and superbikes to GT, endurance and the Grand Prix World Series.
• Bid for rounds each winter against rival circuits, then earn renewals with A-rated weekends.
• Climb the grades, from a Grade 6 club track to a Grade 1 world circuit.

RUN THE BUSINESS
• Book your own club race days and set the classes, laps, ticket price and prize fund.
• Sign title sponsors and name your corners after them, sell TV rights and run marketing campaigns.
• Hire staff, borrow from the bank and keep the neighbours on side.
• Every season ends with a review of your Prestige, crowds, ratings and money.

PICK YOUR GROUND
• Twelve countries, each with its own costs, crowds and weather.
• Four sites: farmland, a hillside, an old airfield or a forest.
• Outgrow your plot? Sell up and move the whole operation to a bigger site, anywhere in the world.
• Four difficulties, three save slots, and 48 trophies to win in Game Center.

NO ADS, NO TIMERS
No ads, no tracking and no energy timers. Race Track Director plays fully offline, and nothing happens until you advance the week or wave the green flag, so you can put it down whenever you like.

Optional in-app purchases add cash to a circuit, or unlock Signature Corners (a banked bowl, a corkscrew drop, a tunnel and a bridge), Night Racing (floodlights, night races and the 24 Hours) and Motorsport Empire (a sister circuit abroad, a driver academy and the stewards' room). The whole game, from your first kart sprint to the Grand Prix, plays without them.

All drivers, teams, series, sponsors and broadcasters in the game are fictional.

Terms of Use: https://director.games/race-track-director/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://director.games/race-track-director/privacy/

name: Red pressure
description:
Red pressure is a colorful light-memory puzzle set in a futuristic energy lab. Follow glowing sequences, tap the right bulbs, and keep the core online through 100 carefully tuned challenges.

Features

100 levels with rising difficulty
Classic, combo, reverse, and dynamic circuit modes
Neon lab visuals with animated bulbs and electric feedback
Star Path map across 10 energy chapters
Unlockable bulb styles in the gallery
Daily shared circuit challenge
Offline play — progress saved on your device

name: Retort Fo Chart
description:
Retort Fo Chart turns a kettle log into Ball Fo and names the cold probe.

Import the minute-by-minute temperatures, or open a run and follow the come-up, the hold, and any gap. L is taken from each probe against the reference temperature and z. Fo adds those minutes only when the clock stays continuous.

The cold spot is the probe with the lowest Fo. Drag the target Fo and the stamp updates: Release, Hold, or Reprocess. A spike past the ceiling, a short hold, or a cold spot that lags the mean keeps the batch. Record the decision, then share the report.

Temperatures, products, and the recorded stamp stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. The chart does not replace the plant sterilization schedule.

name: RoutineRibbon
description:
Organize recurring personal work by area and next date. Set a repeat interval in calendar days, review overdue, today and upcoming routines, and filter to work due now. Mark a routine complete to calculate its next date from the completion day, or defer it by one day.

Keep a completion history, browse routines by area, search, edit, delete and export JSON. Deleting a routine preserves its history; deleting a history entry does not change its next date. RoutineRibbon does not send notifications or sync a shared calendar.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: Rovinq
description:
**Stay informed. Follow global events. Understand economic policy.**

Rovinq is a professional economic calendar and financial news app designed to help you track global economic events, follow central bank decisions, and explore monetary policy developments in one organized workspace.

**Global Economic Calendar**

Explore important economic releases, interest rate decisions, and central bank meetings. Filter events by country, date, category, and importance, with support for multiple time zones.

**Financial & Policy News**

Stay informed about monetary policy, inflation, employment, economic growth, and global financial developments. Browse news by topic and discover related economic events.

**Central Bank Tracker**

Follow major central banks, including the Federal Reserve, ECB, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan. Review meeting schedules, policy decisions, interest rate changes, and available official statements.

**Policy Analysis**

Explore historical interest rate charts, compare central bank policies, and create hypothetical rate scenarios to better understand monetary policy trends.

**Weekly Macro Briefings**

Create personalized economic briefings by selecting important events, policy updates, and news references. Add notes, organize sections, and export reports as PDF files.

**Key Features**

- Global economic calendar
- Financial and policy news
- Central bank meeting tracker
- Global time zone planner
- Historical interest rate charts
- Policy decision comparisons
- Economic event reminders
- Custom rate scenarios
- Weekly briefing editor
- PDF report export

Rovinq brings global economic information, policy research, and practical planning tools together in a refined iOS experience.

*For informational purposes only. Data availability may vary by source. Not investment advice.*

**Follow the events. Understand the policy. See the bigger picture.**

name: Samurai Scribe
description:
Samurai Scribe records meetings, interviews and voice notes on your iPhone or iPad and hands each recording to Samurai Scribe on your own computer over your Wi-Fi. There it becomes a meeting, ready to transcribe and summarize; the transcript and summary appear in Samurai Scribe on the computer, a free download for Mac and Windows at samuraiscribe.com.

No computer nearby? The phone is a safe recorder on its own: record, play, rename, and share any recording with the apps on your phone.

RECORD ANYWHERE
• One large button to start and stop. Pause, and mark a moment to find it later.
• Keeps recording with the screen locked or in another app.
• Start and stop from the Lock Screen, Control Center, the Action Button, Siri or Shortcuts. A Live Activity shows the clock and offers Pause and Stop.
• If a call comes in or another app needs the microphone, the recording carries on by itself afterwards, and marks what was missed.
• If the app is closed in the middle of a recording, what was recorded is saved the next time it opens.

YOUR RECORDINGS STAY ON YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU SEND THEM
• Play, share or delete each recording on the phone, and rename it until it is sent.
• Every recording says where it is: only on this phone, waiting for the computer, sending, or on your computer.

TRANSCRIPTS AND SUMMARIES ON YOUR COMPUTER
• Pair once by scanning a code in Samurai Scribe on your computer. Phone and computer then talk directly over your Wi-Fi.
• New recordings are sent by themselves shortly after you stop, or when you choose. A recording counts as sent only when the computer confirms it has it as a meeting.
• On the computer, each recording becomes a meeting, ready to transcribe and summarize.
• If the computer is off or away, recordings wait safely on the phone and go when it is back.
• Optionally, delete recordings from the phone once the computer has them, right away or a set number of days later.

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD
• No sign-up and no account in this app.
• Recordings never go to a Samurai Scribe server: only from your phone to your own computer.
• Nothing about you leaves the phone unless you send it. A bug report or idea from Settings goes to Samurai Scribe support only when you tap Send, and shows what it includes first.

name: ScrapJam
description:
ScrapJam to narzedzie dla technikow utrzymania ruchu i operatorow linii tloczacych. Pomaga szybko potwierdzic zator zlomu na zsuwni (fotokomorka lub potwierdzenie reczne), precyzyjnie zmierzyc czas przestoju prasy oraz zebrac dane wedlug formy (matrycy), zmiany i zsuwni. Dzieki temu latwiej znalezc waskie gardla systemu zlomu i skrocic puste oczekiwanie prasy.
﻿
Wszystkie dane sa lokalne. Aplikacja nie wymaga konta, logowania ani internetu.
﻿
Jak korzystac - pelny przeplyw
﻿
Krok 1. Przygotuj dane bazowe (Ustawienia)
Otworz karte Ustawienia.
Mozesz edytowac pozycje przez dotkniecie wiersza lub usunac gestem przesuniecia.
Aplikacja ma juz przykladowe formy, zmiany i zsuwnie. Mozesz od razu przejsc do pomiaru.
﻿
Krok 2. Potwierdz zator i uruchom timer (Timer)
Otworz karte Timer.
Wybierz kanal potwierdzenia: Fotokomorka (potwierdzenie w stylu sygnalu sensora) albo Recznie (potwierdzenie terenowe).
Wybierz Forme, Zmiane i Zsuwnie przyciskami z listy.
Dotknij Start pomiaru przestoju.
Timer dziala na zywo. Mozesz uzyc Wstrzymaj lub Wznow, Zakoncz i archiwizuj, a przy wielu aktywnych pomiarach Przelacz aktywny pomiar.
﻿
Krok 3. Zakoncz i sklasyfikuj przestoj
Po usunieciu zatoru wybierz Zakoncz i archiwizuj.
Wybierz przyczyne: lekkie zablokowanie, powazne zablokowanie, falszywy alarm lub nieokreslona.
Opcjonalnie wpisz notatke terenowa.
Zapisz. Zdarzenie trafia do Historii i Analizy.
﻿
Krok 4. Przegladaj historie (Historia)
Otworz Historie.
Filtruj: Wszystkie, Dzis, Sensor lub Recznie.
Uzyj Filtr formy, aby zawęzić do matrycy.
Dotknij wiersza, aby zobaczyc szczegoly: start, koniec, czas, przyczyna, notatka.
Przesun wiersz, aby usunac rekord.
﻿
Krok 5. Analizuj waskie gardla (Analiza)
Otworz Analize.
Przelacz wymiar: Forma, Zmiana lub Zsuwnia.
Zobacz ranking czasu i liczby przestojow oraz udzial procentowy.
To pomaga wskazac, gdzie system zlomu najczesciej zatrzymuje prase.
﻿
Krok 6. Start (pulpit)

name: SDS Trainer: German Speaking
description:
SDS Trainer prepares you for the speaking part of the Swiss digital language test, from A1 to B2.

The interview is a conversation that climbs one level at a time. You introduce yourself, describe your everyday life, give reasons and wishes, and present advantages and disadvantages with your own opinion. SDS Trainer trains the questions the interviewer asks at each level, 29 of them, each with complete sample answers.

FOUR STEPS FOR EVERY QUESTION
• Listen: how two example people answer, sentence by sentence
• Repeat: say the answer aloud; every sentence is checked as you speak
• My answer: build the same answer with your own details
• Speak freely: answer without the text and get feedback

YOUR OWN ANSWERS
• Tell the app your name, country, job, family and hobbies once; it writes your introduction in correct German
• Your date of birth and address the way they are said, because the interviewer asks for them
• Choose your own places, people and reasons for every other question, or write them yourself

FEEDBACK ON WHAT YOU SAY
• Which points of a complete answer you covered and which were missing
• An estimated level on the exam's four criteria: vocabulary, accuracy, fluency, coherence
• Tempo and pauses measured from your recording
• Word-order slips quoted back to you with the correction
• Advice a teacher would give: speak about yourself, never say "Keine Ahnung", use the Swiss word

MOCK INTERVIEW
• Opens with "Stellen Sie sich bitte vor" and moves up one level at a time, with follow-up questions
• Stops where the real interview would, and gives you a report

PHRASES TO KEEP READY
• What to say when a word is missing or you did not understand
• Linking words, with the word order each one needs
• Wishes and imagined situations with Konjunktiv II
• Advantages, disadvantages and opinions for the B2 presentation
• Swiss words: Velo, Tram, Billett, Glace, parkieren

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. SDS Trainer collects no data
• Your details, recordings, transcripts and progress stay on your iPhone
• Works offline once the German speech model is installed

The level shown is an estimate worked out by rule on your iPhone. Articles, endings and pronunciation are not assessed, and the result is not an official grade.

SDS Trainer is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the organisations that develop or run the language test.

SDS TRAINER PLUS
SDS Trainer is free to use in full for one week. After that, practice needs an SDS Trainer Plus subscription, yearly or monthly (prices are shown in the app and vary by country). The course, your own answers and your progress stay available either way.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

description:

Fill your fish book, raise species mastery and look for the rare gold, albino and black colours of every fish.

Works offline. Haptics, tide reminders and 12 languages included.

name: Slidara
description:
**Explore the microscopic world with precision.**

Slidara is a practical microscope slide management and observation workspace designed for science enthusiasts, students, educators, and microscopy hobbyists.

From preparing slides and organizing specimens to measuring microscopic images and comparing observations, Slidara brings essential microscopy tools together in one intuitive iOS app.

### Slide Organization
Create and manage microscope slides using interactive storage racks. Organize specimens by category, assign storage positions, and maintain detailed slide records.

### Preparation Workflows
Build customized slide preparation sequences with step-by-step instructions, timers, and reagent records. Track preparation progress and preserve your experimental history.

### Microscope Measurement
Import microscope images, calibrate image scales using known references, and measure lengths, angles, and areas. Add annotations, scale bars, and observation notes directly to your images.

### Image Comparison
Compare microscope images using split-screen and overlay views. Review measurement differences, highlight visible changes, and document your findings.

### Specimen Archive
Build an organized collection of specimens, slides, microscope images, and observation records. Search your archive and export structured reports for future reference.

### Key Features
- Interactive microscope slide racks
- Slide preparation timers
- Custom preparation workflows
- Microscope image calibration
- Length, angle, and area measurements
- Image annotations and scale bars
- Side-by-side image comparison
- Specimen and observation history
- PDF reports and data export
- Offline functionality and local storage

### Your Personal Microscopy Workspace

Slidara combines practical laboratory organization with precise image measurement tools, helping you document observations and explore microscopic details.

Designed for educational and non-clinical use, Slidara makes microscope slide preparation, measurement, and recordkeeping more accessible and organized.

**Prepare. Observe. Measure. Discover.**

name: TruthBench: Logic Minimizer
description:
Turn a defined truth table into an inspectable Boolean solution. TruthBench is an offline workbench for digital-logic students and teachers who want to understand and check a two-level sum of products.

Define your case
Use 2–5 variables, A through E. Enter decimal row numbers for output 1 and optional don’t-care rows. A is the most significant bit. Other defined rows output 0. Input validation catches overlaps, repeated and out-of-range rows.

Inspect the cover
Quine–McCluskey generates prime implicants. An exact search chooses a cover with the fewest terms, then the fewest literals. Read the resulting SOP, selected bit patterns, covered 1 rows and the complete prime list. Inspect every truth-table row against the result; X rows remain unconstrained. Constant 0 and 1 functions are supported.

Keep useful examples
Save named cases, revise inputs and share a plain-text report containing the expression, prime patterns and row-by-row verification. A worked alarm-enable example and notation guide explain the process.

Scope
This is a truth-table tool, not an expression parser, circuit simulator, Karnaugh-map diagram, timing or hazard analysis. Equivalent minimal expressions may exist. Results are for Boolean learning and checking, not hardware safety certification.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: 닿을까
description:
닿을까는 끝내 전하지 못한 첫사랑에게 보내는 익명 편지 앱입니다.

그때 하지 못한 말, 아직 마음 한켠에 남아 있는 이야기를 편지로 적어 유리병에 담아 바다에 띄워 보세요. 편지는 이름 없이 떠다니고, 그 편지를 받은 첫사랑이 대답해줄지도 몰라요.

■ 이렇게 써요
· 편지 띄우기: 마음을 고르고, 질문을 따라 천천히 적어요. 다 쓰면 편지가 유리병에 담겨 바다로 떠나요.
· 편지 읽기: 시집처럼 한 통씩, 조용히 읽어요. 화살표로 다음 편지로 넘어갈 수 있어요.
· 답장 쓰기: 바다에 떠 있는 편지를 읽고, 그 사람 대신 따뜻한 답장을 남겨요.
· 닿은 편지: 편지 주인이 마음에 가장 닿은 답장을 고르면 '닿은' 편지가 되어 공감 순으로 모여요.
· 내 서랍: 내가 띄운 편지와 남긴 답장을 모아 볼 수 있어요.

■ 안심하고 쓸 수 있도록
· 편지에는 이름 대신 닉네임만 표시돼요.
· 실명, 학교, 직장, 연락처처럼 누군가를 알아볼 수 있는 정보는 쓰지 않도록 안내해요.
· 전화번호, 이메일, 링크, 욕설이 담긴 글은 자동으로 걸러져요.
· 불편한 글은 신고할 수 있고, 신고가 쌓이면 바로 숨겨져요. 원하지 않는 사용자는 차단할 수 있어요. 신고는 24시간 안에 확인해요.
· 언제든 앱 안에서 계정을 삭제할 수 있어요.

닿지 못한 마음이, 오늘은 누군가에게 닿기를.

name: 신한 UP Plus
description:
신한 UP Plus는 신한금융플러스 소속 설계사를 위한 사내 교육·상담자료 플랫폼입니다. 회사에서 등록한 구성원만 내부 계정으로 이용할 수 있습니다.

■ 강의
핵심강의와 신입과정 등 실무 강의를 영상으로 시청하고, 저장된 진도에서 이어볼 수 있습니다.

■ 필수 교육 및 My Class
지정된 필수 교육과 이수 현황을 확인하고, 진행 중인 강의·완료한 강의·찜한 강의를 한곳에서 관리할 수 있습니다.

■ 상담자료
상품 비교 분석 자료, 상담 화법, 고객용 카드뉴스를 확인할 수 있으며, 고객용 카드뉴스를 카카오톡으로 공유할 수 있습니다.

■ 공지사항·검색
회사 공지와 교육 일정을 확인하고 강의와 자료를 검색할 수 있습니다.

[이용 안내]
• 신한금융플러스에 등록된 소속 구성원만 이용할 수 있습니다.
• 사번과 비밀번호로 로그인합니다.
• 앱 내 결제, 유료 구독 및 외부 결제 링크는 없습니다.
• 이용 문의는 소속 회사의 교육 담당 부서로 해 주세요.

name: 에너지밀
description:
오늘 뭐 먹지? 매번 고민된다면 에너지밀에 맡겨보세요.

생년월일로 오늘 나에게 어울리는 기운을 읽고,
아침·점심·저녁마다 딱 맞는 한 끼를 추천해드려요.

■ 이런 걸 할 수 있어요
• 끼니별 메뉴 추천 — 아침, 점심, 저녁 탭을 눌러 오늘의 메뉴를 확인하세요.
• 왜 이 메뉴인지 쉬운 말로 — 어려운 용어 없이 한두 문장으로 알려드려요.
• 다시 추천 — 마음에 안 들면 한 번 더 눌러 다른 메뉴를 받아보세요.
• 안주 페어링 — 오늘 마실 술(소주·맥주·와인·막걸리·위스키·사케)을 고르면 어울리는 안주를 골라드려요.
• 끼니 알림 — 아침·점심·저녁 즈음 오늘의 메뉴를 알려드려요.
• 홈 화면 위젯 — 앱을 열지 않아도 지금 끼니의 추천 메뉴를 확인할 수 있어요.

■ 가볍고 안심되게
• 회원가입 없이 생년월일만 있으면 바로 시작할 수 있어요.
• 입력한 정보는 내 휴대폰에만 저장되고 서버로 보내지 않아요.

※ 메뉴 추천은 재미로 즐기는 콘텐츠이며, 의학적·영양학적 조언을 대신하지 않아요.

name: テトリバ
description:
コマに、個性を。

テトリバは、形の違う4種類のコマを置いて盤面を奪い合うボードゲームです。

■ 遊び方
・コマを選び、向きを回して、盤面に置きます。黒から交互に置きます。
・相手のコマを一部でもはさめば、そのコマは全部ひっくり返ります。
・はさめるかどうかは、置いたコマのすべてのマスから判定します（連鎖はしません）。
・置けないときは PASS。どちらも置けなくなったら、面積の多いほうが勝ちです。

■ 4種類のコマ
シングル・ダブル・アングル・トリプル。形も使える数も違うので、どれをいつ使うかが勝負の分かれ目です。

■ 対戦モード
・CPU対戦：やさしい／ふつう／つよい／きびしい の4段階
・2人対戦：1台のスマホを交互に使って遊べます

■ こんな人に
・リバーシが好きな人
・すきま時間に、頭を使うゲームを遊びたい人
・家族や友だちと、1台で対戦したい人

広告なし。インターネットに接続しなくても遊べます。

name: 奈何驿站
seller_name: Nanjing Mirui Future Technology Co., Ltd
description:
奈何桥边有家小驿站。

摊主是位笑眯眯的老奶奶，守着一口大锅，架子上摆着四坛汤。来都来了，喝一碗再走。

【怎么喝】
点一坛，盛满一杯。把手机当杯子，像真的喝水一样往嘴边一倾，汤就咕咚咕咚流出去。倾得越多，喝得越快。有声音，有震动，喝完还送你一句话。

【今日供应】
· 忘情水：冰的，加了冰块。专治想 TA 想到睡不着。
· 毒鸡汤：金黄浓郁，泡着不太新鲜的鸡骨架。越喝越清醒，越清醒越想躺。
· 后悔药：杯底沉着一颗烫了“悔”字的大药丸。本药无效，全靠心态。
· 孟婆汤：招牌，漂着整朵的彼岸花。一碗下去，连自己网名都忘了。

【喝完送一句】
每种汤都有十几句不同的话，随机送。比如：
“拜拜就拜拜，下一个更乖。”
“现在后悔有啥用，早干嘛去啦！”
“只要肯吃苦，总有吃不完的苦。”
“喝下这锅汤，忘了那个TA。”

【小店规矩】
· 一分钱不收：免费，没有内购，没有广告。
· 不问你是谁：不用注册，不联网，不收集任何信息。
· 汤是假的，别当真：屏幕里的汤喝不进嘴，喝完那句话也只是玩笑。

这只是个小玩具，给苦闷的生活添个乐子，博君一笑。

name: 好多星
description:
一屏红的报警、看不懂的堆栈、改了三行崩了五处——每个工程师都经历过"不知道从哪查起"的时刻。

好多星把真实线上故障做成一桩桩案件，训练的不是知识点，而是高手的核心习惯：看症状 → 建立假设空间 → 按验证成本排序 → 最小代价定位根因。

【破案闯关】
每关一个故障现场：
• 提出假设——不是瞎猜，搭建属于你的假设板
• 收集证据——花预算针对假设做验证，按成本排序，最小代价破案
• 指认根因——证据说话，实锤再出手
• 复盘对照专家推理链，带走一张排错检查单；验证错了随时"返回重新假设"，试错免费

【内心小动物】
排错时的恐慌、惊讶、沮丧、迟疑，值得被看见。五只 3D 内心小兽陪你闯关：恐怖蛙、不行蜗、惊讶濑、垂耳兔、三角龙——它们是五种排错认知状态的外化，会悬浮弹窗吐槽，也能收进图鉴慢慢点亮。

【按层专题的题库】
接入、构建、数据、运行时、并发、可观测——六大层的故障现场按"篇-章-关"拼成全栈地图。轻量序贯解锁，也有跳级挑战；每关还能带走一条层契约知识（TLS 握手、索引原理、协议行为……）。

【适合谁】
• 被线上故障折磨过的后端 / 全栈 / 客户端工程师
• 面试前想练"排查题"思路的求职者
• 刚入行、想看懂老手怎么想问题的新人
• 以及所有喜欢侦探解谜的程序员

解决问题只是过程，思维晋升才是结果。
多想，多星。/ How to think.

name: 微词 - 美好生活好帮手

本机保留搜索轨迹，不喧宾夺主，只让你更快回到想找的那一个。

不以商店免费榜 / 付费榜切割，

——

· 只收「会回来的」，不做无穷推荐墙
· 跨形态统一：App · 小程序 · 券，同一套收藏语言
· 打开即用：无注册、无登录、无订阅门槛

收藏、关注与搜索历史仅存本机；联网仅用于公开目录与推荐查询，不上传你的心爱名单。
完整政策：https://www.weici.app/privacy.html

App · 小程序 · 消费券——只关心自己喜爱的那一些。

name: 落ちたら最初から
description:

昭和レトロな下町を、てっぺん目指して登るジャンプゲームです。

name: 賃貸管理・管理業務主任者・マンション管理士 問題集
seller_name: Henan Zhentianlei Culture Media Co., Ltd
description:
賃貸不動産経営管理士試験、管理業務主任者試験、マンション管理士試験のための問題集アプリです。問題はすべて、e-Gov 法令検索で公開されている法令と国土交通省の公表資料をもとに当アプリが作成したオリジナル問題で、解説には根拠となる条文・資料の原文をそのまま載せています。内容は2027年4月1日時点の法令に基づいています。

ホーム画面は建物の案内板の形です。科目が1Fから順にフロアとして並び、フロアごとの正解数がひと目でわかります。左上の名札で、賃管・管業・マン管を切り替えられます。学習記録は試験ごとに別々に残ります。

▷ フロア案内（科目別の問題）
・賃貸不動産経営管理士 431問：賃貸住宅管理業法、管理受託契約、賃貸借（民法・借地借家法）、原状回復・金銭管理、建物・設備の維持保全、管理実務・関連法令
・管理業務主任者 514問：民法・借地借家法、管理委託契約、管理組合の会計・税務、建物・設備、長期修繕計画、区分所有法、マンション標準管理規約、その他の法令、マンション管理適正化法
・マンション管理士 565問：区分所有法、被災マンション法・マンション再生法、民法・借地借家法・不動産登記法、マンション標準管理規約、管理組合の会計・管理委託契約、建築・設備関係法令、建物・設備・長期修繕、マンション管理適正化法
・四肢択一のほか、組合せ問題、空欄補充問題も収録
・答えを選ぶとすぐ採点。選択肢ごとの理由、全体の解説、根拠の条文を表示します

▷ 本日の巡回
復習日が来た問題、間違えた問題、まだ解いていない問題を混ぜて、毎日10問を出します。正解が続いた問題ほど、次に出る日が先になります。

▷ 模擬試験
・賃管：50問・120分を5回分
・管業：50問・120分を5回分と、マンション管理士試験の合格者向けの45問・110分（5問免除）を5回分
・マン管：50問・120分を5回分と、管理業務主任者試験の合格者向けの45問・110分（5問免除）を5回分
・途中で前後の問題に移動でき、「あとで見る」の印も付けられます
・終了後は得点と科目ごとの正答率を表示し、1問ずつ解説を見直せます

▷ 決議要件ドリル
規約の変更、共用部分の変更、建替えなど32の議題について、必要な決議の要件を4つから選びます。2026年4月の区分所有法改正で変わった要件には印を付け、改正後の条文を表示します。

▷ 要再点検
間違えた問題、付箋を付けた問題、復習日が来た問題を3つに分けてまとめます。

▷ 一問一答
選択肢を1文ずつ取り出し、○か×かで答えます（賃管368文・管業440文・マン管520文）。

▷ 問題データの更新
法令の改正や問題の修正は、アプリのアップデートを待たずに問題データとして配信します。

▷ 無料で使える範囲
各試験の一部の科目、模擬試験の第1回、決議要件ドリルは無料です。試験ごとのアプリ内課金（買い切り）で、その試験のすべての問題・模擬試験・一問一答が使えるようになります。3つの試験は別々に購入できます。月額課金ではありません。

▷ ご注意
本アプリは非公式の学習アプリで、一般社団法人 賃貸不動産経営管理士協議会、一般社団法人 マンション管理業協会、公益財団法人 マンション管理センター、国土交通省とは関係ありません。収録問題は当アプリが独自に作成したもので、本試験の問題ではありません。試験の日程や申込方法は、必ず実施団体の案内でご確認ください。
